story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ciao

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I just wanted to check in before I get busy again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Volevo solo controllare prima di tornare a essere occupato.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: How are you feeling today, really?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Come ti senti oggi, davvero?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Still stiff, and it’s annoying not being able to get up whenever I want
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ancora rigido, ed è fastidioso non poter alzarmi quando voglio.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: But you’re healing, and that’s what matters, even if it feels slow
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ma stai guarendo, e questo è ciò che conta, anche se sembra lento.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You also need to stop blaming yourself for everything
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Devi anche smettere di incolparti per tutto.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You didn’t choose to get hurt, and you’re not a burden for needing help
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Non hai scelto di farti male, e non sei un peso per aver bisogno di aiuto.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m trying
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sto provando

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s just hard to feel useful when I’m stuck in bed all day
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: È solo difficile sentirsi utile quando sono bloccato a letto tutto il giorno.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Hey
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ciao

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Lo so

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: By the way, how does your new phone feel so far?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: A proposito, come ti sembra il tuo nuovo telefono finora?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Does everything look like it transferred correctly from the old one?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Tutto sembra essere stato trasferito correttamente dal vecchio?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Yeah, surprisingly
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sì, sorprendentemente

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s fast, and everything seems to be in the right place
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: È veloce, e tutto sembra essere al posto giusto.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I barely had to redo my settings
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ho dovuto rifare a malapena le mie impostazioni.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Buono

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: The guy who sold it to me kept insisting it was a solid model
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Il tipo che me l'ha venduto continuava a insistere che fosse un modello solido.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks again for getting it for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Grazie ancora per averlo preso per me

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I know you didn’t have to, but it really helps right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: So che non dovevi farlo, ma aiuta davvero in questo momento.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Did I wake you up, or were you already drifting in and out?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ti ho svegliato, o stavi già sonnecchiando?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Of course it helps
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Certo che aiuta

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You deserve nice things too, even if you don’t always believe that
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Meriti anche tu cose belle, anche se non lo credi sempre.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: …Okay
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: …Va bene

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Actually, there’s one thing I still need for the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: In realtà, c'è una cosa di cui ho ancora bisogno per il nuovo telefono

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s asking for a clean contact photo, and the one I had is ancient
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Chiede una foto di contatto pulita, e quella che avevo è antica.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Oh
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Oh

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: You want a new photo of me for your contacts?
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Vuoi una nuova foto di me per i tuoi contatti?

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Alright, give me a second
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Va bene, dammi un secondo

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: 2 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I was already awake, don’t worry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ero già sveglio, non ti preoccupare.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: A little, but it’s fine, I’m glad you texted
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Un po', ma va bene, sono contento che tu abbia scritto.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: There
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Lì

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: If that one looks terrible, you’re not allowed to complain
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Se quello sembra terribile, non puoi lamentarti.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: It’s perfect
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: È perfetto

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Try to rest
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Cerca di riposare

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’ll bring you something to eat later and check on you again
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Ti porterò qualcosa da mangiare più tardi e ti controllerò di nuovo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Grazie, {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: Good
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Buono

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I keep forgetting you can’t really do much besides stare at that screen right now
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Continuo a dimenticare che non puoi davvero fare molto oltre a fissare quel schermo in questo momento.

story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.source: I’m sorry
story/DAY1/DAY1_00_LANDLADY_INTRO.json::.translation: Mi dispiace

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Solo per controllare che non sei svanito

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: I can hear you moving around
{{name:evelyn}} told me you needed a profile pic from me, right?
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:evelyn}} mi ha detto che avevi bisogno di una mia foto profilo, giusto?
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: Try not to ghost the world today
story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Cerca di non ignorare il mondo oggi

story/DAY1/DAY1_01_MASON_INTRO.json::ste.source: You always have something to say

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: La ragazza più carina che conosci 💁‍♀️

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I actually needed a new contact photo for you
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: In realtà avevo bisogno di una nuova foto di contatto per te

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: So this is what I’m reduced to now 😭
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Quindi questo è ciò a cui sono ridotto ora 😭

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Are you awake, or are you doing that thing where you pretend you’re asleep? 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Sei sveglio, o stai facendo quella cosa in cui fai finta di essere addormentato? 😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I was just checking on you
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Stavo solo controllando su di te

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: You’ve got the same energy as a sad houseplant 🌱
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Hai la stessa energia di una pianta d'appartamento triste 🌱

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Maybe I was pretending. Depends who’s asking
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Forse stavo solo fingendo. Dipende da chi chiede
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: Text me if you need anything
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Scrivimi se hai bisogno di qualcosa

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I’m about to post a story and a new post
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Sto per pubblicare una storia e un nuovo post.
È meglio che ti piacciano entrambi.

story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.source: I'm the cutest girl you know 💅
story/DAY1/DAY1_02_HAILEY_INTRO.json::st.translation: Sono la ragazza più carina che conosci 💅

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: But you should at least respond to her texts
story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.translation: Ma dovresti almeno rispondere ai suoi messaggi.

story/DAY1/DAY1_03_EVELYN_FOLLOWUP.json:.source: You don’t have to prove it to me
Did you drink any water yet

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Well i’m okay though, at least not dead
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Beh, sto bene, almeno non sono morto.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I understand but it’s not your fault
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Capisco, ma non è colpa tua.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Rest and heal, you being alive is more important than the rest for me
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Riposa e guarisci, per me è più importante che tu sia vivo piuttosto che il resto.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: And I’m here if you need me ❤️
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: E io sono qui se hai bisogno di me ❤️

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Also part of why I’ve been slow to reply is the new phone
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Parte del motivo per cui sono stato lento a rispondere è il nuovo telefono.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: By the way can you send me a profile picture?
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: A proposito, puoi inviarmi un'immagine del profilo?

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: {{name:evelyn}} told me your old one didn’t survive the accident
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: {{name:evelyn}} mi ha detto che la tua vecchia foto non ha sopravvissuto all'incidente

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I’m just glad you even have a phone now
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Sono solo felice che tu abbia finalmente un telefono.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: Way smoother than the old one
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Molto più fluido rispetto al vecchio.

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: It glitches a bit sometimes though
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: A volte ha qualche glitch però.
Qual è il tuo piano per oggi?

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I just wanted to make sure you’re okay 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: Volevo solo assicurarmi che tu stia bene 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: I didn’t mean to worry you
It’s just hard not to think sometimes
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: È solo difficile non pensare a volte

story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.source: It’s just been a lot lately, getting stuck in bed for I don’t even know how long, missing all the good things with everyone, especially you
story/DAY1/DAY1_04_LENA_INTRO.json::step.translation: È stato davvero tanto ultimamente, rimanere bloccato a letto per non so nemmeno quanto, perdere tutte le cose belle con tutti, specialmente con te.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: If someone touched you, I want names
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Se qualcuno ti ha toccato, voglio i nomi.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Probably some jealous idiots because you’re with {{name:lena}}
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Probabilmente qualche idiota geloso perché sei con {{name:lena}}

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: She’s basically the prettiest girl on campus
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: È fondamentalmente la ragazza più bella del campus.
Pensate che i ragazzi non se ne accorgano? 😒

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: But if you remember anything later, you tell me
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Ma se ti ricordi qualcosa più tardi, dimmelo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: {{name:mason}} gave me your new number. How are you actually doing?
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: {{name:mason}} mi ha dato il tuo nuovo numero. Come stai davvero?
Lo schermo salta un po' a volte.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Had a weird glitch earlier but nothing serious
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Ho avuto un strano glitch prima, ma niente di serio.

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: You’ve had it for two days 😂
Send me a pic so I can set your profile properly
story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Mandami una foto così posso impostare correttamente il tuo profilo.
Aggiornando già il mio stato di contatto

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: I’ll tell you if I play

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.translation: Indovina chi è il più carino oggi 💕

story/DAY1/DAY1_05_AIDEN_INTRO.json::ste.source: Don’t brush it off. Tell me

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: But I’ll see what I can do about snacks
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Ma vedrò cosa posso fare per gli snack.

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: You better open your window before she walks in
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: È meglio che apri la finestra prima che lei entri.

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Your room probably smells like hospital and gamer sweat mixed together 🤢
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: La tua stanza probabilmente puzza di ospedale e sudore da gamer mescolati insieme 🤢

story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.source: Air it out before the biohazard team shows up
story/DAY1/DAY1_06_HAILEY_CHECKIN.json::.translation: Fallo ventilare prima che arrivi la squadra di biohazard.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Don’t leave me on read like that again 😅
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Non lasciarmi in attesa così di nuovo 😅

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: How are you actually feeling right now?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Come ti senti davvero in questo momento?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: My head feels kind of loud
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: La mia testa si sente un po' rumorosa.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Like your thoughts won’t slow down?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Come se i tuoi pensieri non rallentassero?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I was thinking about you earlier at work
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Stavo pensando a te prima al lavoro

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: It was a calm shift for once
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: È stata un turno tranquillo per una volta.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Just one dramatic customer but I survived 😌
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Solo un cliente drammatico ma sono sopravvissuto 😌

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I have that presentation tomorrow and I keep replaying it in my head
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Ho quella presentazione domani e continuo a ripeterla nella mia testa.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I swear I’m not trying to be heavy
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Giuro che non sto cercando di essere pesante

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I just want things to move forward you know
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Voglio solo che le cose vadano avanti, sai?
Non ti preoccupare, andrà tutto bene.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: What else do you have planned for tomorrow?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Cos'altro hai in programma per domani?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Work in the morning, then the presentation and probably more studying
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Lavoro la mattina, poi la presentazione e probabilmente altro studio

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: But right now I care more about you than my schedule 🤍
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Ma in questo momento mi importa di più di te che del mio programma 🤍

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You don’t have to I’m okay
You don’t have to act strong with me
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Non devi fare la forte con me.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: You already are in my eyes ❤️
And it’s not your fault if you’re stuck in bed
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: E non è colpa tua se sei bloccato a letto

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Five weeks before our trip, of course
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: A cinque settimane dal nostro viaggio, ovviamente

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: The timing is bad but we can’t control that
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Il momento è sbagliato ma non possiamo controllarlo.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Why do you think I’m the best girlfriend in the world?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Perché pensi che io sia la migliore ragazza del mondo?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I ate and crashed for a bit
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Ho mangiato e poi mi sono schiantato per un po'.

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Sooo are you going to sleep soon?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Quindi, stai per andare a dormire presto?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: My brain doesn’t want to stop
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Il mio cervello non vuole fermarsi

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Well I might have something for your brain 😏
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Beh, potrei avere qualcosa per il tuo cervello 😏

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: So it can think about something else
Maybe I could send you a pic of me
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Forse potrei inviarti una foto di me
Uno che non hai ancora visto 👀

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: I would love that but what kind of pic?
story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.translation: Mi piacerebbe, ma che tipo di foto?

story/DAY1/DAY1_07_LENA_DOUBLE_TEXT.json.source: Then I played a little to kill time

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Puoi controllare una risposta prima di dormire?

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: {{name:hailey}} sends you a picture of her homework answer
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: {{name:hailey}} ti manda una foto della sua risposta ai compiti.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Then time to rest this huge brain
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Allora è ora di riposare questo cervellone

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That sounds like your kind of review
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sembra una recensione proprio da te.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I did two homework questions on the bus
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: ho fatto due domande di compiti sull'autobus.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about next Saturday? And I make you dinner after the date
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Che ne dici di sabato prossimo? E ti preparo la cena dopo l'appuntamento.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be really happy if we do that
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sarei davvero felice se lo facessimo.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now tell me about your day
I moved around a bit like I said I would
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi sono mosso un po' come avevo detto che avrei fatto.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And then I played for a while with {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E poi ho giocato per un po' con {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Rehab and social life in the same day
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Riabilitazione e vita sociale nello stesso giorno

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really glad you moved around today
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sono davvero felice che ti sei mosso oggi

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I'm glad you had a decent Sunday
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E sono contento che tu abbia passato una buona domenica

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you should go to bed soon
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E dovresti andare a letto presto.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I don't want you exhausted tomorrow
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non voglio che tu sia esausto domani.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm going to wash up and get in bed
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vado a lavarmi e a mettermi a letto.

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I definitely got a little sunburned 😭
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Penso di essermi sicuramente scottato un po' al sole 😭

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So you got cute and slightly toasted?
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quindi sei diventato carino e leggermente abbronzato?
Ma ne è valsa la pena

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I really want to go back there with you
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ora voglio davvero tornare lì con te

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That game was actually really fun
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Quel gioco è stato davvero divertente

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: It's a shame you're so bad at it 😂
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Peccato che tu sia così scarsa 😂
Domani mi prendo la mia vendetta
A me già fa male tutto

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I think we'll be sore tomorrow

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Spero tu sia pronta a perdere

story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll let the scoreboard do the talking
story/DAY10/love/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Lascerò che il punteggio parli da solo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Good morning 😊 Did you sleep well?
That would be a huge help

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: È per questo che sono qui

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: How is your leg feeling today?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Come ti senti alla gamba oggi?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Still annoying, but I think it's getting better
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: È ancora fastidiosa, ma penso stia migliorando

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm going to open the windows and air out my room
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Vado ad aprire le finestre e a far arieggiare la mia stanza

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Would you mind helping me clean it a little?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ti dispiacerebbe aiutarmi a pulirla un po'?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I need my emergency audience alive
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ho bisogno del mio pubblico d'emergenza vivo
Il mio cervello è una zuppa post-festa
Ma hai i compiti del professore

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He sent a tiny correction list this morning
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ha mandato una piccola lista di correzioni stamattina

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Tiny in professor language means annoying
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Piccola in linguaggio da professore significa fastidiosa

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why are you both using calm voices at me
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Perché entrambi mi parlate con toni calmi?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because panic does not solve homework
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Perché il panico non risolve i compiti
E come va la tua gamba?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Move around a little for my leg
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muoviti un po' per la mia gamba

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then today we both have one job
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Allora oggi abbiamo entrambi un compito

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I officially refuse to rush today
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Rifiuto ufficialmente di avere fretta oggi
Io con tutta la mia esistenza

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll probably clean a little, make something simple, and be useless on the couch
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Probabilmente pulirò un po', preparerò qualcosa di semplice e sarò inutile sul divano.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me later when you've done your little rehab walk
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mandami un messaggio più tardi quando hai finito la tua piccola passeggiata di riabilitazione.
Controlli di nuovo su di me?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Someone has to make sure you don't lie about resting
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Qualcuno deve assicurarsi che tu non menti riguardo al riposo.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very committed to this role
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei molto impegnato in questo ruolo
Prendo il mio lavoro sul serio ❤️

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No shift, no running around, no pretending I have energy 😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Niente cambiamenti, niente correre in giro, niente fingere di avere energia 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making coffee and moving like an old lady
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sto facendo il caffè e mi muovo come una vecchia.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You're lying in bed judging someone who's actually trying
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Sei sdraiato a letto a giudicare qualcuno che sta davvero provando

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And somehow I'm still doing a better job
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: E in qualche modo sto facendo ancora un lavoro migliore

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: And my side of the kitchen is still clean
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: E il mio lato della cucina è ancora pulito
Vieni ad aiutare o stai zitto

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Get over here before I burn something
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Vieni qui prima che bruci qualcosa

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: If the kitchen catches fire, you'll have to move with that leg
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Se la cucina prende fuoco, dovrai muoverti con quella gamba

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Don't touch anything until I get there
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Non toccare nulla finché non arrivo
Hai bisogno di aiuto per mangiare adesso?
Sto cercando di mangiare in modo corretto

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: How did you make that much mess?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Come hai fatto a creare così tanto disordine?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I closed your window for you 😊
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho chiuso la tua finestra per te 😊

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You don't have to do that
I'm already downstairs in the kitchen
I need to move around a little
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho bisogno di muovermi un po'

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Otherwise I'm going to lose my mind staying in that room all day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Altrimenti perdo la testa a stare in quella stanza tutto il giorno

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And it will save you from moving around too much to grab ingredients
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: E ti risparmierà di muoverti troppo per prendere gli ingredienti

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You can tell me what you need and I'll get it
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Puoi dirmi cosa ti serve e io lo prendo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I was going to do it after my shower
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Stavo per farlo dopo la mia doccia

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I thought I'd better close it now
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Quindi ho pensato che fosse meglio chiuderla adesso

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: You did the right thing then

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am actually kind of proud of myself 😇
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: In realtà sono un po' fiera di me stessa 😇
Smettila di farti complimenti, piccola rospo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Okay okay not so nice teacher
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ok ok, non è stato così carino, insegnante.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Then time to go enjoy my last good time before prison😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Allora è tempo di godermi l'ultimo momento bello prima del carcere😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe tiny chaos if popcorn betrays me
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Forse un piccolo caos se i popcorn mi tradiscono.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I am still quizzing you later
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma ti interrogo ancora più tardi.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Proof I left the house looking human
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Prova che sono uscita di casa sembrando umana.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You look like a decent human
You get two extra homework questions for that 😌
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ti bevi due domande extra per questo 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A friend from class wants to see a movie
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Un'amica di classe vuole vedere un film

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: And she is coming to pick me up in 20 minutes
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: E viene a prendermi tra 20 minuti

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I am going to the cinema with her and maybe another friend
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vado al cinema con lei e forse un'altra amica

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Tomorrow, back in the studying game
I will not let the responsible era die

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un po' più lungo di ieri

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See, I can trust you sometimes
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vedi, a volte posso fidarmi di te
Non ho fatto assolutamente nulla di produttivo.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I look like I haven't moved for hours
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembro che non mi sia mosso da ore

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like this version of you
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piace questa versione di te

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because this is exactly how I plan to stay for a few more hours
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perché è esattamente così che intendo restare per alcune ore in più

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you after my movie ?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti scriverò dopo il mio film ?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I sat down and never really got back up
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Poi mi sono seduto e non mi sono mai realmente rialzato.
Sono molto orgoglioso di me stesso 😌

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: But I'm choosing the first game

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Perché il tuo gusto è discutibile

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Says the person who almost burned breakfast
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Dice la persona che ha quasi bruciato la colazione

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: That has nothing to do with games
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Non ha nulla a che fare con i giochi

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: It says a lot about your decision-making
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Dice molto sulle tue capacità decisionali

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember this when you need help
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Me lo ricorderò quando avrai bisogno di aiuto
E già mi pento di aver chiesto

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: And you're lucky I invited you
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: E sei fortunato che ti ho invitato

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be there in ten minutes
Don't start getting used to that
We could do a full gaming day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Potremmo fare una giornata di giochi

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You really have nothing better to do
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Davvero non hai niente di meglio da fare

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm choosing to waste my day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Scelgo di sprecare la mia giornata

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Anyway, I'm going to finish making dinner
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Comunque, devo finire di preparare la cena

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then I'll probably watch a few episodes of my series
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Poi probabilmente guarderò qualche episodio della mia serie

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Do you want to join me?
I still have a few things to do
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ho ancora un paio di cose da fare

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Just don't stay up too late
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Solo non fare le ore piccole

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Did you manage to rest this weekend?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Sei riuscito a riposarti questo weekend?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Spending time at home with you and {{name:mason}} was relaxing
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Trascorrere del tempo a casa con te e {{name:mason}} è stato rilassante

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm actually really happy with how my weekend went
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: In realtà sono davvero felice di come è andato il mio weekend

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Even if I don't feel like going back to work tomorrow
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Anche se non ho voglia di tornare al lavoro domani

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I can't blame you for that

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: I weekend sono sempre troppo brevi

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Also my professor checked the first one already
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Inoltre il mio professore ha già controllato il primo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I could send it if I got stuck
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ha detto che potevo mandarlo se mi fossi bloccata

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Because he explained it in a voice note and now it makes sense
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Perché me l'ha spiegato in un messaggio vocale e ora ha senso

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Voice-note response logged outside classroom schedule
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Risposta a messaggio vocale registrata al di fuori dell'orario delle lezioni

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Pattern remains explainable as test preparation
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il modello rimane spiegabile come preparazione per il test

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A voice note isn't proof of anything, but I'm noticing how often he's part of her day.
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Un messaggio vocale non dimostra nulla, ma sto notando quanto spesso lui faccia parte della sua giornata.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I am sleeping before my brain tries to learn one more thing
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sto per dormire prima che il mio cervello provi a imparare un'altra cosa

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I did two homework questions on the bus😭
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ho fatto due domande di compiti sull'autobus😭

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho provato a guardare un film

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sounds like a successful rest day
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembra una giornata di riposo riuscita
Avevo bisogno di qualcosa di tranquillo

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I told myself I would sleep early tonight
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi sono detto che avrei dormito presto stasera.

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I guess I have no discipline 😌
How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Com'è andato il resto della tua giornata?

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: The doctor is coming tomorrow morning

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Non ho bisogno di due genitori

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Someone has to keep you alive
You're enjoying this way too much
story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ti stai divertendo troppo con questa situazione

story/DAY10/ntr/DAY10_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Why didn't you go to the gym today?

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Tutoring is basically his side job
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il tutoraggio è praticamente il suo lavoro secondario

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's actually less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: In realtà è meno spaventoso di quanto pensassi

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I was imagining some ancient professor with glasses

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You mean like every movie ever?

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He's still coming to make you study
What is this Ethan guy actually like?
He'll see where you're at and what needs work

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If he's taking time to help me, I'll make the effort too 😊
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se lui si prende il tempo per aiutarmi, io farò il mio meglio 😊

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now let me survive the morning first

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Move around a little for my leg
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Muoviti un po' per la mia gamba

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then today we both have one job
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Allora oggi entrambi abbiamo un compito

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I officially refuse to rush today
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Rifiuto ufficialmente di avere fretta oggi
Io con tutta la mia esistenza

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll probably clean a little, make something simple, and be useless on the couch
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Probabilmente pulirò un po', preparerò qualcosa di semplice e sarò inutile sul divano.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me later when you've done your little rehab walk
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mandami un messaggio più tardi quando hai finito la tua piccola passeggiata di riabilitazione.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Someone has to make sure you don't lie about resting
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Qualcuno deve assicurarsi che tu non menti riguardo al riposo.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very committed to this role
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei molto impegnato in questo ruolo
Prendo il mio lavoro sul serio ❤️

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No shift, no running around, no pretending I have energy 😌
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Niente spostamenti, niente correre in giro, niente fingere di avere energia 😌

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making coffee and moving like an old lady
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sto facendo il caffè e mi muovo come una vecchia.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Scelgo di non sprecare la mia energia con te

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Chiedi a {{name:aiden}} a che ora devo essere pronta 🙂

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Pensi che io sia la tua segretaria?

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Non hai niente altro da fare comunque

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Hey
I also made sure to mention that you have a manager on the account
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho anche fatto in modo di menzionare che hai un manager per l'account

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I will be the one handling reservations, messages, and the annoying parts
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Quindi sarò io a gestire le prenotazioni, i messaggi e le parti noiose

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ero preoccupato di dover gestire tutto da solo

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: No, that is exactly why I am helping
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: No, è proprio per questo che ti aiuto

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma ho bisogno di qualcosa da te

Some photos of you for the profile
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Alcune foto di te per il profilo

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Il profilo deve sembrare abbastanza attraente perché la gente clicchi

Photos...

You do not have to rush
Just look for a few outfits and try what feels right

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Okay
I will check my clothes and try to send you a few pictures later
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Controllo i miei vestiti e cerco di inviarti qualche foto più tardi.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Take your time
And trust yourself a little

No, not really
You always know what to say...
Thank you
I will try my best

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I made your professional account and filled in most of the details
story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho creato il tuo account professionale e riempito la maggior parte dei dettagli.

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Already?

It went fine

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I told him the list was too long

story/DAY10/nts/DAY10_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Listen to him and try to follow the plan

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ho avuto una grande sessione dalle 10 alle 11:30

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is my after-class brain fried face
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Questa è la mia faccia da cervello fritto dopo le lezioni

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Well, I need to go recover from this trauma now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Beh, ora devo riprendermi da questo trauma

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Maybe a walk outside will help
I will go for a walk before the next test
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Farò una passeggiata prima del prossimo test

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will be back after the test!
I will try to enjoy it 😌
I am not sure if I can enjoy anything right now, but I will try 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Non sono sicura di poter godere di nulla in questo momento, ma ci proverò 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: But fine, i'm not a pussy
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma va bene, non sono un vigliacco

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: But if I fall, you're cleaning it
I hope you burn your mouth

Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Only if you bring it to me
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo se me lo porti tu

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You remember I have a cast on my leg, right?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ricordi che ho un gesso alla gamba, giusto?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: And I remember you still have two hands
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: E io ricordo che hai ancora due mani

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Did you actually take some time for yourself today?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Hai davvero preso un po' di tempo per te oggi?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I was resting on the couch while waiting for you to finish work
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Stavo riposando sul divano mentre aspettavo che finissi di lavorare

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm glad you finally slowed down for a bit
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Sono contenta che tu abbia finalmente rallentato un po'

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Actually, do you want to come downstairs and watch something with me?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: In realtà, vuoi venire giù e guardare qualcosa con me?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I just need to take a shower first
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Devo solo fare una doccia prima

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Do you need help getting into the shower?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Hai bisogno di aiuto per entrare nella doccia?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But if I need help, I'll call you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ma se ho bisogno di aiuto, ti chiamerò
Ho finito di lavorare per oggi

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It's a little difficult staying focused for hours and paying attention to everything
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: È un po' difficile rimanere concentrati per ore e prestare attenzione a tutto

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But it's still better than working in a supermarket or doing something physical right now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ma è comunque meglio che lavorare in un supermercato o fare qualcosa di fisico in questo momento

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Your leg probably agrees with that too 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: La tua gamba probabilmente è d'accordo 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But being this smart is exhausting
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ma essere così intelligente è stancante

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I can still come over and traumatize you more than the test
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Posso sempre venire da te e traumatizzarti più del test

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: At your pace I think I will survive until tomorrow 😇
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Con il tuo ritmo penso che sopravvivrò fino a domani 😇

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Maybe even the day after if I am lucky
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Forse anche il giorno dopo se sono fortunata
Minacciare una studentessa fragile e stanca 😔

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: This is my exhausted victim face 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Questa è la mia faccia da vittima esausta 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And yet you keep texting me
Which is very annoying for me
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Il che è molto fastidioso per me

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Time to turn off my brain
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: È ora di spegnere il cervello

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You should get some rest then
I will try to sleep early tonight 😌
I am tired, not a grandma 😭
That walk was not long enough to recover from the trauma of the test 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Quella passeggiata non è stata abbastanza lunga per riprendermi dal trauma del test 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: My brain feels like soup right now 😵‍💫
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Il mio cervello si sente come una zuppa adesso 😵‍💫

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I moved around the house a bit again
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi sono spostato un po' in casa di nuovo.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And then I played for a while
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E poi ho giocato per un po'

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the doctor came to see me later
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E il dottore è venuto a vedermi dopo.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If everything looks good, I should be able to get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Se tutto sembra a posto, dovrei riuscire a togliere il gesso presto.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay wait I'm actually so happy right now 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ok aspetta, sono davvero così felice in questo momento 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes me really happy for you
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Questo mi rende davvero felice per te.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have to tell me exactly how it goes
Okay, I have to go soon or I'm going to be late for work 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene, devo andare presto o farò tardi al lavoro 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E buona fortuna per il resto della giornata

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I guess that's a win 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quindi suppongo che sia una vittoria 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That might count as a workout
Don't make me regret thanking you earlier
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Non farmi pentire di averti ringraziato prima
Le mie braccia fanno ancora male

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: And my hands are not much better
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: E le mie mani non stanno molto meglio

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I think the controller would finish us tonight
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Credo che il controller ci finirebbe stasera

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm going to finish my anime and sleep
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Finisco il mio anime e poi dormo

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: If I can lift the blanket without dying
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Se riesco a sollevare la coperta senza morire

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: That makes me want to hug you right now
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Questo mi fa venire voglia di abbracciarti proprio adesso.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Because you're getting one when I see you 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Perché ne avrai uno quando ti vedo 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: So what are we doing first when the cast is gone?
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Allora, cosa facciamo prima quando il cast è andato?

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I just got back from work
Without me worrying every two seconds
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Senza che io debba preoccuparmi ogni due secondi

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: And maybe our park date too ❤️
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: E forse anche il nostro appuntamento al parco ❤️

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Maybe even something wilder after that
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Forse anche qualcosa di più selvaggio dopo.
Una sessione di abbracci davvero lunghissima

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I'm not even that tired somehow 😌
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Non sono nemmeno così stanco in qualche modo 😌

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I'm eating right now but I'm still smiling like an idiot
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Sto mangiando in questo momento ma sto ancora sorridendo come un idiota

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: You look very cute for someone who's eating
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Sei molto carino per qualcuno che sta mangiando.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Send me one more later when you're changed and ready for bed
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Mandami un'altra quando sei cambiato e pronto per andare a letto.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Changed, clean, and ready to sleep 🤍
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Cambiato, pulito e pronto per dormire 🤍

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Stop complimenting me or I'm never going to sleep 😭
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Smettila di farmi complimenti o non dormirò mai 😭

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: Now I'm really going to sleep before I fall asleep holding my phone
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Ora vado davvero a dormire prima di addormentarmi tenendo il telefono.

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: And dream about our future park date
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: E sogna il nostro futuro appuntamento al parco

story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.source: I should be able to get the cast off soon
story/DAY11/love/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_LOV.translation: Dovrei riuscire a togliere il gesso presto.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It makes me happy that you want to get some fresh air
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Mi rende felice che tu voglia prendere un po' d'aria fresca

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: But are you sure your not going to hurt yourself?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ma sei sicuro di non farti male?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I think I can handle it
I just need to get out of the house for a little while
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ho solo bisogno di uscire di casa per un po'

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: If it's too much, we can always take a break

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Dovrei essere pronta tra circa quindici minuti

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I was thinking of trying to go outside this morning
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Stavo pensando di provare ad uscire questa mattina

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Would you like to come with me?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ti va di venire con me?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: What a bad start 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He says it like I am not allowed to fail
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lo dice come se non potessi fallire

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which is rude but also helpful
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Che è scortese ma anche utile

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are quite smart
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sei piuttosto intelligente

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Well thanks I guess ?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Beh, grazie, credo?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Also he just walked past and gave me the professor nod

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Let her focus before class

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Forse
