story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I just need to pass 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Devo solo passare 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Go focus. You can survive this.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Vai a concentrarti. Puoi farcela.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is the correct supportive answer
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Questa è la risposta di supporto giusta

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Gold star maybe
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Forse una stella d'oro

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I die, delete my search history
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se muoio, cancella la mia cronologia di ricerca

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Pretending to be a girl who understands chapters
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Fingendo di essere una ragazza che capisce i capitoli

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And tell my friends I was academically brave 😭
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E dire ai miei amici che sono stata accademicamente coraggiosa 😭

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You revised yesterday
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hai ripassato ieri

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because he bullied me with structure
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Perché mi ha preso in giro con la struttura

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Respectfully
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Con rispetto

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He told me to breathe and read the question twice
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mi ha detto di respirare e leggere la domanda due volte

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is good advice
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: È un buon consiglio

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I know
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lo so

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel a bit more useful there
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi sento un po' più utile lì.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I have actual things to take care of
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ora ho cose concrete di cui occuparmi

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll probably stay longer than usual
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Probabilmente rimarrò più a lungo del solito.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Be careful not to overdo it
I actually have a lot to do today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: In realtà ho molto da fare oggi

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since they gave me more responsibilities i need to be there more often
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dal momento che mi hanno dato più responsabilità, devo essere lì più spesso.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You might be the next one whith a cast
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Potresti essere il prossimo con un gesso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Don't trip on your first day back
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Non inciampare nel tuo primo giorno di ritorno

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll try not to embarrass you
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Cercherò di non metterti in imbarazzo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You manage that without even trying
Did the doctor finally put you out of your misery?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Il dottore ti ha finalmente liberato dalla tua sofferenza?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I should be able to walk again soon
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Dovrei essere in grado di camminare di nuovo presto

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I was getting tired of waiting for you every time we went somewhere
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Mi stavo stancando di aspettarti ogni volta che andavamo da qualche parte

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You make it sound like I'm slowing you down on purpose
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Fai sembrare che ti rallenti di proposito
In un certo senso lo fai

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: What time do you start at the bar today?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: A che ora inizi al bar oggi?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But I'll make a little more money because of it !
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma guadagnerò un po' di più per questo!

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Just make sure you don't get too tired
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo assicurati di non stancarti troppo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But thank you for worrying about me ❤️
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma grazie per esserti preoccupata per me ❤️

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That walk did me a lot of good
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Quella passeggiata mi ha fatto molto bene

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: We didn't exactly go very far
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Non siamo andati esattamente molto lontano

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: And we came back pretty quickly too 😄
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: E siamo tornati abbastanza in fretta anche 😄

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But it was perfect for me
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma per me è stato perfetto

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It didn't bother me at all
We'll try to do it more often then
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Cercheremo di farlo più spesso allora

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: My professor wants me to come by his office before the next class
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Il mio professore vuole che passi dal suo ufficio prima della prossima lezione

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just five minutes to check what I missed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Solo cinque minuti per controllare cosa ho perso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That is a lot of extra attention
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: È un sacco di attenzione extra

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He is taking it really seriously
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Lo sta prendendo molto sul serio
Candidato per incoerenza nella timeline rilevato

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject reports brief office review between classes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Il soggetto riporta una breve revisione in ufficio tra le lezioni
Monitorando la persistenza della posizione attuale

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to believe this is just a quick review, so why am I already bracing for something else?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voglio credere che sia solo un ripasso veloce, quindi perché mi sto già preparando a qualcosa di diverso?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need a walk after this
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho bisogno di una passeggiata dopo questo
Se le mie gambe funzionano ancora

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Professor and you both making sense is unfair
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: È ingiusto che tu e il professore facciate entrambi senso

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But I read it twice like he said
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma l'ho letta due volte come ha detto

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Which is better than guessing while internally screaming
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Che è meglio che indovinare mentre urlo dentro

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home a bit later
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Tornerò a casa un po' più tardi

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: What time are you coming home?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: A che ora torni a casa?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: There's no reason for anything to go wrong
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Non c'è motivo perché qualcosa vada storto

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'll text you when I'm home
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ti scriverò quando sono a casa

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:evelyn}} needs your help with something in the attic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:evelyn}} ha bisogno del tuo aiuto con qualcosa in soffitta
Ho appena visto i tuoi messaggi
Rimango un po' più a lungo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Hey, I prepared dinner for tonight 😊
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ehi, ho preparato la cena per stasera 😊

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And you, don't go to bed too late
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: E tu, non andare a letto troppo tardi

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: If you can't go downstairs, just ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}} to bring it to you
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Se non puoi scendere, chiedi semplicemente a {{name:hailey}} o {{name:mason}} di portartelo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I hope it's going to be okay
My manager isn't supposed to be working tonight
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Il mio manager non dovrebbe lavorare stasera

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then try to enjoy the shift with your coworkers
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Allora cerca di goderti il turno con i tuoi colleghi

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can send him one answer tonight if I panic
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ha detto che posso inviargli una risposta stasera se panico

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: This is my exhausted victim face
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Questa è la mia faccia da vittima esausta

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Don't fall asleep in the couch
unless i close my eyes for a second
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: a meno che non chiuda gli occhi per un secondo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You keep texting me anyway, that should keep you awake
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Continua a scrivermi, così ti terrò sveglia

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But yeah, i'm going straight to bed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ma sì, vado dritta a letto
La passeggiata non è stata sufficiente
Il mio cervello è una zuppa
La revisione in ufficio è stata utile?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He noticed the exact part I messed up
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ha notato esattamente la parte che ho sbagliato

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But not in a bad way
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma non in un modo cattivo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels good to be trusted with more things
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fa bene essere fidati con più cose.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know it probably sounds boring from the outside
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: So che probabilmente suona noioso dall'esterno

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not if you're happy about it
He's strict, but he explains things clearly
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È severo, ma spiega le cose chiaramente.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.
In un certo senso lo sei 😌

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just don't want today to become heavy
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non voglio che oggi diventi pesante.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll text you after work if I'm not dead 😅
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti scriverò dopo il lavoro se non sono morto 😅

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But work is moving fast today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma il lavoro sta andando veloce oggi

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm still learning where everything is and what they expect from me
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sto ancora imparando dove si trova tutto e cosa si aspettano da me.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sei tornato a casa piuttosto in fretta

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You could still come sit with us
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Potresti comunque venire a sederti con noi

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Am I really going to have to come drag you out of your room?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Devo davvero venire a trascinarti fuori dalla tua stanza?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Good luck climbing the stairs with your leg
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Buona fortuna a salire le scale con la tua gamba

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Behavior change detected after gym session
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Cambiamento di comportamento rilevato dopo la sessione in palestra

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Subject avoided shared dinner without clear explanation
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Il soggetto ha evitato la cena condivisa senza una chiara spiegazione

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Conversation pattern deviates from established baseline
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Il modello di conversazione devia dalla baseline stabilita

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: The joke sounds like {{name:mason}}, but the distance doesn't feel familiar.
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: La battuta è proprio da {{name:mason}}, ma questa distanza non mi è familiare.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Straight to the shower and your room?
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Direttamente sotto la doccia e nella tua stanza?

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I don't know just making sure
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Non lo so, sto solo controllando

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He's demanding but... it pushes me in a good way
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: È esigente ma... mi spinge in un modo positivo

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I like the way he works
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Mi piace il modo in cui lavora.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I just want things to stay simple right now
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Voglio solo che le cose rimangano semplici in questo momento.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm not trying to make things tense
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non sto cercando di rendere le cose tese.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Everything feels heavier when I'm like this
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Tutto sembra più pesante quando sono così.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll probably just shower and go to bed
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Probabilmente farò solo una doccia e poi andrò a letto.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I wouldn't make it past ten minutes
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non ce la farei a resistere più di dieci minuti.

story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't expect to handle that much today
story/DAY11/ntr/DAY11_03_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non mi aspettavo di gestire così tanto oggi.

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Actually, things moved faster than expected
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: In realtà, le cose si sono mosse più velocemente del previsto

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I received a lot of notifications last night and this morning
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ho ricevuto molte notifiche ieri sera e stamattina

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: There are already enough requests for me to choose a good profile
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ci sono già abbastanza richieste per scegliere un buon profilo

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: If everything looks right, you might be able to do your first outing today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Se tutto sembra a posto, potresti fare la tua prima uscita oggi

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: That is why we will start slowly
Maybe just one or two hours outside, nothing more
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Magari solo un'ora o due fuori, niente di più

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Just enough for you to get used to it and see how it feels
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Giusto il tempo per abituarti e vedere come ti senti

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I was afraid you were going to tell me it would be something long right away
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Avevo paura che mi dicessi subito che sarebbe stata una cosa lunga
Il tuo comfort viene prima di tutto

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Then I will go get ready
Message me when you know more, okay?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Mandami un messaggio quando sai di più, va bene?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Please do not push yourself too much today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Per favore, non sforzarti troppo oggi

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Where are we with the work?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: A che punto siamo con il lavoro?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Mentally prepared to suffer for your grades
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mentalmente preparata a soffrire per i tuoi voti

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But definitely ready to see my handsome {{name:tutor}} 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ma sono decisamente pronta a vedere il mio bel {{name:tutor}} 😌

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And of course you're not thinking about your studies
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E ovviamente non stai pensando ai tuoi studi

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He's still coming to make you study, you know
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lui sta ancora venendo a farti studiare, lo sai?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ethan said he wants to review the weak points he noticed yesterday
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ethan ha detto che vuole rivedere i punti deboli che ha notato ieri
Buono per il mio futuro forse

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Your peace was never going to survive exam season
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: La tua pace non sarebbe mai sopravvissuta alla stagione degli esami

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: School outfit check before I disappear into class
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Controllo dell'outfit scolastico prima di scomparire in classe

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's the nicest fake compliment I've heard today 😊
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Questo è il complimento falso più carino che ho sentito oggi 😊

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm officially on my way to school
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sono ufficialmente in cammino per scuola

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I hate how accurate that is 😭
Ready for another study session later?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pronta per un'altra sessione di studio più tardi?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Enough to function like a normal human
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Abbastanza per funzionare come un normale essere umano
È tutto ciò di cui abbiamo bisogno

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought about what you said the other day
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho pensato a quello che hai detto l'altro giorno

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to get ready or I'm going to be late 😭
I didn't even wake up during the night for once 😌
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non mi sono nemmeno svegliato durante la notte nemmeno una volta 😌

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel a lot more awake today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi sento molto più sveglio oggi

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?
Perfect
I'll book another coaching session for you today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Prenoterò un'altra sessione di coaching per te oggi

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: No fucking way
Everything hurts
You need to give me at least one day to recover
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Devi darmi almeno un giorno per recuperare

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Then you better shut up and let me make noise as much as i want
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Allora fai meglio a stare zitto e lasciarmi fare rumore quanto voglio

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Alright alright
How about we play a game together and call it even?
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Che ne dici di giocare insieme e considerarla chiusa?

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Maybe
Come on
I'm good
I'll even let you lose with dignity
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ti lascerò anche perdere con dignità

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Why?
Because you made so much noise in your room this morning that you woke me up
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Perché hai fatto così tanto rumore nella tua stanza stamattina che mi hai svegliato

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Sorry princess
I didn't know you needed your beauty sleep
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Non sapevo che avessi bisogno del tuo sonno di bellezza

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: You should be more worried about yours
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Dovresti preoccuparti di più del tuo

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Your face needs all the help it can get
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: La tua faccia ha bisogno di tutto l'aiuto possibile

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I hope your whole body is sore today
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Spero che oggi ti faccia male tutto il corpo

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: It already is

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Hey
He must feel really lonely in his life to ask for that on an app
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Deve sentirsi davvero solo nella vita per chiedere una cosa del genere su un'app

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It happens more often than people think
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Succede più spesso di quanto la gente pensi

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Some people spend their whole life working and end up with no one to talk to
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Alcune persone passano tutta la vita a lavorare e finiscono senza nessuno con cui parlare

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: For them, even one calm hour with someone kind can mean a lot
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Per loro, anche un'ora tranquilla con qualcuno gentile può significare molto

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I think I understand a little better what I am supposed to do now
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Penso di capire un po' meglio cosa devo fare adesso

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Not just be pretty and sit there
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Non solo essere carina e stare lì

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: But actually make him feel less alone for a while
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma farlo sentire meno solo per un po'

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Exactly
And you are naturally good at that
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: E tu sei naturalmente brava in questo

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I hope so
I found a really good profile
story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho trovato un profilo davvero interessante

story/DAY11/nts/DAY11_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I am going to get ready and then I will go
I will keep you updated, okay?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming you 💅
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Se imparo qualcosa contro la mia volontà, ti incolpo 💅

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Blink twice if your leg is being dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Batti le palpebre due volte se la tua gamba sta esagerando
I miei compiti hanno una formazione teatrale

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I still need my favorite tutor functional
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ho ancora bisogno del mio tutor preferito funzionante

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I would have wanted that too
You would have had to protect me from the evil sky 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Avresti dovuto proteggermi dal cielo malvagio 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I take that responsibility very seriously
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Prendo quella responsabilità molto sul serio.
Sono fondamentalmente uno specialista delle tempeste.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Send me a picture of my brave survivor then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mandami una foto del mio coraggioso sopravvissuto allora.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I haven't finished doing my makeup yet 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Non ho ancora finito di truccarmi 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I didn't say full glam was required
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Non ho detto che fosse necessario un trucco completo.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You get the almost ready version
And don't forget your leg exercises today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E non dimenticare gli esercizi per le gambe oggi

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There was a storm during the night
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: C'è stata una tempesta durante la notte

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay maybe more than a little
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Va bene, forse più di un po'

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I really wanted to sleep with you

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: You say that like you're the responsible one
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Lo dici come se fossi tu il responsabile.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Maybe we do a small session today
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Magari facciamo una piccola sessione oggi.
Quindi niente che hai pianificato tu.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: I'm trying to be responsible here
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Sto cercando di essere responsabile qui.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm going to do some grocery shopping
Is there anything you want me to buy?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: C'è qualcosa che vuoi che compri?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you get me a water bottle or a flask?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Potresti prendermi una bottiglia d'acqua o un thermos?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Something I can keep in my room with clean water
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Qualcosa che posso tenere in camera con acqua pulita

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll see what I can find
I'll try not to come back too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Cercherò di non tornare troppo tardi

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Do you have time to bring me something to eat?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Hai tempo per portarmi qualcosa da mangiare?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'll heat up your lunch and bring it to you
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Scaldo il tuo pranzo e te lo porto

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I'm coming to pick up your plate
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Vengo a prendere il tuo piatto

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Do you need anything else while I'm here?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Hai bisogno di qualcos'altro mentre sono qui?
No, penso di essere a posto

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Do not say it like that
Your bullying tutor method might be working
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Il tuo metodo di bullismo da tutor potrebbe funzionare
Anche se c'è un piccolo problema

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Can you ask {{name:mason}} if {{mason:he}} can come pick me up at university?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Puoi chiedere a {{name:mason}} se {{mason:he|lui|lei}} può venire a prendermi all'università?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I would ask {{mason:him}} myself but {{mason:he}} is less scary when you are involved
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Lo chiederei io stessa {{mason:him|a lui|a lei}}, ma {{mason:he|lui|lei}} fa meno paura quando ci sei tu di mezzo.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will take care of it
But if you get home early, you revise again
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ma se torni a casa presto, ripassi di nuovo

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I knew there was a trap
You cannot say that after I survived class
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Non puoi dirlo dopo che sono sopravvissuta alla lezione

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am way too cute to be forced to revise 😇
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Sono troppo carina per essere costretta a studiare 😇

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is discrimination against adorable people 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Questa è discriminazione contro le persone adorabili 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll destroy you on that game
I see you still have hope
Go to work before you embarrass yourself more
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Vai a lavorare prima di farti ancora più ridicolo.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Enjoy the silence while it lasts
And why would that interest me?
Because your day is clearly empty without my updates
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Perché la tua giornata è chiaramente vuota senza i miei aggiornamenti.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Bold of you to assume that
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Coraggioso da parte tua presumere questo.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I try to match the audience
If I don't get home too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Se non torno a casa troppo tardi stasera.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I can already transfer you 300 dollars
So I already received money for the work I did
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Quindi ho già ricevuto soldi per il lavoro che ho fatto

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I do not even know how to thank you for doing all this
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Non so nemmeno come ringraziarti per aver fatto tutto questo

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: How was your second day of work?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Com'è andato il tuo secondo giorno di lavoro?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: A smile and a kiss, then
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Un sorriso e un bacio, poi

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I may have to send you more of them
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Allora potrei dovertene mandare di più

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Come eat before dinner gets cold
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Vieni a mangiare prima che la cena si freddi

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And do not go to bed too late tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: E non andare a letto troppo tardi stasera

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It was calmer than yesterday too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: È stato più tranquillo anche rispetto a ieri

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I managed to buy everything we needed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Sono riuscita a comprare tutto ciò di cui avevamo bisogno

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: We are almost out of money

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I have decided to be useful tonight
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ho deciso di essere utile stasera

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So I am repaying my debt
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Quindi sto ripagando il mio debito

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: {{name:hailey}} comes into your room to bring you food and clean your room
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: {{name:hailey}} entra nella tua stanza per portarti da mangiare e pulire

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am a generous little angel 😇
But you unplugged my whole PC while cleaning
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ma hai staccato tutto il mio PC mentre pulivi

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: How dare you take a picture of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Come ti permetti di farmi una foto?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It clearly shows you touching the cables
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mostra chiaramente che tocchi i cavi

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thanks for asking {{name:mason}} to pick me up
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Grazie per aver chiesto a {{name:mason}} di venire a prendermi

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It shows a hardworking innocent girl being framed
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mostra una ragazza innocente e laboriosa che viene incastrata

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally holding the cable
Maybe the cable attacked me first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Forse il cavo mi ha attaccato per primo

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You do not know the full story
And you are taking secret pictures of me
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E tu stai facendo foto segrete di me

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Go revise before you destroy more electronics
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Vai a rivedere prima di distruggere altri elettronici

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But if the PC dies, it was already weak
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ma se il PC muore, era già debole

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Picco di battito cardiaco elevato rilevato durante l'interazione privata recente

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Cattura emotiva rilevante archiviata in HAK Evidence

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Being close to {{name:hailey}} stayed with me, and I want more moments like that.
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: La vicinanza con {{name:hailey}} mi è rimasta impressa, e voglio altri momenti così.
Quindi sei a casa al sicuro?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Alive, safe, and only mildly dramatic
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Viva, al sicuro e solo leggermente drammatica

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I still need to get home
I finally collapsed on the couch
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Alla fine sono crollato sul divano

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I'm stealing snacks from the kitchen like a little rat
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E sto rubando snack dalla cucina come un piccolo topo.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really sorry I missed your calls
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi dispiace davvero di aver perso le tue chiamate.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a very glamorous day of stress and minor disasters
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ho avuto una giornata molto glamour di stress e piccoli disastri.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And one customer who acted like I personally ruined his life
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E un cliente che si è comportato come se avessi rovinato personalmente la sua vita.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I kept thinking about being home and talking to you though
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Continuavo a pensare di essere a casa e di parlare con te però.
Il lavoro è stato terribile oggi

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That part you can do now
That's why I wanted to stay here with you a little longer
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ecco perché volevo restare qui con te un po' più a lungo

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You still shouldn't go to bed too late
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non dovresti ancora andare a letto troppo tardi.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just wanted a little more of you first
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Volevo solo un po' di più di te prima.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You'll have more of me tomorrow
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Avrai di più di me domani

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And hopefully tomorrow will be easier for you too
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E speriamo che domani sarà più facile anche per te.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always say the annoyingly right thing 😌
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dici sempre la cosa giustamente fastidiosa 😌

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Go take your shower when you're done eating
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vai a farti la doccia quando hai finito di mangiare

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And send you a pic of me?
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E inviarti una foto di me?

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But only because I've missed you all day
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ma solo perché mi sei mancato tutto il giorno

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Promise you won't show it to anyone
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Prometti che non lo mostrerai a nessuno.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm still in my work clothes 😭
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sono ancora nei miei vestiti da lavoro 😭

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look so good ( and sexy ) I almost died
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sei così bello (e sexy) che sono quasi morto.
Va bene, questa è una buona risposta

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I won't be able to right now
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non posso farlo in questo momento.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It felt like the whole day was just problem after problem
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sembrava che l'intera giornata fosse solo un problema dopo l'altro.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You took that loss pretty hard
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Hai preso quella sconfitta piuttosto male.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: That's a lot of excuses for one evening
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Sono molte scuse per una sola serata.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Next time we should bet something
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: La prossima volta dovremmo scommettere qualcosa.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Loser owes the winner a favor
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Il perdente deve un favore al vincitore.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I hope you don't lose too often then 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Spero che tu non perda troppo spesso allora. 😏

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Come get your ass kicked in 5 minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Vieni a prenderti una bella sconfitta tra 5 minuti.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I've been waiting all day to make you cry
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ho aspettato tutto il giorno per farti piangere.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'll try not to laugh too much
We'll see who's laughing in a few minutes
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Vedremo chi riderà tra pochi minuti.

story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Do you need a teddy bear to sleep tonight? 😏
story/DAY12/love/DAY12_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Hai bisogno di un orsetto di peluche per dormire stasera? 😏

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, I made breakfast for you 😊
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ehi, ho preparato la colazione per te 😊

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I had plenty of time, so I made breakfast
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Avevo molto tempo, quindi ho fatto colazione

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have to deal with your manager every day
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Devi affrontare il tuo manager ogni giorno

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: It's the least I can do around the house
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: È il minimo che posso fare in casa
È davvero gentile da parte tua

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'll be downstairs when you're ready
Okay, give me a few minutes 😊
Take your time getting up and get some rest
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Prenditi il tuo tempo per alzarti e riposati un po'

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You had a long night at work
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Hai avuto una lunga notte al lavoro

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm so sorry, I slept way too much
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Mi dispiace tanto, ho dormito troppo

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I didn't even hear my alarm
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Non ho nemmeno sentito la mia sveglia

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You worked late, it's normal to be tired
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Hai lavorato fino a tardi, è normale essere stanchi

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said to come by if the second class exposes my tragic gaps
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ha detto di passare se la seconda lezione mette in luce le mie lacune tragiche

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm sure his words were nicer
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sono sicuro che le sue parole fossero più gentili

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are relying on him a lot
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ti stai affidando molto a lui

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He just happens to know how to make my brain behave
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lui sa solo come far funzionare il mio cervello

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now I have no excuse to fail
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ora non ho scuse per fallire

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I learn anything against my will, I am blaming both of you 💅
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se imparo qualcosa contro la mia volontà, darò la colpa a entrambi 💅
Ho bisogno che tutti siano funzionanti

story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And probably professor rescue after the second one
story/DAY12/ntr/DAY12_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E probabilmente salvataggio del professore dopo la seconda

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Damn you’re really getting bold huh

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: So how did it go with your professor tonight?

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Umm it went well I guess 😌

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Well that’s good news at least

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It’s nice to have some fun after all the studying I’ve been doing lately 😌

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I was a little shy at first

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: How can I not flirt with a professor who's so hot? 😇

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I wanted to wait until tonight

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I could say it properly

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought a lot about us

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And about how honest you've been with me
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E riguardo a quanto sei stato onesto con me

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first, I was scared because I didn't understand it

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought maybe it meant something was wrong between us
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensavo che forse significasse che c'era qualcosa che non andava tra di noi.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Or at least I'm starting to
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: O almeno sto iniziando a farlo.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought about what you said
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho pensato a quello che hai detto.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I mostly listened to how I felt
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E ho principalmente ascoltato come mi sentivo
È quello che mi ha sorpreso.

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because every time I imagined talking about it with you
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Perché ogni volta che immaginavo di parlarne con te

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And maybe a little curiosity too 😳
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E magari anche un po' di curiosità 😳

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I need you to understand something
story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma ho bisogno che tu capisca qualcosa

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not saying yes to anything tonight

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not promising I know exactly where my limits are

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm not running away from this anymore

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I want to understand you

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can go as slow as you need

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I feel safe saying this

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If we keep talking about it

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I think that's my answer for tonight

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm willing to learn more about what you feel

story/DAY12/nts/DAY12_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for being honest about it

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Just so I can shut you up properly

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Go work before you start crying at your phone
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Vai a lavorare prima che inizi a piangere sul tuo telefono

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Still thinking about that jump rope
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Sto ancora pensando a quel salto con la corda

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'm pretty sure I could do better with the cast
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Sono abbastanza sicura che potrei fare meglio con il gesso

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You couldn't jump over a charging cable right now
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Non potresti saltare nemmeno un cavo di ricarica in questo momento

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: And yet somehow I'd still look better doing it
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Eppure in qualche modo sembrerei comunque migliore a farlo

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You'll need something to look at when you're losing tonight
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ti servirà qualcosa da guardare quando perderai stasera

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Do I look like I gained weight in that photo?
I feel like I look bigger than usual
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Mi sembra di sembrare più grande del solito

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But I might still try to be a little more careful with what I eat
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ma potrei comunque cercare di stare un po' più attenta a quello che mangio

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Maybe do some gymnastics or yoga too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Magari fare un po' di ginnastica o yoga anche

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: You have plenty of room before you need to worry about anything
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Hai ancora tanto spazio prima di doverti preoccupare di qualcosa

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But yoga or gymnastics is good for health anyway
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ma lo yoga o la ginnastica fanno bene alla salute comunque

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So if you want to do it for yourself, that sounds great
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Quindi se vuoi farlo per te stessa, mi sembra fantastico

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: That was exactly the kind of answer I needed
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Era proprio il tipo di risposta di cui avevo bisogno

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm coming for the series now 😄
Sustained emotional proximity detected between {{name:player}} and {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Prossimità emotiva sostenuta rilevata tra {{name:player}} e {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Heartbeat intensity increased during shared private moment
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Intensità del battito cardiaco aumentata durante il momento privato condiviso
Incrociando i marcatori visivi ed emotivi...

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Cattura emotiva rilevante archiviata in HAK Evidence

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: HAK can measure my pulse, but it can't tell me what to do with these feelings.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: HAK può misurarmi il battito, ma non può dirmi cosa fare con questi sentimenti.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: The kitchen pro preparing a beautiful dish
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Il cuoco esperto sta preparando un piatto bellissimo

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I hope the dish is good at least 😄
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Spero che il piatto sia buono almeno 😄

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Thanks for spending so much time with me lately
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Grazie per aver passato così tanto tempo con me ultimamente

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Even with all the studying stuff 😌
I like spending time with you too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Anche a me piace passare del tempo con te

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I am even expanding my little goblin photo album with all your pictures
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E sto anche ampliando il mio piccolo album di foto di goblin con tutte le tue foto

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just call me a goblin?
I open my heart and this is my reward 😔
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Apro il mio cuore e questa è la mia ricompensa 😔

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Maybe because someone keeps asking for them 💅
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Forse perché qualcuno continua a chiederle 💅

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: One more for the creepy goblin collection 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Un'altra per la collezione di goblin inquietanti 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So hurry up and drag your little larva body down here 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Quindi sbrigati e trascina il tuo corpicino di larva qui 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You look way too proud of yourself
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sembri troppo orgogliosa di te stessa

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Because I survived classes AND cooked !
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Perché ho sopravvissuto alle lezioni E cucinato!

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It made everything feel more real
It felt really good having you here
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: È stato davvero bello averti qui

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I don't want today to be a one time thing
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Perché non voglio che oggi sia una cosa da una sola volta

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I really hope you liked it too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Spero davvero che ti sia piaciuto anche a te.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Talking together about what I like before
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Parlando insieme di cosa mi piace prima

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And moving forward while making your partner feel good too
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E andare avanti facendo sentire bene anche il tuo partner.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That worked really, really well for me ❤️
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ha funzionato davvero, davvero bene per me ❤️

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes me very happy to hear
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Questo mi rende molto felice da sentire.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I want more of that with you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Perché ne voglio di più con te

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I need to calm down a little before bed 😭
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ora devo calmarmi un po' prima di andare a letto 😭

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I already miss you a little
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E già mi manchi un po'

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you have a good time?
And seeing you move more easily made me so happy
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E vederti muoverti più facilmente mi ha reso così felice

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} keeps getting more competitive.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Le prese in giro tra te e {{name:mason}} diventano sempre più competitive.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Every game now feels like a personal challenge.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ogni partita ora sembra una sfida personale.

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm starting to care more about being there with {{name:mason}} than winning.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Stare lì con {{name:mason}} sta iniziando a contare più che vincere.
Non dirmi che ti stai nascondendo

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You'll get a free lesson on how to exercise properly
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Riceverai una lezione gratuita su come esercitarti correttamente

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Had to be clean before destroying you
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Dovevo essere pulita prima di distruggerti

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: Repeated cardiac anomalies detected during today's private interactions
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: Anomalie cardiache ripetute rilevate durante le interazioni private di oggi.
Esecuzione della ricostruzione della traccia emotiva...

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: Relevant moments have been archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: I momenti rilevanti sono stati archiviati in HAK Evidence

story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.source: The little moments with {{name:lena}} are staying with me more than I expected.
story/DAY13/love/DAY13_03_HAK_HEARTSPIKE.translation: I piccoli momenti con {{name:lena}} mi restano impressi più di quanto mi aspettassi.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I mean she promised to be quieter
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Volevo dire che ha promesso di essere più silenziosa

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: For a second I was actually worried
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Per un attimo ero davvero preoccupata

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Although {{name:hailey}} is making enough noise for the whole house right now 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Anche se {{name:hailey}} sta facendo abbastanza rumore per tutta la casa adesso 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Can you tell her to be a little quieter?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Puoi dirle di fare un po' più silenzio?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Otherwise I'll have to go upstairs and do it myself
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Altrimenti dovrò salire e farlo io stessa

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Study is killing me 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lo studio mi sta uccidendo 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He heard me talk about it whith my friends
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ha sentito che ne parlavo con i miei amici

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Apparently I have to come revise with him after class instead
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: A quanto pare devo andare a ripassare con lui dopo le lezioni

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Seriously?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Davvero?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Yes 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sì 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But then he made a deal with me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ma poi ha fatto un accordo con me

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I do well on the quiz tomorrow, he will personally take me shopping himself
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se faccio bene al quiz domani, mi porterà personalmente a fare shopping

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said that?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lo ha detto davvero?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: YES 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: SÌ 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He said I need motivation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ha detto che ho bisogno di motivazione

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And that he heard shopping is apparently my natural habitat
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E che ha sentito che lo shopping è apparentemente il mio habitat naturale

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: My brain is swollen
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il mio cervello è gonfio

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which is rude but accurate 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Che è scortese ma accurato 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Look at this face
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Guarda questa faccia

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Does this look like someone built for revision suffering?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ti sembra che qualcuno sia fatto per soffrire a ripassare?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Looks like someone trying to negotiate her way out of studying
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sembra che qualcuno stia cercando di negoziare per uscire dallo studio

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Correct 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Corretto 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But honestly the shopping promise is kind of motivating me
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ma onestamente la promessa di shopping mi sta un po' motivando

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I hate that it is working
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Odio che funzioni

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Reward-based attention from an authority figure is strengthening emotional attachment patterns.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: L'attenzione basata su ricompense da parte di un'autorità sta rafforzando i modelli di attaccamento emotivo.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Ask why he wants to take her shopping
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Chiedi perché vuole portarla a fare shopping.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Focus on helping her survive the quiz
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Concentrati su come aiutarla a superare il quiz.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably illegal
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Probabilmente illegale

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why does he want to take you shopping himself?
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Perché vuole portarti a fare shopping lui stesso?

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Because apparently stressed students need rewards
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Perché a quanto pare gli studenti stressati hanno bisogno di ricompense.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And because he thinks I work better when I have motivation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E perché pensa che lavori meglio quando ho motivazione.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You are making this sound way more dramatic than it is 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Stai rendendo tutto molto più drammatico di quanto sia 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Survive the quiz first. Shopping after.
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Supera prima il quiz. Shopping dopo.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: See 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Vedi 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You and him are bullying me together now
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tu e lui mi state prendendo in giro insieme ora.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Huge morning today 😔
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mattinata pesante oggi 😔

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Fine
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Va bene

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: If I become the smartest girl alive, somebody defenetly owes me clothes 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Se divento la ragazza più intelligente del mondo, qualcuno mi deve assolutamente dei vestiti 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Now let me survive this horrible morning first 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Prima devo sopravvivere a questa mattinata orribile 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Afternoon free though
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Pomeriggio libero però

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Which means shopping should legally happen
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Il che significa che lo shopping dovrebbe avvenire legalmente

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That's not a good idea
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non è una buona idea

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: 15 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: 15 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is exactly what my professor said 😭
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Esattamente quello che ha detto il mio professore 😭

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He literally told me I am not allowed to go shopping today
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mi ha letteralmente detto che non posso andare a fare shopping oggi

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Università prima, poi di nuovo lavoro

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I think it'll be fine 🙂

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma ieri è stato solo un disastro

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want every morning to feel like an interrogation
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non voglio che ogni mattina sembri un'interrogazione.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I care about you too
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E anche io mi prendo cura di te.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I just need you to trust me a little
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho solo bisogno che tu mi fidi un po'.

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have to get ready now
I fell asleep fast after yesterday 😅
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi sono addormentato velocemente dopo ieri 😅

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I'll make sure you're the one getting dragged out of bed tomorrow
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Farò in modo che sia tu a essere trascinato fuori dal letto domani

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Keep talking and you'll be late for work
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Continua a parlare e arriverai tardi al lavoro

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: If you don't get up soon
I'll drag my cast all the way to your room just to wake you up 😌
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Trascinerò il mio gesso fino alla tua stanza solo per svegliarti 😌

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Hey, I was looking for you
And you took a photo of me? 😳
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: E hai fatto una foto a me? 😳

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry, I didn't mean to make you uncomfortable
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Scusa, non volevo metterti a disagio

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Besides, you're right to take care of your body
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Inoltre, hai ragione a prenderti cura del tuo corpo

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That's sweet of you to say
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: È carino da parte tua dirlo

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I just want to be in shape for tonight
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Voglio solo essere in forma per stasera

story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: So I did a little workout before getting ready
story/DAY13/ntr/DAY13_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Quindi ho fatto un po' di esercizio prima di prepararmi
