Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Hey, I'm starting to get hungry
And you do not need to rush
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: E non c'è bisogno di avere fretta

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I was just worried because you did not answer
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ero solo preoccupata perché non hai risposto

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: That is very sweet of you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: È molto dolce da parte tua

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I will be upstairs in ten minutes with your lunch
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Sarò sopra tra dieci minuti con il tuo pranzo

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you bring me something to eat if it does not bother you?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Potresti portarmi qualcosa da mangiare se non ti disturba?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I was worried a second ago. Now I'm struggling to find my words.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Un secondo fa ero preoccupato. Ora non trovo le parole.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I just got out of the shower
I'll dry myself quickly and bring you something to eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Mi asciugo in fretta e ti porto qualcosa da mangiare

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am proud of your non-empty page
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Sono orgogliosa della tua pagina non vuota
Comportamento da tutor malvagio di nuovo 💅

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: This is the face of a soldier between battles
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Questa è la faccia di un soldato tra le battaglie

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Wow i'm starting to believe youre actually at war
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Wow, sto iniziando a credere che tu sia davvero in guerra

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But i am cute enough to survive
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ma sono abbastanza carina da sopravvivere

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Go win the next round then
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Vai a vincere il prossimo round allora

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I am going back to the front
If I fall, avenge me with tomorrow's shopping money 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Se cado, vendicami con i soldi della spesa di domani 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And then I have more tests 😭
How did the first ones go?
Maybe my brain invented a new academic language
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Forse il mio cervello ha inventato un nuovo linguaggio accademico

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: But I did not leave the page blank at least 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Ma almeno non ho lasciato la pagina bianca 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: You say that like you don't enjoy watching the chaos
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Lo dici come se non ti piacesse guardare il caos.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I just hope I don't finish too late tonight
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Spero solo di non finire troppo tardi stasera.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: But I really want to talk whith you tonight ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Ma voglio davvero parlare con te stasera ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Then as soon as you get home we will talk
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Allora, non appena torni a casa, parleremo.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: That gives me something nice to look forward to
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Questo mi dà qualcosa di bello da aspettare.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Okay, I should get back before lunch break disappears
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Va bene, dovrei tornare prima che la pausa pranzo scompaia.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Good luck for the rest of the day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Buona fortuna per il resto della giornata

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Don't forget to move your body and don't play to much game
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Non dimenticare di muovere il tuo corpo e non giocare troppo.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: Just long and a little boring
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Solo lungo e un po' noioso

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: So basically a classic university morning 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Quindi fondamentalmente una classica mattina universitaria 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: I'm eating with my friends right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: Sto mangiando con i miei amici in questo momento

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.source: And {{name:aiden}} apparently found another group of girls to annoy
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_LENA_BREAK_LOV.translation: E {{name:aiden}} ha trovato un altro gruppo di ragazze da infastidire.
Sta rimanendo fedele a se stesso

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: We'll settle it on the game tonight
Maybe we should train somewhere else
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Forse dovremmo allenarci da un'altra parte

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: If you can with your cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Se riesci con il tuo gesso

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I've already seen people swimming with a cast
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho già visto gente nuotare con un gesso

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: She's probably better than both of us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Probabilmente è meglio di entrambi noi

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: You were actually pretty impressive for once
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Sei stato davvero impressionante per una volta

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Try not to sound too surprised
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Cerca di non sembrare troppo sorpreso

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Don't let it get to your head
If you've got a problem with me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Se hai un problema con me

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Then I'll come downstairs and help you
I can't let you do everything alone
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Non posso lasciarti fare tutto da sola

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Would you like to continue the series?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ti va di continuare la serie?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: You don't even need to ask
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Non c'è bisogno nemmeno di chiedere

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm waiting for you on the couch 😌
I just finished brushing my teeth
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ho appena finito di lavarmi i denti
Indicatori di attaccamento emotivo in aumento

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Cattura emotiva rilevante archiviata in HAK Evidence

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So I'm not imagining how close we've become.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Allora non sto immaginando quanto ci siamo avvicinati.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I actually enjoy what I'm doing
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: In realtà mi piace quello che faccio

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Did you already start making dinner?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Hai già iniziato a preparare la cena?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am really proud of you

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Smettila di essere carino con me 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Later, after you brought food to {{name:hailey}} in her room
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Dopo, quando hai portato da mangiare a {{name:hailey}} nella sua stanza

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I still cannot believe my private professor brought me food in bed 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Non riesco ancora a credere che il mio professore privato mi abbia portato da mangiare a letto 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: That is not an excuse to stare at me while I eat
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Quella non è una scusa per fissarmi mentre mangio

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You took a picture of me 😭
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Hai fatto una foto di me 😭

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are literally a paparazzi pervert
The evidence shows a tired innocent girl being harassed in her natural habitat 😔
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Le prove mostrano una ragazza stanca e innocente molestata nel suo habitat naturale 😔

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You are lucky I am exhausted
Otherwise I would destroy you verbally right now
Elevated heart rate spike detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Picco di battito cardiaco elevato rilevato durante l'interazione privata recente

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Cattura emotiva rilevante archiviata in HAK Evidence

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I keep looking forward to those moments with her, even when I have no clever line ready.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Continuo ad aspettare quei momenti con lei, anche quando non ho pronta nessuna battuta brillante.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Tomorrow I am sleeping for ten years
You survived the whole day though
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ma hai sopravvissuto a tutta la giornata

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I am taking a shower and collapsing into my bed after this
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Faccio una doccia e poi crollo nel letto

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But first I'm going to take a shower and eat something
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ma prima farò una doccia e mangerò qualcosa.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And yet you still like me
Keep it to yourself, of course
She knows exactly how to catch me off guard. Even now.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sa esattamente come cogliermi alla sprovvista. Anche adesso.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How am I supposed to stay calm now?
But maybe that's exactly what I was going for 🤍
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ma forse è proprio quello che stavo cercando 🤍

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now let me eat before I become dramatic
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ora lasciami mangiare prima che diventi drammatico.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But I expect another one later
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ma mi aspetto un altro più tardi.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because now I'm fed, clean, comfy, and all yours for the rest of the evening 😌
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Perché ora sono sazio, pulito, comodo e tutto tuo per il resto della serata 😌

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you're keeping me company all night
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Allora mi fai compagnia tutta la notte

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I just need to get into bed and warm up a little, then I'm all yours
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Devo solo andare a letto e scaldarmi un po', poi sono tutto tuo.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the day actually went better than I thought it would
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E la giornata è andata effettivamente meglio di quanto pensassi.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So I have the whole evening for you ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quindi ho tutta la serata per te ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now that's exactly what I wanted to hear
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ora è esattamente quello che volevo sentire

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The playful rivalry between you and {{name:mason}} keeps escalating, turning every game into another excuse to get closer.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: La rivalità giocosa tra te e {{name:mason}} continua a crescere, trasformando ogni partita in un'altra scusa per avvicinarsi.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I knew you were a sore loser
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Lo sapevo che eri un cattivo perdente

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: But jumping on me so I couldn't win?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Ma saltarmi addosso così che non potessi vincere?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Didn't look like you hated it that much 😉
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Non sembrava che ti dispiacesse così tanto 😉

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Can we pretend that never happened?
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Possiamo fingere che non sia mai successo?

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Go to bed before I smash this cast over your head
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Vai a letto prima che ti rompa questo gesso in testa

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I'm going to be even stronger tonight 😏
I just got out of the shower
If you started without me, you're dead
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Se hai iniziato senza di me, sei morto

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: I wouldn't steal your only chance to win 😂
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Non ruberei mai la tua unica possibilità di vincere 😂

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: The teasing between you and {{name:mason}} is becoming more personal.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Il battibecco tra te e {{name:mason}} sta diventando sempre più personale.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Another game feels like an excuse to stay close, and I'm happy to take it.
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Un'altra partita sembra una scusa per restare vicini, e la colgo volentieri.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And explore a little further together
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: E esploriamo un po' di più insieme

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: By learning what the other person likes and what feels good to them ❤️
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Imparando cosa piace all'altra persona e cosa le fa stare bene ❤️

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: That's exactly what I want too
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: È esattamente quello che voglio anch'io.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Us figuring it out together feels right
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Sentirci insieme a risolverlo sembra giusto

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want it to stay like that with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Perché voglio che rimanga così con te

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now you're making me think too much before sleep
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Ora mi fai pensare troppo prima di dormire.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Then maybe I should make it worse
And way too proud of yourself
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: E troppo orgoglioso di te stesso

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You're making it very hard to act normal right now
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Stai rendendo molto difficile comportarsi normalmente in questo momento.
Ora fammi un complimento come si deve 🤍
Sto imparando molto in fretta stasera

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Because I want a lot more of this with you
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Perché ne voglio molto di più con te

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: You have no idea how happy that makes me
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Non hai idea di quanto mi renda felice.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I'm really happy we had that talk the other day
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Sono davvero felice che abbiamo avuto quella conversazione l'altro giorno.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: Now I really have to sleep before I keep getting worse
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Ora devo davvero dormire prima che continui a peggiorare.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And try not to haunt me with those pictures
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: E cerca di non perseguitarmi con quelle foto

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: It feels really good when we're that honest with each other
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: È davvero bello quando siamo così onesti l'uno con l'altro.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: I feel so much better now that things are clearer between us
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: Mi sento molto meglio ora che le cose sono più chiare tra di noi.

story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.source: And I really can't wait for us to open up more and more
story/DAY14/love/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.LOV.translation: E non vedo l'ora che ci apriamo sempre di più.

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And I'm sorry I let you make breakfast again
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: E mi dispiace di averti lasciato preparare la colazione di nuovo

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I'm happy to take care of you for once
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Sono felice di prendermi cura di te per una volta

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I don't even know what to say to that
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Non so nemmeno cosa dire a riguardo

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Just come downstairs when you're ready

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ho preparato di nuovo la colazione

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And before you ask, I'm fine
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: E prima che tu chieda, sto bene
La mia gamba non fa male oggi

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: So don't worry about me and get some rest
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Quindi non preoccuparti per me e riposati un po'

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Last night must have been exhausting
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Ieri sera dev'essere stata una faticaccia
Scusa se ti ho fatto aspettare

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: More like he already decided I am not allowed
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Più che altro ha già deciso che non posso

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Do not make me analyze it before battle
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non farmi analizzare prima della battaglia

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Professor voice and your voice are merging in my head
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: La voce del prof e la tua si stanno mescolando nella mia testa

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: See you after the first battle 🤍
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ci vediamo dopo la prima battaglia 🤍

story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That is definitely a soldier face
story/DAY14/ntr/DAY14_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quella è decisamente una faccia da soldato

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm coming
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Sto arrivando

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Hey, how is dinner coming along?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Ehi, come sta andando la cena?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: We didn't need your permission
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Non avevamo bisogno del tuo permesso

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: We already started the drinks
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Abbiamo già iniziato a bere

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You seem pretty happy to spend time with your coach after all
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Sembri piuttosto felice di passare del tempo con il tuo allenatore dopo tutto

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Say that again and I'll tell him you volunteered for the next session
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Dillo di nuovo e gli dirò che ti sei offerto per la prossima sessione

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: He could probably train your mouth since it's the only part of you that never gets tired
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Probabilmente potrebbe allenare la tua bocca, visto che è l'unica parte di te che non si stanca mai

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Enjoy your drink before I get there
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Goditi la tua bevanda prima che arrivi

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm doing what I can
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Faccio quello che posso

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Your legs are injured, not your hands
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Le tue gambe sono infortunate, non le tue mani

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Try using them a little faster
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Prova a usarli un po' più in fretta

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Keep talking and I'll season your food with painkillers
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Continua a parlare e condirò il tuo cibo con antidolorifici

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: At least then the food might have some flavor
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Almeno così il cibo potrebbe avere un po' di sapore

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: You're getting dangerously close to eating nothing
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Stai diventando pericolosamente vicino a non mangiare nulla

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Chris just arrived
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Chris è appena arrivato

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Then you can both sit at the table
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Allora potete entrambi sedervi a tavola

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: I'm coming
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Sto arrivando

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I'm home, and honestly it went really well 😊
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Sono a casa, e onestamente è andata davvero bene 😊

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: And he touched me a little too
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: E mi ha toccato un po' anche

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: He was very polite and kind

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ha chiesto prima di fare qualsiasi cosa
Ti sei divertita durante la giornata?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I feel like I am getting younger again
You deserve to feel that way

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Il cliente ha lasciato una mancia 😊

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Then yes, it went rather wonderfully
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Allora sì, è andata piuttosto meravigliosamente
Mi ha persino comprato dei vestiti

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:hailey}} ha completato 3 sessioni di studio consecutive
Stima di prontezza per l'esame aumentata all'81%

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm glad she's making progress, even if I don't know what to make of the way she talks about those sessions.
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mi fa piacere che stia facendo progressi, anche se non so cosa pensare del modo in cui parla di quelle sessioni.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived evidence of sustained exam preparation and increased study engagement
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove di preparazione sostenuta per l'esame e un aumento dell'impegno nello studio

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And after the session he even stayed a little longer
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: E dopo la sessione è rimasto un po' di più

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He just talked with me for a bit
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ha solo chiacchierato un po' con me

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Sounds like you had a good afternoon
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sembra che tu abbia passato un bel pomeriggio

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Proof of emotional and academic damage
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Prova di danno emotivo e accademico
Ethan ha detto che ho migliorato di nuovo
Finalmente hai ricevuto la tua punizione!

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But first I'm going to take a shower and eat something
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma prima farò una doccia e mangerò qualcosa.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you still like me
Keep it to yourself, of course
How am I supposed to stay calm now?
But maybe that's exactly what I was going for 🤍
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma forse è proprio quello che stavo cercando 🤍

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now let me eat before I become dramatic
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ora lasciami mangiare prima che diventi drammatico

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I expect another one later
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma mi aspetto un altro più tardi.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And the day actually went better than I thought it would
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E la giornata è andata effettivamente meglio di quanto pensassi.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Because now I'm fed, clean, comfy, and all yours for the rest of the evening 😌
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Perché ora sono sazio, pulito, comodo e tutto tuo per il resto della serata 😌

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then you're keeping me company all night
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora mi fai compagnia tutta la notte

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just need to get into bed and warm up a little, then I'm all yours
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Devo solo andare a letto e scaldarmi un po', poi sono tutto tuo.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I have the whole evening for you ❤️
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quindi ho tutta la serata per te ❤️

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's exactly what I wanted to hear
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ora è esattamente quello che volevo sentire

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: How dare you add sports challenges to a gaming session?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Come ti permetti di aggiungere sfide sportive a una sessione di gioco?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'll be there when I'm done
Mason and {{name:aiden}} moved unusually close after a lost challenge
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason e {{name:aiden}} si sono avvicinati in modo insolito dopo una sfida persa

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Interaction intensity increased beyond normal gaming behavior
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: L'intensità dell'interazione è aumentata oltre il normale comportamento di gioco

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Their closeness is becoming harder to shrug off, and I'm still working out what I make of it.
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: La loro vicinanza diventa sempre più difficile da ignorare, e sto ancora cercando di capire cosa ne penso.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Mason and {{name:aiden}} shared an unusually close moment after a lost gaming challenge
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mason e {{name:aiden}} hanno condiviso un momento insolito dopo una sfida di gioco persa

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You just shouldn't be so bad 😂
I'm the only one who lost
When are you coming back to play?
I still need to help {{name:evelyn}} with a letter
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Devo ancora aiutare {{name:evelyn}} con una lettera

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'll be there when I'm done
You're going to miss Chris losing

I'm the only one who lost

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Devo ancora aiutare {{name:evelyn}} con una lettera

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: It's like the idea of sharing you is exciting to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: È come se l'idea di condividerti mi eccitasse.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Thinking about you taking pleasure with another man
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Pensando a te che ti diverti con un altro uomo
O flirtare con un altro ragazzo

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: And the idea of someone else seeing all of you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: E l'idea che qualcun altro veda tutto di te

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Having you for himself for a moment
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Averti per sé stesso per un momento

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: All of that is extremely exciting to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Tutto ciò è estremamente emozionante per me

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'm starting to understand
So when you say someone else seeing all of me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Quindi quando dici che qualcun altro vede tutto di me

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: If someone else saw me like that…
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Se qualcun altro mi vedesse così…

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: What would that do to you?
It would excite me a lot
And the idea of another man seeing you like that does something to me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: E l'idea che un altro uomo ti veda in quel modo fa qualcosa dentro di me

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: That's what I wanted to know 😳
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Questo è ciò che volevo sapere 😳

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Now imagine I send something like that to someone else
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Ora immagina di inviare qualcosa del genere a qualcun altro.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'd want to know, and I'd want to have it too
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Penso che vorrei sapere, e vorrei averlo anche io.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I think I'd want to know, but not receive it myself
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Penso che vorrei sapere, ma non riceverlo io stesso.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I don't think I'd want to know
I've been thinking a lot about what you told me
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Ho pensato molto a quello che mi hai detto.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So you'd want to share that moment with me?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Quindi vorresti condividere quel momento con me?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Maybe not knowing would make it stronger
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Forse non sapere lo renderebbe più forte

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: So the mystery would be part of it?
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Quindi il mistero sarebbe parte di esso?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: You're really trying to understand this, huh
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Stai davvero cercando di capire questo, eh?

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: And maybe I like the way you react 😌
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: E forse mi piace il modo in cui reagisci 😌
Riguardo alla tua faccenda da cornuto

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: But I feel safe doing this with you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Ma mi sento al sicuro a farlo con te

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Now I really need to stop before I go too far 😭
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Ora devo davvero fermarmi prima di andare troppo oltre 😭

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Yeah... same here, it's getting harder to keep it together
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Sì... anche io, sta diventando più difficile mantenere la calma.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Be ready for next time then 😏
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Preparati per la prossima volta allora 😏

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: I'm trying to understand how it feels for you
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Sto cercando di capire come ti senti.

story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..source: Like… what exactly makes it exciting in your head
story/DAY14/nts/DAY14_03_LENA_NIGHT.NTS..translation: Tipo... cosa rende esattamente tutto questo emozionante nella tua testa?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: If you try to act tough and mess it up right away I will judge you loudly
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Se cerchi di fare il duro e sbagli subito, ti giudicherò ad alta voce.

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Only one week of classes left
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Manca solo una settimana di lezioni

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: What are you planning to do
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Cosa hai in mente di fare

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Any news on when that cast comes off?
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Novità su quando ti tolgono quel gesso?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: And drag you with me once your leg is ready
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: E ti trascinerò con me una volta che la tua gamba sarà pronta

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: That's suppose to be a good thing?
The doctor is checking my leg today, so I should know more after that
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Il medico mi controlla la gamba oggi, quindi dopo ne saprò di più
Pensi che sia oggi il gran giorno?

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Your leg has been in there long enough
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: La tua gamba è rimasta lì dentro abbastanza a lungo

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I hope so, but I'm waiting to hear what he says
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Lo spero, ma aspetto di sentire cosa dice

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: Even if it comes off, take it slow
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Anche se te lo toglie, vacci piano

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: No celebrating with a sprint down the stairs
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Non festeggiare scendendo le scale di corsa

story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.source: I'll ask him what I can do before I try anything
story/DAY15/DAY15_00_AIDEN_SHARED.json::.translation: Gli chiederò cosa posso fare prima di provare qualsiasi cosa

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: But I think I got enough rest
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Ma penso di aver riposato a sufficienza

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: By the way, I sent you some money this morning
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: A proposito, ti ho inviato dei soldi questa mattina

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: For groceries, bills and everything else
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Per la spesa, le bollette e tutto il resto

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I really don't know how to thank you
You already do enough for me
You deserve to rest and enjoy yourself a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Meriti di riposarti e divertirti un po’

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And honestly, I'm happy I get to spend so much time with you lately
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: E onestamente, sono felice di passare così tanto tempo con te ultimamente

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: It feels like we've gotten a lot closer
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Sembra che ci siamo avvicinati molto di più

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I like spending more time with you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Mi piace passare più tempo con te
Più di quanto mi aspettassi, in realtà 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: The doctor is coming after work today
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Il dottore arriva dopo il lavoro oggi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: Actually, I wanted to ask you something
Would it be easier if I kept some food in my room for lunch?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Sarebbe più facile se tenessi un po' di cibo nella mia stanza per pranzo?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: That way I wouldn't have to bother you every day
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: In questo modo non ti disturberei ogni giorno

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I actually like taking care of you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: In realtà mi piace prendermi cura di te.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: So whenever you're hungry, just tell me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Quindi ogni volta che hai fame, dimmelo.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: And I'll bring you a hot meal
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: E ti porterò un pasto caldo.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I'll talk to you later then
We went to bed pretty late yesterday
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Siamo andati a letto piuttosto tardi ieri.
Ho dormito molto bene, in realtà.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.source: I woke up a few times during the night
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING.translation: Mi sono svegliato un paio di volte durante la notte.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ho sopravvissuto al giorno del test
Il mio corpo eroico ha bisogno di recupero

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You cannot just skip because you are tired
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Non puoi semplicemente saltare perché sei stanco

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I can if I pay the tutor tax
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Posso se pago la tassa del tutor

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You earned a bit of rest
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ti sei guadagnato un po' di riposo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I knew you were secretly reasonable 💅
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Lo sapevo che eri segretamente ragionevole 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: The court has ruled in my favor 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Il tribunale ha deciso a mio favore 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Besides, I need to be in top condition for shopping this afternoon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Inoltre, devo essere in forma per lo shopping di questo pomeriggio

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Of course that is your priority
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Certo, quella è la tua priorità
Il recupero della moda è sacro 😇

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I am still in bed and i don't plan on leaving
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Sono ancora a letto e non ho intenzione di alzarmi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And my bed is also holding me hostage
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: E il mio letto mi tiene in ostaggio

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So what are you doing today?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ma il mio pomeriggio è libero

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And I want to use that time to go shopping for our date tomorrow 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E voglio usare quel tempo per fare shopping per il nostro appuntamento di domani 😌
È meglio che mi tenga aggiornato.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll send you the outfits so you can tell me which one you like most ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ti invierò gli outfit così potrai dirmi quale ti piace di più ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You in different outfits sounds dangerous already
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tu in diversi outfit suona già pericoloso.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I'll make sure to send you the hardest choices
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Allora mi assicurerò di inviarti le scelte più difficili.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I need to thank you again for last night
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Devo ringraziarti di nuovo per ieri sera.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And for spoiling me that much
You spoil me too, you know
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Anche tu mi vizii, lo sai?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's exactly how it should be
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: È esattamente così che dovrebbe essere

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Still sore in a few places
Try not to complain too much

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: È ricco che venga da te
Onestamente, allungarsi sembra una buona idea
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: But I might get the cast off soon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Ma potrei togliermi il gesso presto

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: After that I'll be able to move properly again
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Dopo di che potrò muovermi di nuovo correttamente
Hai preparato il tuo costume da bagno?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Unlike you, I can get ready without turning it into a medical operation
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: A differenza di te, riesco a prepararmi senza trasformarlo in un'operazione medica

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: It's not exactly easy to put on with the cast
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Non è esattamente facile da indossare con il gesso

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: So the cast is now losing against clothes too
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Quindi il gesso sta perdendo anche contro i vestiti

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.source: Let's go before you need a break from getting dressed
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_.translation: Andiamo prima che tu abbia bisogno di una pausa per vestirti

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Everything seems to be healing correctly

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Il dottore ha rimosso il gesso

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: But he also made me do a lot of movements
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Ma mi ha anche fatto fare molti movimenti

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: And now it's starting to hurt a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: E ora inizia a farmi un po' male

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Could you bring me some ice?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Potresti portarmi un po' di ghiaccio?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: I think I'm just going to let it rest for an hour
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Penso che lascerò riposare per un'ora

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: Just let me know if you need anything
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.translation: Fammi sapere se hai bisogno di qualcosa

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNO.source: He's about to come up and examine you

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Let's start with the school outfits

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Il tuo gusto è sotto osservazione
Adesso il giro degli outfit da giorno 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You officially influenced my wardrobe now
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Adesso hai ufficialmente influenzato il mio guardaroba

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: If I look too good later, that is your fault 💅
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Se sembro troppo bella dopo, è colpa tua 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I will keep shopping a little
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Continuerò a fare shopping un po'
Il campo di battaglia è bellissimo 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Il mio capo mi ha appena mandato un messaggio

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I meant settling it by fighting
You can't hit someone who's already injured
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Non puoi colpire qualcuno che è già infortunato

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll kill you on the game instead
Try not to cry when you lose
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Cerca di non piangere quando perdi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Because now you have more time to annoy me
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Perché ora hai più tempo per infastidirmi

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I've never seen someone so stiff
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Non ho mai visto qualcuno così rigido

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Even with a cast, I think I did better
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Anche con il gesso, penso di aver fatto meglio
Quella non è flessibilità, è barare

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: Turns out jump rope wasn't your only weakness
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: A quanto pare, saltare la corda non era la tua unica debolezza

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I just chose not to look good doing it
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho solo scelto di non sembrare brava a farlo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOO.source: I'll wait for you on the game

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm just a little stuck in the shower
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Sono solo un po' bloccato in doccia
Per fortuna il mio telefono era vicino

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: So you're telling me you're trapped in the shower? 😄
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Quindi mi stai dicendo che sei intrappolato in doccia? 😄

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And you're still naked as a worm?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: E sei ancora nudo come un verme?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Significant emotional tension detected during recent private interaction
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Tensione emotiva significativa rilevata durante l'interazione privata recente

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Elevated heartbeat and embarrassment markers recorded
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Battito cardiaco elevato e marcatori di imbarazzo registrati

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Relevant emotional capture archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Cattura emotiva rilevante archiviata in HAK Evidence

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm not the only one feeling this. That makes it harder to ignore.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Non sono l'unico a provare questo. Così diventa più difficile ignorarlo.
Come sta la tua gamba adesso?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: And sorry about the awkward situation
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: E scusa per la situazione imbarazzante

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It's not the first naked man I've ever seen
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Non è il primo uomo nudo che vedo

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: That somehow doesn't make me feel less embarrassed
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Questo non mi fa sentire meno imbarazzata
Comunque, la cena è quasi pronta

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'll bring you something to eat soon
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ti porterò qualcosa da mangiare presto

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'll come down a little later for dinner
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Scenderò un po' più tardi per cena

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: Are you sure everything is okay?
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Sei sicura che vada tutto bene?
Dille che hai bisogno di aiuto

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But tell me if you need anything
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ma dimmi se hai bisogno di qualcosa

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I'm bringing you some ice for your leg
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ti porto del ghiaccio per la gamba

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: You should rest as much as possible tonight
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Dovresti riposare il più possibile stasera

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: It will help your leg recover properly
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Aiuterà la tua gamba a recuperare correttamente

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: GIORNO 15 — Dopo aver esaminato la tua gamba, il medico ti ha tolto il gesso. Ora puoi muoverti più liberamente, ma la tua gamba ha ancora bisogno di riposo.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source:
Hey.

You've reached the end of the available content for this character for now.

Thank you for playing iNTeRcepted.

If you want to support the project, get new episodes, and access exclusive content, you can subscribe to my Patreon.

Your support genuinely helps me keep building this game.

See you in the next chapter.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation:
Ehi.

Per ora hai raggiunto la fine dei contenuti disponibili per questo personaggio.

Grazie per aver giocato a iNTeRcepted.

Se vuoi supportare il progetto, ricevere nuovi episodi e accedere a contenuti esclusivi, puoi iscriverti al mio Patreon.

Il tuo supporto mi aiuta davvero a continuare a costruire questo gioco.

Ci vediamo nel prossimo capitolo.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I tried to take a shower
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ho provato a fare una doccia

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: But I can't really move my leg properly right now
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Ma non riesco a muovere bene la gamba in questo momento

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.source: I think I need some help
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING.translation: Penso di aver bisogno di aiuto

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I already gave you emotional honesty
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ti ho già dato onestà emotiva

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: But I still have one surprise for you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ma ho ancora una sorpresa per te

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I bought a few extra little things while shopping
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ho comprato alcune cosine extra mentre facevo shopping
Strictly per ricerca scientifica sugli outfit 💅

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I am happy with this week
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E sono felice di questa settimana

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So that was the surprise. She looks far too pleased with herself.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Quindi era questa la sorpresa. Sembra fin troppo soddisfatta di sé.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So that was the surprise. She looks far too pleased with herself.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Quindi era questa la sorpresa. Sembra fin troppo soddisfatta di sé.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Even with all the revision torture
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Anche con tutta questa tortura di revisioni

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: So that was the surprise. She looks far too pleased with herself.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Quindi era questa la sorpresa. Sembra fin troppo soddisfatta di sé.
Questo significa che la sorpresa ha funzionato

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now I want to see every color
One color and suddenly you want the whole collection
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Un colore e all'improvviso vuoi tutta la collezione
Sto solo facendo le cose per bene

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: GIORNO 15 — Dopo aver esaminato la tua gamba, il medico ti ha tolto il gesso. Ora puoi muoverti più liberamente, ma la tua gamba ha ancora bisogno di riposo.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I kind of liked spending that time with you
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E in realtà mi è piaciuto passare quel tempo con te

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I came here straight after class 😮‍💨
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sono venuto qui subito dopo le lezioni 😮‍💨

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So now you're officially on outfit duty
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quindi ora sei ufficialmente incaricato dell'outfit 😊

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think that's my favorite on you ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Penso che sia il mio preferito su di te ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a feeling you'd like that one ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Avevo la sensazione che ti sarebbe piaciuto ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Don't panic but I may have gone a little further 👀
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non farti prendere dal panico, ma potrei essere andato un po' oltre 👀

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Well I need to be completely prepared, right? 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bene, devo essere completamente preparato, giusto? 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can't just surprise me like that 😭
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non puoi semplicemente sorprendermi in quel modo 😭

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And no, I was not prepared for this 😭
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E no, non ero pronto per questo 😭

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I'm about to start trying things on and you need to be ready to help me 🤍
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Perché sto per iniziare a provare delle cose e hai bisogno di essere pronto ad aiutarmi 🤍

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You have to be ready for anything with me 🤍
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Devi essere pronto per qualsiasi cosa con me 🤍

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was waiting for a proper compliment 🤍
You're beautiful, sexy, and a little devil 😌
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sei bella, sexy e un po' diavolo 😌

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, I'll text you again once I'm back home 🤍
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene, ti scriverò di nuovo una volta tornato a casa 🤍

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Get home safe, love you little devil ❤️
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Arriva a casa sano e salvo, ti amo piccolo diavolo ❤️

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: GIORNO 15 — Dopo aver esaminato la tua gamba, il medico ti ha tolto il gesso. Ora puoi muoverti più liberamente, ma la tua gamba ha ancora bisogno di riposo.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is a lot of pressure 😭

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Yo hurry up and get out of the shower already
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Dai, sbrigati e esci dalla doccia!

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: 1 HOUR LATER
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: 1 ORA DOPO

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Finally won baby. And from now on I’m gonna be the only winner
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Finalmente ho vinto, baby! E da ora in poi sarò l'unica vincitrice.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You’re dreaming
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Stai sognando

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You sure about the dare you asked for
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Sei sicuro della sfida che hai chiesto?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You scared ? If you’re that scared you can chicken out
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Hai paura? Se hai così tanta paura puoi ritirarti.

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: You asked for it
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: L'hai chiesta tu!

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Oh okay
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Oh va bene

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: So not so small huh
story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.translation: Quindi non è così piccolo, eh?

story/DAY15/love/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_.source: Don’t get too cocky now

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Do we let the front door unlocked tonight?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Lasciamo la porta principale aperta stasera?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: Otherwise I'll just climb through your window
Your leftovers saved my lunch today
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: I tuoi avanzi hanno salvato il mio pranzo oggi

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.source: They even talked to me about a promotion
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Hanno persino parlato con me di una promozione

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I might not even get a break
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Potrei non avere nemmeno una pausa

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But if you really can't, then at least be careful and take care of yourself
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ma se davvero non puoi, allora almeno fai attenzione e prenditi cura di te stessa
Evento ad alta risposta emotiva rilevato

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Alcohol exposure and elevated excitement levels observed
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Esposizione ad alcol e livelli di eccitazione elevati osservati

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Multiple interaction markers exceeded expected thresholds
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Molti indicatori di interazione hanno superato le soglie attese

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I hope she's all right. Those numbers don't tell me what she actually wants.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Spero che stia bene. Quei numeri non mi dicono cosa vuole davvero.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: HAK archived footage from a high-energy shift showing unusually elevated emotional engagement during service
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Riprese archiviate HAK da un turno ad alta energia che mostrano un coinvolgimento emotivo insolitamente elevato durante il servizio

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Everything is ready in the kitchen if you need anything
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Tutto è pronto in cucina se hai bisogno di qualcosa

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: GIORNO 15 — Dopo aver esaminato la tua gamba, il medico ti ha tolto il gesso. Ora puoi muoverti più liberamente, ma la tua gamba ha ancora bisogno di riposo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source:
Hey.

You've reached the end of the available content for this character for now.

Thank you for playing iNTeRcepted.

If you want to support the project, get new episodes, and access exclusive content, you can subscribe to my Patreon.

Your support genuinely helps me keep building this game.

See you in the next chapter.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation:
Ehi.

Per ora hai raggiunto la fine dei contenuti disponibili per questo personaggio.

Grazie per aver giocato a iNTeRcepted.

Se vuoi supportare il progetto, ricevere nuovi episodi e accedere a contenuti esclusivi, puoi iscriverti al mio Patreon.

Il tuo supporto mi aiuta davvero a continuare a costruire questo gioco.

Ci vediamo nel prossimo capitolo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Thank you for still taking care of me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Grazie per continuare a prenderti cura di me

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: You really don't have to do all this
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Non devi davvero fare tutto questo

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I just want to take care of the people around me
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Voglio solo prendermi cura delle persone intorno a me

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: But make sure you take care of yourself too
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Ma assicurati di prenderti cura di te stessa anche

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: Remember, tonight is going to be really busy

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I wanted to thank you both
You don't have to thank me
I know that I have been a mess this week
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: So di essere stata un disastro questa settimana

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I feel bad about it
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: E mi sento male per questo

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You don't have to feel bad about that
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Non devi sentirti male per questo
Lo so, ma mi sento così
Rilevato un segnale di colpa in {{name:hailey}}

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Shopping session timeline contains unresolved gaps
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: La timeline della sessione di shopping contiene lacune irrisolte

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Emotional stress pattern suggests a possible undisclosed event
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il modello di stress emotivo suggerisce un possibile evento non dichiarato

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Review the previously archived shopping evidence
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Rivedi le prove della sessione di shopping già archiviate

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Her guilt makes me anxious, but I still don't know what she hasn't told me.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il suo senso di colpa mi mette in ansia, ma ancora non so cosa non mi abbia detto.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived a visual fragment from the shopping session. Subject posture and proximity markers suggest emotional tension inconsistent with normal shopping assistance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK ha archiviato un frammento visivo dalla sessione di shopping. La postura del soggetto e i marcatori di prossimità suggeriscono tensione emotiva non coerente con l'assistenza normale allo shopping
Non preoccuparti, non è niente di brutto

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway, I just wanted to say thank you
And tomorrow I need to see professor
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: E domani devo vedere il professore

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He said I can come by
Just to return a book and talk about the next exam plan
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Solo per restituire un libro e parlare del piano per il prossimo esame
Ma è solo una questione di lavoro

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I am fine, you're the one making it weird
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sto bene, sei tu che rendi tutto strano

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I have to be up early tomorrow
DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: GIORNO 15 — Dopo aver esaminato la tua gamba, il medico ti ha tolto il gesso. Ora puoi muoverti più liberamente, ma la tua gamba ha ancora bisogno di riposo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Are you sure everything is okay?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sei sicura che vada tutto bene?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: My professor helped a lot too
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Anche il mio professore mi ha aiutato molto

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: New AlphaMana activity aligns with previous captures
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: La nuova attività di AlphaMana si allinea con le catture precedenti.
Esecuzione della correlazione delle prove ritardate...

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.source: Relevant capture has been archived into HAK Evidence
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_HAK_HEARTSPIKE_.translation: La cattura pertinente è stata archiviata in HAK Evidence.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to worry about me
The doctor took the cast off today. I still need to take it easy
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oggi il dottore mi ha tolto il gesso. Devo ancora stare calma
AlphaMana ha scritto: Non sono riuscito a resistere

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you sure your manager is treating you well?
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei sicuro che il tuo manager ti stia trattando bene?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What is that supposed to mean?

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non è quello che ho detto

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm already having a bad day
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho già avuto una brutta giornata

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't need this right now
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non ho bisogno di questo in questo momento.
Pensavo che ti fidassi di me

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then believe me when I say things are fine
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora credimi quando dico che va tutto bene

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I feel like everything just keeps piling up
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sento che tutto continua ad accumularsi.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thank you, that means a lot

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma per favore, fidati di me

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: GIORNO 15 — Dopo aver esaminato la tua gamba, il medico ti ha tolto il gesso. Ora puoi muoverti più liberamente, ma la tua gamba ha ancora bisogno di riposo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'll leave the back door unlocked for you
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Lascerò la porta sul retro aperta per te

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Have fun with your imaginary friends
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Divertiti con i tuoi amici immaginari

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: They're still more believable than yours
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sono ancora più credibili dei tuoi

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:mason}} is being kissed by an unidentified gym contact
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:mason}} sta ricevendo un bacio da un contatto sconosciuto in palestra

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: That alert stings, but it doesn't tell me what {{name:mason}} wanted.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Quell'avviso fa male, ma non mi dice cosa volesse {{name:mason}}.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: {{name:mason}} is seen being kissed during the late-night meeting after leaving the gym.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: {{name:mason}} è stata vista mentre veniva baciata durante l'incontro di tarda notte dopo essere uscita dalla palestra.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: DAY 15 — After examining your leg, the doctor removed your cast. You can move more freely now, but your leg still needs rest.
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: GIORNO 15 — Dopo aver esaminato la tua gamba, il medico ti ha tolto il gesso. Ora puoi muoverti più liberamente, ma la tua gamba ha ancora bisogno di riposo.

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source:
Hey.

You've reached the end of the available content for this character for now.
