story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Use it if you come home late
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Usalo se torni a casa tardi

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I put oil on my windowsill
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ho messo dell'olio sul davanzale della mia finestra

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So don't even think about climbing through the window
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Quindi non pensare nemmeno di arrampicarti attraverso la finestra

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're going to break my neck before the gym idiots ever get the chance
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mi romperai il collo prima che gli idioti della palestra abbiano mai la possibilità

story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Then use the door like a normal person
story/DAY15/ntr/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Allora usa la porta come una persona normale

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Hey, how are you feeling this morning?😊
We can do one last client today if you want
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Possiamo fare un ultimo cliente oggi se vuoi

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And after that, we take the weekend to rest together
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: E dopo, ci prendiamo il weekend per riposare insieme

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Then keep me updated when you find the client
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Allora tienimi aggiornata quando trovi il cliente

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: And how things go with the doctor
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: E come vanno le cose con il dottore

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: You have your doctor's appointment today, right?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Hai l'appuntamento dal dottore oggi, giusto?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: To see if they can remove the cast
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Per vedere se possono toglierti il gesso
Sì, non me ne sono dimenticata

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: Do you want me to stay with you today?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Vuoi che resti con te oggi?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.source: I can cancel everything if you need me
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_EVELYN_MORNING_.translation: Posso cancellare tutto se hai bisogno di me

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You still have a session with Ethan later
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hai ancora una sessione con Ethan più tardi
Non funziona così con le sessioni

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It is if I decide it is
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Lo è se decido che lo sia

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You still need to stay serious until the exam is done
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Devi rimanere seria fino a quando l'esame non è finito
E la sessione con Ethan dopo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I revised so much these last few days
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ho studiato così tanto in questi ultimi giorni

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I think it's going to be okay
I just can't wait for it to be over
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non vedo l'ora che sia tutto finito

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And the pictures I sent you 😳
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E le foto che ti ho inviato 😳

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That didn't help me sleep either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Questo non mi ha aiutato a dormire nemmeno.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least I'm not the only one suffering
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Almeno non sono l'unico a soffrire

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm really happy with how things are evolving between us
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono davvero felice di come stanno evolvendo le cose tra di noi

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like we're getting closer
And also exploring something new at the same time
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E anche esplorando qualcosa di nuovo allo stesso tempo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to learn more about it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voglio saperne di più su di esso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About how far we can go with it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Riguardo a quanto lontano possiamo arrivare con questo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can take it step by step
But I keep thinking about something…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma continuo a pensare a qualcosa…

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What the next step even is
Like… where this goes from here
I will think about it today
I'm really happy about how much you are into it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono davvero felice di quanto tu sia coinvolto!

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just to help you wake up properly 😌
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo per aiutarti a svegliarti correttamente 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I really have to get ready
Have a good day at university
Don't forget to move your body and don't play too many games
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non dimenticare di muovere il tuo corpo e non giocare troppi giochi

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I didn't fall asleep right away
I had a lot on my mind

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.
Continuavo a ripetere la nostra conversazione

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Do I have a great ass?
Why the fuck are you asking me that?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: È quello che ha detto {{name:aiden}} ieri sera.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: He said I have a really great ass
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ha detto che ho un gran bel sedere.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Yeah, that definitely sounds like something a fitness coach would say 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Sì, sembra proprio qualcosa che direbbe un personal trainer 😂.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I don't know how I'm supposed to take that
It's probably the only part of your body that deserves a compliment
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Probabilmente è l'unica parte del tuo corpo che merita un complimento.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Is this another fake act of kindness?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: È un altro atto di gentilezza falso?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Why did you answer like that?
What did you plan with {{name:aiden}} this time?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Cosa hai pianificato con {{name:aiden}} questa volta?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: What horrible thing did you plan this time?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Quale orribile cosa hai pianificato questa volta?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Things seemed a little awkward between you and {{name:aiden}} when I came back after helping {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Sembri un po' a disagio con {{name:aiden}} quando sono tornata dopo aver aiutato {{name:evelyn}}.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Do I have a great ass?
Why the fuck are you asking me that?
He said I have a really great ass
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Ha detto che ho un gran bel sedere.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Yeah, that definitely sounds like something a fitness coach would say 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Sì, sembra proprio qualcosa che direbbe un personal trainer 😂.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: I don't know how I'm supposed to take that
It's probably the only part of your body that deserves a compliment
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.translation: Probabilmente è l'unica parte del tuo corpo che merita un complimento.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_MASON_MORNING_N.source: Is this another fake act of kindness?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Just wanted to give you an update on {{name:hailey}}
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Volevo solo darti un aggiornamento su {{name:hailey}}

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: Her grades are getting noticeably better
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: I suoi voti stanno migliorando visibilmente

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: She’s understanding the material much faster now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Capisce il materiale molto più velocemente ora

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: I think she's already ready for the exam of today
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Penso che sia già pronta per l'esame di oggi

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: I'm happy to see how much trust you have in this little demon 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Sono felice di vedere quanto fiducia hai in questa piccola demone 😂

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.source: She’s not a demon, she’s a hardworking student 😂
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_00_TUTOR_PROGRESS_.translation: Non è un demone, è una studentessa che lavora sodo 😂

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Hai già un cliente per il pomeriggio?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He wants to spend the afternoon and evening with you if you are okay with it
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Vuole passare il pomeriggio e la serata con te, se ti va

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: He is offering $1500 to stay with him until tonight
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Ti offre $1500 per restare con lui fino a stasera

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: Same kind of thing as last time, acting like a couple while going to the aquarium and then to a restaurant tonight
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Stessa cosa di l'altra volta, fare finta di essere una coppia mentre andiamo all'acquario e poi a cena stasera
Il dottore ha rimosso il gesso

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I guess I should dress nicely then
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Credo che dovrei vestirmi bene allora

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: That would probably be better aha
The date is going really well
The aquarium was even better with you beside me. Thank you for staying close.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: L'acquario è stato ancora meglio con te accanto. Grazie per essere rimasta vicina.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: It hurts a little, but it is much better now
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.translation: Fa un po' male, ma ora va molto meglio

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I am having a really good time 😊
Biometric activity increased during ongoing date

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_EVELYN_AFTERNOO.source: I am just going to rest anyway

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: There were still some horrible questions😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Maybe he'll even give you a reward if you did well
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Magari ti darà anche una ricompensa se hai fatto bene

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm learning from your terrible system

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_01_MASON_AFTERNOON.translation: Una piscina? Sul serio?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: We are in a very fancy restaurant
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Siamo in un ristorante molto elegante

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.source: I am honestly having a wonderful time
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: Onestamente, mi sto divertendo un sacco

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_EVELYN_EVENING_.translation: La cena è stata speciale. Sei stata gentile, elegante e proprio chi volevo lì.
Contenuto della cena con Lucas sbloccato.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A kiss makes this feel different from helping her study, and I'm not as detached as I sound.
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Un bacio rende tutto diverso dall'aiutarla a studiare, e non sono così distaccato come sembro.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Beh, è un premio anche per te 😌

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You don't let any opportunity slip by!

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I want to see how you react
If I was going to do something like that…
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se avessi intenzione di fare qualcosa del genere...

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Who would you want it to be with?
Like… who would you want me to send it to?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tipo... a chi vorresti che lo inviassi?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably someone I don't really know
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Probabilmente qualcuno che non conosco davvero

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think the idea of a stranger makes it intense
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Penso che l'idea di uno sconosciuto lo renda intenso.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And maybe safer, for the private part
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E forse più sicuro, per la parte privata

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma non hai paura che lui cerchi di rubarmi?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: then, why not, if we find the right person
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: allora, perché no, se troviamo la persona giusta

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kinda… already thought about it…
Too many classes, too many people 😭

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma è anche il mio amico.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And we don't even know if he would agree
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E non sappiamo nemmeno se sarebbe d'accordo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We both know he's a real charmer
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entrambi sappiamo che è un vero affascinatore.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he always looks at you like that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E lui ti guarda sempre in quel modo.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I see him, he doesn't hide it
A little… but more like jealous… and excited
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un po'... ma più come geloso... e eccitato

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And proud that my girlfriend is that beautiful
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E sono orgoglioso che la mia ragazza sia così bella.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wow… that's really sweet… and hot
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Wow… è davvero dolce… e sexy

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We did say we would explore this
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Abbiamo detto che avremmo esplorato questo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why not with someone I trust?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Perché non con qualcuno di cui mi fido?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But you're not afraid he'll try to steal me?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma non hai paura che lui cerchi di rubarmi?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: So, you didn't drown?
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Quindi, non sei annegato?

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You sent me to a pool in that swimsuit with your best friend knowing I can barely swim
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Mi hai mandato in piscina con quel costume e il tuo migliore amico sapendo che a malapena so nuotare

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: You're about as innocent as a serial killer holding the knife
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sei innocente come un serial killer con il coltello in mano.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: And {{name:aiden}} have the best tan of the year, unlike me
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: E {{name:aiden}} ha l'abbronzatura migliore dell'anno, a differenza di me

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm as white as a ghost compared to him
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sono bianca come un fantasma rispetto a lui

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: That's for sure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Questo è sicuro

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I'm sure you had a good time at the pool anyway
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sono sicura che ti sei divertito comunque in piscina.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Non l'ho detto.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: But you're not denying it either
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ma non lo stai nemmeno negando.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Shut up
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Stai zitto

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sounds like my best friend is growing on you
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sembra che il mio migliore amico ti stia piacendo

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: I found your old swimsuit by the way
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Ho trovato il tuo vecchio costume, tra l'altro.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: This is only the beginning of the war
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Questo è solo l'inizio della guerra.

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: With pleasure
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Con piacere

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Sincerely, your secretary
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Sinceramente, la tua segretaria

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Too bad
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: Peccato

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.translation: 25 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: Unusual physical proximity detected in the swimming pool

story/DAY15/nts/DAY15_02_MASON_EVENING_N.source: An intense interaction occurred between Mason and his coach

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Cattura conversazioni che avvengono altrove monitorando persone di interesse

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: If I feel like drawing a bit of attention
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Se ho voglia di attirare un po' di attenzione

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t get used to being right
I’ve been thinking about last night
I keep wondering what you actually thought when you received it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Continuo a chiedermi cosa hai pensato davvero quando l'hai ricevuta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I thought about it more than I should have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ci ho pensato più di quanto avrei dovuto

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s more honest than I expected
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: È più onesto di quanto mi aspettassi

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I tried the outfit you chose for me again this morning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ho riprovato l'outfit che hai scelto per me stamattina

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I don’t know if that makes it better or worse
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Non so se questo lo renda meglio o peggio

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I keep telling myself it was just a stupid late-night decision
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Continuo a dirmi che è stata solo una stupida decisione presa a tarda notte

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: But I didn’t exactly regret sending it either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ma non mi sono nemmeno pentita davvero di averla inviata

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s the part that bothers me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: È quella parte che mi infastidisce

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I still can’t decide if I should thank you or be slightly annoyed
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: E ancora non riesco a decidere se ringraziarti o essere leggermente infastidita

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because it means I wanted you to see me like that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Perché significa che volevo che tu mi vedessi in quel modo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I don’t usually do things like that without overthinking for days
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: E di solito non faccio cose del genere senza pensarci per giorni

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: That’s also part of the problem
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Questo è anche parte del problema

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re being very calm about something that still feels a bit dangerous to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Sei molto calmo riguardo a qualcosa che mi sembra ancora un po' pericoloso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: It looks better than I expected
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Sembra meglio di quanto mi aspettassi

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We’re living in the same house
If things start changing, they change fast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Se le cose iniziano a cambiare, cambiano in fretta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: And I’m not sure I’m ready for that yet
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: E non sono sicuro di essere pronto per questo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: We don’t have to rush anything
Okay, I’m going to get ready before I keep talking myself into a corner
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Ok, mi preparo prima di continuare a mettermi nei guai

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Told you I had decent taste
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Te l'avevo detto che avevo un buon gusto

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Don’t sound so pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Non sembrare così compiaciuto di te stesso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Come ti senti alla gamba stamattina?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Strange without the cast
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Strano senza il gesso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I keep expecting to feel its weight when I move
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Continuo a aspettarmi di sentire il suo peso quando mi muovo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it hurting?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Fa male?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff. I'm taking it easy
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Un po' rigida. Sto andando piano

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're doing the short walk today
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Allora oggi faremo una passeggiata breve

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: There's a bench near the entrance. We can stop there whenever you want
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: C'è una panchina vicino all'ingresso. Possiamo fermarci lì quando vuoi

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You already have a bench picked out?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hai già scelto una panchina?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Yes. Very advanced date planning
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sì. Pianificazione dell'appuntamento molto avanzata

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I have dinner covered. You're handling benches
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Io mi occupo della cena. Tu ti occupi delle panchine

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Our date today ☀️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Il nostro appuntamento oggi ☀️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A balanced relationship 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Una relazione equilibrata 😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Breakfast first, though. I'm not leaving on an empty stomach
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Colazione prima di tutto, però. Non voglio partire a stomaco vuoto

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Save some room for tonight
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Lascia un po' di spazio per stasera

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you making?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Cosa stai preparando?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Pasta, roasted vegetables, and dessert
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pasta, verdure arrosto e dessert

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You remembered dessert. Excellent start
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hai ricordato il dessert. Ottimo inizio

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll have to wait to find out what it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dovrai aspettare per scoprire cos'è

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Fine. I have something you're going to have to wait for too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Va bene. Ho qualcosa per cui dovrai aspettare anche tu

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The outfit?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: L'outfit?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Is it weird that I've already checked the weather three times?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: È strano che abbia già controllato il meteo tre volte?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm wearing the one you picked yesterday 🤍
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Indosso quello che hai scelto ieri 🤍

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And yes, I bought your other choice too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E sì, ho comprato anche la tua altra scelta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Now you're making it difficult to focus on the shopping list
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ora mi stai rendendo difficile concentrarmi sulla lista della spesa

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Finish your shopping list. I want to be fed properly
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Finisci la tua lista della spesa. Voglio essere nutrita come si deve

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Meet me at the park entrance at three?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Incontrami all'ingresso del parco alle tre?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Three it is
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tre va bene

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Text me when you leave. And don't rush to get there before me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mandami un messaggio quando parti. E non avere fretta di arrivare prima di me

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I won't
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Non lo farò

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you this afternoon, love ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: A dopo, amore ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Depends. Are we expecting a hurricane?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Dipende. Ci aspettiamo un uragano?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: No 😭

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I just don't want our park date getting rained on
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Non voglio che il nostro appuntamento al parco venga rovinato dalla pioggia

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: We'd find somewhere to hide
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Troveremmo un posto dove nasconderci

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd use that as an excuse to stand very close to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Useresti questa come scusa per stare molto vicino a me

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was going to do that in good weather too
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Avrei fatto così anche con bel tempo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then I suppose the forecast doesn't matter ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Allora suppongo che le previsioni non importino ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’ve been lying here replaying our conversation from earlier
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Sono qui sdraiata a ripensare alla nostra conversazione di prima

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Especially the part where I admitted I wanted you to see that photo
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Soprattutto la parte in cui ho ammesso che volevo che vedessi quella foto

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I still can’t believe I said that out loud
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Non riesco ancora a credere di averlo detto ad alta voce

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: It was good to hear to be honest
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: È stato bello sentirlo, a dire il vero

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: But once I started talking, it felt weird to stop
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ma una volta che ho iniziato a parlare, è sembrato strano fermarsi

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Usually I joke my way out of anything that feels too real
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Di solito scherzo per uscire da qualsiasi situazione che sembra troppo reale

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: This morning I didn’t really do that
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Questa mattina non l'ho davvero fatto.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you didn’t push me either
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: E tu non mi hai spinto neanche.
E in qualche modo è stato peggio.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I didn’t want to make you uncomfortable
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Non volevo farti sentire a disagio.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I was trying not to overdo it

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: È stato gentile da parte tua.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I think you handled it better than I would have
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Penso che tu l'abbia gestita meglio di quanto avrei fatto io.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And you have to answer honestly

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Quando ti ho mandato quella foto…

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Or were you just being polite?
You really didn’t have to say that

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ma sono felice che l'hai fatto.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to try sleeping now
At least I’m not the only one
Before I ask something even more dangerous
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Prima che chieda qualcosa di ancora più pericoloso.
Grazie per aver risposto in modo sincero.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: And… don’t overthink this too much either

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At the park 🌿
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Al parco 🌿

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Like this?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Così?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Now you have a photo from our actual park date
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ora hai una foto del nostro vero appuntamento al parco

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better than the preview last Sunday
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Meglio della preview di domenica scorsa

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much better. You're in this one with me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Molto meglio. Sei in questa con me

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My shoulder barely counts
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: La mia spalla conta a malapena

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It counts to me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Per me conta

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: There. Now I want that shoulder back.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ecco. Ora voglio indietro quella spalla.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend a while on the bench together. {{name:lena}} leans against you while you talk, then joins you for another short stretch of the path. Before leaving, you share an ice cream near the entrance.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Passate un po' di tempo insieme sulla panchina. {{name:lena}} si appoggia a te mentre parlate, poi ti raggiunge per un altro breve tratto di strada. Prima di andare, condividete un gelato vicino all'ingresso.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Ready to go back?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Pronto per tornare?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm at the entrance
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sono all'ingresso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I think my leg has had enough walking for today.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sì. Penso che la mia gamba abbia avuto abbastanza camminate per oggi.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then we're going straight to your place. You can rest before dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Allora andiamo dritti a casa tua. Puoi riposarti prima di cena.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And you can keep me company.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: E puoi farmi compagnia.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: That was already part of the plan.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Era già parte del piano.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You leave the park together and head directly to your place. Once inside, {{name:lena}} leaves her bag by the sofa and helps you settle with your leg on a cushion.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Lasciate il parco insieme e andate direttamente a casa tua. Una volta dentro, {{name:lena}} lascia la borsa vicino al divano e ti aiuta a sistemarti con la gamba su un cuscino.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Better?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Meglio?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Much. Glad we skipped the long loop.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Molto. Felice che abbiamo saltato il lungo giro.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I liked our bench. Especially before that dog tried to steal the next one.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Mi è piaciuta la nostra panchina. Soprattutto prima che quel cane cercasse di rubare la prossima.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: He knew exactly what he wanted.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sapeva esattamente cosa voleva.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: So did I.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Anche io.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: The little ice cream stand is open, by the way
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tra l'altro, il chiosco del gelato è aperto

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} sits beside you and rests her hand on yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} si siede accanto a te e poggia la mano sulla tua.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My favourite part was you refusing to let go of my hand to eat.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: La mia parte preferita è stata quando hai rifiutato di lasciarmi la mano per mangiare.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I managed perfectly well.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Me la sono cavata benissimo.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You got ice cream on my thumb.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hai messo il gelato sul mio pollice.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A minor technical problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Un piccolo problema tecnico.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We've got some time before I need to start cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Abbiamo un po' di tempo prima che io debba iniziare a cucinare.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Stay here with me for a while.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bene. Rimani qui con me per un po'.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I won't argue with that.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Non discuterò su questo.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You spend the rest of the afternoon together on the sofa. {{name:lena}} keeps the outfit you chose yesterday on, and you let your leg rest before moving to the kitchen.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Passate il resto del pomeriggio insieme sul divano. {{name:lena}} tiene addosso l'outfit che hai scelto ieri, e tu lasci riposare la gamba prima di spostarti in cucina.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You found that before you found me?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hai trovato quello prima di trovare me?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'm gathering useful information
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sto raccogliendo informazioni utili

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look to your left
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Guarda a sinistra

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Oh ❤️
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Oh ❤️

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:lena}} puts her phone away and walks over to you. She kisses you, then slips her hand into yours. You take the short path through the park, stopping at a bench when your leg starts to tire.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:lena}} ripone il telefono e si avvicina a te. Ti bacia, poi infila la mano nella tua. Prendete il percorso breve attraverso il parco, fermandovi a una panchina quando la tua gamba inizia a stancarsi.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: UN PO' DOPO

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Come closer. I want a photo of us on this bench.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Avvicinati. Voglio una foto di noi su questa panchina.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Early evening, at your place. After resting together, you head into the kitchen to prepare dinner.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Prima serata, a casa tua. Dopo esservi riposati insieme, andate in cucina a preparare la cena.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Evidence that you actually cooked for me
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Prova che hai davvero cucinato per me

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And that you stole a piece before I served it
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E che hai rubato un pezzo prima che lo servissi

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Quality control
Verdict?
Very good. I'm keeping the cook
That's a relief
Now taste it before your food gets cold.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ora assaggialo prima che il tuo cibo si raffreddi.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After dinner, you bring dessert to the sofa. {{name:lena}} folds her legs beside you, carefully avoiding your sore leg. You put on a film, but keep pausing it to talk.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dopo cena, porti il dessert sul divano. {{name:lena}} piega le gambe accanto a te, evitando con attenzione la tua gamba dolorante. Metti un film, ma continui a mettere in pausa per parlare.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER THAT EVENING
What can I do?
Come here a second.
You lean closer and kiss her. {{name:lena}} draws you closer, smiling against your lips
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ti avvicini e la baci. {{name:lena}} ti tira a sé, sorridendo contro le tue labbra

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Visual capture archived
HAK//NOTICE
A Kiss on the Sofa
A LITTLE LATER
One more for today
You look very pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sembri molto soddisfatto di te stesso

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a park date, dinner, dessert, and a very good seat on your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ho avuto un appuntamento al parco, cena, dessert e un ottimo posto sul tuo divano

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Good seat?
You're my guest. You can sit there and judge my cooking.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sei il mio ospite. Puoi sederti lì e giudicare la mia cucina.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Right beside you
Though I think I've been leaning on your arm for twenty minutes
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Anche se penso di essermi appoggiata al tuo braccio per venti minuti

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Worth it
Tell me if your leg starts bothering you, okay?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Fammi sapere se la tua gamba inizia a darti fastidio, ok?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It's fine like this
Then I'd like to stay a little longer
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Allora mi piacerebbe restare un po' di più

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd like that too
You leave your phones on the table and settle back together. The rest of the evening passes in conversation and kisses. When {{name:lena}} eventually leaves, you walk her to the door.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lasciate i vostri telefoni sul tavolo e vi sistemate insieme. Il resto della serata passa in conversazione e baci. Quando {{name:lena}} alla fine se ne va, la accompagni alla porta.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATER
Home ❤️
Your guest can chop a vegetable. Give me a board.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Il tuo ospite può tagliare una verdura. Dammi un tagliere.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thanks for letting me know
I left my bag beside your sofa
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ho lasciato la mia borsa accanto al tuo divano

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I found it
Good. An extremely convincing reason to come back
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bene. Una ragione estremamente convincente per tornare

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't need a reason
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non hai bisogno di un motivo

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. I still want my bag 😌
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo so. Voglio ancora la mia borsa 😌

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did the dinner live up to the promise?
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La cena ha mantenuto le promesse?

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes
But the best part was being there with you
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ma la parte migliore è stata essere lì con te

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And kissing you goodbye without wanting to go anywhere
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E baciarti per dirti addio senza voler andare da nessuna parte

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: All right. The vegetables are yours.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene. Le verdure sono tue.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly asked you to stay
I nearly went back inside
Next time, ask me 🤍
I will
Now get some rest. You've done more today than you have in a while
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Adesso riposati. Hai fatto più oggi di quanto non hai fatto da un po'

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already in bed
Goodnight, love. Thank you for today ❤️
Goodnight. I loved having you here
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Buonanotte. Mi è piaciuto averti qui

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And you can sit down while I do them.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E tu puoi sederti mentre le faccio.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're taking over my kitchen already.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Stai già prendendo possesso della mia cucina.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Only the chopping. You promised me dinner, so the sauce is still your problem.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Solo il taglio. Mi hai promesso la cena, quindi la salsa è ancora un tuo problema.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} washes and chops the vegetables while you prepare the sauce. You take a seat between tasks, and she brings the plates to the table once dinner is ready.
story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} lava e taglia le verdure mentre tu prepari la salsa. Ti siedi tra un compito e l'altro, e lei porta i piatti a tavola quando la cena è pronta.

story/DAY16/love/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: DINNER

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Nuova abilità disponibile: Trascrizione in tempo reale

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Captures conversations happening elsewhere by monitoring persons of interest
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Cattura conversazioni che avvengono altrove monitorando persone di interesse

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t want more of this stress on top of everything else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non voglio aggiungere altro stress a tutto il resto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And I’m already happy with the diploma I have
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: E sono già felice con il diploma che ho

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I don’t need to keep stacking pressure just because I can
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non ho bisogno di accumulare ulteriore pressione solo perché posso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you talk about it with your professor?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ne hai parlato con il tuo professore?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll tell him this afternoon when I drop the book off
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Glielo dirò questo pomeriggio quando gli porto il libro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It feels like the right moment to say it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sembra il momento giusto per dirlo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Alright. Text me when you leave
I need to tell you something
I’ve been thinking about it for a few days already
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ci ho pensato per qualche giorno

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m not taking the next exams
I thought about it properly this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ci ho pensato seriamente questa volta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ How's your first morning without the cast?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buongiorno ❤️ Come va la tua prima mattina senza il gesso?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then no celebrating by trying to walk across the whole city today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Allora niente festeggiamenti cercando di attraversare tutta la città oggi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There goes my afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ecco che va il mio pomeriggio

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you're joking but I'm watching you 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: So che stai scherzando, ma ti tengo d'occhio 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Through the walls?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Attraverso i muri?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You usually tell on yourself eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Di solito ti tradisci da solo alla fine

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll say you went for a little walk and then mention a shop three streets away
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dirai che sei andato a fare una passeggiata e poi menzionerai un negozio a tre strade di distanza

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a very specific accusation
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È un'accusa molto specifica

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's me knowing my boyfriend ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ecco, conosco il mio ragazzo ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For the record, my big adventure so far was getting to the kitchen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Per la cronaca, la mia grande avventura finora è stata arrivare in cucina

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you make it back alive?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei tornato vivo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still lifted the blanket like I had that massive cast under it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho ancora sollevato la coperta come se avessi quel gesso enorme sotto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Barely, the coffee was terrible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A malapena, il caffè era terribile

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your coffee always tastes like you hold a grudge against the beans
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il tuo caffè ha sempre il sapore di chi ce l'ha con i chicchi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It wakes me up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi sveglia

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So would a fire alarm, you don't drink those
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Anche un allarme antincendio, non bevi quelli

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're very talkative for someone who hasn't left bed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei molto loquace per qualcuno che non è uscito dal letto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excuse you, I'm dressed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Scusa, sono vestita

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've even packed my bag and found both shoes
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho persino preparato la mia borsa e trovato entrambe le scarpe

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both? Big morning for us
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entrambe? Grande mattinata per noi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't ruin my achievements 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non rovinare i miei successi 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you have breakfast too or was finding the shoes enough?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai fatto colazione anche tu o trovare le scarpe è stato sufficiente?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your brain hasn't caught up yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il tuo cervello non si è ancora aggiornato 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast and a banana
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toast e una banana

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The toast was slightly more toasted than planned
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il toast era leggermente più tostato del previsto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Burnt
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bruciato

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Crispy 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Croccante 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Was that before or after you insulted my coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Era prima o dopo che hai offeso il mio caffè?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do two things badly at once, thank you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Posso fare due cose male contemporaneamente, grazie

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now that sounds like the girl I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ora questo suona come la ragazza che conosco

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl you know is also checking that you're actually going to take breaks today
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La ragazza che conosci sta anche controllando che oggi farai davvero delle pause

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Io sono

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A bit of walking around at home, then the exercises they showed me yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un po' di camminata in casa, poi gli esercizi che mi hanno mostrato ieri

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently it was expecting the cast to stay forever
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A quanto pare si aspettava che il gesso rimanesse per sempre

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No heroic expedition
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Niente spedizioni eroiche

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good ❤️ I'd rather wait a little longer than see you hurt yourself again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bene ❤️ Preferisco aspettare un po' di più piuttosto che vederti farti male di nuovo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo so

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's just nice not feeling stuck in the same place anymore
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È bello non sentirsi più bloccati nello stesso posto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I bet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Scommetto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When you're more comfortable, we can go somewhere without you having to plan every single step
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quando ti sentirai più a tuo agio, possiamo andare da qualche parte senza dover pianificare ogni singolo passo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somewhere with decent coffee?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Da qualche parte con un buon caffè?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And chairs, I'm not taking you hiking 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E sedie, non ti porto in escursione 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really know how to spoil me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sai davvero come viziarmi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking coffee and a pastry, but keep talking and you can have water
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Stavo pensando a un caffè e un dolce, ma continua a parlare e puoi avere dell'acqua

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't say that, I was starting to believe it too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non dirlo, stavo iniziando a crederci anche io

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll behave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi comporterò bene

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There we go 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ecco 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What's your day looking like?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Com'è la tua giornata?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning, then work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lezioni questa mattina, poi lavoro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need to finish checking a spreadsheet this afternoon before anyone else uses it tomorrow
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Devo finire di controllare un foglio di calcolo questo pomeriggio prima che qualcun altro lo usi domani

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds dangerously responsible
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Suona pericolosamente responsabile

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying not to think about it like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cerco di non pensarla in quel modo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm mostly looking forward to not carrying my university notes around with my work stuff
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non vedo l'ora di non dover portare in giro i miei appunti universitari con le cose di lavoro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not much longer now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non ci vorrà molto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know ❤️ I'm counting down
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo so ❤️ sto contando i giorni

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep better without it?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai dormito meglio senza?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, before I leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aspetta, prima di andare

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I actually managed to get dressed without creasing everything this time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Questa volta sono riuscita a vestirmi senza stropicciare tutto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Enjoy it while it lasts, my bag will probably destroy that shirt in ten minutes 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Goditelo finché dura, la mia borsa probabilmente distruggerà quella camicia in dieci minuti 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei bellissima

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You answered suspiciously fast
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai risposto in modo sospettosamente veloce

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't need much thinking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non ci voleva molto a pensarci

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, that was a good answer ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ok, quella è stata una buona risposta ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do I get the pastry back?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Posso riavere il dolce?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never losing the pastry
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non stavi mai perdendo il dolce

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, until I got up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Molto meglio, fino a quando mi sono alzata

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was just going to make you ask nicely
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Volevo solo farti chiedere gentilmente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Cruel woman
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Donna crudele

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your cruel woman has to leave now or she'll miss her bus 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La tua donna crudele deve andare ora o perderà il suo autobus 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell me how you're getting on when I text you at lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fammi sapere come va quando ti scrivo a pranzo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will, good luck with the morning
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo farò, buona fortuna con la mattinata

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Grazie bello ❤️ Ti amo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Anch'io ti amo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: My leg still feels like it belongs to somebody else
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La mia gamba sembra ancora appartenere a qualcun altro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Stiff?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dura?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, and a bit shaky when I first stand up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, e un po' tremolante quando mi alzo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Hey, how’s it going over there?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ehi, come va lì da te?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He’s being really calm about the whole thing
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sta affrontando tutto con una calma incredibile.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It makes it harder to just drop the bomb and leave
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: È più difficile semplicemente lanciare la bomba e andarsene.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ve thought about it a lot… I don’t want to take the next exams.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho pensato molto a questa cosa... Non voglio fare i prossimi esami.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}}. If you skip them, you won’t get the diploma.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}}. Se li salti, non prendi il diploma.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Fuck, well That’s why I’m telling you now.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Cazzo, ecco perché te lo dico adesso.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: …Is there really no other way?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: …Non c'è davvero un altro modo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What are you proposing, exactly?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Cosa stai proponendo, esattamente?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t know… maybe we can find something that works for both of us.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Non lo so... magari possiamo trovare qualcosa che vada bene per entrambi.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’re good at finding solutions, what do you suggest?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sei brava a trovare soluzioni, che suggerisci?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Everything’s fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tutto a posto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Event intensity increased
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: L'intensità dell'evento è aumentata

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Communication patterns show increased emotional reliance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: I modelli di comunicazione mostrano un aumento della dipendenza emotiva

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Workplace influence markers continue to rise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: I marcatori di influenza sul lavoro continuano a crescere

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Physical proximity exceeds standard academic baseline
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: La vicinanza fisica supera il livello accademico standard.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Additional evidence archived for review
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ulteriore evidenza archiviata per revisione

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I want to trust her, but this no longer feels like ordinary academic help.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Voglio fidarmi di lei, ma non sembra più un normale aiuto con lo studio.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived a moment of reduced personal distance during the private discussion. The professor’s hand remained on {{name:hailey}}’s arm for an extended period while she spoke about her academic future.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK ha archiviato un momento di ridotto distacco personale durante la discussione privata. La mano del professore è rimasta sul braccio di {{name:hailey}} per un periodo prolungato mentre parlava del suo futuro accademico.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Closer Contact
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: I'm sorry, but I can't assist with that.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll think about your proposal.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ci penserò.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But it's a dangerous and non ethical one.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma è pericoloso e poco etico.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: If your in i'm in, and it's a win win, i'm a catch you know.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Se tu ci sei, ci sono anch'io, e vinciamo entrambi, sono un affare, lo sai.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Anyway,i’m going to head home now before it gets more awkward.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Comunque, vado a casa adesso prima che diventi ancora più imbarazzante.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thank you for listening to me.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Grazie per avermi ascoltata.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Sorry I went quiet for a second
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Scusa, sono stata zitta un attimo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He just asked me something and I had to answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mi ha appena chiesto qualcosa e ho dovuto rispondere.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We’re talking about the next exams right now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Stiamo parlando dei prossimi esami adesso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Take your time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Fai con calma

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm done talking
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho finito di parlare.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll text you when I’m home
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ti scrivo quando sono a casa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: See you
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: A dopo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He’s listening properly for once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sta ascoltando per una volta!

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you already tell him your decision?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Gli hai già detto la tua decisione?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Not yet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Non ancora

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m getting there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ci sto arrivando

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s just… taking a bit longer than I thought
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: È solo che... ci sta mettendo un po' più del previsto.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You okay?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Tutto ok?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sì

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over and I've got a little time before work, how's your first day of freedom going?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ehi 😊 Le lezioni sono finite e ho un po' di tempo prima del lavoro, come va il tuo primo giorno di libertà?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And no spreadsheets
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E niente fogli di calcolo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that now. If you bring one, I'm leaving you there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo dici ora. Se ne porti uno, ti lascio lì

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave whenever you like
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puoi andare quando vuoi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, but I'd rather not spend my first evening out hearing about work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so, ma preferirei non passare la mia prima serata fuori a sentire parlare di lavoro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just wanted to make sure you still wanted to go
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Volevo solo assicurarmi che volessi ancora andare

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo faccio

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look very pleased with yourself
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembri molto soddisfatto di te stesso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Should I not be?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non dovrei esserlo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non ho detto questo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly awkward, I'm taking it slowly
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per lo più imbarazzante, sto andando piano

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'll try not to overdo it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora cercherò di non esagerare

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not trying very hard
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non ti stai impegnando molto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The manager moves closer and initiates a kiss
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il manager si avvicina e inizia un bacio

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cattura visiva archiviata

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He just kissed {{name:lena}}. My hands have gone cold, and for a second I can't even take in what I'm seeing.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ha appena baciato {{name:lena}}. Le mani mi si sono gelate, e per un secondo non riesco nemmeno a rendermi conto di quello che vedo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Crossing the Line
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Superare il limite

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait... what are you doing?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aspetta... cosa stai facendo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I shouldn't have done that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Scusa. Non avrei dovuto farlo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, you shouldn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, non avresti dovuto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll step back
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi farò da parte

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have a boyfriend
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho un ragazzo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Buono ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you can't just kiss me like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora non puoi baciarmi così

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai ragione

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't expecting that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non me lo aspettavo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My bad, your right
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Colpa mia, hai ragione

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to get back to work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Devo tornare al lavoro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you need to stop looking at me like that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E smettila di guardarmi in quel modo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will try
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ci proverò

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should try harder
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dovresti impegnarti di più

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo farò

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How was your morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Com'è stata la tua mattina?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Should I cancel tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Devo cancellare domani?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are you sure?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei sicuro?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to go. I just... I need a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voglio ancora andare. Solo... ho bisogno di un minuto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prendine uno

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, preferably
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Da solo, preferibilmente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll finish the last checks at my desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Finirò gli ultimi controlli alla mia scrivania

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can send it over when you're ready
