story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puoi inviarlo quando sei pronto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Let me get my phone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Fammi prendere il mio telefono

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The professor spent ages explaining something that wasn't even on the right slide
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il professore ha passato un sacco di tempo a spiegare qualcosa che non era nemmeno nella slide giusta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After her shift, at the bus stop...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dopo il suo turno, alla fermata dell'autobus...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm out ❤️ Sorry, I thought I'd be able to text sooner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono fuori ❤️ Scusa, pensavo di poter scrivere prima

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you sort out the spreadsheet?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai sistemato il foglio di calcolo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, eventually
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, alla fine

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We started with the wrong printout, so that was a great use of everyone's time 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abbiamo iniziato con la stampa sbagliata, quindi è stata una grande perdita di tempo per tutti 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The expensive sandwich deserved a better afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il panino costoso meritava un pomeriggio migliore

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I was hungry again an hour later, so it didn't even do its job
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E avevo di nuovo fame un'ora dopo, quindi non ha nemmeno fatto il suo lavoro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Heading home now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stai tornando a casa adesso?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Waiting for the bus, unless it decides not to exist again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aspettando l'autobus, a meno che non decida di non esistere di nuovo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it late?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È tardi?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone finally told him and he just went 'yes, that's for next week'
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qualcuno finalmente glielo ha detto e lui ha solo risposto 'sì, quello è per la prossima settimana'

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It says four minutes. It also said four minutes when I got here
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dice quattro minuti. Diceva anche quattro minuti quando sono arrivato qui

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least I found a seat
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Almeno ho trovato un posto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Long afternoon?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pomeriggio lungo?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Longer than I expected, yeah
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Più lungo di quanto mi aspettassi, sì

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tutto bene?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, just a lot going round in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, solo tante cose che girano nella mia testa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need food and a bit of time not looking at numbers
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho bisogno di cibo e di un po' di tempo senza guardare numeri

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can talk about something incredibly unimportant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Posso parlare di qualcosa di incredibilmente poco importante

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please do 😭 How did your big trip around the house go?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fallo per favore 😭 Com'è andato il tuo grande giro per casa?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Molto rassicurante

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I discovered the sofa was still where I left it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho scoperto che il divano era ancora dove l'avevo lasciato

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A successful expedition then
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora è stata un'escursione di successo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I stopped when my leg started getting tired
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E mi sono fermato quando la mia gamba ha iniziato a stancarsi

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you actually listening to me ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Guarda te che mi ascolti davvero ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't sound so surprised
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sembrare così sorpreso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm enjoying the moment, let me have it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi sto godendo il momento, lasciamelo avere 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel like watching something together later?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti va di guardare qualcosa insieme più tardi?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Together as in us arguing about the same film from different houses?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Insieme come in noi che discutiamo dello stesso film da case diverse?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esattamente quello

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I found a detective film that looks terrible and I don't want to suffer alone
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho trovato un film giallo che sembra terribile e non voglio soffrire da solo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent ten minutes thinking I was the problem 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho passato dieci minuti a pensare che fossi io il problema 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You make such a convincing offer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fai un'offerta così convincente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Say yes, I've already saved it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dì di sì, l'ho già salvato

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, we'll watch it when you're ready
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, lo guarderemo quando sei pronta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good ❤️ My bus is finally here
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene ❤️ Il mio autobus è finalmente arrivato

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I get home, then I'll sort out dinner
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti scrivo quando arrivo a casa, poi sistemerò la cena

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Talk to you in a bit
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ci sentiamo tra poco

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you manage to get something to eat before work?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei riuscita a prendere qualcosa da mangiare prima di lavorare?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A sandwich from the place near the bus stop
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un panino dal posto vicino alla fermata dell'autobus

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It cost enough that I checked the bag for a second sandwich
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È costato abbastanza da farmi controllare la borsa per un secondo panino

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've made it through two rooms and put a proper shoe on
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono riuscita a passare attraverso due stanze e ho messo una scarpa decente

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was there one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'era?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, just a napkin and disappointment
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, solo un tovagliolo e delusione

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least I've found somewhere to sit for a minute
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Almeno ho trovato un posto dove sedermi per un minuto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't look that disappointed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sembri così delusa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't opened the sandwich yet 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non avevo ancora aperto il panino 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you enjoy your very expensive lunch
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti lascio godere il tuo pranzetto molto costoso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd better eat something too
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fai bene a mangiare qualcosa anche tu

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Già fatto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, one less person to supervise 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene, una persona in meno da supervisionare 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at you, moving up in the world 😭
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Guarda te, che ti stai alzando nel mondo 😭

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You supervising people at work now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Adesso supervisi le persone al lavoro?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly a spreadsheet that refuses to add up
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per lo più un foglio di calcolo che si rifiuta di sommare

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: My manager wants to go through it with me when I get in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il mio manager vuole esaminarlo con me quando arrivo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you won't be stuck doing it on your own
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Almeno non sarai bloccata a farlo da sola

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly, and then it can stop taking up space in my head
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esattamente, e poi può smettere di occupare spazio nella mia testa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go, I'll text you when I'm out ❤️
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Devo andare, ti scrivo quando esco ❤️

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good afternoon
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Buon pomeriggio

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Later that afternoon, in the manager's office...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Più tardi quel pomeriggio, nell'ufficio del manager...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversazione in ufficio rilevata vicino a {{name:lena}}

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A spreadsheet, that's what she said. I want this to be an ordinary afternoon at work, but I can't stop watching the screen.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un foglio di calcolo, è quello che ha detto. Voglio che sia un normale pomeriggio al lavoro, ma non riesco a smettere di guardare lo schermo.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//TRASCRIZIONE IN DIRETTA

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is that the version you sent me this morning?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È quella la versione che mi hai inviato stamattina?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Putting the shoe on was the hard part
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mettere la scarpa è stata la parte difficile

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It should be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dovrebbe essere

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because this total is different
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perché questo totale è diverso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, don't tell me I've printed the old one
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aspetta, non dirmi che ho stampato la vecchia versione

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You tell me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dimmelo tu

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I changed it before class. Check the file on your screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'ho cambiato prima della lezione. Controlla il file sul tuo schermo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questa qui?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, look at the bottom. The figure's right there
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, guarda in basso. La cifra è proprio lì

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So the spreadsheet is right and the printout isn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quindi il foglio di calcolo è giusto e la stampa no

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly. Which means I've spent my lunch worrying about a problem I already fixed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esattamente. Il che significa che ho passato il pranzo a preoccuparmi di un problema che ho già risolto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I've been writing notes on the wrong copy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E ho scritto appunti sulla copia sbagliata

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you try doing it standing up?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai provato a farlo in piedi?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Well, yours is going straight in the bin with mine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Beh, la tua va dritta nel cestino insieme alla mia

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before printing it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Potevi controllare prima di stamparlo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have checked before writing on every page
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Potevi controllare prima di scrivere su ogni pagina

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair enough
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Giusto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, I'm glad we've agreed this is a shared disaster
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene, sono felice che siamo d'accordo che questo è un disastro condiviso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come around here. Show me what you changed
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vieni qui. Mostrami cosa hai cambiato

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There, that line was included twice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ecco, quella riga è stata inclusa due volte

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I missed that yesterday
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Me ne sono perso ieri

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You told me to check my calculation again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so. Mi hai detto di controllare di nuovo il mio calcolo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And you did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E l'hai fatto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Once
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una volta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Three times, because I thought you must know something I didn't
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tre volte, perché pensavo che tu sapessi qualcosa che io non sapevo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You should have told me
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Avresti dovuto dirmelo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just did
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'ho appena fatto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little sooner would have saved you some time
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un po' prima ti avrebbe fatto risparmiare tempo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then next time I get to say 'I told you so' while you're still in the room
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora la prossima volta posso dire 'te l'avevo detto' mentre sei ancora in stanza

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think you've earned that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Penso che te lo sei guadagnato

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to remember you said that
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ricorderò che l'hai detto

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects standing together beside the desk
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Due soggetti in piedi insieme accanto alla scrivania

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cattura visiva archiviata

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They're standing so close. I keep telling myself it's work, but seeing them together like that makes my stomach tighten.
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono così vicini. Continuo a dirmi che è lavoro, ma vederli insieme così mi stringe lo stomaco.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too Close
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Troppo vicino

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You seem more comfortable in here now
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembri più a tuo agio qui dentro adesso

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew it
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sapevo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: With the work? A little
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Con il lavoro? Un po'

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't exactly what I meant
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non era esattamente quello che intendevo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe you should be more specific
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora forse dovresti essere più specifico

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The first few days you stood by the door whenever you brought something in
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nei primi giorni stavi vicino alla porta ogni volta che portavi qualcosa dentro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you always looked busy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perché sembravi sempre occupato

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E adesso?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I know half the time you're just looking at the same numbers I am
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ora so che metà delle volte stai solo guardando gli stessi numeri che guardo io

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'm less intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quindi sono meno intimidatorio

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you were intimidating
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non ho detto che sei intimidatorio

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You just didn't want to come any closer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non volevi semplicemente avvicinarti di più

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sat down before you could sense a disturbance
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi sono seduto prima che tu potessi percepire un disturbo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know, you notice a lot for someone with so much work to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sai, noti molto per qualcuno con così tanto lavoro da fare

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some things are hard not to notice
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alcune cose sono difficili da non notare

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing it again
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo stai facendo di nuovo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Doing what?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fare cosa?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Looking at me instead of the screen
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Guardandomi invece dello schermo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've finished explaining the spreadsheet
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai finito di spiegare il foglio di calcolo

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't an answer
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quella non è una risposta

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't meant to be
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non era quello il mio intento

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really don't make this easy
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non me la rendi affatto facile

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Make what easy?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Facile cosa?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, I felt it 😌
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Troppo tardi, l'ho sentito 😌

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keeping a straight face when I'm supposed to be working
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mantenere un'espressione seria mentre dovrei lavorare

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little later, after the paperwork is finished...
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un po' dopo, dopo che la burocrazia è finita...

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are we still on for tomorrow?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ci siamo ancora per domani?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The drink?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il drink?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, the drink
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, il drink

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I'd come, didn't I?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho detto che sarei venuta, vero?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You also said you might be tired after work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai anche detto che potresti essere stanca dopo il lavoro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I probably will be. I can still sit down somewhere that isn't this chair
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Probabilmente lo sarò. Posso comunque sedermi da qualche parte che non sia questa sedia

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a place a couple of streets over. Around seven?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'è un posto a un paio di strade da qui. Verso le sette?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seven should be fine
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Le sette vanno bene

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, is it hurting or just awkward?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sul serio, fa male o è solo imbarazzante?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It was the smart thing to do
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Era la cosa più intelligente da fare.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Even if it means more work
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Anche se significa fare più lavoro

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’s going to help me deeply this time

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Oggi è stata una giornata intensa

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Thanks for checking on me earlier
I kind of have to take the exams after all
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Dopo tutto devo fare gli esami

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He made it pretty clear I won’t get the diploma otherwise
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ha reso chiaro che altrimenti non prenderò il diploma

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Okay… but you said you maybe had a solution?
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Va bene… ma hai detto che forse avevi una soluzione?

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’m going to have to spend more time with him for the exams
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Devo passare più tempo con lui per gli esami.
Sessioni extra, quel genere di cose

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That’s good actually. I’m glad you changed your mind
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: È vero, sono contento che tu abbia cambiato idea.

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm home and attempting dinner before our very serious film night
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ Sono a casa e sto tentando di preparare la cena prima della nostra serissima serata film

story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We don't need to discuss him
He wasn't even in the second half
story/DAY16/ntr/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non era nemmeno nella seconda metà

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look who's suddenly responsible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guarda chi è diventato improvvisamente responsabile

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I learned from a very strict woman
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho imparato da una donna molto severa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra adorabile

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Annoying. Very pretty though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fastidiosa. Però molto carina

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That saved you ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Questo ti ha salvato ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I'll prove I'm eating
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aspetta, ti dimostro che sto mangiando

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Toast, coffee, and a woman who is definitely going to be late if she keeps texting you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Toast, caffè e una donna che sicuramente sarà in ritardo se continua a scriverti

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent a lot of time together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Abbiamo passato molto tempo insieme

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei bellissima

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were supposed to notice the toast
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dovevi notare il toast

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I noticed both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho notato entrambi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll allow it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te lo concedo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes all day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lezioni tutto il giorno?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: This morning, then some work with my group after lunch
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Questa mattina, poi un po' di lavoro con il mio gruppo dopo pranzo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We spent twenty minutes yesterday deciding who was supposed to send a document everyone already had
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ieri abbiamo passato venti minuti a decidere chi doveva inviare un documento che avevamo già tutti.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Promising start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Inizio promettente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. I'm bringing snacks and lowering my expectations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esattamente. Porto degli snack e abbasso le mie aspettative.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sounds like you're the only one prepared
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra che tu sia l'unica preparata.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Should I be jealous?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dovrei essere geloso?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Emotionally, absolutely not
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Emotivamente, assolutamente no.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I haven't forgotten what we talked about last night
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E non ho dimenticato di cosa abbiamo parlato ieri sera.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to think about the first step properly, not while I'm trying to find my other shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voglio pensare bene al primo passo, non mentre cerco la mia altra scarpa.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd hate to compete with the shoe
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non vorrei competere con la scarpa.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's currently winning
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Attualmente sta vincendo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Found it. Both shoes are on, so now I have no excuse
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: L'ho trovata. Ho entrambe le scarpe, quindi ora non ho scuse.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One last picture before I leave, since you can't be here to distract me in person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un'ultima foto prima di partire, visto che non puoi essere qui a distrarmi di persona.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it very hard to encourage you to leave
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Stai rendendo molto difficile incoraggiarti a partire.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was a very supportive relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Era una relazione molto di supporto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're supposed to wish me luck, not make me miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dovresti augurarmi buona fortuna, non farmi sentire la tua mancanza.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can do both
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Posso fare entrambe le cose.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you can ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo so che puoi ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Text me when you have a quiet moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mandami un messaggio quando hai un momento tranquillo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo farò ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And keep some room in your schedule for that hug
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E lascia un po' di spazio nel tuo programma per quel abbraccio.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll cancel my appointment with the sofa
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cancellerò il mio appuntamento con il divano.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Tell it I'm sorry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dille che mi dispiace 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh my god
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh mio dio

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've been saving that one since yesterday, haven't you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: L'hai tenuta in serbo da ieri, vero?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Since the doctor took it off
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Da quando il dottore l'ha tolto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: La mia piccola studentessa ha davvero studiato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You also got some very interesting rewards along the way
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hai anche ricevuto alcune ricompense molto interessanti lungo il cammino

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I passed the most important exam
So technically I don't really need to keep studying that hard
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quindi tecnicamente non ho davvero bisogno di studiare così tanto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You should still pass the remaining exams to be safe. Keeping Ethan a bit longer is a win-win.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Dovresti comunque passare gli esami rimanenti per sicurezza. Tenere Ethan un po' più a lungo è un vantaggio per entrambi.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You worked hard enough. Maybe it's time to do something other than books for a while.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hai lavorato abbastanza. Forse è ora di fare qualcosa di diverso dai libri per un po'.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Is it really about the exams...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: È davvero solo per gli esami...

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Or is it you who wants me to keep seeing Ethan? 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O sei tu che vuoi che continui a vedere Ethan? 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm just thinking about your diploma
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sto solo pensando al tuo diploma

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can be a good person sometimes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Posso essere una brava persona a volte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But when I am, I'm right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma quando lo sono, ho ragione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll keep Ethan for the next exams
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Terrò Ethan per i prossimi esami

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You are the one who will be happy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sei tu quella che sarà felice

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You've been stuck studying for weeks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sei bloccato a studiare da settimane

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Moving a bit wouldn't kill you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Muoversi un po' non ti farebbe male

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Especially if you want to keep your body in shape for the summer
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Soprattutto se vuoi tenerti in forma per l'estate

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Be careful, I may be small but I can still kick your ass 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Fai attenzione, posso essere piccola ma posso comunque prenderti a calci 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I do feel like I need to move again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sento di aver bisogno di muovermi di nuovo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, I finally have time to eat without someone asking me about our group project 😮‍💨
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ehi, finalmente ho tempo di mangiare senza che qualcuno mi chieda del nostro progetto di gruppo 😮‍💨

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It certainly had more information available
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aveva sicuramente più informazioni disponibili

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Harsh
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Severo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Accurate 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Accurato 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But it did help me work out something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma mi ha aiutato a capire qualcosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to be able to talk to someone normally first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voglio poter parlare normalmente con qualcuno prima

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to pick a person just because we're excited about trying something new
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non voglio scegliere una persona solo perché siamo entusiasti di provare qualcosa di nuovo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want you doing that either
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non voglio che tu faccia così neanche

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I want him to know I'm in a relationship
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E voglio che lui sappia che sono in una relazione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to get halfway through a conversation and feel like I've hidden the important part
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non voglio arrivare a metà conversazione e sentire di aver nascosto la parte importante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Agreed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: D'accordo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not sure how to write that without making my profile sound like a very serious announcement
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sono sicura di come scriverlo senza far sembrare il mio profilo un annuncio molto serio

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Start with hello. Probably leave out a formal introduction from your boyfriend
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Inizia con un ciao. Probabilmente lascia fuori un'introduzione formale dal tuo ragazzo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mean you haven't prepared one?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vuoi dire che non ne hai preparato uno?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could include references
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Potrei includere dei riferimenti

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Assolutamente no 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like you to read what I write, though
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piacerebbe che leggessi quello che scrivo, però

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not to choose someone for me. Just because this is new and I'd rather not feel alone doing it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non per scegliere qualcuno per me. Solo perché è nuovo e preferirei non sentirmi sola a farlo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And when I said someone we don't know might be simpler, I didn't mean you have to trust the first person who answers
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E quando ho detto che qualcuno che non conosciamo potrebbe essere più semplice, non intendevo che devi fidarti della prima persona che risponde

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You found somewhere sunny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai trovato un posto soleggiato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less awkward around our friends doesn't automatically mean I'll feel comfortable with him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Essere meno imbarazzata con i nostri amici non significa automaticamente che mi sentirò a mio agio con lui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tonight I'll write something and choose a normal photo
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quindi stasera scriverò qualcosa e sceglierò una foto normale

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I can decide whether I'm happy to put it up and start a conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Domani posso decidere se sono felice di pubblicarlo e iniziare una conversazione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds like an actual plan
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembra un vero piano

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A slightly nervous plan, but yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un piano leggermente nervoso, ma sì

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's allowed
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questo è permesso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also reserve the right to complain to you about terrible profiles
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi riservo anche il diritto di lamentarmi con te dei profili terribili

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quella parte non è mai stata in dubbio

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and my lunch hasn't asked a single question about the presentation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, e il mio pranzo non ha fatto nemmeno una domanda sulla presentazione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought the difficult part would be admitting I was curious
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensavo che la parte difficile sarebbe stata ammettere che ero curiosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'm thinking about how to start a conversation without sounding completely unlike myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ora sto pensando a come iniziare una conversazione senza sembrare completamente diversa da me stessa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to suddenly become some incredibly confident person
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non devi diventare all'improvviso una persona incredibilmente sicura di sé

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because I still rehearse phone calls before ordering food
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene, perché ancora faccio delle prove per le telefonate prima di ordinare cibo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And then tell me to call instead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E poi mi dici di chiamare invece

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because you love me 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perché mi ami 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Unfortunately for my phone bill
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Purtroppo per il mio conto telefonico

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do want to try this
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voglio davvero provare questo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just want the first step to feel like something I chose, not something I rushed into because we had a good conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voglio solo che il primo passo sembri qualcosa che ho scelto, non qualcosa in cui mi sono buttata perché abbiamo avuto una bella conversazione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Excellent company
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Compagnia eccellente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we start there
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora iniziamo da lì

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I need to go back. They've found another reason to discuss the slides
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Devo tornare indietro. Hanno trovato un altro motivo per discutere delle diapositive

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stay strong
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Rimani forte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm taking the rest of my lunch with me. It's the only thing I trust right now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Porto via il resto del mio pranzo. È l'unica cosa di cui mi fido in questo momento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're invited next time. Provided you bring your own fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei invitato la prossima volta. A patto che porti le tue patatine

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about yesterday
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho pensato a ieri

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Mostly about what I'd actually feel comfortable doing first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Principalmente su cosa mi sentirei a mio agio a fare per prima

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did you get anywhere?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E sei arrivata a qualche conclusione?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. A little further than just sitting there wondering what you would like
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Un po' più avanti che stare lì a chiedermi cosa ti piacerebbe

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you escape?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei riuscita a scappare?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You mentioning {{name:aiden}} has made very ordinary things feel less ordinary
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il fatto che tu abbia nominato {{name:aiden}} ha reso cose molto ordinarie meno ordinarie

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What things?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quali cose?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if I had the notes from our last class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi ha chiesto se avevo gli appunti dell'ultima lezione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I would just send them
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Di solito li manderei e basta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I stared at the message for a stupid amount of time before remembering he was literally asking for class notes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oggi ho fissato il messaggio per un tempo stupido prima di ricordarmi che stava letteralmente chiedendo appunti di lezione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please tell me you didn't send him a mysterious reply
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per favore dimmi che non gli hai mandato una risposta misteriosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Temporarily
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Temporaneamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He got the notes. Very exciting development
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ha preso gli appunti. Sviluppo molto emozionante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Slow down, you're getting ahead of yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Calmati, stai correndo troppo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shut up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stai zitta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But that's the thing. He's already part of my normal life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma ecco il punto. È già parte della mia vita normale

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If we talk about this and it feels strange afterward, I'll still see him around campus
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Se ne parliamo e poi sembra strano, lo vedrò comunque in giro per il campus

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. I hadn't really thought about the next ordinary lunch together
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Non avevo davvero pensato al prossimo pranzo normale insieme

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ce l'ho

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think that means we shouldn't talk to him
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non penso che significhi che non dovremmo parlargli

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just don't want to treat it like asking him to join us for a game
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non voglio trattarlo come chiedergli di unirsi a noi per una partita

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I understand
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Capisco

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I said I needed lunch and someone asked if we could discuss the slides while I ate
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho detto che avevo bisogno di pranzo e qualcuno ha chiesto se potevamo discutere delle diapositive mentre mangiavo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How would you want to bring it up?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Come vorresti affrontare la cosa?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Alone, for a start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Da sola, per cominciare

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd rather have a slightly awkward conversation than try to explain something personal with my friends listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Preferirei avere una conversazione un po' imbarazzante piuttosto che cercare di spiegare qualcosa di personale con i miei amici che ascoltano

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And probably offering advice nobody asked for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E probabilmente offrendo consigli che nessuno ha chiesto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aspetta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's coming over. I'll text you when I get a moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sta arrivando. Ti scrivo quando ho un momento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN MOMENTO DOPO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is anyone sitting here?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'è qualcuno qui?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Depends. Are you here to steal my lunch?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dipende. Sei qui per rubarmi il pranzo?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you throw the slides at them?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai lanciato le diapositive contro di loro?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Someone joins the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qualcuno si unisce al tavolo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation in progress
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversazione in corso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unexpected Seat
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un Posto Inaspettato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was going to ask about the notes, but now that you've mentioned lunch...
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Volevo chiedere delle note, ma ora che hai parlato del pranzo...

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got the notes. That's your gift for today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai preso le note. È il tuo regalo per oggi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Generous as always
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Generoso come sempre

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You okay? You looked miles away earlier
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stai bene? Sembravi lontano un miglio prima

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah. Just thinking about something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Stavo solo pensando a qualcosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something I can help with?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'è qualcosa con cui posso aiutarti?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe. I'd rather talk about it when it's quieter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Forse. Preferirei parlarne quando è più tranquillo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La conversazione continua

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Attention directed towards the other speaker
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Attenzione rivolta all'altro interlocutore

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I considered it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ci ho pensato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Something to Say
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qualcosa da dire

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh. Okay
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oh. Va bene

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so worried, it's nothing bad
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sembrare così preoccupato, non è nulla di grave

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't worried until you said that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non ero preoccupato fino a quando non l'hai detto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Great, now I've made it sound dramatic
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ottimo, ora l'ho fatta sembrare drammatica

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can tell me when you're ready. I was only coming over to say thanks
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puoi dirmelo quando sei pronto. Sono solo venuto a dirti grazie

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For the notes?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per gli appunti?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For saving me from admitting I hadn't written any of that down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per avermi salvato dall'ammettere che non avevo scritto nulla di tutto ciò

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is. I was wondering why you were being so nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ecco, mi chiedevo perché fossi così gentile.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can be nice without wanting something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Posso essere gentile senza voler qualcosa in cambio.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But I found a table outside instead, so I'm choosing personal growth
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma ho trovato un tavolo fuori, quindi sto scegliendo la crescita personale

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then take your hand away from my fries
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora togli la mano dalle mie patatine!

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Giusto.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Playful exchange at the table
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Scambio giocoso al tavolo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shared laughter
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Risate condivise.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like knowing she's laughing, even if I'm still getting used to the thought of them together.
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piace sapere che sta ridendo, anche se mi sto ancora abituando all'idea di loro due insieme.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Lunch Negotiations
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Negoziati per il pranzo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 20 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 20 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, I have my phone to myself again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok, ho di nuovo il mio telefono tutto per me.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything okay?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tutto ok?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We just had a normal conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Abbiamo appena avuto una conversazione normale.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly brought it up, but there were people sitting right next to us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stavo per tirarlo fuori, ma c'erano persone sedute proprio accanto a noi.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows I want to talk about something. Not what it is
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sa che voglio parlare di qualcosa. Non di cosa si tratta.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Proud of you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fiero di te

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Com'è stata?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Less terrifying than I expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Meno spaventoso di quanto mi aspettassi.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although he did try to steal my lunch, so I couldn't take him too seriously
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Anche se ha cercato di rubarmi il pranzo, quindi non potevo prenderlo troppo sul serio.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds familiar
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Suona familiare.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow I'll find a quieter moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Domani troverò un momento più tranquillo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to see whether we can actually talk about it before deciding anything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voglio vedere se riusciamo davvero a parlarne prima di decidere altro.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay. Tell me how you're feeling tonight
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok. Dimmi come ti senti stasera.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo farò

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Grazie 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I downloaded an app during my break
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho scaricato un'app durante la mia pausa.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You did?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Davvero?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just to see what it was like. I haven't put a profile up or messaged anyone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo per vedere com'era. Non ho messo un profilo o scritto a nessuno

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hang on, I'm trying to remember how to get back to the profile screen
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aspetta, sto cercando di ricordare come tornare alla schermata del profilo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN MOMENTO DOPO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay, found it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ok, l'ho trovato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was less intimidating when I stopped treating every man on the screen like some enormous life decision
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Era meno intimidatorio quando ho smesso di considerare ogni uomo sullo schermo come una decisione di vita enorme

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Any interesting discoveries?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai fatto qualche scoperta interessante?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One man had six pictures of himself next to the same car
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un uomo aveva sei foto di sé accanto alla stessa macchina

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe the car has a good personality
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Forse la macchina ha una bella personalità

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here's my very exclusive lunch spot
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ecco il mio posto per il pranzo super esclusivo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: But I'm warning you right now
Even if she's family, she's getting the exact same treatment as everyone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Anche se è famiglia, avrà lo stesso trattamento di tutti gli altri

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She needs someone to put her in her place
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Ha bisogno di qualcuno che la metta al suo posto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: And while we're talking about people who need to get serious…
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: E mentre parliamo di persone che devono farsi serie…

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Your leg still isn't gonna fix itself if you keep being lazy
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: La tua gamba non si aggiusterà da sola se continui a essere pigro

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: The doctor only took my cast off yesterday, remember?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Il medico mi ha tolto il gesso solo ieri, ricordi?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: Just don't come crying when the real sessions start
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Non venire a piangere quando iniziano le vere sessioni

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.source: She wants to join the training sessions
I might have given her a little push
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_AIDEN_HAILEY_TR.translation: Potrei averle dato una piccola spinta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Did your grand expedition away from the sofa happen, or did the console win?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi 😊 La tua grande spedizione lontano dal divano è avvenuta, o ha vinto la console?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Probably not immediately
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Probabilmente non subito

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's partly why I want to talk face to face. I can tell him to stop making jokes if I need to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È anche per questo che voglio parlare faccia a faccia. Posso dirgli di smettere di fare battute se ne ho bisogno

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please don't tell him how quickly I said his name
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per favore, non dirgli quanto in fretta ho detto il suo nome

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You mean immediately?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vuoi dire subito?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds worse when you say it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Suona peggio quando lo dici tu

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can leave that detail out 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso omettere quel dettaglio 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to show him our messages either. I can explain the situation myself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non gli mostrerò nemmeno i nostri messaggi. Posso spiegare la situazione da sola

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Grazie

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then we'll see how he feels. I'm not inviting him anywhere before we've even managed that conversation
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora vedremo come si sente. Non lo inviterò da nessuna parte prima di aver gestito quella conversazione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know how you're doing when you get a chance
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fammi sapere come va quando hai un momento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I got home, made dinner, and realized I'd cooked enough pasta for a family of six
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Poi sono tornato a casa, ho preparato la cena e mi sono reso conto di aver cucinato abbastanza pasta per una famiglia di sei

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo farò ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wrote a short introduction earlier. Want to read it?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho scritto una breve introduzione prima. Vuoi leggerla?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Send it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mandala.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm in a relationship, and my partner knows I'm here. I'd like to get to know someone, starting with a conversation and maybe a coffee
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono in una relazione e il mio partner sa che sono qui. Vorrei conoscere qualcuno, iniziando con una conversazione e magari un caffè

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That says what you mean
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo dice quello che intendi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't sound too formal?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non suona troppo formale?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little. Add something about yourself that isn't about us
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un po'. Aggiungi qualcosa su di te che non riguardi noi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like my impressive ability to cook six portions of pasta by accident?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tipo la mia impressionante abilità di cucinare sei porzioni di pasta per sbaglio?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's tomorrow sorted
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo è risolto per domani

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly, yes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Onestamente, sì

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like quiet cafés, terrible films, and apparently cooking for people who don't exist
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piacciono i caffè tranquilli, i film terribili e apparentemente cucinare per persone che non esistono

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds much more like you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo suona molto più come te

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're included in the pasta, don't worry 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei incluso nella pasta, non preoccuparti 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I want to try taking one now while the light's nice
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aspetta, voglio provare a farne una adesso che la luce è bella

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to give you a completely unbiased opinion
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cercherò di darti un'opinione completamente imparziale

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That would be a first
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sarebbe una novità

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, this one actually looks like me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, questo sembra davvero me

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And possibly the rest of my life
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E forse il resto della mia vita

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the expression I get when you tell me you've only stolen one fry
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quella è l'espressione che faccio quando mi dici che hai rubato solo una patatina

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I look innocent because I am
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembro innocente perché lo sono

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo is excellent. The legal defense needs work
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La foto è eccellente. La difesa legale ha bisogno di lavoro

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the photo then 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora tengo la foto 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll use that one and read the introduction again tomorrow before I put anything up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Userò quella e leggerò di nuovo l'introduzione domani prima di pubblicare qualcosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I can see if there's someone I actually want to talk to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora posso vedere se c'è qualcuno con cui voglio davvero parlare

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you don't owe anyone a conversation just because they message you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E non devi nulla a nessuno solo perché ti scrivono

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm curious, not accepting applications from the entire internet
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so. Sono curiosa, non sto accettando domande da tutto internet

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now that's a good profile title
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ora quello è un buon titolo per il profilo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not helping anymore
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non stai più aiutando

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could bring some next time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Potresti portarne un po' la prossima volta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm nervous about tomorrow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono nervosa per domani

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I like that it's a small thing I actually want to do, rather than some huge leap I'm trying to be ready for
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma mi piace che sia una piccola cosa che voglio davvero fare, piuttosto che un grande salto per cui sto cercando di essere pronta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me if it turns out to feel different than you expected
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi dirmi se alla fine ti sembra diverso da come ti aspettavi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche tu

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you pretending you're fine just because you were the one who brought it up
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non voglio che fai finta di stare bene solo perché sei stata tu a tirarlo fuori

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I won't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non lo farò

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now, very important question
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ora, domanda molto importante

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Look at you solving my problems
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Guarda te che risolvi i miei problemi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm listening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti ascolto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: When I bring you pasta, are we watching something decent, or are you making me watch another film where nobody turns a light on?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quando ti porto la pasta, guardiamo qualcosa di decente, o mi fai vedere un altro film dove nessuno accende la luce?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's atmosphere
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quella è atmosfera

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's two hours of me asking who's standing in the doorway
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono due ore in cui chiedo chi sta in piedi sulla soglia

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can pick this time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi scegliere questa volta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Davvero?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. But I reserve the right to complain
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Ma mi riservo il diritto di lamentarmi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd be worried if you didn't
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sarei preoccupata se non lo facessi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that afternoon with you, you know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voglio quel pomeriggio con te, lo sai

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not to have another serious discussion. Just to eat too much and sit next to you for a while
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non per avere un'altra discussione seria. Solo per mangiare troppo e stare accanto a te per un po'

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, let me get comfortable before you distract me again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aspetta, fammi sistemare prima di distrarmi di nuovo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want that too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo voglio anch'io

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then don't forget. I'm still claiming my spot on the sofa
