story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora non dimenticare. Rivendico ancora il mio posto sul divano

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It's yours
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È tuo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hang on, I'm moving from the sofa to bed before I fall asleep here
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aspetta, mi sposto dal divano al letto prima di addormentarmi qui

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. I'm saving you the other pillow
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco. Ti sto risparmiando l'altro cuscino

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're really not helping with how much I miss you
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non stai davvero aiutando quanto mi manchi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then come and claim it when you can
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora vieni a prenderlo quando puoi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo farò ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 5 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buona notte, bello ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night. Save me some pasta
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buonanotte. Risparmiami un po' di pasta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is enough pasta to outlive both of us. Go to sleep 😭
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'è abbastanza pasta per sopravvivere a entrambi. Vai a dormire 😭

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Hair still damp, but I'm not moving again
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco. Capelli ancora umidi, ma non mi muovo più.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to fall asleep
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembri sul punto di addormentarti.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I made it to the kitchen and back several times
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono riuscito ad andare in cucina e tornare diverse volte

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not. I've only just sat down
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non lo sono. Mi sono appena seduta.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's usually how it starts
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Di solito è così che inizia.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very funny
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Molto divertente.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to check before tomorrow, actually
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'è qualcosa che volevo controllare prima di domani, in realtà.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go ahead
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vai avanti.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The other night, when I asked what you'd want to know if I sent a picture to someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'altra sera, quando ti ho chiesto cosa vorresti sapere se mandassi una foto a qualcun altro.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember your answer. I just don't want to assume it covers everything we might do
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ricordo la tua risposta. Non voglio dare per scontato che copra tutto quello che potremmo fare.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's fair
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È giusto.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An experienced traveler
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un viaggiatore esperto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, and receive the picture too
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai detto che vorresti sapere e ricevere anche la foto.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. I like the idea of being included in what you choose to share
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Mi piace l'idea di essere incluso in ciò che scegli di condividere.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. But if I'm out talking to someone, I won't necessarily be looking at my phone the whole time
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. Ma se sono fuori a parlare con qualcuno, non starò necessariamente guardando il mio telefono tutto il tempo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to give me updates every five minutes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non ti chiedo di darmi aggiornamenti ogni cinque minuti.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like to see the picture if that's something you decide to share. A conversation is different
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piacerebbe vedere la foto se è qualcosa che decidi di condividere. Una conversazione è diversa.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I don't want you waiting for a message and thinking something's wrong because I'm not typing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. Non voglio che tu aspetti un messaggio e pensi che ci sia qualcosa che non va perché non sto scrivendo.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me when you're free, then we can actually talk
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dimmi quando sei libero, così possiamo davvero parlare.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There was also a little time outside
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'è stato anche un po' di tempo all'aperto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that better
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piace di più.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And don't get too excited about the pictures yet. I haven't even had the first conversation 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E non ti eccitare troppo per le foto ancora. Non ho nemmeno avuto la prima conversazione 😌.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm being very patient
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sto essendo molto paziente.

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're doing a convincing impression of it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stai facendo un'impressione convincente di questo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd want to know, but wouldn't necessarily want the picture yourself
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai detto che vorresti sapere, ma non necessariamente avere la foto tu stessa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That still fits
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Ci sta ancora

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to hear about it from you. I don't need you collecting things to show me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voglio sentirne parlare da te. Non ho bisogno che tu raccolga cose da mostrarmi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's a relief, honestly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È un sollievo, sinceramente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I sat down before I started regretting my ambition
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Poi mi sono seduto prima di iniziare a rimpiangere la mia ambizione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather tell you how something felt than worry about proving it happened
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Preferisco dirti come mi sono sentita piuttosto che preoccuparmi di dimostrare che è successo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not checking your homework
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non sto controllando i tuoi compiti

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough of that today
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. Ne ho avuto abbastanza per oggi

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if you're busy, we can talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E se sei occupato, possiamo parlare dopo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I'll tell you when I've got a moment, rather than trying to keep up a second conversation on my phone
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. Ti dirò quando ho un momento, piuttosto che cercare di mantenere una seconda conversazione sul mio telefono

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You still get my ordinary pictures, by the way. You're not escaping my face that easily 😌
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comunque, ricevi ancora le mie foto normali. Non scappi così facilmente dal mio viso 😌

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't planning to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non avevo intenzione di farlo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That actually sounds sensible
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: In realtà sembra sensato

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you might not want to know
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai detto che potresti non voler sapere

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you mean not knowing about each individual thing, or not having updates while it's happening?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Intendevi non sapere di ogni singola cosa, o non avere aggiornamenti mentre sta succedendo?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hadn't really separated those in my head
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non avevo davvero separato queste cose nella mia testa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's why I'm asking
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco perché sto chiedendo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can understand leaving room for a surprise. I just don't want us to mean two different things without realizing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso capire di lasciare spazio per una sorpresa. Non voglio che significhemo due cose diverse senza rendercene conto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let's agree on the limits, but leave some things as a surprise
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mettiamoci d'accordo sui limiti, ma lasciamo alcune cose come sorpresa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather have no updates during it, then talk afterward
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Preferirei non avere aggiornamenti durante, poi parlare dopo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd rather agree on what we're trying first, then leave room for you not to tell me about every little thing
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Preferirei metterci d'accordo su cosa stiamo provando prima, poi lasciare spazio per non dirmi ogni piccola cosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. A surprise within what we've actually talked about, not me guessing how far that answer goes
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. Una sorpresa su ciò di cui abbiamo realmente parlato, non io a indovinare quanto lontano vada quella risposta

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound surprised
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembri sorpreso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For now, we're only talking about making contact and seeing whether a first date feels right
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per ora, stiamo solo parlando di fare contatto e vedere se un primo appuntamento ci sta bene

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I'm not treating this like we've already agreed to everything else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so. Non sto trattando questa cosa come se avessimo già concordato tutto il resto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if something feels wrong, I'm telling you. I'm not keeping that to myself to preserve the mystery
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E se qualcosa non va, te lo dico. Non me lo tengo per me per mantenere il mistero

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Same for me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo. Lo stesso vale per me

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. That makes more sense to me now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. Ora ha più senso per me

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I think I'd rather not follow everything while it's happening
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Penso che preferirei non seguire tutto mentre succede

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But afterward, I would like to hear how it went and how you felt
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma dopo, mi piacerebbe sapere come è andata e come ti sei sentito

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I put my phone away, have the conversation, and we talk when I'm free
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quindi metto via il telefono, faccio la conversazione e parliamo quando sono libero

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm trying not to ruin the moment
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cerco di non rovinare il momento

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah. That sounds closer to what I meant
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Questo suona più vicino a quello che intendevo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. I can do that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. Posso farlo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I need to talk to you sooner, I'm still going to
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E se ho bisogno di parlarti prima, lo farò comunque

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Obviously. You don't have to stick to some plan when you need me
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ovviamente. Non devi seguire un piano quando hai bisogno di me

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good ❤️
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buono ❤️

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad we talked about that now
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono contenta che ne abbiamo parlato adesso

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I kept imagining myself looking at my phone, wondering whether I was supposed to be sending you something
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Continuavo a immaginarmi a guardare il mio telefono, chiedendomi se dovevo inviarti qualcosa

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want you worrying about that
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non voglio che ti preoccupi per questo

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was the rest of your day?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Com'è andato il resto della tua giornata?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. It's easier now we've actually said it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so. È più facile ora che l'abbiamo effettivamente detto

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So what do you want to do tomorrow?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora, cosa vuoi fare domani?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll ask {{name:aiden}} if we can talk for a few minutes after class
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Chiederò a {{name:aiden}} se possiamo parlare per qualche minuto dopo le lezioni

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want to explain that we've been discussing the idea of me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voglio spiegare che abbiamo discusso l'idea che io vada a un appuntamento con qualcun altro

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And that he's someone I'd consider having that conversation with
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E che lui è qualcuno con cui considererei di avere quella conversazione

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You think he'll believe you're serious?
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensi che crederà che sei serio?

story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We finished our part of the project, so I can finally stop thinking about it
story/DAY16/nts/DAY16_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Abbiamo finito la nostra parte del progetto, quindi posso finalmente smettere di pensarci

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re really trying to keep me busy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Stai davvero cercando di tenermi occupata.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I just didn’t expect you to suggest something like that after last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Non mi aspettavo che suggerissi qualcosa del genere dopo ieri sera.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Don’t take too long or I’ll start without you and buy only junk food
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Non impiegare troppo tempo o inizio senza di te e compro solo cibo spazzatura.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been staring at the same page for twenty minutes
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Sto fissando la stessa pagina da venti minuti.
Shopping + tacos fatti in casa. Ci sei?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: You’re offering to cook with me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Mi stai offrendo di cucinare con me?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Buongiorno ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: She has a permanent invitation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ha un invito permanente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good. Keep that in mind 🤍
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bene. Tienilo a mente 🤍

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: How's your leg after yesterday?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Come va la tua gamba dopo ieri?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A bit stiff when I got up, but better after moving around a little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Un po' rigida quando mi sono alzato, ma meglio dopo essermi mosso un po'

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm glad we stopped when we did
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sono contenta che ci siamo fermati quando lo abbiamo fatto

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. I'll take it easy this morning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Anch'io. Questa mattina farò con calma

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What are you planning?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Cosa hai in mente?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A few things around the house this morning, then probably some games later
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Qualche cosa in casa questa mattina, poi probabilmente qualche gioco più tardi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What about you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E tu?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm spending the afternoon with my family
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Passerò il pomeriggio con la mia famiglia

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I reached for my bag and remembered where it was
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ho cercato la mia borsa e mi sono ricordata dove fosse

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Lunch first. Then apparently we're playing cards
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pranzo prima. Poi apparentemente giochiamo a carte

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Apparently?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Apparentemente?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I was informed. My participation wasn't optional 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sono stata informata. La mia partecipazione non era facoltativa 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Try to come back with your dignity intact
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Cerca di tornare con la tua dignità intatta

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll aim higher. I'm going to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Punterò più in alto. Voglio vincere

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's the spirit
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Questo è lo spirito

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: And then I'll graciously allow them to admire me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: E poi permetterò loro di ammirarmi con grazia

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very gracious
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Molto graziosa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay, I need to get ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ok, devo prepararmi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: It's still beside the sofa
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: È ancora accanto al divano

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Keep my bag safe. I'll collect it when I see you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Tieni al sicuro la mia borsa. La prenderò quando ti vedo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Of course. Have a good time today ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Certo. Divertiti oggi ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You too love
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Anche tu, amore

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: At least one of us got to stay at your place last night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Almeno uno di noi ha potuto restare a casa tua ieri sera

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your bag was very quiet company
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: La tua borsa è stata una compagnia molto silenziosa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then don't get too attached to it 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Allora non affezionarti troppo 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Too late. We've already had breakfast
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Troppo tardi. Abbiamo già fatto colazione

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Without me? Rude
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Senza di me? Scortese

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Here's the person you should have invited instead
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ecco la persona che avresti dovuto invitare invece

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Okay come help me in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ok, vieni ad aiutarmi in cucina.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to just supervise
A while later, after cooking in the kitchen
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Un po' dopo, dopo aver cucinato in cucina.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m still the one in charge of the seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Io sono ancora quella che si occupa del condimento.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re also the one making the biggest mess
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sei anche tu quello che fa il casino più grande

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: And I only bought three unnecessary things
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E ho comprato solo tre cose inutili.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Hai appena fatto una foto a me?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: While I have sauce on my face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Mentre ho la salsa in faccia?
Prova di cosa? La mia sofferenza?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You’re not allowed to say that while I’m covered in taco seasoning
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Non puoi dire così mentre sono coperta di condimento per taco

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Don’t get used to me being this calm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Non abituarti a vedermi così calma

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m only like this because the tacos are almost ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sono così solo perché i taco sono quasi pronti

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Now stop talking and help me finish plating
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ora smettila di parlare e aiutami a finire di impiattare

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: The cookies were looking at me weird
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: I biscotti mi guardavano in modo strano.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m giving us both a solid 8/10
I’m saving the 10 for when we don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Riservo il 10 per quando non rischiamo di far suonare l'allarme antincendio

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You mean when you don’t almost set off the smoke alarm
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Intendi quando non rischi di far suonare l'allarme antincendio

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Comunque... vado a sistemare e poi mi schianto a letto.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m exhausted in the best way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sono stanca, ma in senso buono.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: It helped more than I expected
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: È stato più utile di quanto pensassi.
Non dire 'quando vuoi' così in fretta.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I might start requesting weekly taco nights
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Potrei iniziare a chiedere serate taco settimanali.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Anyway… I’m going to clean up and then crash
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Comunque... vado a sistemare e poi mi schianto a letto.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Proof I carried at least one bag
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Prova che ho portato almeno una borsa.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aggiornamento: il pranzo è stato fantastico

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Say hello to your mom for me
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Saluta tua mamma da parte mia

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: She sends you a kiss back 😘
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ti manda un bacio 😘
Aiutami
Cosa sta succedendo?
Ho quasi finito le mie carte

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: But every time I look pleased, someone makes me draw more
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ma ogni volta che sembro soddisfatta, qualcuno mi fa pescare di più
Allora smettila di sembrare soddisfatta

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Act like your hand is terrible
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Fai finta che la tua mano sia terribile
Questo è il tuo consiglio geniale?
Lasciali sottovalutarti
Le carte sono un disastro

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Fine. I'm trusting you with my reputation
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Va bene. Mi fido di te per la mia reputazione
POCHI MINUTI DOPO
Ho perso di nuovo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you keep a straight face?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sei riuscita a mantenere un'espressione seria?
Per circa dieci secondi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then someone asked why I looked like I was hiding a crime
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Poi qualcuno ha chiesto perché sembravo nascondere un crimine
Quindi il bluff ha bisogno di lavoro

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I think I need a new adviser
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Penso di aver bisogno di un nuovo consigliere

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Harsh. I was working with limited information
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Duro. Stavo lavorando con informazioni limitate

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: They asked who I kept texting
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hanno chiesto chi continuavo a messaggiare
Già?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Did you tell them you were receiving expert assistance?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Hai detto loro che ricevevi assistenza esperta?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I said my boyfriend was helping me lose
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ho detto che il mio ragazzo mi stava aiutando a perdere
Fa male
Solo perché è vero 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You should give them a chance to miss you. Take a break
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Dovresti dare loro la possibilità di sentirti mancare. Fai una pausa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have. I'm getting another slice of cake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: L'ho fatto. Sto prendendo un'altra fetta di torta

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least I'm winning at dessert
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Almeno sto vincendo al dessert
Una forte ripresa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll be home later this afternoon
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tornerò a casa più tardi questo pomeriggio
Sei libera stasera?
Ho perso due volte
Sì. Perché?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I have an idea. I'll tell you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ho un'idea. Ti dico quando sono a casa ❤️
Ora sono curiosa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Let me finish my very important cake first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bene. Fammi finire prima la mia torta molto importante

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Everyone suddenly becomes very competitive when I'm about to win
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Tutti diventano improvvisamente molto competitivi quando sto per vincere
Incluso te?
Quello è diverso

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Look at the face of someone being treated unfairly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Guarda la faccia di qualcuno che viene trattato ingiustamente

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: You look like you're planning revenge
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sembri che stai pianificando una vendetta

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: LATE EVENING — You are back home and have a quiet moment to yourself.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: TARDA SERA — Sei tornato a casa e hai un momento di tranquillità tutto per te.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Really?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Davvero?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd love to play with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sì. Mi piacerebbe giocare con te

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You always sound like you're having fun
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sembri sempre divertirti

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought I'd like to try it with you instead of just hearing about it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pensavo che mi sarebbe piaciuto provarlo con te invece di sentirne solo parlare

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then let's find something we can both enjoy
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Allora troviamo qualcosa che possiamo goderci entrambi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: What about that racing game you mentioned?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Che ne dici di quel gioco di corse di cui hai parlato?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That would work. We can do a private race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene. Possiamo fare una gara privata

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. But you have to explain the controls first
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene. Ma devi spiegarmi prima i controlli

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Deal. I'll send you an invite once you're ready
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Affare fatto. Ti invierò un invito quando sei pronta

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — You both launch the racing game. Before starting, you explain the controls and let {{name:lena}} try a practice lap.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: UN PO' DOPO — Entrambi avviate il gioco di corse. Prima di iniziare, spieghi i controlli e lasci {{name:lena}} provare un giro di prova.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm home
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sono a casa

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Ready. Please appreciate my concentration
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pronta. Per favore, apprezza la mia concentrazione

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very professional. How's the practice lap going?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Molto professionale. Come va il giro di prova?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've met the same wall three times
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ho incontrato lo stesso muro tre volte

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Brake before the corner, then turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Frena prima della curva, poi gira

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're trying to do both at full speed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Stai cercando di fare entrambe le cose a tutta velocità

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I thought speed was the point
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Pensavo che la velocità fosse il punto

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Staying on the road helps too
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Rimanere sulla strada aiuta anche

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. One more practice lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene. Un altro giro di prova

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE FIRST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: DOPO LA PRIMA GARA

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I have a very serious question
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E ho una domanda molto seria

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished so far ahead of me 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sei arrivato così lontano davanti a me 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've played it a lot more. Don't compare your first race to that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: L'ho giocato molto di più. Non confrontare la tua prima gara con quella

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I also got stuck facing the wrong way
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Anch'io sono rimasta bloccata con la macchina girata nel verso sbagliato

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: But you got around the last corner cleanly
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ma sei riuscito a girare l'ultima curva senza problemi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's the one you kept hitting in practice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quella è quella che continuavi a colpire durante la prova

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did notice that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: L'ho notato.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See? You're already getting the timing
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vedi? Stai già migliorando con i tempi.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene. Di nuovo.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Same track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Stessa pista?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I have unfinished business with it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sì. Ho degli affari in sospeso con essa.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm listening
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ti ascolto

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER THE SECOND RACE — {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but completes the track with fewer crashes.
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: DOPO LA SECONDA GARA — {{name:lena}} finisce ancora dietro di te, ma completa il percorso con meno incidenti.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Still lost
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ancora perso.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Check your time, though
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Controlla il tuo tempo, però.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You finished much faster than the first race
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hai finito molto più veloce della prima gara.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I only spun around twice
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E io ho solo sbandato due volte.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Exactly. You remembered to slow down before the sharp corners
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Esatto. Ti sei ricordato di rallentare prima delle curve strette.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was repeating your instructions in my head
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ripetevo le tue istruzioni nella mia testa.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: They worked. That was a much better lap
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hanno funzionato. È stata un giro molto migliore.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're being nice because I'm your girlfriend
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sei gentile perché sono la tua ragazza.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd tell you if you hadn't improved
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te lo direi se non fossi migliorata

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Would you play something with me tonight?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Giocheresti a qualcosa con me stasera?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The faster lap is because you drove better
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Il giro più veloce è perché hai guidato meglio.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay, that's a good answer ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene, è una buona risposta ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Want to stop or try a different track?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vuoi fermarti o provare un'altra pista?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One more on this one
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Un'altra su questa.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want to see if I can do it without crashing at all
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Voglio vedere se riesco a farlo senza incidenti.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: AFTER ONE LAST RACE
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: DOPO UN'ULTIMA GARA

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I nearly had it
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ci sono quasi riuscita.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You only clipped the barrier at the end
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hai solo toccato il guardrail alla fine.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Because I got excited and forgot to brake
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Perché mi sono emozionata e ho dimenticato di frenare.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your first half was really good. Keep doing that and the rest will follow
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La tua prima metà è stata davvero buona. Continua così e il resto seguirà.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. You're asking ME to play?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aspetta. Stai chiedendo a ME di giocare?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I want a rematch another night
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Voglio una rivincita un'altra sera.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'd be very happy with that
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sarei molto felice di questo.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're still smiling about me asking, aren't you?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Stai ancora sorridendo per la mia richiesta, vero?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A little
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Un po'.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I like getting to share this with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi piace condividere questo con te.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. Even if you're annoyingly difficult to catch
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Anch'io. Anche se sei fastidiosamente difficile da prendere.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now you understand why I always want one more round
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ora capisci perché voglio sempre un altro giro.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Unfortunately, yes 😌
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Purtroppo, sì 😌

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Did you play games like this when you were little?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Giocavi a giochi come questo da piccolo?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. I'd lean sideways with the controller like that would help me turn
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sì. Mi piegavo di lato con il controller come se questo mi aiutasse a girare.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sì 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did that tonight 😭
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: L'ho fatto stasera 😭

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then you have excellent instincts
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Allora hai ottimi istinti.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Apparently everyone except the car understood what I wanted
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A quanto pare, tutti tranne la macchina hanno capito cosa volevo.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: We'll work on getting the car involved next time
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La prossima volta lavoreremo per coinvolgere la macchina.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for being patient with me tonight
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Grazie per essere stata paziente con me stasera.

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had a good time. You don't have to win for me to enjoy playing with you
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi sono divertito. Non devi vincere per farmi piacere giocare con te

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I had fun too ❤️
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi sono divertita anche io ❤️

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Getting ready for tomorrow, then bed
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene. Mi preparo per domani, poi a letto

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love. Thanks for asking me to play
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Buonanotte, amore. Grazie per avermi chiesto di giocare

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️ We'll do it again
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Buonanotte ❤️ Lo rifaremo

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Why are you so surprised?
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Perché sei così sorpresa?

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You never suggest it. It's usually me telling you about my games
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non lo suggerisci mai. Di solito sono io a parlarti dei miei giochi

story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm really happy you asked, actually
story/DAY17/love/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: In realtà sono davvero felice che tu l'abbia chiesto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Morning
No
Today I’ve got the whole day free
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Oggi ho tutta la giornata libera

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Miraculously
Want to come shopping with me then?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Vuoi venire a fare shopping con me allora?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shopping?
I need new pants. The doctor took my cast off two days ago, so I can finally wear pants that fit properly again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Mi servono dei pantaloni nuovi. Il medico mi ha tolto il gesso due giorni fa, quindi finalmente posso tornare a indossare pantaloni della mia taglia.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Oh damn, finally
Yes, with pleasure
I’ve been waiting for an excuse to leave the house without academic guilt
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Aspettavo un motivo per uscire di casa senza sensi di colpa accademici

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You up?
Give me thirty minutes to look less like a disaster
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Dammi trenta minuti per sembrare meno un disastro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Take your time
Don’t start without me 😌
Yeah. How are you feeling today?
Better than yesterday
Still a bit tired but my brain isn’t completely soup anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sono ancora un po' stanca, ma il mio cervello non è più completamente in pappa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Good. When are you seeing your professor again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Bene. Quando rivedi il tuo professore?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Probably one day out of two
Sometimes every day if he thinks I need it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: A volte tutti i giorni, se pensa che ne abbia bisogno.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He’s taking this whole “extra sessions” thing pretty seriously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Sta prendendo sul serio questa cosa delle "sessioni extra".

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Today too?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've decided we never watched that film and my reputation is still intact
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ ho deciso che non abbiamo mai visto quel film e la mia reputazione è ancora intatta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, then it wasn't just me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bene, allora non ero solo io

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What about you? Better night?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E tu? Notte migliore?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better, and I got up and made breakfast before checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Molto meglio, e mi sono alzato e ho fatto colazione prima di controllare il telefono

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Without leaving a trail of things you'd dropped?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Senza lasciare un sentiero di cose che hai lasciato cadere?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: One spoon, but I picked it up
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un cucchiaio, ma l'ho raccolto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm proud of your very ambitious morning ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono orgogliosa della tua mattinata così ambiziosa ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've also put both shoes on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho messo anche entrambe le scarpe

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Seduta?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Sitting down
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Seduto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See, you can be taught 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vedi, puoi essere insegnato 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning to you too, detective
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buongiorno anche a te, detective

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How's your breakfast going?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Come va la tua colazione?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's fine, packing my bag is the problem
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene, il problema è fare la valigia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm taking last night's pasta so I don't get robbed by another sandwich
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Porto la pasta di ieri sera così non mi rubano un altro panino

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Future You finally got something out of that dinner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il tuo futuro finalmente ha ottenuto qualcosa da quella cena

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She got food and an extremely full bag
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ha preso cibo e una borsa estremamente piena

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Put the food at the top
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Metti il cibo in cima

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I have to carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Poi devo portare il libro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Carry the book
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Porta il libro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You make everything sound so easy when you're not the one trying to close this zip 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fai sembrare tutto così facile quando non sei tu a cercare di chiudere questa zip 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could leave something at home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potresti lasciare qualcosa a casa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't start, I haven't even had breakfast yet 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non iniziare, non ho nemmeno fatto colazione 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I need all of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho bisogno di tutto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Including whatever's been sitting at the bottom for three weeks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Incluso quello che è rimasto sul fondo per tre settimane?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't know what's at the bottom
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non sai cosa c'è sul fondo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Do you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vero?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's not the point
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non è questo il punto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, I think I've got it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aspetta, penso di aver capito

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please appreciate that I'm dressed and ready before the last possible minute
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Per favore, apprezza che sono vestita e pronta prima dell'ultimo minuto possibile

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look really good ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Stai davvero bene ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Grazie bello 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would a red scarf make you feel better?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Una sciarpa rossa ti farebbe sentire meglio?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The bag looks like it's about to lose a fight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La borsa sembra che stia per perdere una battaglia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Compliment the girl, not the luggage
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fai un complimento alla ragazza, non ai bagagli

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The girl is lovely. The luggage has my sympathy
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La ragazza è adorabile. I bagagli hanno la mia simpatia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Much better 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Molto meglio 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes this morning again?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lezioni di nuovo questa mattina?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, then straight to work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, poi dritto al lavoro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to get everything finished without staring at the clock for the last hour
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi piacerebbe finire tutto senza fissare l'orologio per l'ultima ora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A reasonable goal
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un obiettivo ragionevole

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing with your day?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cosa farai oggi?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Going to clear out that kitchen cupboard I've been avoiding
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vado a svuotare quel mobile della cucina che ho evitato

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will hide your remote the next time I come over
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nasconderò il tuo telecomando la prossima volta che vengo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one where things fall on you when you open it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quella in cui le cose ti cadono addosso quando la apri?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I prefer to think of it as a surprise feature
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Preferisco pensarlo come una funzione a sorpresa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could also just put fewer things in it 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potresti anche semplicemente metterci meno cose 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm making space for the good coffee mugs
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sto facendo spazio per le belle tazze da caffè

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Important, I don't want our first proper coffee together to come out of a measuring jug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Importante, non voglio che il nostro primo vero caffè insieme venga da un misurino

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've ruined my entire presentation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai rovinato tutta la mia presentazione

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save the effort for the coffee, I won't judge the mug too much ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Risparmia le energie per il caffè, non giudicherò troppo la tazza ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather take you out for one soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Preferirei portarti a prenderne uno presto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi piacerebbe

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: All right, I need to leave before being early turns into missing the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene, devo andare prima che arrivare in anticipo si trasformi in perdere l'autobus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like a confession
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra una confessione

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I probably won't be on my phone much this afternoon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Probabilmente non starò molto sul telefono questo pomeriggio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't forget your lunch after all that effort
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non dimenticare il pranzo dopo tutto questo sforzo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's already digging into my side, I couldn't forget it if I tried 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Già mi sta scavando nel fianco, non potrei dimenticarlo nemmeno se ci provassi 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get to the bar tonight, like I said
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti scrivo quando arrivo al bar stasera, come ho detto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, have a good day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ok, buona giornata

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too handsome ❤️ Love you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Anche tu, bello ❤️ Ti amo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Anch'io ti amo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It sounds like a warning 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra un avvertimento 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep well at least?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai dormito bene almeno?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, once I stopped trying to work out how the actual ending made sense
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, una volta che ho smesso di cercare di capire come avesse senso il finale

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It didn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non è successo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The second one looks less tragic
Thanks for the vote of confidence

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sto solo dicendo la verità, non sono cattiva

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I saw something quite nice near the entrance
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho visto qualcosa di carino vicino all'ingresso

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m still buying this one though
We can go pay and get food after
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Possiamo andare a pagare e prendere qualcosa da mangiare dopo.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ We're at the bar, and I've finally sat down somewhere that isn't an office chair
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ Siamo al bar, e finalmente mi sono seduta da qualche parte che non è una sedia da ufficio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep mocking my recommendations, but you seem to like this one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi continuare a prendere in giro le mie raccomandazioni, ma sembra che ti piaccia questa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do like it here
See, that wasn't difficult
You're going to be unbearable about this all night, aren't you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sarai insopportabile su questo per tutta la notte, vero?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only until you stop acting surprised that I have good taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo finché non smetti di fare la sorpresa che ho buon gusto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not giving you that one
You don't have to
And you? What do you actually do when you're not in that office?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E tu? Cosa fai realmente quando non sei in quell'ufficio?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go out, find somewhere good to eat, drive somewhere when I have a free day
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Esci, trova un posto carino dove mangiare, guida da qualche parte quando ho una giornata libera

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tell everyone where to sit when you get there?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E dirai a tutti dove sedersi quando arrivi?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nice, not too busy yet
Someone has to stop them choosing the table by the toilets
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qualcuno deve fermarli dal scegliere il tavolo vicino ai bagni

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're not even denying it
Why would I?
I can't decide whether that's confidence or a complete lack of shame
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non riesco a decidere se sia sicurezza o una totale mancanza di vergogna

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me know when you've made up your mind
As the musicians set up at the other end of the room...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mentre i musicisti si preparano dall'altra parte della stanza...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are they playing here tonight?
Looks like it
I thought that was just equipment from another night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensavo fosse solo attrezzatura di un'altra serata

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your one drink is nearly finished
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il tuo drink è quasi finito

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We've got a little table near the side wall
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Abbiamo un tavolino vicino al muro laterale

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you timing me?
I'm deciding whether to ask for the food menu
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sto decidendo se chiedere il menu del cibo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's one right here
You've noticed
I've been carrying leftover pasta around all day. Let me look at something else
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho portato in giro della pasta avanzata tutto il giorno. Fammi guardare qualcos'altro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your phone again?
I'm checking the time
Your boyfriend waiting to hear from you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il tuo ragazzo aspetta di sentirti?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know what I was doing
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho detto che gli avrei fatto sapere cosa stavo facendo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him the food's good
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dì che il cibo è buono

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why?
So he knows why you're staying
I haven't said I'm staying yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non ho ancora detto che rimango

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been looking at that menu for five minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stai guardando quel menu da cinque minuti

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe I'm hungry
Then stay and eat with me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora resta e mangia con me

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right, I want to hear a bit of the music too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene, voglio sentire un po' di musica anche io

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But I'm choosing the food
I thought you'd say that
Give me a minute, I'm going to let him know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dammi un minuto, gli faccio sapere

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That does look nice
We're going to get something to eat before leaving, there's a band starting here 😊
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Andremo a prendere qualcosa da mangiare prima di partire, c'è una band che inizia qui 😊

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you're staying a bit longer?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quindi rimani un po' più a lungo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I hadn't realised they had live music tonight
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì, non mi ero reso conto che stasera ci fosse musica dal vivo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What are you getting?
A flatbread and fries, nothing very sophisticated
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un pane piatto e delle patatine, niente di molto sofisticato

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than carrying your lunch around all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Meglio che portare il tuo pranzo in giro per tutta la sera

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That container is empty now, it can stop judging my decisions 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quella scatola è vuota ora, può smettere di giudicare le mie decisioni 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought you were just going for a drink
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensavo stessi solo andando a bere qualcosa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did too, but we're having a nice time and I haven't eaten since lunch
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anch'io, ma ci stiamo divertendo e non mangio da pranzo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right
And the chair isn't trying to destroy my back, which I appreciate
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E la sedia non sta cercando di distruggere la mia schiena, cosa che apprezzo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll still text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti scriverò comunque quando sono a casa ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay
When the food arrives...
Dinner, before I eat all the fries 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cena, prima che mangi tutte le patatine 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Looks good
It smells good too, I'm going to eat while it's hot
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ha anche un buon profumo, mangio mentre è caldo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy your food
Talk in a bit ❤️
Are the fries allowed to be eaten now?
Have you ordered?
I took one photo, you'll survive
They looked better without the phone between us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Erano meglio senza il telefono tra di noi

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have my attention without being dramatic about it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi avere la mia attenzione senza fare la drama queen

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then put it down and try that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora mettilo giù e prova così

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The flatbread?
No, the tablecloth
Keep talking and I'll eat your half too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Continua a parlare e mangerò anche la tua metà

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ordered extra fries for a reason
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho ordinato patatine extra per un motivo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do have your uses
Careful, that's nearly another compliment
Not yet, I'm still looking
A few songs into the set...
What did you say?
Move your chair over here, I'm not shouting across the table
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sposta la tua sedia qui, non voglio urlare dall'altra parte del tavolo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just asked me to sit next to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Potevi semplicemente chiedermi di sedermi accanto a te

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I just did
In the most bossy way possible
And yet you're moving the chair
Because I can't hear you, don't look so pleased
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Perché non ti sento, non sembrare così compiaciuto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not stopping you
Let me move my bag before you put your foot through it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fammi spostare la mia borsa prima che ci metti il piede dentro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll let you get on with it
Is the book getting its own chair too?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche il libro avrà la sua sedia?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It has better manners than you, it deserves one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ha migliori maniere di te, se lo merita

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} moves her chair beside her manager to hear him over the music
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} sposta la sua sedia accanto al suo manager per sentirlo sopra la musica

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She leans closer to answer him, her hand resting briefly on his forearm
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si avvicina per rispondergli, la mano appoggiata brevemente sul suo avambraccio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
It's the hand on his arm that gets to me. Such a small gesture, and I'm sitting here wondering how much closer they'll get.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È la mano di lei sul suo braccio che mi colpisce. Un gesto così piccolo, e io sono qui a chiedermi quanto ancora si avvicineranno.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
A Little Closer
You know this one?
Yeah, don't ask me to sing it
I wasn't going to risk the evening
Excuse you, I might be very good
You might. I'm enjoying this too much to find out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Potresti. Mi sto divertendo troppo per scoprirlo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're horrible
Did the cupboard survive you?
You laughed
That doesn't make you less horrible
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo non ti rende meno orribile

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're different out here
Less tired than I was at six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Meno stanco di quanto fossi alle sei?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You actually hold my gaze when you're talking to me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: In realtà mi fissi negli occhi quando parli con me

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe you stare too much
I like looking at you
You could try being subtle
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Potresti provare a essere più sottile

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I could. I don't see the point
I noticed
It's currently in several piles across the kitchen
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Attualmente è in diversi mucchi in tutta la cucina

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already an improvement
After the set, with the plates cleared...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dopo il concerto, con i piatti puliti...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I should check the bus times
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dovrei controllare gli orari degli autobus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll get the bill
I can pay for my food
I invited you
That doesn't mean I can't pay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo non significa che non possa pagare

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It means I'm paying tonight
You really are like this everywhere
You haven't had a boring evening, have you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non hai avuto una serata noiosa, vero?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll give you that
So you're at the point where you regret starting 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quindi sei arrivata al punto in cui ti penti di aver iniziato 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
There's a bus in about twenty minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'è un autobus tra circa venti minuti

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Plenty of time. Get your jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Abbiamo tempo. Prendi la tua giacca

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please?
Get your jacket, please
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prendi la tua giacca, per favore

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See, you can learn
Deeply
Leave me at least one usable mug, okay?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lasciami almeno una tazza utilizzabile, ok?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises
I'm putting my phone down for a bit, I'll text you when I'm home ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Metto giù il telefono per un po', ti scrivo quando sono a casa ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, talk later
At their table, a little later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Al loro tavolo, un po' dopo...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation at the bar is detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si sente una conversazione al bar vicino a {{name:lena}}

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said this was a drink after work. I want to believe I can relax about it, but I keep looking at the screen.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ha detto che era un drink dopo il lavoro. Voglio credere di potermi rilassare, ma continuo a guardare lo schermo.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
You look good
You saw me at work an hour ago
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi hai visto al lavoro un'ora fa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food too, so it's winning by a lot 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'è anche cibo, quindi sta vincendo alla grande 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You looked good then too
Is that why you kept looking over?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È per questo che continuavi a guardare?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You thought I was checking whether you'd finished the report?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensavi che stessi controllando se avevi finito il rapporto?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're supposed to be
The report got finished, didn't it?
