story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il rapporto è stato finito, vero?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No work talk tonight
You brought it up
I can already tell you're going to be exhausting
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso già dire che sarai estenuante

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is that how you speak to your boss ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È così che parli al tuo capo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Should I remind you what my boss did to me ?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Devo ricordarti cosa ha fatto il mio capo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you finish on time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei riuscita a finire in tempo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ..what good weather we have today
Yeah I thought so
You've been smiling since you sat down. I'll take my chances
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai sorriso da quando ti sei seduto. Proverò a rischiare

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You always this pleased with yourself?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei sempre così soddisfatto di te stesso?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: On a good evening
We've barely started
Exactly
Right, before your head gets any bigger, what are you having?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Giusto, prima che la tua testa diventi ancora più grande, cosa prendi?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get the ginger one, it's good here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prendi quello allo zenzero, è buono qui

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you give instructions everywhere you go?
Just about, I had to put the lunch container back in my bag very carefully
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quasi, ho dovuto rimettere il contenitore del pranzo nella borsa con molta attenzione

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only when I know what I'm talking about
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo quando so di cosa parlo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So in your opinion, everywhere
You're getting to know me
Unfortunately
I'm having the orange one
Just to disagree with me?
Because I like it. Shocking, I know
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Perché mi piace. Scioccante, lo so

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fine, but don't ask for mine when you change your mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene, ma non chiedere il mio quando cambi idea

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't worry, I wouldn't give you the satisfaction
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non preoccuparti, non ti darei la soddisfazione

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After their drinks arrive...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dopo che arrivano le loro bevande...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still carrying the book too?
Okay, the table was a good choice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, il tavolo era una buona scelta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So was the bar
You can accept one compliment without collecting the rest
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi accettare un complimento senza doverne collezionare altri

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Why stop at one?
Do you come here a lot?
Often enough to know which table isn't beside the speaker
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sufficientemente spesso da sapere quale tavolo non è vicino all'altoparlante

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very strategic
I brought a friend here for his birthday last month. He'd invited six people and booked nowhere
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il mese scorso ho portato un amico qui per il suo compleanno. Aveva invitato sei persone e non aveva prenotato niente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds organised
He called it being spontaneous. I called the owner
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lui lo chiamava essere spontaneo. Io ho chiamato il proprietario

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, it has experienced a full working day without being opened once
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì, ha passato un'intera giornata lavorativa senza essere aperto nemmeno una volta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So your story about saving the evening is actually a story about knowing someone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quindi la tua storia su come salvare la serata è in realtà una storia su come conoscere qualcuno

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We ate, didn't we?
I hope he bought your dinner after that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Spero che ti abbia comprato la cena dopo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. If I'm organising it and paying for it, we can celebrate my birthday instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo. Se lo organizzo io e pago io, possiamo festeggiare il mio compleanno invece

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There it is
What?
The part where you make yourself the main event
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La parte in cui ti fai diventare l'evento principale

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're welcome to tell the next story
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei libero di raccontare la prossima storia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't think I can compete with your heroic table reservation
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non credo di poter competere con la tua eroica prenotazione del tavolo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can try
A useful contribution
All right, yesterday my professor explained the wrong slide for ten minutes
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene, ieri il mio professore ha spiegato la diapositiva sbagliata per dieci minuti

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody said anything?
We were all writing it down. I had half a page before someone finally asked
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eravamo tutti a scrivere. Avevo già mezza pagina prima che qualcuno finalmente chiedesse

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You should have interrupted him
I was busy assuming he knew more than I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ero occupato a pensare che lui sapesse più di me

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You make that mistake with everyone in charge?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fai questo errore con tutti quelli in carica?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less and less lately
Good
That wasn't a compliment to you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non era un complimento per te

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't take it as one
Emotional support literature 😌
That makes a change
{{name:lena}} laughs with her manager over their drinks
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} ride con il suo manager mentre bevono qualcosa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Visual capture archived
That smile hurts more than I expected. I used to see it and feel like the person she wanted to be with.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quel sorriso fa più male di quanto mi aspettassi. Prima lo vedevo e mi sentivo la persona con cui voleva stare.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
Away From the Office
What are you doing when classes finish?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cosa fai quando finiscono le lezioni?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sleeping until I don't hate my alarm anymore
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dormire fino a quando non odio più la mia sveglia

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After that
I want a day at the beach with a book and no timetable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voglio una giornata in spiaggia con un libro e senza orari

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not some big organised thing, just enough time that I don't have to keep checking my phone
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non qualche grande cosa organizzata, solo abbastanza tempo per non dover controllare il mio telefono

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know a good stretch away from the main beach
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Conosco un bel tratto lontano dalla spiaggia principale

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you do
What's the place like?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I hope your professor gives you a ton of punishment exercises tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Spero che il tuo prof ti dia un sacco di esercizi di punizione domani.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That doesn’t bother me at all
Extra work with him is… fine
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Lavorare di più con lui è... ok
Mi è appena venuta in mente una cosa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Anyway I’m going to sleep before you start interrogating me again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Comunque, vado a dormire prima che tu ricominci a interrogarmi.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We went shopping for my pants and somehow you still ended up buying more stuff than me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Siamo andati a comprare i miei pantaloni e in qualche modo hai comprato più cose di me

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re a threat to the shopping industry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sei una minaccia per il mondo dello shopping.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And yet you still invited me

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little after nine, outside the bar...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Poco dopo le nove, fuori dal bar...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like me
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sembri me

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Someone has to
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Qualcuno deve farlo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Fine, I'll get it in a minute 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Va bene, lo prendo tra un minuto 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: How did your afternoon go? Did you finish the cupboard?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Com'è andato il tuo pomeriggio? Sei riuscita a finire l'armadietto?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Finished it and then somehow started on the drawer underneath
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: L'ho finito e poi in qualche modo ho iniziato a sistemare il cassetto sotto.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's how it gets you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ecco come ti prende.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I found enough takeaway cutlery to open a restaurant
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ho trovato abbastanza posate da asporto per aprire un ristorante.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Please tell me you threw some of it away
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Per favore, dimmi che ne hai buttato via un po'.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most of it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La maggior parte.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Most?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La maggior parte?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't make me regret saying it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non farmi pentire di averlo detto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There might be a sudden fork emergency
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Potrebbe esserci un'emergenza forchetta improvvisa.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll keep that in mind if mine goes missing 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo terrò a mente se la mia sparisce 😌.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It's actually nice having it sorted though
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: È davvero bello averlo sistemato, però.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Now you can find the mugs without something landing on you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ora puoi trovare le tazze senza che ti cada addosso qualcosa.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll be impressed
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ti impressionerà.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to ask about that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Stavo per chiedere di quello.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: My collection of forks?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La mia collezione di forchette?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Coming over, idiot ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vengo da te, idiota ❤️.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I checked tomorrow's hours before I left today. I finish at five
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ho controllato gli orari di domani prima di partire oggi. Finisco alle cinque.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Can I come over after work? Around six?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Posso venire dopo il lavoro? Verso le sei?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Too late, I'm keeping that one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Troppo tardi, me lo tengo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, of course
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sì, certo.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You don't have somewhere else to be?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non hai un altro posto dove andare?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I'd like to spend the evening with you
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No, mi piacerebbe passare la serata con te.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'd like that too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Anche a me piacerebbe.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We can make something to eat, and you can pick a film that doesn't insult both of us
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Possiamo preparare qualcosa da mangiare e tu puoi scegliere un film che non insulti entrambi.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sure you can cope without solving a crime?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sei sicura di poter resistere senza risolvere un crimine?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll investigate the kitchen cupboard instead
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Invece, indagherò sull'armadietto della cucina.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A much more dangerous assignment
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Un incarico molto più pericoloso.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll bring protective equipment 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Porterò l'attrezzatura protettiva 😭.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed having you here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Mi è mancato averti qui.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Obviously
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ovviamente

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I missed it too
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Anche a me è mancato.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And I want an actual hug, not another message about one
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: E voglio un abbraccio vero, non un altro messaggio su uno.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That can be arranged
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Si può organizzare.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good ❤️ I'll text you when I leave work tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Bene ❤️ ti scriverò quando esco dal lavoro domani.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll be here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sarò qui.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'd better be, I'm not putting up with a full day just to find you've gone out 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Fai bene a esserci, non voglio passare un'intera giornata solo per scoprire che sei uscita 😌.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll make room on the sofa
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Farò spazio sul divano.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't take the good cushion
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non prendere il cuscino buono.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Still making demands from your own house
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Continui a fare richieste dalla tua casa.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Always ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sempre ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your stop is down here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La tua fermata è qui giù

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay, I'm going to bed before I fall asleep with the light on
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Va bene, vado a letto prima di addormentarmi con la luce accesa.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you take the lunch box out?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Hai tolto la scatola del pranzo?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, it's in the sink. You can stop supervising me now 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sì, è nel lavandino. Puoi smettere di sorvegliarmi ora 😭.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll consider it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo prenderò in considerazione.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Buonanotte bello, ti voglio bene ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Love you too, see you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ti voglio bene anche io, ci vediamo domani

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: See you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ci vediamo domani ❤️

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know where it is
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: So dove si trova

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The music was good. I'd have stayed longer if I didn't have things to do tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La musica era bella. Sarei rimasta più a lungo se non avessi cose da fare domani

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: We'll know for next time
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo sapremo per la prossima volta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're already deciding there's a next time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Stai già decidendo che ci sarà un'altra volta?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm saying I'd take you out again
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Dico che ti porterei di nuovo fuori

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You could leave a little room for uncertainty
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Potresti lasciare un po' di spazio per l'incertezza

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The conversation continues as the two subjects walk toward the bus stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: La conversazione continua mentre i due soggetti si dirigono verso la fermata dell'autobus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They're walking out together. I should be glad the evening is ending, but I can't shake the feeling that I'm waiting for something worse.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Stanno andando via insieme. Dovrei essere felice che la serata stia finendo, ma non riesco a liberarmi dalla sensazione di aspettare qualcosa di peggio.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//TRASCRIZIONE IN DIRETTA

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Why? I know what I want
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Perché? So cosa voglio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That must be nice
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Deve essere bello

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You weren't exactly rushing for the door either
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non stavi esattamente correndo verso la porta neanche tu

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, I wasn't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No, non lo ero

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: They stop on a quieter corner, with the bus stop visible farther along the street...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Si fermano in un angolo più tranquillo, con la fermata dell'autobus visibile più avanti lungo la strada...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I've wanted to kiss you again all evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ho voluto baciarti di nuovo per tutta la sera

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You really don't keep anything to yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non tieni davvero nulla per te

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Not that
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non quello

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't get ahead of yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non farti prendere la mano

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then stop looking at my mouth
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Allora smettila di guardare la mia bocca

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I didn't realise how loud it was in there until we came outside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non mi ero reso conto di quanto fosse rumoroso lì dentro fino a quando non siamo usciti

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I don't
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non lo faccio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I have a boyfriend. That hasn't changed since yesterday
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ho un ragazzo. Questo non è cambiato da ieri

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know. I'm not pretending I only invited you out to talk about work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo so. Non sto facendo finta di averti invitato solo per parlare di lavoro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, you've made that very clear
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No, l'hai reso molto chiaro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: For once, can you stop looking so smug?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Per una volta, puoi smettere di sembrare così compiaciuto?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're making that difficult
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo stai rendendo difficile

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: {{name:lena}} draws him closer by his jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: {{name:lena}} lo tira più vicino per la giacca

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The manager leans in and kisses her; she returns the kiss
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Il manager si avvicina e la bacia; lei ricambia il bacio

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Cattura visiva archiviata

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: She's pulling him closer this time. I can't tell myself this is only something he did to her anymore.
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Questa volta è lei a tirarlo più vicino. Non posso più dirmi che sia soltanto qualcosa che lui le ha fatto.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Before the Bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Prima dell'autobus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't say it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non dirlo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Say what?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Dire cosa?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You were managing to make yourself heard
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Riuscivi a farti sentire

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Whatever smug thing you're about to say
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Qualsiasi cosa compiaciuta tu stia per dire

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I was going to say I had a good evening
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Stavo per dire che ho passato una bella serata

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Somehow you still made that sound smug
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: In qualche modo hai comunque fatto sembrare che fosse compiaciuto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You'll get used to it
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ti ci abituerai

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Don't push your luck
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non tentare la sorte

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Worth a try
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Vale la pena provare

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I need to go now
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Devo andare ora

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your bus isn't here yet
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Il tuo autobus non è ancora arrivato

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I know, but I'm going to wait at the stop
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo so, ma aspetterò alla fermata

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right. See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Va bene. Ci vediamo domani

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Only because you were making me lean right over to answer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Solo perché mi costringevai a piegarmi per rispondere

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At work
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Al lavoro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That's where I'll be
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: È lì che sarò

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Buona notte

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Good night, {{name:lena}}
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Buonanotte, {{name:lena}}

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A little later, on the bus home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Poco dopo, sull'autobus di ritorno a casa...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm on the bus ❤️ I'll be home soon
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sono sull'autobus ❤️ Sarò a casa presto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Did you get a seat?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Hai trovato un posto?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and my bag has finally been taken off my shoulder
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sì, e la mia borsa è finalmente stata tolta dalla mia spalla

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The book will be relieved
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Il libro sarà sollevato

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: It has had a much more exciting day than it deserved 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ha avuto una giornata molto più emozionante di quanto meritasse 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You didn't seem to mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Non sembravi infastidito

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Was it a long walk to the stop?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: È stata una lunga passeggiata fino alla fermata?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: No, he walked with me as far as the corner, then I went to wait for the bus
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: No, è venuto con me fino all'angolo, poi sono andata ad aspettare l'autobus

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Va bene

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll text you when I'm inside
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ti scrivo quando sono dentro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: All right
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Va bene

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Once she is home...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Una volta che è a casa...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Hey ❤️ I'm home, did you manage to stay awake?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ehi ❤️ sono a casa, sei riuscito a rimanere sveglio?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I'm still here
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sì, sono ancora qui

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sorry we stayed later than I expected
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Scusa, siamo rimasti più a lungo di quanto pensassi

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You had a good time?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ti sei divertito?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You're very quick to decide what I do and don't mind
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sei molto veloce a decidere cosa mi piace e cosa no

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sì, mi sono divertita

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The food was good and the band ended up playing a full set
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Il cibo era buono e la band ha suonato un intero set

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: What sort of music?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Che tipo di musica?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Mostly covers, a couple I knew and several I pretended I knew 😭
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Per lo più cover, alcune le conoscevo e altre facevo finta di conoscere 😭

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You do that?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Lo fai?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A very convincing nod gets you surprisingly far
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Un cenno molto convincente ti porta sorprendentemente lontano

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'll remember that next time you watch me play something
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Me lo ricorderò la prossima volta che mi guardi suonare qualcosa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That is completely different, I always understand your highly complicated game decisions 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Quella è completamente diversa, capisco sempre le tue decisioni di gioco altamente complicate 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sure you do
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Certo che lo fai

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: The bar was nice though. I hadn't been there before
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Il bar era carino però. Non ci ero mai stata prima

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Then tell me. Did you have a good evening?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Allora dimmi. Hai passato una bella serata?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Your manager picked it?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Il tuo manager l'ha scelto?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yeah, and he spent a good part of the evening making sure I appreciated his excellent taste
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sì, e ha passato buona parte della serata assicurandosi che apprezzassi il suo ottimo gusto

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Sounds like he's the same outside work then
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sembra che sia lo stesso anche fuori dal lavoro

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: He definitely likes getting his own way
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Gli piace decisamente avere la sua strada

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: And you?
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: E tu?

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I made him add 'please' when he told me to get my jacket
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Gli ho fatto aggiungere 'per favore' quando mi ha detto di prendere la mia giacca

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Big achievement
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Grande risultato

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm choosing to count it 😌
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Scelgo di contarlo 😌

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: You sound like you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sembri esserti divertito

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I did, it was nice to get out for a bit
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sì, è stato bello uscire un po'

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Yes, I did
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sì, l'ho avuta

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: I'm glad you're home
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sono felice che sei a casa

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Anch'io ❤️.

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Give me a minute to change, I don't want to sit around in these clothes any longer
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Dammi un minuto per cambiarmi, non voglio restare in questi vestiti ancora a lungo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Okay
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Va bene

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: A few minutes later...
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Qualche minuto dopo...

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There, no shoes and nothing left to carry
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ecco, niente scarpe e nulla da portare

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: That looks more comfortable
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Sembra più comodo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: Much. The bag can wait until morning
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Molto. La borsa può aspettare fino a domani

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: At least take the lunch box out
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Almeno togli la scatola del pranzo

story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..source: There we go
story/DAY17/ntr/DAY17_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTR..translation: Ecco fatto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So, how's the future graduate feeling today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Allora, come si sente il futuro laureato oggi?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can't wait to finally have my diploma in my hands
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non vedo l'ora di avere finalmente il mio diploma tra le mani

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Easy to forget when he's always in sportswear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Facile da dimenticare quando è sempre in abbigliamento sportivo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I mostly want my summer body
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Voglio soprattutto il mio corpo estivo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That comment yesterday really got to you, huh?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quel commento di ieri ti ha colpita, eh?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I want to look good in a bikini this summer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Voglio sembrare bene in bikini quest'estate

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: So I need to start now
We have a session planned today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Abbiamo una sessione programmata per oggi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm not completely sure about the diploma yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non sono del tutto sicuro riguardo al diploma ancora

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: And yet you're the one who suggested I keep him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Eppure sei stata tu a suggerire di tenerlo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: But I'm going to keep pushing until the end
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ma continuerò a spingere fino alla fine

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I didn't think studying with Ethan would give you this much motivation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non pensavo che studiare con Ethan ti desse così tanta motivazione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: The carrot at the end of the stick is very motivating 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: La carota alla fine del bastone è molto motivante 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You're not even trying to hide it anymore
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non stai nemmeno cercando di nasconderlo più

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can come down whenever you want

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good morning ❤️ I've lost an earring and somehow decided it's your fault, how's your morning going?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buongiorno ❤️ Ho perso un orecchino e ho deciso che è colpa tua, come va la tua mattina?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was suspiciously smooth for someone who's just woken up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È stato sospettosamente fluido per qualcuno che si è appena svegliato

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've been awake a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono sveglia da un po'

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Couldn't sleep?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non sei riuscita a dormire?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I woke up early and couldn't get comfortable again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi sono svegliato presto e non sono riuscito a trovare una posizione comoda

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Nothing dramatic, just an argument with the pillows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Niente di drammatico, solo una lite con i cuscini

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could have messaged me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potevi scrivermi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You would have answered and then blamed me for being tired
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu avresti risposto e poi mi avresti dato la colpa per essere stanca.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's completely different from blaming you for jewelry
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È completamente diverso dal darti la colpa per i gioielli.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Wait, found it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aspetta, l'ho trovato!

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That is an impressive accusation before breakfast
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È un'accusa impressionante prima di colazione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It was caught in my sleeve the entire time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Era bloccato nella mia manica tutto il tempo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like that apology in writing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vorrei quella scusa per iscritto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Dear handsome, I regret that the evidence failed to support my very reasonable accusation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Caro bello, mi dispiace che le prove non abbiano supportato la mia accusa molto ragionevole.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Accepted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Accettato.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Excellent, now help me decide whether these look all right together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ottimo, ora aiutami a decidere se questi stanno bene insieme.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: 2 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: 2 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Both earrings, both shoes, actual lecture notes in the bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Entrambi gli orecchini, entrambe le scarpe, appunti veri nella borsa.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convincing impression of a woman who has her life together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un'impressione molto convincente di una donna che ha la sua vita in ordine.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, it took several attempts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Grazie, ci sono voluti diversi tentativi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was reading your messages while putting them on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Stavo leggendo i tuoi messaggi mentre li mettevo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And yes, they look good together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E sì, stanno bene insieme.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good, because I'm not changing again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bene, perché non mi cambio di nuovo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were never going to listen to me, were you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non avresti mai ascoltato me, vero?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not if you were wrong 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non se avevi torto 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling about today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Come ti senti riguardo a oggi?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I messaged {{name:aiden}} before I started getting ready
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho messaggiato {{name:aiden}} prima di iniziare a prepararmi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I laughed, dropped one, and now I have one very elegant ear
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Poi ho riso, ne ho fatto cadere uno e ora ho un orecchio molto elegante

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Asked if he had a few minutes after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gli ho chiesto se aveva qualche minuto dopo le lezioni.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What did he say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cosa ha detto?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, and then he asked whether he should bring the notes he borrowed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, e poi ha chiesto se doveva portare gli appunti che ha preso in prestito.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: At least he remembers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Almeno si ricorda

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He still has no idea what I want to talk about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non ha ancora idea di cosa voglio parlare

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Which is making me want to explain the entire thing by text just to get the first sentence over with
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Questo mi fa venire voglia di spiegare tutto via messaggio, giusto per togliermi il pensiero della prima frase

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Would that actually make it easier?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Questo lo renderebbe davvero più facile?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For about ten seconds
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Per circa dieci secondi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then I'd spend the whole morning wondering whether he was laughing at his phone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Poi passerei tutta la mattina a chiedermi se stava ridendo del suo telefono

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're allowed to open with something awkward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puoi iniziare con qualcosa di imbarazzante

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let me see the damage
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fammi vedere i danni

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know, but I was hoping to skip straight to being charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo so, ma speravo di passare direttamente a essere affascinante

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You managed with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ce l'hai fatta con me

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You were an unusually forgiving audience ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei stata un pubblico insolitamente indulgente ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You had me at the first insult
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi hai conquistato con il primo insulto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then perhaps I should start by telling him he's annoying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Allora forse dovrei iniziare dicendogli che è fastidioso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might not realize this is a special conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potrebbe non rendersi conto che questa è una conversazione speciale

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly my concern
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esattamente la mia preoccupazione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll talk to him properly after class, before I give myself another excuse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Parlerò con lui seriamente dopo le lezioni, prima di darmi un'altra scusa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sound much too pleased about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembri troppo contenta di questo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I published the profile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho pubblicato il profilo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Already?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Già?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Before I could rewrite the introduction for the sixth time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Prima di poter riscrivere l'introduzione per la sesta volta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The photo from last night, the bit about being in a relationship, and my very attractive pasta problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La foto di ieri sera, il pezzo sulla relazione, e il mio molto attraente problema con la pasta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A strong introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un'introduzione forte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I added that I mean a real coffee in a real café, not someone inviting himself to my place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho aggiunto che intendo un vero caffè in un vero caffè, non qualcuno che si invita a casa mia

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra proprio una cosa da te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put the phone face down afterward like it might start giving me instructions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho messo il telefono a faccia in giù, come se potesse iniziare a darmi istruzioni

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You know you don't have to answer anything during class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sai che non devi rispondere a niente durante le lezioni

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I do, and I'm leaving it alone until my break
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo so, e lo lascerò in pace fino alla mia pausa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Mostly because I don't want my first reply to contain a sentence from today's lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Principalmente perché non voglio che la mia prima risposta contenga una frase della lezione di oggi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Depends on the lecture
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dipende dalla lezione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No man deserves my notes on research methods as an introduction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nessun uomo merita le mie note sui metodi di ricerca come introduzione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find someone with very specific interests
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potresti trovare qualcuno con interessi molto specifici

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already have one of those 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne ho già uno di quelli 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Fair enough
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Giusto così

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It feels strange that it's actually there now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È strano che ora sia davvero lì

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But I'm glad I pressed the button instead of spending another day adjusting commas
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma sono contenta di aver premuto il pulsante invece di passare un'altra giornata a sistemare le virgole

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I see the problem
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vedo il problema

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What time do you finish?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A che ora finisci?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Around lunch, unless someone discovers a question just as we're leaving
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Intorno all'ora di pranzo, a meno che qualcuno non scopra una domanda proprio mentre stiamo uscendo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I have a book to return before the library starts sending me threateningly polite emails
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E ho un libro da restituire prima che la biblioteca inizi a mandarmi email minacciosamente educate

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A busy day of facing your enemies
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Una giornata intensa a fronteggiare i tuoi nemici

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You, university, the library
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tu, università, la biblioteca

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm on the list?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono nella lista?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You made me miss you while I was trying to get dressed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi hai fatto sentire la tua mancanza mentre cercavo di vestirmi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Prego

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That wasn't a thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quella non era una risposta di ringraziamento

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I put your pasta in a separate container, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho messo la tua pasta in un contenitore separato, tra l'altro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Finalmente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So now I have a very practical reason to come over soon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quindi ora ho una ragione molto pratica per venire presto da te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You already have several very impractical ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne hai già diverse di molto impratiche

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Those are my favorites ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Queste sono le mie preferite ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay, leaving now before I start another conversation with you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ok, vado via ora prima di iniziare un'altra conversazione con te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good luck today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buona fortuna oggi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Grazie, bello

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And have some breakfast that didn't come out of a packet next to the console
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E fai colazione con qualcosa che non esce da un pacchetto accanto alla console

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've narrowed down my options considerably
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai ridotto notevolmente le mie opzioni

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You still look beautiful, which weakens your case against me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei ancora bellissima, il che indebolisce la tua posizione contro di me

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have a crush on him, don't you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hai ancora una cotta per lui, vero?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm ready, let's go before you say something even worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sono pronta, andiamo prima che dici qualcosa di ancora peggio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're going to be late for {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sto ancora scegliendo il mio outfit

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You're not going to a party
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Non stai andando a una festa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I know… but I still want to look good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Lo so… ma voglio comunque sembrare carina

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: But with that outfit he's only going to be looking at your ass the whole time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma con quell'outfit lui guarderà solo il tuo sedere tutto il tempo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I still can't believe you're continuing after the main exam
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Non riesco ancora a credere che continui dopo l'esame principale

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a really good supervisor
Or rather… really good punishments and rewards 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: O meglio... davvero buone punizioni e ricompense 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You still have to actually study though
It's hard to focus when you do that…
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: È difficile concentrarsi quando fai così...
Integrità della sessione di studio compromessa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So the reward came before the work this time, and my feelings about that are harder to joke away.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quindi questa volta la ricompensa è arrivata prima del lavoro, e diventa più difficile nascondere quello che provo dietro le battute.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of physical reward during study session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove di ricompensa fisica durante la sessione di studio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'll do my best to make sure you get the best grade possible then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Farò del mio meglio per assicurarmi che tu prenda il voto migliore possibile allora

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Ethan is coming to pick me up
Why doesn't he just come to the house?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Perché non viene direttamente a casa?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: We're more comfortable at his place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ci sentiamo più a nostro agio a casa sua

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Classes are over, I returned the library book, and I've stolen a sunny spot on the steps
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ehi 😊 Le lezioni sono finite, ho restituito il libro in biblioteca e mi sono presa un posto soleggiato sui gradini

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because if we're going to try something like this, I'd rather it was with someone we trust
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perché se dobbiamo provare qualcosa del genere, preferisco farlo con qualcuno di cui ci fidiamo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Both of you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Entrambi voi?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He trusts you, and so do I
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Lui si fida di te, e anche io.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you can joke about absolutely anything, but I also know I can tell you when something matters
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: So che puoi scherzare su qualsiasi cosa, ma so anche che posso dirti quando qualcosa è importante.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Oh
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oh

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was that the part that finally shut you up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Era quella la parte che finalmente ti ha fatto tacere?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For a second, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per un secondo, sì

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That actually means a lot. I didn't expect that part either
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Significa davvero molto. Non mi aspettavo nemmeno quella parte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't look so surprised. I do occasionally say nice things about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sembrare così sorpreso. Ogni tanto dico cose carine su di te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not usually without calling me an idiot immediately afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Di solito non senza chiamarmi idiota subito dopo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did the morning go?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Com'è andata la mattina?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can still do that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Posso ancora farlo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eccola qui

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm touched. I am. It's just also really strange knowing my friend is okay with me taking his girlfriend on a date
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono commosso. Lo sono. È solo davvero strano sapere che il mio amico è d'accordo che porti la sua ragazza a un appuntamento

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can be touched and find it strange. I'm managing curious and embarrassed at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puoi essere commosso e trovarlo strano. Io riesco a essere curioso e imbarazzato allo stesso tempo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed the embarrassed part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho notato la parte imbarazzata

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo che l'hai fatto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've spent five minutes avoiding my eyes after walking over here to ask me out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai passato cinque minuti a evitare i miei occhi dopo essere venuto qui per chiedermi di uscire

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping you wouldn't point that out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Speravo che non lo facessi notare

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't choose me for my ability to stay quiet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non mi hai scelto per la mia capacità di stare zitto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Clearly that was an oversight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Chiaramente è stato un errore

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fine once I actually started listening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene, una volta che ho iniziato ad ascoltare

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But you do want this? Not just because he likes the idea?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma lo vuoi davvero? Non solo perché a lui piace l'idea?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wouldn't have come over here if I only wanted to make him happy
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sarei venuta qui se volevo solo farlo felice

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like being around you. I'm curious about what it would feel like if we stopped pretending all the flirting was just a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piace stare con te. Sono curiosa di sapere come sarebbe se smettessimo di fingere che tutto il flirt fosse solo uno scherzo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora l'hai notato

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not nearly as subtle as you think
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sei affatto sottile come pensi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to be charming
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stavo cercando di essere affascinante.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sometimes it works. Don't make me regret admitting that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A volte funziona. Non farmi pentire di averlo ammesso.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making it very difficult to act casual about this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stai rendendo tutto molto difficile per sembrare tranquillo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You haven't been casual since I said the first sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sei stato affatto tranquillo da quando ho detto la prima frase.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair. And yes, I'd like to take you for a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Giusto. E sì, mi piacerebbe portarti a prendere un caffè.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Although I wrote the date in the wrong place three times before I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Anche se ho scritto la data nel posto sbagliato tre volte prima di accorgermene

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei sicuro?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Surprised, not uninterested. There's a difference
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sorpriso, non disinteressato. C'è una differenza.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because for a moment you looked like you were trying to find the exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene, perché per un momento sembravi cercare l'uscita.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was trying to think of something less embarrassing than asking you to repeat the whole thing a third time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stavo cercando di pensare a qualcosa di meno imbarazzante che chiederti di ripetere tutto per la terza volta.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Apprezzo l'impegno

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like you. An awkward conversation hasn't suddenly made that difficult to admit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piaci. Una conversazione imbarazzante non ha reso difficile ammetterlo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of us needed a little longer
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alcuni di noi hanno avuto bisogno di un po' più di tempo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'ho notato.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And before you start feeling too pleased with yourself, I'm asking about a first date. Nothing beyond that is decided
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E prima che tu inizi a sentirti troppo compiaciuto, sto parlando di un primo appuntamento. Nient'altro è deciso.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. A coffee, then we see how it feels
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so. Un caffè, poi vediamo come ci sentiamo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A distracted student? Doesn't sound like you at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uno studente distratto? Non sembra affatto te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Even if it feels weird?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Anche se sembra strano?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then it feels weird. I'm still going to complain about the coffee and steal your fries next week
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora sembra strano. Mi lamento ancora del caffè e ti rubo le patatine la prossima settimana.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Ideally without telling the entire table why we went out
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Idealmente senza dire a tutto il tavolo perché siamo usciti.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm teasing you, not announcing it to everyone
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo. Ti sto prendendo in giro, non lo annuncio a tutti.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Or making him regret being honest with me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: O farlo pentire di essere stato onesto con me.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I might need a second not to grin next time I see him, but I'm not going to make him feel bad about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so. Potrei aver bisogno di un attimo per non sorridere la prossima volta che lo vedo, ma non voglio farlo sentire in colpa per questo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You really won't?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Davvero non lo farai?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He trusts me. You've just told me you do too. I'm not going to be an idiot about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Si fida di me. Mi hai appena detto che anche tu ti fidi. Non voglio fare l'idiota riguardo a questo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only about everything else?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo riguardo a tutto il resto?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Let's not expect miracles
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non aspettiamoci miracoli

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm choosing to ignore that 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Scelgo di ignorare questo 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you. Seriously
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Grazie. Sul serio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're welcome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prego

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Coffee tomorrow? There's that place near the campus with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Caffè domani? C'è quel posto vicino al campus con le sedie diverse

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The one where you complained the cups were too small?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quello dove ti sei lamentato che le tazze erano troppo piccole?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They were too small
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Erano troppo piccole

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is already sounding like our normal conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Già sembra una delle nostre conversazioni normali

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to ease you in
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sto cercando di farti ambientare

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tomorrow could work
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Domani potrebbe funzionare

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to decide the time later? I need to check when my last class finishes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vuoi decidere l'orario dopo? Devo controllare quando finisce la mia ultima lezione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, message me when you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, scrivimi quando lo sai

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I might be a little awkward at first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E potrei essere un po' imbarazzata all'inizio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'll give you something to complain about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora ti darò qualcosa di cui lamentarti

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You do that without trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo fai senza nemmeno provarci

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See? We have a system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vedi? Abbiamo un sistema

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A domani

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A domani

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 25 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 25 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked, and he said he'd like to get a coffee with me tomorrow 😊
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abbiamo parlato e ha detto che gli piacerebbe prendere un caffè con me domani 😊

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Come ti senti?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Like I've been holding my shoulders up around my ears since breakfast and only just noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È come se avessi tenuto le spalle su per tutto il tempo da colazione e me ne sono accorta solo ora

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can put them down now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puoi rilassarti adesso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ci sto provando

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He knows we discussed him together, and that this isn't something I'm hiding from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sa che ne abbiamo parlato insieme e che non è qualcosa che ti sto nascondendo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We've only agreed on a coffee, nothing beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abbiamo solo concordato un caffè, nient'altro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did talking to him feel all right?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E parlare con lui ti è sembrato ok?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I left my phone in my bag until we'd finished, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho lasciato il telefono nella borsa fino a quando non abbiamo finito, come abbiamo detto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He understands that you know, and we agreed on a coffee without making promises about anything else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sa che tu lo sai e abbiamo concordato un caffè senza fare promesse su altro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you could actually concentrate on the conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono contenta che tu sia riuscito a concentrarti sulla conversazione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me too, I already had enough happening inside my head
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Anch'io, avevo già abbastanza in testa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details to myself, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tengo per me i piccoli dettagli, come abbiamo detto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the important part is good, and he understands that you know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma la parte importante va bene e lui capisce che tu lo sai

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just a coffee tomorrow, nothing we've decided beyond that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo un caffè domani, niente di più

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then tell me how you're feeling rather than giving me the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora dimmi come ti senti invece di raccontarmi tutta la conversazione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Relieved, and a little pleased with myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sollevata e un po' soddisfatta di me stessa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd feel like I was borrowing somebody else's confidence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensavo di sentirmi come se stessi prendendo in prestito la fiducia di qualcun altro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But once I'd said the awkward part, I was still just me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma una volta che ho detto la parte imbarazzante, ero ancora solo io

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's the person he knows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quella è la persona che conosce
