story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I think I needed to remember that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, penso di averne bisogno di ricordarlo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And there was a moment when I realized I actually wanted him to say yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E c'è stato un momento in cui ho capito che in realtà volevo che dicesse di sì

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How did that feel?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Com'è stata?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More personal than when we were just talking about the idea
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Più personale rispetto a quando stavamo solo parlando dell'idea

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not bad, just enough to make me lose my next sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non male, giusto abbastanza da farmi perdere la prossima frase

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}} is by the courtyard gate
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}} è vicino al cancello del cortile

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did the library forgive you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La biblioteca ti ha perdonato?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You, lost for words? I'm trying very hard not to look too pleased about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tu, senza parole? Sto cercando di non sembrare troppo contenta per questo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Absolutely not, you'd have made a face and I'd have started laughing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Assolutamente no, avresti fatto una faccia e io avrei iniziato a ridere

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here, this is the version that has recovered slightly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ecco, questa è la versione che si è ripresa un po'

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very good smile
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È un sorriso davvero bello

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I can't quite get rid of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so, non riesco a liberarmene del tutto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non devi farlo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me do it again ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi fai rifarlo di nuovo ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He'll let me know his schedule later, then we'll pick a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi farà sapere il suo programma più tardi, poi sceglieremo un orario

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight when you're settled
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dimmi stasera quando sei sistemato

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him I'd be there in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gli ho detto che sarei arrivata in un minuto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will, I need to go get something to eat first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo farò, devo prima andare a prendere qualcosa da mangiare

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've had a few messages on the app
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho ricevuto alcuni messaggi sull'app

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anything you feel like answering?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'è qualcosa a cui ti va di rispondere?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One or two, yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uno o due, sì

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going to sit somewhere with a drink and actually read them instead of opening everything between doors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi siederò da qualche parte con una bevanda e li leggerò davvero invece di aprire tutto tra le porte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Probably more comfortable than standing in the library exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Probabilmente più comodo che stare all'uscita della biblioteca

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Much less likely to get me politely removed, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Meno probabile che mi facciano rimuovere educatamente, tra l'altro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you once I've had a chance to talk properly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti scriverò appena avrò avuto la possibilità di parlare per bene

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Are you still happy to talk to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei ancora felice di parlare con lui?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: 50 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: 50 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've finished my drink and somehow found a person I wanted to keep talking to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho finito la mia bevanda e in qualche modo ho trovato una persona con cui volevo continuare a parlare

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds promising
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembra promettente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was not the man who asked whether I was actually single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non era l'uomo che ha chiesto se fossi davvero single

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I pointed him back to the first sentence of my profile and left that conversation there
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'ho rimandato alla prima frase del mio profilo e ho lasciato quella conversazione lì

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An efficient reading comprehension test
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un test di comprensione del testo molto efficace

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very efficient
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Molto efficace

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But the other conversation was nice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma l'altra conversazione è stata carina

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He actually read what I'd written, including the part about you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ha davvero letto quello che avevo scritto, compresa la parte su di te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I just need to stop trying to decide how the whole conversation will go before it starts
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, devo solo smettere di cercare di decidere come andrà tutta la conversazione prima che inizi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did that make it awkward?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È stato imbarazzante?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He asked if this was something we'd agreed on, I said yes, and he didn't keep trying to turn it into a secret
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ha chiesto se fosse qualcosa su cui ci eravamo messi d'accordo, ho detto di sì, e non ha continuato a cercare di trasformarlo in un segreto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we got to have an ordinary conversation, which was the part I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Poi abbiamo potuto avere una conversazione normale, che era la parte che volevo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What made you answer him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cosa ti ha fatto rispondere a lui?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One of his pictures was a very burnt pizza with an apology underneath it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una delle sue foto era una pizza bruciata con una scusa sotto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So you chose him for his cooking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quindi lo hai scelto per le sue doti culinarie?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I chose him because it made me laugh, which seemed like a reasonable place to start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'ho scelto perché mi ha fatto ridere, il che sembrava un buon punto di partenza

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: His first message asked whether the imaginary people I cook for ever helped with the washing up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il suo primo messaggio chiedeva se le persone immaginarie per cui cucino aiutassero mai con i piatti

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better than asking whether you're single
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Meglio che chiedere se sei single

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sentence at a time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una frase alla volta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A significant improvement
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un miglioramento significativo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I told him they were terrible guests and he said his only dinner guest had once brought a fire extinguisher as a joke
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gli ho detto che erano ospiti terribili e lui ha detto che il suo unico ospite a cena una volta ha portato un estintore come scherzo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because of the pizza?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A causa della pizza?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently there were several attempts before the pizza in the photo
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A quanto pare ci sono stati diversi tentativi prima della pizza nella foto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can't decide if the persistence is admirable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non riesco a decidere se la perseveranza sia ammirevole

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to let him cook for you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non devi lasciarlo cucinare per te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I mentioned that and he immediately suggested somewhere with actual staff 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'ho menzionato e lui ha subito suggerito un posto con personale vero 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds sensible of him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembra sensato da parte sua

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He's twenty-six, works across town, and isn't part of our university circle
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ha ventisei anni, lavora dall'altra parte della città e non fa parte del nostro giro universitario

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know him yet, obviously, but I liked that he could talk without trying to impress me every other sentence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non lo conosco ancora, ovviamente, ma mi è piaciuto che potesse parlare senza cercare di impressionarmi in ogni frase

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's annoyingly sensible
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È fastidiosamente sensato

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you feel comfortable talking to him?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti senti a tuo agio a parlare con lui?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So far, yes, and he made me laugh without trying too hard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Finora sì, e mi ha fatto ridere senza sforzarsi troppo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping some of the little details for myself, but this is someone new, not anybody from our friends
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tengo per me alcuni dei piccoli dettagli, ma questa è una persona nuova, non qualcuno dei nostri amici

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's enough for now, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene così per ora

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I also liked that I could take a few minutes to answer without him asking where I'd disappeared to
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi è piaciuto anche che potessi prendere qualche minuto per rispondere senza che lui chiedesse dove fossi sparita

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not making your phone feel like homework is a good start
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non far sentire il tuo telefono come un compito è un buon inizio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now, otherwise I'll keep talking to you instead
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Metto via il telefono adesso, altrimenti continuerò a parlare con te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we stopped, we were talking about getting a coffee tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quando ci siamo fermati, stavamo parlando di prendere un caffè domani

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Already picked somewhere?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai già scelto un posto?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I suggested the café near the main shopping street, the one with the big windows
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho suggerito il caffè vicino alla strada principale dello shopping, quello con le grandi finestre

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Somewhere I know, in the afternoon, and just a drink to see whether we get along in person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un posto che conosco, nel pomeriggio, e solo un drink per vedere se andiamo d'accordo di persona

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Does that feel like something you want to do?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti sembra qualcosa che vuoi fare?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I caught myself typing the suggestion before he asked, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi sono sorpresa a scrivere il suggerimento prima che lui chiedesse, in realtà.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which surprised me more than getting messages in the first place
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questo mi ha sorpreso più che ricevere messaggi in primo luogo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You sound happy about that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembri felice per questo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Io sono

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on. I'll be here later ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vai pure. Sarò qui più tardi ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't go looking for someone to tick a box, I had a conversation I enjoyed and wanted another one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non cercavo qualcuno per spuntare una casella, ho avuto una conversazione che mi è piaciuta e ne volevo un'altra.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That sounds more like you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questo sembra più te.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It felt like me, too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Anche a me è sembrato così.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it helped not trying to keep you updated at the same time
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E mi ha aiutato non dover cercare di tenerti aggiornato allo stesso tempo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I can actually talk to you instead of bouncing between two conversations
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ora posso davvero parlare con te invece di rimbalzare tra due conversazioni.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prefer that to getting half a sentence from each
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Preferisco questo piuttosto che ricevere metà frase da ciascuno.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Grazie

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is your girlfriend after successfully sending a normal message without rewriting it twenty times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comunque, questa è la tua ragazza dopo aver inviato con successo un messaggio normale senza riscriverlo venti volte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look pleased with yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembri soddisfatto di te stesso.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am, and I'm allowing myself five minutes of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sono, e mi concedo cinque minuti di questo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can have more than five
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puoi averne più di cinque.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dangerous, I might become unbearable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pericoloso, potrei diventare insopportabile.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll take the risk
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prenderò il rischio.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This photo is for you, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questa foto è per te, tra l'altro.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not giving anyone else the version of me celebrating a very small victory 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non darò a nessun altro la versione di me che celebra una vittoria molto piccola 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll treasure the exclusive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Terrò caro l'esclusiva.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: POCHI MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll confirm the time later when I know whether tomorrow's group meeting is staying in the morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Confermerò l'orario più tardi quando saprò se la riunione di gruppo di domani rimane al mattino.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Tell me tonight
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dimmi stasera.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo farò ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't forget that you have a boyfriend who also enjoys conversations unrelated to university
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non dimenticare che hai un ragazzo che ama anche conversazioni che non riguardano l'università

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't forgotten you for a second
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non ti ho dimenticata nemmeno per un secondo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: But tell me one ordinary thing from your day before I go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma dimmi una cosa normale della tua giornata prima che vada

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I opened a game to do one thing and spent half an hour changing the controls
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho aperto un gioco per fare una cosa e ho passato mezz'ora a cambiare i controlli

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That is painfully believable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È incredibilmente credibile

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was beginning to think you'd escaped through another exit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stavo cominciando a pensare che fossi scappato da un'altra uscita

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The woman at the desk didn't even look at me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La donna alla scrivania non mi ha nemmeno guardata

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then changed them back because I preferred the old ones
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Poi li ho cambiati di nuovo perché preferivo quelli vecchi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you, that has made me feel much more productive
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Grazie, mi hai fatto sentire molto più produttivo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy to help
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Felice di aiutarti

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me later, I want to know if you ever actually play it ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Scrivimi dopo, voglio sapere se alla fine lo giochi davvero ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I nearly did, but I have a reputation for being reliable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ci stavo quasi riuscendo, ma ho una reputazione da mantenere

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Since when?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Da quando?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making an excellent first impression
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stai facendo un'ottima prima impressione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: First impression? I thought I was well past that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prima impressione? Pensavo di essere già oltre

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on, let's walk a little
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dai, facciamo due passi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Two subjects enter the courtyard
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Due soggetti entrano nel cortile

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Conversation continues
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La conversazione continua

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can give her room to choose without pretending that I feel nothing.
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Posso lasciarle spazio per scegliere senza fingere di non provare nulla.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Away from the Crowd
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lontano dalla folla

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, now you actually are making me curious
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene, ora mi stai davvero facendo venire curiosità

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You remember what I said yesterday? About wanting to talk somewhere quieter
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ricordi cosa ho detto ieri? Di voler parlare in un posto più tranquillo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, and I have been very mature about not asking you twelve times
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, e sono stata molto matura a non chiederti dodici volte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I prepared an apology for a machine that just beeped
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho preparato una scusa per una macchina che ha solo bipato

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I appreciate the effort
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Apprezzo l'impegno

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this a good place?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È un buon posto?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, let's sit for a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, sediamoci un attimo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're doing that thing with the strap on your bag
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stai facendo quella cosa con la tracolla della tua borsa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What thing?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quale cosa?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Twisting it around your fingers
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Girandola tra le dita

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I hadn't noticed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non me ne ero accorta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to make whatever this is sound perfect
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non devi far sembrare perfetta questa cosa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a dangerous amount of kindness from you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È un bel po' di gentilezza da parte tua

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm saving the jokes until I know what we're talking about
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tengo le battute per quando so di cosa stiamo parlando

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A very moving exchange
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un scambio molto toccante

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} and I have been talking about me going on a date with someone else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} e io abbiamo parlato della possibilità che io esca con qualcun altro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, what the fuck?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aspetta, che diavolo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little quieter, please
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un po' più piano, per favore

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry, but... {{name:player}} wants you to go on a date with another guy?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Scusa, ma... {{name:player}} vuole che tu esca con un altro ragazzo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. We've been talking about it for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Ne stiamo parlando da un po'

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Why? Did something happen between you two?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perché? È successo qualcosa tra voi due?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, we're happy together. It's not about breaking up or finding someone to replace him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, siamo felici insieme. Non si tratta di lasciarci o trovare qualcuno che lo sostituisca

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I'm definitely missing something, because I'd be wondering why my girlfriend wanted to date somebody else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora mi sto perdendo qualcosa, perché mi chiederei perché la mia ragazza voglia uscire con qualcun altro

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He was the one who brought it up. He likes the idea of me being with someone else, with us deciding together
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È stato lui a tirarlo fuori. Gli piace l'idea che io stia con qualcun altro, decidendo insieme

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I think we both grew as people
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Penso che entrambi siamo cresciuti come persone

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He brought it up?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'ha tirato fuori?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. And after talking about it, I realized I was curious too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. E dopo averne parlato, ho capito che ero curiosa anch'io

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're serious? This isn't you two trying to see what I'll say?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei seria? Non è che voi due stiate cercando di vedere cosa dirò?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do I look like I'm having fun explaining this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembro che mi stia divertendo a spiegare questo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm not laughing at you, I just really wasn't ready for that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Scusa. Non sto ridendo di te, non ero proprio pronto per questo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither was I when he first told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Neanche io, quando me l'ha detto la prima volta.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right, but why are you telling me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene, ma perché me lo dici?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I wanted to ask how you'd feel about being that person
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perché volevo chiederti come ti sentiresti ad essere quella persona.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Me? Wait, you mean you want to go on a date with me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Io? Aspetta, vuoi dire che vuoi uscire con me?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, the man standing behind you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, l'uomo dietro di te.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Anyway, this is where I'm hiding for five minutes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comunque, qui è dove mi nascondo per cinque minuti

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't do that, I'm still trying to catch up
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non fare così, sto ancora cercando di capire.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, you. That's why I asked you to meet me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, tu. Ecco perché ti ho chiesto di incontrarmi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Holy shit. And he knows it's me? Not just some guy he doesn't know?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cavolo. E lui sa che sono io? Non solo un tizio che non conosce?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you specifically, so this isn't something I'm bringing up behind his back
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abbiamo parlato di te specificamente, quindi non è qualcosa di cui parlo alle sue spalle.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So he knows you're here right now, asking me this?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quindi sa che sei qui adesso, a chiedermelo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. He knew I was going to talk to you after class
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Sapeva che avrei parlato con te dopo le lezioni.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you wanted advice about something. I wasn't expecting to be part of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensavo volessi un consiglio su qualcosa. Non mi aspettavo di farne parte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you understand why I spent all morning working out how to say it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ora capisci perché ho passato tutta la mattina a pensare a come dirlo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I kept expecting him to tell me to stop flirting with you. This is a very different conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Continuavo a aspettarmi che mi dicesse di smettere di flirtare con te. Questa è una conversazione molto diversa.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could at least pretend to be less proud of yourself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Potresti almeno fingere di essere meno orgoglioso di te stesso.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not even at proud yet. I'm still trying to believe you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sono nemmeno orgoglioso ancora. Sto ancora cercando di crederti.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:player}} has been keeping a few surprises to himself, hasn't he?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:player}} si teneva qualche sorpresa per sé, eh?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I had exactly the same look on my face when we first talked about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A quanto pare. Avevo esattamente la stessa espressione quando ne abbiamo parlato la prima volta.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Poor guy. He finally tells you what's on his mind and now we're sitting here comparing our reactions
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Povero ragazzo. Finalmente ti dice cosa ha in mente e ora siamo qui a confrontare le nostre reazioni.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're the one staring at me like I asked you to help me rob a bank
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei tu quello che mi fissa come se ti avessi chiesto di aiutarmi a rapinare una banca.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd have understood the bank faster
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Avrei capito la banca più in fretta.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't surprise me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questo non mi sorprende.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously though, I never thought I'd hear this kind of proposal from you two
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sul serio, non avrei mai pensato di sentire una proposta del genere da voi due.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. We like discovering new things together, but this one took a bit more talking
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so. Ci piace scoprire cose nuove insieme, ma questa ha richiesto un po' più di chiacchiere.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I would hope so
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Spero di sì.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're enjoying the silence
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembri che ti stia godendo il silenzio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At first I wasn't sure what I thought. Then we talked more, and I found myself wanting to see how it could feel
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: All'inizio non sapevo cosa pensare. Poi abbiamo parlato di più e ho iniziato a voler vedere come potrebbe essere.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And that's where I came in?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E lì sono entrato in gioco io?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Eventually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alla fine.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Whose idea was that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Di chi è stata quell'idea?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked about you. You're not getting the whole conversation
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abbiamo parlato di te. Non hai sentito tutta la conversazione.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm only asking whether I should thank you or him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sto solo chiedendo se dovrei ringraziare te o lui.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Neither until you've actually answered my question
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nessuno dei due finché non hai realmente risposto alla mia domanda.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're enjoying watching me struggle now
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti diverti a vedermi lottare adesso.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little. I've been nervous about this all morning
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un po'. Sono stata nervosa per questo tutta la mattina.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. Why me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene. Perché io?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For once nobody can ask whether the next slide is important
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per una volta nessuno può chiedere se la prossima slide è importante

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I really wasn't expecting her to show up like that 👀
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Non mi aspettavo davvero che si presentasse così 👀

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She's always had a crush on you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ha sempre avuto una cotta per te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Now she's just taking full advantage of it 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ora ne sta approfittando al massimo 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Bro it was actually hard to concentrate on the exercises 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Fratello, è stato davvero difficile concentrarsi sugli esercizi 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Everyone can do whatever they want
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ognuno può fare quello che vuole

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Looking forward to the next sessions 🔥
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Non vedo l'ora delle prossime sessioni 🔥

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: And you, take it easy on the leg
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: E tu, stai attenta alla gamba

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: The doctor only took your cast off two days ago
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Il medico ti ha tolto il gesso solo due giorni fa.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: First real session without the cast and you already handled most of the exercises
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Prima vera sessione senza il gesso e hai già gestito la maggior parte degli esercizi
{{name:hailey}} ha fatto la sua parte anche lei

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: It was really hard to stay focused during the session 😭
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: È stato davvero difficile rimanere concentrati durante la sessione 😭

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've just put dinner on the table, have you eaten or are you still negotiating with that game?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ ho appena messo la cena in tavola, hai mangiato o stai ancora trattando con quel gioco?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like talking to you like this
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piace parlare con te in questo modo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even when you ask questions I can't answer with a joke?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche quando fai domande a cui non posso rispondere con una battuta?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Especially then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Soprattutto allora

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although I'm sure you'll make another attempt in a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche se sono sicura che farai un altro tentativo tra un minuto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm waiting for an opening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sto aspettando un'opportunità

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Predictable man
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Uomo prevedibile

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Anyway, I wanted to try something on before I get too comfortable to move
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Comunque, volevo provare qualcosa prima di diventare troppo comoda per muovermi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per domani?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I was going to wear whatever I pulled out first
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì, avrei indossato qualsiasi cosa avessi tirato fuori per prima

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I realized I actually wanted to choose something I liked
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Poi ho capito che in realtà volevo scegliere qualcosa che mi piacesse

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Show me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fammi vedere

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Give me a minute
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dammi un minuto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 6 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 6 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one, with the jacket if it's cooler
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo, con la giacca se fa più fresco

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piace

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You answered very quickly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai risposto molto in fretta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you prefer a slower compliment?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Preferisci un complimento più lento?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd prefer one I believe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Preferirei uno che credo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look like you're about to enjoy your afternoon, not spend it worrying about your clothes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembri pronta a goderti il pomeriggio, non a preoccuparti dei tuoi vestiti

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembra buono

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's actually exactly what I wanted
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È esattamente quello che volevo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you look beautiful
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E sei bellissima

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That part helps too 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quella parte aiuta anche 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can walk in these shoes without thinking about every step, so they're staying
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso camminare con queste scarpe senza pensare a ogni passo, quindi rimangono

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A very practical fashion decision
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Una decisione di moda molto pratica

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I contain multitudes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Contengo molteplici sfaccettature

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm keeping the outfit, then
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora tengo l'outfit

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner or me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cena o me?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if I decide to send him a picture, you'll get that one too, like we said
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E se decido di inviargli una foto, anche tu la riceverai, come abbiamo detto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one was only for you, I haven't sent it anywhere else
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questa è solo per te, non l'ho inviata da nessun'altra parte.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like getting the preview
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piace avere un'anteprima.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then appreciate it, there was a very undignified struggle with the jacket before I took it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora apprezzala, c'è stata una lotta poco dignitosa con la giacca prima di togliermela.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame I missed that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Peccato che mi sia perso quel momento.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You asked me about the dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi hai chiesto della cena

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This one is just between us, by the way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questa è solo tra noi, a proposito.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not turning tomorrow into a collection of things you have to look at
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non voglio trasformare domani in una collezione di cose che devi guardare.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd still have been disappointed to miss the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sarei comunque rimasto deluso di perdermi il vestito.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your ordinary girlfriend pictures are not being discontinued 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le tue normali foto da fidanzata non verranno interrotte 😌.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is just for you, not a report of something I've sent him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questa foto è solo per te, non è un resoconto di qualcosa che gli ho inviato.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can enjoy the dress and still let me keep some little things to myself tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi goderti il vestito e lasciarmi tenere alcune piccole cose per me domani.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can live with that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso convivere con questo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'm enjoying not planning every single sentence in advance
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene, perché mi piace non pianificare ogni singola frase in anticipo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You are allowed to show initiative
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi prendere l'iniziativa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This photo is only for you, I haven't sent it to him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questa foto è solo per te, non gliel'ho inviata.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And tomorrow I can leave my phone alone while we're talking, then tell you about it afterward
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E domani posso lasciare il telefono da parte mentre parliamo, poi te ne parlerò dopo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That still sounds right to me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi sembra ancora giusto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I don't want to spend our first coffee looking down at a screen
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anch'io, non voglio passare il nostro primo caffè a guardare uno schermo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Something else happened while I was trying this on
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È successo qualcos'altro mentre lo provavo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cosa?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner looks good, and I wish I was sitting opposite you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cena sembra buona, e vorrei essere seduto di fronte a te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I caught myself wondering if he'd like it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi sono ritrovata a chiedermi se gli sarebbe piaciuto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then immediately wanting to see your face when you saw it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E poi volevo subito vedere la tua faccia quando lo avresti visto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you wanted both
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piace che tu volessi entrambi.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So do I, actually
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anch'io, in realtà.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought those feelings might get in each other's way
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensavo che quei sentimenti potessero ostacolarci.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Instead I was just standing here wanting to show you the dress
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Invece ero qui che volevo mostrarti il vestito.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono contento che tu l'abbia fatto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anch'io ❤️.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's better ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È meglio così ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And our film afternoon is still happening
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E il nostro pomeriggio di film è ancora in programma.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I put the pasta container at the front of the fridge so I won't forget it when I come over
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho messo il contenitore della pasta davanti al frigo così non me lo scordo quando vengo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd let you in without it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti lascerei entrare anche senza.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know, but it's important that you understand what a generous visitor I am
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so, ma è importante che tu capisca quanto sia generoso il tuo ospite.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous with food, ruthless with the remote
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Generoso con il cibo, spietato con il telecomando.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You agreed I could choose
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai detto che potevo scegliere.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ricordo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, I've found something where you can actually see the actors
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene, ho trovato qualcosa dove puoi davvero vedere gli attori.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're never letting that go, are you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non ti lascerai scappare questa, vero?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not until I find out who was standing in that doorway
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non finché non scopro chi c'era in quella porta.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Although you'd have to stop making me laugh while I'm trying to eat
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche se dovresti smettere di farmi ridere mentre cerco di mangiare

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody knows, that's part of the film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nessuno lo sa, fa parte del film.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Terrible system
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sistema terribile.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, I'm getting changed before I end up falling asleep in tomorrow's outfit
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aspetta, mi cambio prima di addormentarmi con l'outfit di domani.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 8 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 8 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much better, I'm keeping these clothes for absolutely no audience at all
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Molto meglio, tengo questi vestiti per nessun pubblico.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even me?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nemmeno per me?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can have a small exception
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi avere una piccola eccezione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like this version too
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche a me piace questa versione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because this is the one you're getting during our film
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene, perché questa è quella che avrai durante il nostro film

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No promises on that part
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nessuna promessa su quella parte

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: As long as I get to sit beside you
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A patto che possa sedermi accanto a te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's rather the point ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È proprio questo il punto ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to put my phone down before I find another reason to keep you awake
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Metto giù il telefono prima di trovare un altro motivo per tenerti sveglio

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, pretty girl
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buona notte, bella ragazza

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night, handsome
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buona notte, bello

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And eat breakfast before I have to ask tomorrow
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E mangiare la colazione prima di doverlo chiedere domani

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There she is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco lei

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I never left 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non me ne sono mai andata 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How's your leg after today?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Come va la tua gamba dopo oggi?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I ate, and I actually played for a while
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho mangiato e ho effettivamente giocato per un po'

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A bit tired, but I didn't push it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un po' stanco, ma non ho forzato

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked getting outside, even if it wasn't exactly an adventure
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi è piaciuto uscire, anche se non è stata esattamente un'avventura

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to be an adventure to be good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non deve essere un'avventura per essere bello

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Listen to you being reasonable
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Guarda te che sei ragionevole

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've used a lot of courage today, I'm saving what's left
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho usato molto coraggio oggi, sto risparmiando quello che mi resta

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Speaking of which, tomorrow is arranged
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A proposito, domani è tutto organizzato

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: With the controls exactly where they were before?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Con i controlli esattamente dove erano prima?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} finishes early enough, so we're meeting at the café near campus at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} finisce abbastanza presto, quindi ci incontriamo al caffè vicino al campus alle tre e mezza

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The one with the mismatched chairs
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quello con le sedie diverse

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did he seem different when he messaged you?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembrava diverso quando ti ha scritto?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little more careful, maybe
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un po' più attento, forse

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not awkward, just less determined to make a joke out of everything
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non imbarazzante, solo meno determinato a fare una battuta su tutto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You might have surprised him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Potresti averlo sorpreso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I definitely surprised myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi sono sicuramente sorpresa.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was putting my things away when I remembered what I'd actually asked him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stavo mettendo via le mie cose quando mi sono ricordata di cosa gli avessi chiesto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And then I just stood in the hallway smiling at nothing
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E poi sono rimasta lì in corridoio a sorridere a vuoto.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd have liked to see that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi sarebbe piaciuto vederlo.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is no need to bring that up again
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non c'è bisogno di tirarlo fuori di nuovo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you'd have asked what I was smiling about and made it worse
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, tu avresti chiesto di cosa stessi sorridendo e avresti peggiorato la situazione.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost certainly
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quasi sicuramente.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The strange part is that I already know him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cosa strana è che lo conosco già.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tomorrow I'll be looking at someone familiar and wondering whether he's about to say something I haven't heard before
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Domani guarderò qualcuno di familiare e mi chiederò se sta per dire qualcosa che non ho mai sentito prima.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's the part you're curious about?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È quella la parte che ti incuriosisce?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, I think it is
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì, penso di sì.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not trying to turn him into a different person, I just want to see what this feels like when we stop pretending it's an ordinary lunch
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non sto cercando di trasformarlo in un'altra persona, voglio solo vedere come ci si sente quando smettiamo di fingere che sia un pranzo normale.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We're meeting at the café by the main shopping street at half past three
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ci incontriamo al caffè vicino alla strada principale dello shopping alle tre e mezza.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There is a little need
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'è un po' di bisogno

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I picked it because I know where it is and I won't have to spend the first ten minutes looking lost
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'ho scelto perché so dove si trova e non dovrò passare i primi dieci minuti a sembrare persa.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good choice
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buona scelta.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm going there on my own, no lifts from someone I haven't met yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E ci vado da sola, niente passaggi da qualcuno che non ho ancora incontrato.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have you been talking much this evening?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Avete parlato molto stasera?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A little before dinner
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un po' prima di cena.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I told him I was eating and would put the phone away
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Poi gli ho detto che stavo mangiando e avrei messo via il telefono.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How did he take that?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Come l'ha presa?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Like a normal person who also has things to do
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Come una persona normale che ha anche delle cose da fare.

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It sounds like such a small thing, but I liked not having to explain myself
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembra una cosa da niente, ma mi è piaciuto non dovermi spiegare

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you think you'll get along in person?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensi che vi troverete bene di persona?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What did you make?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cosa hai cucinato?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I hope so, but that's why I want to meet instead of making up his entire personality from messages
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Spero di sì, ma è per questo che voglio incontrarlo invece di immaginarmi tutta la sua personalità dai messaggi

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't know whether he's quiet at first or talks with his hands or laughs at his own jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non so se all'inizio è silenzioso, se parla con le mani o se ride delle sue stesse battute

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You already have someone who does the last one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai già qualcuno che fa quest'ultima cosa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes, and he keeps insisting they're excellent jokes
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì, e continua a insistere che sono battute eccellenti

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: They are
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sono

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: See? Completely unreasonable 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vedi? Completamente irragionevole 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that there are things I don't know yet
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piace che ci siano cose che non so ancora

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not enough to invite him into my life all at once, just enough to want a coffee
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non abbastanza per invitarlo nella mia vita tutto in una volta, giusto abbastanza per voler prendere un caffè

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An omelet and a salad
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un'omelette e un'insalata

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay, your turn
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok, tocca a te

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My turn for what?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il mio turno per cosa?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What was the first thing you thought when I said I was actually meeting him tomorrow?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qual è stata la prima cosa che hai pensato quando ho detto che lo incontravo davvero domani?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not the very supportive answer, the first one
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non la risposta molto incoraggiante, la prima

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honestly? I smiled before I'd even finished reading
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Onestamente? Ho sorriso prima di aver finito di leggere

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want this, but it suddenly feels much more real
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo voglio, ma all'improvviso sembra molto più reale

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That quickly?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Così in fretta?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, especially because you sounded happy when you told me
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì, soprattutto perché sembravi felice quando me l'hai detto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I tried to think of something less obvious to say than how much I was smiling
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Poi ho cercato di pensare a qualcosa di meno ovvio da dire rispetto a quanto stavo sorridendo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could have just said that
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Potevi semplicemente dirlo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What happened to all the pasta?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Che fine ha fatto tutta la pasta?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't want to turn your entire afternoon into my reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non volevo trasformare il tuo pomeriggio intero nella mia reazione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want to hear your reaction
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voglio ancora sentire la tua reazione

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don't want your part in this to be only asking whether I'm okay
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non voglio che il tuo ruolo in questo sia solo chiedere se sto bene

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then yes, I'm excited, and I'm glad you wanted to ask him
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora sì, sono emozionato, e sono felice che tu abbia voluto chiederglielo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'ho fatto

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I like knowing you're sitting there smiling at your phone too ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E mi piace sapere che sei lì a sorridere al tuo telefono anche tu ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Real in a bad way?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Reale in un brutto modo?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not bad, just different from talking about some imaginary afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non male, solo diverso dal parlare di un pomeriggio immaginario

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm taking a break before the pasta and I start resenting each other
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Faccio una pausa prima che io e la pasta cominciamo a odiarci

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Now there's an actual time, and tomorrow you'll get ready and go
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ora c'è un orario reale, e domani ti preparerai e andrai

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had that same little moment when I put it in my calendar
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho avuto quel piccolo momento quando l'ho messo nel mio calendario

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still want you to go, I just didn't expect to notice the difference so much
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voglio ancora che tu vada, non mi aspettavo di notare così tanto la differenza

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me instead of trying to sound completely relaxed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Grazie per avermelo detto invece di cercare di sembrare completamente rilassata

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not asking you to talk me out of it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non ti sto chiedendo di farmi cambiare idea

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I'm not going to spend tomorrow trying to give you a perfect story about it
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E non passerò domani a cercare di darti una storia perfetta su questo

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good, because I'd rather hear about your actual afternoon
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene, perché preferirei sentire del tuo pomeriggio reale

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then that's what you'll get ❤️
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora è quello che otterrai ❤️

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, here's proof I can make a different meal
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aspetta, ecco la prova che posso fare un pasto diverso

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Getting back into sports actually felt really good
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Tornare a fare sport è stato davvero bello

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Isn't it more the flirting with {{name:aiden}} that felt good?
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Non è più il flirtare con {{name:aiden}} che ti ha fatto stare bene?

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I have no idea what you're talking about 😇
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Non ho idea di cosa parli 😇

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I'm just happy both of you are having fun
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Sono solo felice che entrambi vi stiate divertendo
Continua a dirlo a te stessa

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And get ready to see even more 😌
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: E preparati a vedere ancora di più 😌

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I had a really good session
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ho avuto una sessione davvero buona

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I feel like I'm actually going to succeed
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Sento che ce la farò davvero

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Succeed at getting Ethan into your bed, yeah
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ce la farai a portare Ethan a letto, sì

story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And yet you keep texting me
I need to rest after today
story/DAY17/nts/DAY17_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ho bisogno di riposare dopo oggi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because if you do, you’re being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Perché se ce l'hai, sei sospettosamente silenzioso

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Then why haven’t you complimented me yet
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Allora perché non mi hai ancora fatto un complimento?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’m just extremely good at noticing when people are late with their compliments
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Sono solo estremamente brava a notare quando le persone sono in ritardo con i loro complimenti

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Anyway I’m bored out of my mind
Why aren’t you getting ready for university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Perché non ti stai preparando per l'università?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Because the year is basically over
I don’t technically need to show up anymore
So I’m taking my well-deserved freedom very seriously
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Quindi prendo molto sul serio la mia meritata libertà

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: It’s not skipping if there’s nothing left to learn
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Non è saltare se non c'è più nulla da imparare

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: And a free woman is currently very bored
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: E una donna libera è attualmente molto annoiata
Vieni a farmi compagnia più tardi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: I’ve been in bed too long
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Sono stata a letto troppo a lungo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Or I’ll start posting worse stories just to force you to react
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Oppure inizierò a postare storie imbarazzanti solo per costringerti a reagire

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: New day, same face, still cute 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Nuovo giorno, stessa faccia, sempre carina 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I almost opened the racing game instead of my lecture notes 😭
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Stavo per aprire il gioco di corse invece delle mie note 😭

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: What's up?
I have a presentation to prepare for university
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ho una presentazione da preparare per l'università

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: The slides are mostly done, but I keep losing my place when I practise out loud
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Le diapositive sono quasi pronte, ma continuo a perdere il filo quando pratico ad alta voce

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Come over after your day. You can practise with me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Vieni dopo la tua giornata. Puoi esercitarti con me

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'd sit through it?
Of course. What is it about?
Customer loyalty. Why people keep going back to the same business
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Fidelizzazione dei clienti. Perché le persone tornano sempre allo stesso negozio

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I can ask questions. Especially when you lose me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Posso fare domande. Soprattutto quando mi perdi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Please do. I'd rather find the confusing parts with you than in front of everyone
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Per favore fallo. Preferisco trovare le parti confuse con te piuttosto che davanti a tutti

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then bring your notes
Already planning your comeback?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Stai già pianificando il tuo ritorno?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Okay ❤️
University, work, then you. That's my Monday sorted
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Università, lavoro, poi tu. Ecco come ho sistemato il mio lunedì

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for the first part
Looking very prepared
The bag has the notes. I just have to remember to use them
