story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: La borsa ha le note. Devo solo ricordarmi di usarle

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You'll be fine
You have to listen properly tonight, though
No distracting me halfway through
I'll save it for after
Maybe. But I remembered I actually have class this morning
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Forse. Ma mi sono ricordata che ho lezione questa mattina

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I walked right into that one 😌
I'll let you know when I can get away from work
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ti farò sapere quando riesco a liberarmi dal lavoro

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Have a good morning, love
You too ❤️
The rematch can wait
I really liked playing with you yesterday
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Mi è piaciuto davvero giocare con te ieri

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You didn't make me feel stupid when I kept crashing
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Non mi hai fatto sentire stupida quando continuavo a schiantarmi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You were learning. And you got better
I know. I want another try soon ❤️
Any time
Today I need a slightly different kind of help, though
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Oggi ho bisogno di un aiuto un po' diverso, però

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: LATER THAT EVENING — {{name:lena}} has gone home. You have cleared the table before joining {{name:hailey}} on the sofa.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: PIÙ TARDI QUELLA SERA — {{name:lena}} è tornata a casa. Hai sparecchiato prima di unirti a {{name:hailey}} sul divano.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Just come already before I eat everything
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Vieni già prima che mangi tutto

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: A bit later on the couch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Un po' più tardi sul divano

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: What if I need to steal food from your plate?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: E se ho bisogno di rubare cibo dal tuo piatto?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: You already stole half of it
The point is you’re being weirdly distant
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Il punto è che sei stranamente distante

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I’m literally right next to you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sono letteralmente proprio accanto a te

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Because I might fall asleep like this

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Sei praticamente il mio prigioniero ora 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: I even left space for you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Ho persino lasciato spazio per te

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.source: Why are you texting me if you’re already in the living room?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_HAILEY_EVENING.translation: Perché mi stai scrivendo se sei già in soggiorno?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Quick update before I start work: I should be out at six
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Aggiornamento veloce prima di iniziare a lavorare: dovrei uscire alle sei

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I've rewritten the introduction during lunch
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ho riscritto l'introduzione durante il pranzo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: It sounds less like I'm reading a textbook now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ora sembra meno che stia leggendo un libro di testo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: We'll try it out when you get here
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Lo proveremo quando arrivi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: And I'll finally collect my other bag
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: E finalmente prenderò la mia altra borsa

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: By bringing another one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Portando un'altra?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: A bag full of notes. They're different categories
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Una borsa piena di appunti. Sono categorie diverse

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Of course. I should have realised
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Certo. Avrei dovuto capirlo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Don't worry. I'll leave with both this time 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Non preoccuparti. Questa volta me ne andrò con entrambe 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll put the old one by the door
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Metterò la vecchia vicino alla porta

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Thanks, love. I need to go now
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Grazie, amore. Devo andare ora

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Want to come straight here?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Vuoi venire direttamente qui?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: See you tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ci vediamo stasera ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yes. I'll stop for something to eat on the way
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sì. Faccio una sosta per mangiare qualcosa lungo la strada

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I'll have the table cleared for your notes
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Preparerò il tavolo per i tuoi appunti

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: My very exclusive rehearsal venue
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Il mio luogo di prova super esclusivo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: One seat. Very selective audience
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Un posto. Pubblico molto selettivo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: At least the audience already likes me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Almeno il pubblico già mi piace

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Very much
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Molto

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Good. Be useful as well as affectionate tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Bene. Sii utile oltre che affettuoso stasera ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: I can manage both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Posso gestire entrambe le cose

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re the one leaning on me
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Sei tu che ti appoggi a me

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: If you keep looking at me like that I’m going to do something
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Se continui a guardarmi così farò qualcosa

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re really not scared of me huh
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Non hai davvero paura di me, eh?
Di solito mi prendi più in giro
Ti mostrerò che sono solo parole

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove del primo bacio consensuale tra {{name:hailey}} e {{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I don't need HAK to tell me that kiss meant something to me.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Non ho bisogno di HAK per sapere che quel bacio ha significato qualcosa per me.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove del primo bacio consensuale tra {{name:hailey}} e {{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of first consensual kiss between {{name:hailey}} and {{name:player}}
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove del primo bacio consensuale tra {{name:hailey}} e {{name:player}}

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Now you’re stuck with the consequences
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Ora sei bloccato con le conseguenze

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re not the one who just made the first move
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Non sei tu a aver fatto il primo passo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You pull her back for a longer kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: La tiri indietro per un bacio più lungo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ha archiviato la prova di un bacio consensuale prolungato

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I want to stay in this moment with her, without rushing whatever comes next.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Voglio restare in questo momento con lei, senza affrettare quello che verrà dopo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ha archiviato la prova di un bacio consensuale prolungato

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of prolonged consensual kiss
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ha archiviato la prova di un bacio consensuale prolungato

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: We’re definitely not going back to normal after this
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Non torneremo sicuramente alla normalità dopo questo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: What can i do when you do that face
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Cosa posso fare quando fai quella faccia?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: You’re still bad at smooth answers
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Sei ancora pessima con le risposte smooth.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: I’m going to bed before I start something we won’t stop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Vado a letto prima che inizi qualcosa che non ci fermerà.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: Try not to miss me too much 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: Cerca di non sentire troppo la mia mancanza 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove di risposta emotiva elevata durante il contatto ravvicinato

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove di risposta emotiva elevata durante il contatto ravvicinato

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.source: HAK archived evidence of elevated emotional response during close contact
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_L.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove di risposta emotiva elevata durante il contatto ravvicinato

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EARLY EVENING — It is half past six. You are at home, waiting to hear from {{name:lena}} after work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: INIZIO SERATA — Sono le sei e mezza. Sei a casa e aspetti notizie da {{name:lena}} dopo il lavoro.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Without looking down once 😌
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Senza guardare mai in basso 😌

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's good. Keep the question at the start
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene. Tieni la domanda all'inizio

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Already written in very large letters
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Già scritto in lettere molto grandi

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Everything packed away. I'm done studying for tonight
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Tutto messo via. Ho finito di studiare per stasera

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You earned the break
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Te lo sei guadagnato il riposo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for tonight. The useful part AND the part on the sofa ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Grazie per stasera. La parte utile E quella sul divano ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I enjoyed both
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi sono piaciute entrambe

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So did I. Especially the part after I closed the laptop
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Anche a me. Soprattutto la parte dopo che ho chiuso il laptop

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Now I'm getting ready for bed before I start rehearsing the whole thing again
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ora mi preparo per andare a letto prima di ricominciare a ripetere tutto

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Understood. The floor is yours.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Capito. Il palco è tuo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight, love
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Buonanotte, amore

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Goodnight ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Buonanotte ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} opens her slides and starts her presentation. You listen as she explains how quality, convenience and personal service can encourage customers to return. Halfway through, she pauses and looks down at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} apre le sue diapositive e inizia la sua presentazione. Ascolti mentre spiega come qualità, comodità e servizio personale possano incoraggiare i clienti a tornare. A metà, si ferma e guarda i suoi appunti.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: This is where I always get stuck.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: È qui che mi blocco sempre.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I ask something?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Posso chiedere qualcosa?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. That's what you're here for.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sì. È per questo che sei qui.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: If two places sell the same thing for the same price, what makes someone choose one over the other?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Se due posti vendono la stessa cosa allo stesso prezzo, cosa fa scegliere uno piuttosto che l'altro?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The experience. Whether it's easy to shop there, whether the staff help you...
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: L'esperienza. Se è facile fare acquisti lì, se il personale ti aiuta...

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That makes sense. Why not start that section with the question?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ha senso. Perché non iniziare quella sezione con la domanda?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Instead of that long definition?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Invece di quella lunga definizione?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yeah. Give me an example first, then explain it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sì. Dammi prima un esempio, poi spiegamelo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm out. Getting our food, then coming straight over ❤️
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sono fuori. Prendo il nostro cibo e poi vengo direttamente ❤️

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Wait. Let me write that down.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aspetta. Fammi annotare questa cosa.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She adds the question to her notes and tries the section again, using two neighbourhood cafes as an example. This time, she gets through it without stopping.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Aggiunge la domanda ai suoi appunti e riprova la sezione, usando due caffè del quartiere come esempio. Questa volta, riesce a farlo senza fermarsi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I followed all of that.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ho seguito tutto.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Was it too simple?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Era troppo semplice?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I understood what you meant. Then the definition made more sense.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: No. Ho capito cosa intendevi. Poi la definizione ha avuto più senso.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. That's actually helpful.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ok. È davvero utile.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Actually?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Davvero?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Don't ruin your good work.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non rovinare il tuo buon lavoro.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} finishes the presentation, checks the time and closes her laptop. You ask one last question about her conclusion, and she answers without looking at her notes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTI DOPO — {{name:lena}} finisce la presentazione, controlla l'ora e chiude il suo laptop. Fai un'ultima domanda sulla sua conclusione e lei risponde senza guardare i suoi appunti.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That felt much better.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: È stato molto meglio.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was work?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Com'è andato il lavoro?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You looked up more on the second try, too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hai guardato di più al secondo tentativo, anche.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were looking right at me every time I did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi guardavi dritto negli occhi ogni volta che lo facevo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You asked for an attentive audience.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hai chiesto un pubblico attento.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I did. And I liked having one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: L'ho fatto. E mi è piaciuto averne uno.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Thank you for taking it seriously.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Grazie per averlo preso sul serio.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} moves beside your chair and bends down to kiss you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} si sposta accanto alla tua sedia e si piega per baciarti.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Rehearsal
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dopo la Prova

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were waiting for me to close that laptop, weren't you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Stavi aspettando che chiudessi quel laptop, vero?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was following the rules. No kissing until you finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Stavo seguendo le regole. Niente baci fino a quando non hai finito.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very disciplined of you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Molto disciplinato da parte tua.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Busy enough that I didn't have time to worry about the presentation
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Abbastanza impegnata da non avere tempo per preoccuparmi della presentazione

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Can I stop pretending I'm just someone in the audience now?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Posso smettere di fingere di essere solo qualcuno nel pubblico adesso?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Please do.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Per favore, fallo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You didn't need a presentation to have a reason to come over.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non avevi bisogno di una presentazione per avere un motivo per venire qui.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. But I did need to practise it.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo so. Ma avevo bisogno di praticarlo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I wanted to spend the evening with you. This worked out nicely.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E volevo passare la serata con te. È andata bene.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It did.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: È vero.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After eating, you move to the sofa. {{name:lena}} sits close beside you, leaving room for your recovering leg. Your arm settles around her shoulders, and she turns toward you for another kiss.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25 MINUTI DOPO — Dopo aver mangiato, ti sposti sul divano. {{name:lena}} si siede vicino a te, lasciando spazio per la tua gamba in fase di recupero. Il tuo braccio si posa sulle sue spalle e lei si gira verso di te per un altro bacio.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Much better than the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Molto meglio del tavolo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The table wasn't that bad.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Il tavolo non era così male.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I couldn't sit like this there.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non potevo sedermi così lì.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I've got our sandwiches. See you in a little while
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ho i nostri panini. Ci vediamo tra poco

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Come here, then.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vieni qui, allora.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: After the Sandwiches
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dopo i Panini

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Your hand is wandering.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La tua mano sta vagando.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can tell me to stop.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Puoi dirmi di fermarmi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I didn't say stop. Higher.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non ho detto di fermarti. Più in alto.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Hands Where She Put Them
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mani Dove Lei Le Ha Messe

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And the other one?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E l'altra?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You can have that too. Under. I already decided.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Puoi avere anche quello. Sotto. Ho già deciso.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You're making it very difficult to keep the evening polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Stai rendendo molto difficile mantenere la serata educata.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: The presentation is over. I don't need polite.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La presentazione è finita. Non ho bisogno di essere gentile.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A dopo

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: My turn too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Anche il mio turno.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You don't have to.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non è necessario.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I know. I want to. Open your jeans.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo so. Voglio farlo. Apri i tuoi jeans.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Her Hand
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La sua mano

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Tell me if that's too much.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Dimmi se è troppo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It isn't.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non lo è.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: On the Sofa
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sul divano

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: There. That was the point.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ecco. Questo era il punto.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You look very pleased with yourself.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sembri molto soddisfatto di te stesso.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I am. You can thank me later
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo sono. Puoi ringraziarmi dopo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A LITTLE LATER — {{name:lena}} arrives at your place with her notes and a bag of food. You greet her with a kiss, put the sandwiches in the kitchen and sit together at the table.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: POCO DOPO — {{name:lena}} arriva a casa tua con i suoi appunti e una borsa di cibo. La saluti con un bacio, metti i panini in cucina e vi sedete insieme al tavolo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 25 MINUTES LATER — After cleaning up, she nestles against you
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 25 MINUTI DOPO — Dopo aver sistemato, si accoccola contro di te.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Comfortable?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Comodo?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. Are you?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sì. E tu?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Molto.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Then stop moving away to talk.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Allora smettila di allontanarti per parlare.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was going to ask about your day.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Stavo per chiederti com'è andata la tua giornata.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How was university?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Com'è andata l'università?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Fine. Though I spent lunch rewriting that introduction instead of eating properly.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Bene. Anche se ho passato il pranzo a riscrivere quell'introduzione invece di mangiare bene.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So the sandwich was important.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quindi il panino era importante.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Very important. Thank you for helping with the presentation before I got distracted.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Molto importante. Grazie per avermi aiutato con la presentazione prima che mi distraessi.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. I need you to pretend you're not my boyfriend for ten minutes.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene. Ho bisogno che tu faccia finta di non essere il mio ragazzo per dieci minuti.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You did most of the work before you came here.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Hai fatto la maggior parte del lavoro prima di venire qui.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You helped me say it out loud. That's the part I needed.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mi hai aiutato a dirlo ad alta voce. Quella era la parte di cui avevo bisogno.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Later, {{name:lena}} checks the time and gathers her notes. She puts her laptop away, picks up both bags and joins you by the door.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTI DOPO — Più tardi, {{name:lena}} controlla l'ora e raccoglie i suoi appunti. Ripone il laptop, prende entrambe le borse e ti raggiunge alla porta.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Both bags accounted for?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Entrambe le borse sono a posto?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Yes. I'm leaving you with absolutely no administrative reason to invite me back.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sì. Ti lascio senza alcun motivo amministrativo per invitarmi di nuovo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I think I'll manage without one.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Penso che riuscirò a farne a meno.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you would.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Speravo che lo avresti fatto.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} sets the bags down for a moment and steps back toward you. She kisses you goodbye, one hand resting on your shoulder while your arm wraps around her waist.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} appoggia le borse per un momento e si avvicina a te. Ti bacia per dirti addio, una mano appoggiata sulla tua spalla mentre il tuo braccio le avvolge la vita.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: One More Before Leaving
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Un'altra prima di andare

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Okay. Now I'm really going.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene. Ora me ne vado davvero.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: That's a difficult opening request.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: È una richiesta di apertura difficile.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Text me when you get home.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Mandami un messaggio quando arrivi a casa.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I will. Love you.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo farò. Ti amo.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Love you too.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ti amo anche io.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} picks up both bags and leaves. You tidy the table and settle in for the rest of the evening.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} prende entrambe le borse e se ne va. Tu sistemi il tavolo e ti prepari per il resto della serata.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: 20 MINUTI DOPO — {{name:lena}} È A CASA

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Home ❤️ Both bags made it
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: A casa ❤️ Entrambe le borse sono arrivate

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Excellent. Any forgotten notes?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Eccellente. Hai dimenticato qualche appunto?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: No. I checked twice
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: No. Ho controllato due volte.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: And I tried that difficult section again while I was unpacking
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: E ho riprovato quella parte difficile mentre disfacevo le valigie.

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: How did it go?
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Com'è andata?

story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.source: An ordinary person in the audience, then. Who isn't allowed to kiss me until I'm finished.
story/DAY18/love/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Quindi, una persona normale nel pubblico. Che non può baciarmi finché non ho finito.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have a session later this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ho una sessione più tardi questa mattina.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: He moved it earlier than usual
Just that it worked better for his schedule
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Solo che funzionava meglio per il suo programma.
Non sono riuscita a dormire molto. E tu?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I'm going to get ready slowly
I made some breakfast for you too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ho preparato anche una colazione per te

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I kept waking up for no reason
Then I just stayed in bed staring at the ceiling like an idiot
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Poi sono rimasta a letto a fissare il soffitto come un'idiota.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: It's just one of those mornings where the brain thinks too much
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: È solo una di quelle mattine in cui la mente pensa troppo.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ Do you need me to pick anything up for tonight?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ Hai bisogno che prenda qualcosa per stasera?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Kept waking up, but I'll be fine once I'm moving
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Continuavo a svegliarmi, ma starò bene appena mi muovo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How about you?
Pretty well, and I made it down to the mailbox and back this morning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Abbastanza bene, sono riuscito ad andare alla cassetta della posta e tornare stamattina

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Bet it felt good not having to ask someone else
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Scommetto che è stato bello non dover chiedere a qualcun altro

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It did, even if all I collected was junk mail
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo è stato, anche se tutto ciò che ho raccolto era posta spazzatura

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A disappointing prize for all that effort 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un premio deludente per tutto quel lavoro 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll survive
What's on the menu tonight?
Chicken and rice, nothing that needs an instruction manual
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pollo e riso, niente che richieda un manuale d'istruzioni

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I can manage that
Just yourself, I've got the rest
I got the lemonade you like too
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho preso anche la limonata che ti piace

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered?
You always look for it when you're here
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo cerchi sempre quando sei qui

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's really sweet ❤️
I'm bringing dessert, let me do that part
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Porto il dessert, lascia che faccia io quella parte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to argue with dessert
Excellent, one decision made without a fight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Eccellente, una decisione presa senza litigare

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still around six?
Yeah, I finish at five. I'll stop on the way and come straight over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, finisco alle cinque. Mi fermerò lungo la strada e verrò direttamente

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll be here
You didn't have to do everything
I'm glad we're doing this tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono felice che lo facciamo stasera

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Me too
I should finish getting ready before I manage to be late
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dovrei finire di prepararmi prima di riuscire a fare tardi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're not ready yet?
Almost, I've been standing here with one earring in while talking to you 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quasi, sono qui con un orecchino mentre parlo con te 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A few minutes later, before she leaves...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pochi minuti dopo, prima che parta...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There, both earrings and everything 😊
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ecco, entrambi gli orecchini e tutto 😊

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
Thank you ❤️
It's dinner, not a wedding 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È solo cena, non un matrimonio 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day
You too, and don't eat all the good bits before I get there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Anche tu, e non mangiare tutti i pezzi buoni prima che io arrivi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No promises about the crispy edges
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nessuna promessa per i bordi croccanti

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Save me some or I'm keeping the dessert 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Salvami un po' o mi tengo il dessert 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, see you tonight
Love you too
I know, I just wanted to help
You can help me eat it
That part I'm very qualified for 😌
Good morning, by the way
Good morning handsome ❤️ I went straight into planning mode
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buongiorno bello ❤️ Sono subito entrata in modalità pianificazione

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you sleep okay?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 Quick important question before I go back: apple tart or chocolate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ehi 😊 Domanda veloce e importante prima di tornare: torta di mele o cioccolato?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you finish then
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti lascio finire allora

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll text you when I leave ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti scrivo quando parto ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shortly before five, in the manager's office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Poco prima delle cinque, nell'ufficio del manager...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Office conversation detected near {{name:lena}}
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Conversazione in ufficio rilevata vicino a {{name:lena}}

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm supposed to be looking forward to seeing {{name:lena}} tonight. Instead, every update from that office pulls me back to last night.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dovrei essere impaziente di vedere {{name:lena}} stasera. Invece, ogni aggiornamento da quell'ufficio mi riporta a ieri sera.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//LIVE TRANSCRIPTION
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//TRASCRIZIONE IN DIRETTA

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Finito?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The updated totals are in your inbox, and the signed copies are in this folder
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: I totali aggiornati sono nella tua casella di posta, e le copie firmate sono in questa cartella

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Bring them over, I don't bite
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Portali qui, non mordo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I can leave a folder on a desk without instructions
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Posso lasciare una cartella su una scrivania senza istruzioni

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There she is. You've hardly said a word to me all day
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eccola. Non mi hai praticamente detto nulla tutto il giorno

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I've been thinking about how last night ended
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho pensato a come è finita la scorsa notte

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apple tart
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Torta di mele

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So have I
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Anch'io

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non in quel modo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to tell me you didn't enjoy it?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi dirai che non ti è piaciuto?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's not the problem
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, mi è piaciuto. Non è quello il problema

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I went home and talked to him like nothing had happened
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono tornata a casa e gli ho parlato come se non fosse successo nulla

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was a kiss, not a marriage proposal
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È stato un bacio, non una proposta di matrimonio

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wouldn't see it that way
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lui non la vedrebbe in quel modo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He wasn't there
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lui non era lì

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That doesn't make it better
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questo non lo rende migliore

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You weren't nearly this worried outside the bar
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non eri così preoccupata fuori dal bar

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, that's what I was hoping you'd say
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene, era quello che speravo dicessi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I should've been
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Avrei dovuto esserlo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And I kissed you back that even worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E ti ho baciato di rimando, ancora peggio

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then stop trying to talk yourself out of having enjoyed it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora smettila di cercare di convincerti di non averlo gradito

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not. I just feel bad about what i did and that I'm keeping it from him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non lo sto facendo. Mi sento solo male per quello che ho fatto e per il fatto che glielo sto nascondendo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Who cares what he thinks? You kissed me, and you liked it. That's all that matters
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A chi importa cosa pensa? Mi hai baciato e ti è piaciuto. Questo è tutto ciò che conta

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't want to hurt him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non voglio fargli del male

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You won't. You can still be with him and have a good time with me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non lo farai. Puoi ancora stare con lui e divertirti con me

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't know if I can do that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non so se posso farlo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can. You just have to want to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puoi. Devi solo volerlo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come have a drink with me when you're done
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vieni a bere qualcosa con me quando hai finito

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was this ever really a choice?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È stata mai davvero una scelta?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I'm seeing him tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, lo vedo stasera

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cena?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Dinner and a film. I told him I'd be there around six
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cena e un film. Gli ho detto che sarei lì verso le sei

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very domestic
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Molto casalingo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's something I want to do, you don't have to make it sound boring
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È qualcosa che voglio fare, non devi farlo sembrare noioso

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can see me another night
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puoi vedermi un'altra sera

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could try not deciding that for me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Potresti provare a non decidere per me

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know you'd have a good time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: So che ti divertiresti

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You never get tired of hearing yourself, do you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non ti stanchi mai di sentirti parlare, vero?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not when I'm right
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non quando ho ragione

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were allowed to agree with me 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Potevi concordare con me 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm leaving now
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sto uscendo adesso

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You know where to find me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sai dove trovarmi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I work here. It would be difficult not to
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lavoro qui. Sarebbe difficile non farlo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:lena}} picks up her bag and moves toward the office door
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:lena}} prende la sua borsa e si dirige verso la porta dell'ufficio

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Her manager look at her ass as she leaves
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il suo manager guarda il suo sedere mentre esce

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cattura visiva archiviata

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: She's leaving, and I finally let out the breath I've been holding. Even now, I hate the way he watches her go.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sta andando via, e finalmente lascio uscire il respiro che trattenevo. Anche adesso, odio il modo in cui la guarda andarsene.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Leaving on Time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Uscita in orario

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At five, outside the office...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alle cinque, fuori dall'ufficio...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five o'clock, I'm out ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cinque in punto, esco ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All finished?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tutto finito?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enough for today, I've left the rest where it belongs
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Basta per oggi, ho lasciato il resto dove appartiene

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At work?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Al lavoro?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's your afternoon going?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Come sta andando il tuo pomeriggio?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Where it can bother someone else for an hour 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dove può dare fastidio a qualcun altro per un'ora 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Stopping for the tart, then coming over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Fermandomi per la torta, poi vengo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time, the food isn't on yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prenditi il tuo tempo, il cibo non è ancora pronto

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: After a quick stop at the bakery...
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dopo una veloce fermata in panetteria...

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: They had two slices left. I consider that excellent planning
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Avevano due fette rimaste. Considero che sia una pianificazione eccellente

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You got lucky
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai avuto fortuna

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't ruin my very organised girlfriend image 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per favore non rovinare la mia immagine di ragazza molto organizzata 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep the box upright, that's all I'm asking
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tieni la scatola dritta, è tutto ciò che chiedo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's getting a better seat on the bus than I am
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sta ottenendo un posto migliore sull'autobus di me

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nearly through the last batch of paperwork
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quasi finito l'ultimo lotto di scartoffie

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you around six ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ci vediamo verso le sei ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: See you soon
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A presto

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Still leaving at five, I'm not letting a folder steal our evening
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parto ancora alle cinque, non lascerò che una cartella rubi la nostra serata

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I haven't started cooking yet, you've got time
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non ho ancora iniziato a cucinare, hai tempo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, I just want to get out on time for once
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so, voglio solo uscire in orario per una volta

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: What are you planning to do once the exams are finally over?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Cosa hai in mente di fare una volta che gli esami saranno finalmente finiti?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I haven't really thought that far ahead yet
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Non ci ho pensato molto in là

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But the first thing will probably be sleeping until my body forces me to get up
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ma la prima cosa sarà probabilmente dormire finché il mio corpo non mi costringe a svegliarmi

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: That would be a nice change
I have spent so much time stressed that I almost forgot what free time is supposed to feel like
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ho passato così tanto tempo stressata che quasi mi sono dimenticata come ci si sente ad avere del tempo libero

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You'll remember pretty quickly once it's over
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Te ne ricorderai abbastanza in fretta una volta che sarà finita

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I'm kind of looking forward to being completely useless for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Non vedo l'ora di essere completamente inutile per un po'

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:evelyn}} cooked something that actually smells decent
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} ha cucinato qualcosa che ha un buon profumo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Vieni a mangiare prima che inizi a farmi quella faccia

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Come eat before she starts giving me that look
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Vieni a mangiare prima che inizi a farmi quella faccia

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: We are sitting down for dinner with {{name:evelyn}}. Are you joining us?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ci sediamo a cena con {{name:evelyn}}. Vuoi unirti a noi?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I've already eaten with {{name:lena}}. She's gone home now, so I'll come say hello.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ho già mangiato con {{name:lena}}. È tornata a casa, quindi vengo a salutarti.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You're in a great mood tonight
Just wanted to annoy you a little

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm downstairs, and your dessert survived the bus
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ sono giù, e il tuo dessert ha sopravvissuto all'autobus

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her phone goes back into her bag. When you pull the blanket over her feet, she turns toward you instead of the screen. "What?" you ask. "Nothing. Come here." She rests her head against you and holds your hand under the blanket. It takes a nudge from you before she notices the film has already started.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il suo telefono torna nella borsa. Quando tiri la coperta sopra i suoi piedi, si gira verso di te invece che verso lo schermo. "Cosa?" chiedi. "Niente. Vieni qui." Appoggia la testa su di te e ti tiene la mano sotto la coperta. Ci vuole una spinta da parte tua prima che si accorga che il film è già iniziato.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 80 MINUTES LATER — You spend the film close together, occasionally arguing about whether the lead actor is meant to be funny. When the credits roll, she stays for another few minutes before getting her things. At the door, she gives you a longer hug, promises to text when she is home, and heads for the bus.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 80 MINUTI DOPO — Passate il film vicini, litigando di tanto in tanto su se l'attore principale debba essere divertente. Quando scorrono i titoli di coda, rimane per altri pochi minuti prima di prendere le sue cose. Alla porta, ti dà un abbraccio più lungo, promette di scriverti quando è a casa e si dirige verso l'autobus.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — {{name:lena}} IS HOME
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTI DOPO — {{name:lena}} È A CASA

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm home ❤️ Thank you for tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono a casa ❤️ Grazie per stasera

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you get back okay?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei tornata bene?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, got a seat and almost fell asleep before my stop 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì, ho trovato un posto e quasi mi sono addormentata prima della mia fermata 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You left your hair tie on the sofa
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai lasciato il tuo fermaglio sul divano

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it, I'll need an excuse to steal that cushion again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tienilo, mi servirà una scusa per rubare di nuovo quel cuscino

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't need an excuse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non hai bisogno di una scusa

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What about you?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E tu?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You went quiet a couple of times tonight
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei stata zitta un paio di volte stasera

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, I had a lot on my mind
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Scusa, avevo molte cose in mente

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did I do something?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho fatto qualcosa?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you didn't do anything wrong, your perfect
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, non hai fatto nulla di sbagliato, sei perfetto

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was really happy to be there with you
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ero davvero felice di essere lì con te

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was happy you came
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ero felice che tu fossi venuta

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Me too, I'd missed being next to you instead of watching from my end of a screen
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anch'io, mi mancava essere accanto a te invece di guardare da un altro schermo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Much easier for you to steal the blanket
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Molto più facile per te rubare la coperta

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That too 😌
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche quello 😌

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Less impressive condition, but still edible
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Condizioni meno impressionanti, ma ancora commestibile

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And I liked your film, even if I still don't think that man was meant to be funny
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E mi è piaciuto il tuo film, anche se non penso ancora che quell'uomo dovesse essere divertente

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You laughed more than I did
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai riso più di me

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Mostly at you laughing at him
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per lo più per te che ridevi di lui

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take it
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo prendo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dinner was really good too ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cena era davvero buona anche ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even without all my chicken on your plate?
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche senza tutto il mio pollo nel tuo piatto?

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't start, I took one piece 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non iniziare, ho preso un pezzo 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get some sleep, you looked ready to fall asleep on me
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Fai un po' di sonno, sembravi pronta a addormentarti su di me

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I nearly did. It was nice not having to go anywhere for a while
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ci sono quasi riuscita. È stato bello non dover andare da nessuna parte per un po'

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We'll do it again
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo rifaremo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AVAILABLE 😭
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DISPONIBILE 😭

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piacerebbe

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night handsome, love you ❤️
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buonanotte bello, ti voglio bene ❤️

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Love you too, sleep well
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti voglio bene anche io, dormi bene

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm opening the door before you make it worse
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apro la porta prima che tu faccia peggio

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please do
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per favore fallo

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around six, you open the door. {{name:lena}} sets the pastry bag down and wraps both arms around you before you've finished saying hello. She kisses your cheek and stays against you for another moment, then steps inside.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Verso le sei, apri la porta. {{name:lena}} posa la borsa dei dolci e ti abbraccia prima che tu abbia finito di dire ciao. Ti bacia sulla guancia e rimane contro di te per un altro momento, poi entra.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — Over dinner, you pour the lemonade you bought for her. She looks at the bottle, then at you. "You even put it in the fridge," she says. "I thought warm lemonade might get a bad review." She smiles, but goes quiet for a moment before reaching across the table for your hand.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTI DOPO — A cena, versi la limonata che hai comprato per lei. Lei guarda la bottiglia, poi te. "L'hai messa anche in frigo," dice. "Pensavo che la limonata calda potesse ricevere una brutta recensione." Sorride, ma rimane in silenzio per un momento prima di allungare la mano verso la tua.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The conversation loosens over dinner. She tells you about her morning and steals a piece of chicken from your plate while you answer. When you notice, she insists that yours had the crispy edge she was promised. When you set out the two slices of tart, she laughs at your attempt to decide which one is bigger.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La conversazione si allenta durante la cena. Ti racconta della sua mattina e ruba un pezzo di pollo dal tuo piatto mentre rispondi. Quando te ne accorgi, insiste che il tuo aveva il bordo croccante che le era stato promesso. Quando metti sul tavolo le due fette di torta, ride del tuo tentativo di decidere quale sia più grande.

story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: 20 MINUTES LATER — After helping you clear the plates, she leaves her shoes beside the sofa and claims the good cushion. She takes the tie out of her hair as she settles beside you. Before the film starts, she leans against your shoulder and takes a photo of the two of you. She sends you a copy to keep.
story/DAY18/ntr/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: 20 MINUTI DOPO — Dopo aver aiutato a sparecchiare, lascia le sue scarpe accanto al divano e si prende il cuscino migliore. Si toglie il fermaglio dai capelli mentre si sistema accanto a te. Prima che il film inizi, si appoggia alla tua spalla e scatta una foto di voi due. Ti manda una copia da tenere.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Quali sono i tuoi piani per oggi?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I have to go buy some revision books with {{name:ethan}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Devo andare a comprare dei libri di ripasso con {{name:ethan}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s just code for going to his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: È solo un modo per dire che vado a casa sua

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: No, I actually need the books
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: No, ho davvero bisogno dei libri

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Funny how you only start working hard at the end of the year
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: È divertente come inizi a lavorare sodo solo alla fine dell'anno

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That’s what happens when you have a professor who knows how to motivate 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Questo succede quando hai un professore che sa come motivare 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’ll probably just rot in bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Probabilmente mi farò solo un giro a letto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: {{name:aiden}} won’t even want to hang out with you anymore
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: {{name:aiden}} non vorrà nemmeno più uscire con te

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I invited {{name:aiden}} over to hang out
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Ho invitato {{name:aiden}} a fare un giro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: All sore, messy hair, looking half dead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Tutta dolorante, con i capelli in disordine, che sembri mezzo morto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 I woke up before my alarm and now half past three feels about a week away
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ehi 😊 mi sono svegliata prima della sveglia e ora le tre e mezza sembrano lontane un'eternità

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I mostly want you to stop treating your own feelings like the least important part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voglio soprattutto che tu smetta di trattare i tuoi sentimenti come se fossero la parte meno importante

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ci sto provando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I like that you want me to do this as me, not as some version of myself I have to invent
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi piace che tu voglia che lo faccia come sono, non come una versione di me stessa che devo inventare

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's the girl I'm in love with
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quella è la ragazza di cui sono innamorato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was unfairly sweet ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È stato ingiustamente dolce ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now I've forgotten what I was looking for before you made me smile at the kitchen table
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ora ho dimenticato cosa stavo cercando prima che tu mi facessi sorridere al tavolo della cucina

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Keys?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Chiavi?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, actually
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, in effetti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at me, useful and charming
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guarda me, utile e affascinante

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not ruin it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non roviniamolo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I'm getting ready later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti scriverò quando mi preparo più tardi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good morning. And eat before the meeting swallows your lunch break
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buona mattina. E mangia prima che la riunione si inghiotta la tua pausa pranzo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You really are stealing my job today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oggi stai davvero rubando il mio lavoro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That looks considerably better than what I made
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quello sembra decisamente meglio di quello che ho fatto io

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You could try putting something on the plate instead of eating over the sink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potresti provare a mettere qualcosa nel piatto invece di mangiare sopra il lavandino

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You weren't here. You can't prove anything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non eri qui. Non puoi provare niente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti conosco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have the group meeting this morning, then I'll come home and get changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho la riunione di gruppo stamattina, poi tornerò a casa e mi cambierò

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still wearing the dress from yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Indossi ancora il vestito di ieri?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I'm refusing to start that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì. Rifiuto di ricominciare a prendere quella decisione

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want to ask you something before I go, though
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Volevo chiederti qualcosa prima di andare, però

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What is it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Che cos'è?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can go back to sleep. I'll wake you up in June
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puoi tornare a dormire. Ti sveglierò a giugno

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: About today. About limits, I suppose
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Riguardo a oggi. Riguardo ai limiti, suppongo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We've talked about what you want to know afterward, but not quite about this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Abbiamo parlato di cosa vuoi sapere dopo, ma non proprio di questo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: When we said coffee, did we mean coffee and nothing else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quando abbiamo detto caffè, intendevamo solo caffè e nient'altro?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. We picked somewhere for you to meet, not a rule about where the afternoon has to stop
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No. Abbiamo scelto un posto dove incontrarti, non una regola su dove deve fermarsi il pomeriggio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So if it goes well and I want to stay longer, I'm not supposed to come home just because that's all we mentioned?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quindi, se va bene e voglio restare più a lungo, non dovrei tornare a casa solo perché è tutto ciò di cui abbiamo parlato?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Of course not
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo che no

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I want you to do what you feel like doing, not keep checking whether it was on a list we made this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voglio che tu faccia quello che ti va di fare, non che continui a controllare se era su una lista che abbiamo fatto stamattina

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to kiss him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E se voglio baciarlo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Allora bacialo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You say that very easily
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo dici molto facilmente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very helpful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Molto utile

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Because I mean it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Perché lo penso sul serio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And if I want to go further than that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E se voglio andare oltre?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not going to set a limit for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non ti metterò limiti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No limits from me. I want you to decide what you want, not what you think I want you to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nessun limite da parte mia. Voglio che tu decida cosa vuoi, non cosa pensi che io voglia che tu faccia

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Davvero?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Really. You don't have to ask me for permission at every step
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Davvero. Non devi chiedermi il permesso a ogni passo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't know what I'll feel like yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non so ancora come mi sentirò

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You don't need to know already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non hai bisogno di saperlo già

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Maybe you have one coffee and leave. Maybe you want to spend the rest of the afternoon together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Magari prendi un caffè e te ne vai. Magari vuoi passare il resto del pomeriggio insieme

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I don't want you stopping yourself just to fit a plan, or pushing yourself to make the story more interesting for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non voglio che ti fermi solo per seguire un piano, o che ti forzi a rendere la storia più interessante per me

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was fine last night. Now I'm checking the time while the kettle boils
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Stavo bene ieri sera. Ora controllo l'ora mentre l'acqua bolle

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That was the bit I was worried about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Era proprio quella parte che mi preoccupava

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Coming home and feeling like I'd either done too much or disappointed you by not doing enough
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Tornare a casa e sentire di aver fatto troppo o di averti deluso non facendo abbastanza

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There's no amount you have to do to make today a success
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non c'è nulla che devi fare per rendere oggi un successo
