story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So I decide what I actually want, and see what he wants too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quindi decido cosa voglio davvero e vedo anche cosa vuole lui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I can still change my mind in the middle of it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E posso sempre cambiare idea in mezzo a tutto questo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Obviously. This isn't you promising anything to either of us
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ovviamente. Non è che tu stia promettendo nulla a entrambi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's a much bigger answer than I was expecting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È una risposta molto più grande di quanto mi aspettassi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I already had breakfast, before you ask
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho già fatto colazione, prima che tu chieda

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Last night you said it suddenly felt much more real. Has that changed?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ieri sera hai detto che all'improvviso sembrava molto più reale. È cambiato?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Not entirely. I still notice it when I think about you actually being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non del tutto. Lo noto ancora quando penso a te che sei davvero lì

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: But feeling nervous doesn't mean I want to make your decisions for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma sentirsi nervoso non significa che voglio prendere le tue decisioni per te

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't turn being relaxed into another thing you have to perform for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non trasformare il sentirti rilassato in un'altra cosa che devi fare per me

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I won't. I'll tell you if something feels different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non lo farò. Ti dirò se qualcosa sembra diverso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want the real answer from you, even when it takes a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bene. Voglio la risposta reale da te, anche se ci vuole un minuto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You remembered ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Te lo sei ricordato ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you still smiling like you were last night?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Stai ancora sorridendo come ieri sera?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. A little distracted too, but I'm looking forward to hearing how you feel
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì. Un po' distratta anche io, ma non vedo l'ora di sapere come ti senti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Just don't decide how my entire afternoon goes before I've even left the house
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non decidere come sarà il mio pomeriggio prima che io sia uscita di casa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm trying to concentrate on the girl who keeps texting me instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sto cercando di concentrarmi sulla ragazza che continua a scrivermi invece

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She sounds lovely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra adorabile

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She is ❤️
I could practically hear tomorrow's lecture before I went to bed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potevo praticamente sentire la lezione di domani prima di andare a letto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Even with {{name:aiden}}? Knowing we'll still see him around afterward?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Anche con {{name:aiden}}? Sapendo che lo vedremo ancora dopo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. I haven't forgotten who we're talking about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì. Non ho dimenticato di chi stiamo parlando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I trust you. I'm not asking you to spend the whole date protecting me from finding it strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi fido di te. Non ti chiedo di passare tutto il tempo a proteggermi dal trovarlo strano

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He might be the one who needs a minute today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potrebbe essere lui a aver bisogno di un attimo oggi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Still trying to understand yesterday?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Stai ancora cercando di capire ieri?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Probably. I'm not sure the words "my boyfriend knows" have completely settled in yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Probabilmente. Non sono sicura che le parole "il mio ragazzo sa" siano ancora del tutto affondate

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let him order something before you surprise him again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fagli ordinare qualcosa prima di sorprenderlo di nuovo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm not giving a second presentation. He can cope 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non farò una seconda presentazione. Può cavarsela 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's called being a good influence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Si chiama essere una buona influenza

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm still meeting someone I don't actually know yet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E sto ancora incontrando qualcuno che in realtà non conosco ancora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly. Being free to choose doesn't mean you suddenly have to trust him with everything
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Esatto. Essere liberi di scegliere non significa che devi improvvisamente fidarti di lui per tutto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I still want to see what he's like over a coffee first. That hasn't changed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Voglio ancora vedere com'è davanti a un caffè prima. Questo non è cambiato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Then that's where you start
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Allora è da lì che inizi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I liked his messages. I don't want to spend the date wondering whether I'm matching the version I imagined
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi sono piaciuti i suoi messaggi. Non voglio passare il tempo a chiedermi se corrispondo alla versione che ho immaginato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You might find the real person more interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potresti trovare la persona reale più interessante

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: As long as he leaves the cooking to the café, we have a chance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Finché lascia la cucina al caffè, abbiamo una possibilità

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you eaten, or are you just supervising everyone else?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai mangiato, o stai solo supervisionando gli altri?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And when you said I could keep some things to myself, we'd only talked about a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E quando hai detto che potevo tenere alcune cose per me, avevamo parlato solo di un primo appuntamento

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I wanted to say this part out loud before treating that answer like it meant anything more
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Volevo dire questa parte ad alta voce prima di considerare quella risposta come se significasse qualcosa di più

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm glad you did. Now you know I want you to choose for yourself, rather than stop at the coffee because of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono contenta che l'hai fatto. Ora sai che voglio che tu scelga per te stesso, invece di fermarti al caffè per colpa mia

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Some things can stay mine without us misunderstanding each other
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene. Alcune cose possono rimanere mie senza che ci fraintendiamo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. And anything that worries either of us is still something we talk about
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì. E qualsiasi cosa che preoccupa uno di noi è ancora qualcosa di cui parliamo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I thought you were going to give me a very careful answer about what was allowed
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pensavo che mi avresti dato una risposta molto attenta su cosa era permesso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I have food right here, thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho del cibo proprio qui, grazie

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Buying the books took longer than expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Comprare i libri ha preso più tempo del previsto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER – LIVING ROOM
{{name:hailey}} gives {{name:aiden}} a kiss on the cheek
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} dà un bacio sulla guancia a {{name:aiden}}
Soggetto che intensifica intenzionalmente la familiarità

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That greeting feels less casual every time, and I'm noticing my own reaction now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quel saluto sembra sempre meno casuale, e adesso sto notando la mia reazione.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK archived evidence of {{name:hailey}} initiating a cheek kiss upon {{name:aiden}}’s arrival
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK ha archiviato la prova di {{name:hailey}} che inizia un bacio sulla guancia all'arrivo di {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Since when do you kiss him?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Da quando ha iniziato a allenarmi 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: He deserves a little reward for taking such good care of me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Se lo merita un piccolo premio per prendersi così cura di me

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} deliberately walks slowly in front of the couch
Subject deliberately walked in front of both males while wearing revealing clothes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Soggetto ha camminato intenzionalmente davanti a entrambi i maschi indossando vestiti rivelatori

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I don’t really know how to play though… 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Non so davvero come si gioca però… 😇
Soggetto si è seduto sulle ginocchia di Aiden

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I can see the closeness increasing, but I still need to work out how comfortable I am with it.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vedo che la loro vicinanza aumenta, ma devo ancora capire fino a che punto mi sento a mio agio.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK recorded {{name:hailey}} sitting on {{name:aiden}}’s lap under the pretext of learning how to play
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK ha registrato {{name:hailey}} seduta sulle ginocchia di {{name:aiden}} con la scusa di imparare a giocare

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: What? I need a good view of the screen 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Cosa? Ho bisogno di una buona vista dello schermo 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Don’t you dare come down dressed like that
Of course you’re not, you’re as bad as her
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Certo che no, sei peggio di lei

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I have a training session later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ho una sessione di allenamento più tardi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It was fun hanging out with you guys
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: È stato divertente stare con voi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you two do that in private?
If it’s a dare then I’m doing it even harder 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Se è una sfida, allora lo farò ancora di più 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I warned you you’d pay for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ti avevo avvertito che avresti pagato per questa mattina

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey 😊 I'm home and getting ready, and the dress has survived being reconsidered three times
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ehi 😊 sono a casa e mi sto preparando, e il vestito ha sopravvissuto a tre ripensamenti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Apparently. I feel like I've missed an entire chapter
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A quanto pare. Sento di aver perso un intero capitolo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It took me a while too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ci ho messo un po' anche io

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you talk again before coming here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Avete parlato di nuovo prima di venire qui?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This morning, yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questa mattina, sì

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And? Am I allowed to ask how that went, or is that private?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E? Posso chiederti come è andata, o è privato?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Some of it is private. But I asked whether coffee was supposed to be the limit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alcune cose sono private. Ma ho chiesto se il caffè dovesse essere il limite

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked him that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gli hai chiesto questo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What did he say?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cosa ha detto?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That he doesn't want to set a limit for me. He wants me to decide what I actually feel like doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non vuole mettermi dei limiti. Vuole che decida io cosa voglio davvero fare

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei bellissima

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Seriously? Just like that?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sul serio? Così, senza preavviso?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We talked for longer than that. I'm giving you the useful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abbiamo parlato più a lungo di così. Ti do solo la parte utile

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying to imagine having that conversation and keeping a straight face
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sto cercando di immaginare quella conversazione e mantenere un'espressione seria

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You didn't even manage the first sentence yesterday
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sei nemmeno riuscito a dire la prima frase ieri

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Fair point
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Giusto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It's still strange to me. Not bad, but strange
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È ancora strano per me. Non male, ma strano

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It can be strange without us spending the whole date explaining it again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Può essere strano senza dover passare tutta la data a spiegarlo di nuovo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai ragione

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And it doesn't mean I've arrived with a promise about how today ends
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E non significa che sia arrivata con una promessa su come finisce oggi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. It means I should ask you, not try to guess what he agreed to
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so. Significa che dovrei chiederti, non cercare di indovinare cosa ha accettato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel good in it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi sento bene in questo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. First question for you, then
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene. Prima domanda per te, allora

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Go on
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Continua

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you actually want the window seat, or did you take the other one because I was already sitting here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vuoi davvero il posto vicino al finestrino, o hai preso l'altro perché ero già seduta qui?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted the window seat
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Volevo il posto vicino al finestrino

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then swap with me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora scambiamoci

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Really?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Davvero?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. You're allowed to choose the chair too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Puoi scegliere anche la sedia

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're going to be very annoying about this now, aren't you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Adesso diventerai molto fastidioso, vero?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Only until you stop pretending you don't have preferences
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo finché non smetti di fingere di non avere preferenze

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was about to ask whether you thought it was too much, then I realized I actually liked it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stavo per chiederti se pensavi fosse troppo, poi ho capito che in realtà mi piaceva

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subjects switch seats
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: I soggetti cambiano posto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Observed gaze lingers lower than intended
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sguardo osservato si sofferma più in basso del previsto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I knew there was curiosity here, but noticing their attention still catches me off guard.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sapevo che c'era curiosità, ma notare la loro attenzione mi coglie ancora alla sprovvista.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Caught Looking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Beccato a guardare

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEIR COFFEE ARRIVES
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: DOPO CHE ARRIVA IL LORO CAFFÈ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is it good?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È buono?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Very. You're allowed to enjoy yours even if it's small
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Molto. Puoi goderti il tuo anche se è piccolo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It is good. Irritatingly good
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È buono. Fastidiosamente buono

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's why you keep coming back
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ecco perché continui a tornare

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That and it's quiet if you miss the lunch rush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E poi è tranquillo se perdi l'ora di pranzo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I don't think I've ever been here without watching the time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non credo di essere mai stato qui senza guardare l'orologio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You usually have somewhere else to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Di solito hai un altro posto dove andare

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then keep that answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora tieni quella risposta

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Classes, work, something I've forgotten to finish
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lezioni, lavoro, qualcosa che ho dimenticato di finire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Today I nearly brought my notes in my bag out of habit
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oggi stavo per portare i miei appunti nella borsa per abitudine

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can leave them there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Puoi lasciarli lì

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did. That's what I'm trying to tell you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'ho fatto. È quello che cerco di dirti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Sorry. I'm enjoying the fact that you chose to be here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Scusa. Mi piace il fatto che hai scelto di essere qui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a very inconveniently nice answer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È una risposta molto scomoda e carina

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I have those occasionally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ogni tanto ne ho

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I just don't always hear them without three jokes afterward
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so. Ma non sempre le sento senza tre barzellette dopo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm trying not to hide behind those as much today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sto cercando di non nascondermi dietro a queste oggi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't need to stop being funny
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non devi smettere di essere divertente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo farò ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good, because being handsome and silent sounds exhausting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene, perché essere bello e silenzioso sembra estenuante

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There he is
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eccolo lì

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What would you do with a whole afternoon free? Not what you should do. What you'd actually do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cosa faresti con un pomeriggio intero libero? Non quello che dovresti fare. Quello che faresti davvero.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd go for a walk without counting how long I was taking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Andrei a fare una passeggiata senza contare quanto tempo ci metto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Maybe find somewhere to sit, listen to something, not answer the class group for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Magari trovare un posto dove sedermi, ascoltare qualcosa, e non rispondere al gruppo di classe per un po'.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: There's a garden a couple of streets over
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: C'è un giardino a un paio di strade da qui.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know the one. I always walk past the entrance
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo conosco. Passo sempre davanti all'entrata.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We could go in this time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Potremmo entrare questa volta.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Mi piacerebbe.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER, OUTSIDE THE CAFÉ
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: PIÙ TARDI, FUORI DAL CAFÉ

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling otherwise?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Come ti senti altrimenti?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Left here, isn't it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: A sinistra qui, giusto?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Unless you plan to keep going around the same block
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. A meno che tu non voglia continuare a girare intorno allo stesso isolato.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I could pretend I was giving you a tour
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Potrei fingere di darti un tour.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of the place where I go to university?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Del posto dove vado all'università?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It needs work
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ha bisogno di un po' di lavoro.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un po'

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're being suspiciously quiet
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei sospettosamente silenzioso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were worried I'd make a joke
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eri preoccupato che facessi una battuta.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't ask you to stop speaking entirely
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non ti ho chiesto di smettere di parlare del tutto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm having a nice time. I don't want to ruin every quiet bit by filling it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi sto divertendo. Non voglio rovinare ogni momento di silenzio riempiendolo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Nervous, but not wishing I'd cancelled
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Nervosa, ma non rimpiango di aver cancellato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's new
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È una novità.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un po'

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piace.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER, IN THE GARDEN
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN PO' DOPO, NEL GIARDINO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This is nicer than the path outside
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È meglio di quel sentiero fuori.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You can hear yourself think in here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qui puoi davvero sentire i tuoi pensieri.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was hoping to do less of that today
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Speravo di farne meno oggi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How's it going?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Come va?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Better once we left the café
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È andata meglio dopo che siamo usciti dal caffè.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was I that bad over coffee?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ero così pessimo al caffè?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: More like the ten minutes before you have to do something and your brain runs out of useful things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Più come i dieci minuti prima di dover fare qualcosa e il tuo cervello esaurisce le cose utili da dire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No. I stopped imagining what I was supposed to do next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, ho smesso di pensare a cosa dovevo fare dopo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E adesso?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I'd like you to stop for a second
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ora vorrei che ti fermassi un attimo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Here?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Qui?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you're about to say something dangerous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai l'aria di chi sta per dire qualcosa di pericoloso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ero

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then maybe I got impatient
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Forse mi sono impazientito.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Subject initiates a kiss
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il soggetto inizia un bacio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Contact reciprocated
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Contatto ricambiato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A kiss makes this real in a way talking about it never could, and I need a moment with that.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un bacio rende tutto reale come le parole non avrebbero mai potuto, e ho bisogno di un momento per assimilarlo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to fill all ten minutes with thinking
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non devi riempire tutti e dieci i minuti pensando

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: To Shut Him Up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per zittirlo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ciao

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't say you could do that first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non ho detto che potevi farlo per primo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You stopped walking and looked at me like that. I took a risk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti sei fermato e mi hai guardato così. Ho preso un rischio.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That wasn't a risk. That was you skipping ahead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non era un rischio. Era solo tu che saltavi avanti.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So I was right about where this was going
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quindi avevo ragione su dove stava andando.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're really pleased with yourself right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei davvero soddisfatto di te stesso adesso.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un po'

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were about to kiss me anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Comunque stavi per baciarmi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Keep talking and see what happens
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Continua a parlare e vediamo cosa succede.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A radical suggestion
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una proposta radicale

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought you weren't starting that decision again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensavo che non stessi ricominciando a prendere quella decisione

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What, you'll stop me again?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cosa, mi fermerai di nuovo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shush
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Shhh

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So tell me honestly, who kisses better? Me or him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quindi dimmi onestamente, chi bacia meglio? Io o lui?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:aiden}}
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: What? It's a valid question
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cosa? È una domanda valida

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You turn everything into a competition. In games, in class, in life
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Trasformi tutto in una competizione. Nei giochi, a scuola, nella vita

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And now apparently in kissing too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E ora apparentemente anche nei baci

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: If you really want to know, for now you're still very far behind
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Se vuoi davvero sapere, per ora sei ancora molto indietro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wow. That's cold
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Wow. È freddo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai chiesto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: No, I like it. Now it sounds like a challenge
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, mi piace. Ora sembra una sfida

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It wasn't supposed to be
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non doveva esserlo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late. I'm already taking it personally
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Troppo tardi. La sto già prendendo sul personale

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're impossible
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei impossibile

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And yet you kissed me to shut me up
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eppure mi hai baciato per zittirmi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Which should tell you how effective words are with me right now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il che dovrebbe dirti quanto siano efficaci le parole con me in questo momento

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Want to sit for a little while?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vuoi sederti un po'?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. Over there, in the shade
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Laggiù, all'ombra

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Look at that. A seating preference without an interrogation
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Guarda un po'. Una preferenza di posto senza interrogatorio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're one comment away from sitting by yourself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei a un commento dal sederti da solo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: PIÙ TARDI QUEL POMERIGGIO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Shall I walk you back to the stop?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti accompagno alla fermata?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piacerebbe

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you want to make plans for another day now?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vuoi fare piani per un altro giorno adesso?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not right this second. I want a little time to take today in
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non proprio in questo momento. Voglio un po' di tempo per assaporare oggi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That isn't a polite way of saying no
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non è un modo educato per dire di no

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I didn't take it as one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non l'ho presa così

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. I'm glad we did this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene. Sono contenta che l'abbiamo fatto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Anch'io

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Text me when you're home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mandami un messaggio quando sei a casa?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo farò

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: AFTER THEY SAY GOODBYE
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: DOPO CHE DICONO ADDIO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home ❤️ That was a good afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sto tornando a casa ❤️ È stato un bel pomeriggio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad. How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono contenta. Come ti senti?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Happy, and a bit quieter than I expected
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Felice, e un po' più tranquilla di quanto mi aspettassi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I thought I'd want to type everything at once. Mostly I just want to sit with it for a minute
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Pensavo di voler scrivere tutto in una volta. Per lo più voglio solo sedermi e riflettere un attimo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Take your time. You don't have to turn the walk home into a report
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Prenditi il tuo tempo. Non devi trasformare la passeggiata a casa in un rapporto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I still wanted to send you this
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so. Volevo comunque inviarti questo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a lovely smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È un sorriso adorabile

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I feel like I've had an actual afternoon off
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembra che abbia davvero avuto un pomeriggio libero

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Not just a gap between two things I needed to do
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non solo un intervallo tra due cose che dovevo fare

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you got that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono contenta che tu l'abbia capito

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Can we talk properly when I'm settled at home?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Possiamo parlare per bene quando sono sistemata a casa?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And tell me something from your day too. I don't want mine to take up all the space
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E raccontami qualcosa della tua giornata anche. Non voglio che la mia occupi tutto lo spazio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I just sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gli ho appena inviato una foto veloce per dirgli che sono in arrivo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before going in. I like how much light there is in there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho scattato questa foto prima di entrare. Mi piace quanta luce c'è dentro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm at the café by the shopping street. I found a table by the big windows
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono al caffè vicino alla strada dello shopping. Ho trovato un tavolo vicino alle grandi finestre

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm early, so naturally I'm pretending choosing a drink is a very complicated task
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono in anticipo, quindi naturalmente faccio finta che scegliere una bevanda sia un compito molto complicato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least you'll have decided by the time he arrives
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Almeno avrai deciso quando lui arriva

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You would think so
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo penseresti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait, he's outside. I recognize him from the photos
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aspetta, è fuori. Lo riconosco dalle foto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away now. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Metto via il telefono adesso. Parliamo dopo ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: This one, not the mirror one I sent you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questa, non quella allo specchio che ti ho inviato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: POCHI MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ordered, and I asked if he'd be comfortable taking a photo together
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abbiamo ordinato, e ho chiesto se gli andrebbe di fare una foto insieme

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He said yes. I told him I'd like to send it to you as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ha detto di sì. Gli ho detto che mi piacerebbe mandartela anche

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look more relaxed already
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembri già più rilassato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Actually speaking to someone is easier than trying to imagine the first sentence
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Parlare realmente con qualcuno è più facile che cercare di immaginare la prima frase

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy your coffee. You can tell me how you're doing later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Goditi il tuo caffè. Puoi dirmi come stai dopo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I will 😊
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo farò 😊

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER THAT AFTERNOON
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: PIÙ TARDI QUEL POMERIGGIO

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Beyond the Coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Oltre il Caffè

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A LITTLE LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: UN PO' PIÙ TARDI

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: An Unplanned Goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un Addio Inaspettato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: LATER
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dopo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm on my way home 😊 It went well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sto tornando a casa 😊 È andata bene

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Come ti senti?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. Better than I did when I was studying the drinks menu like there was going to be a test
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene. Meglio di quando studiavo il menu delle bevande come se ci fosse un test

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It was nice not having to carry the whole conversation myself
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È stato bello non dover portare tutta la conversazione da solo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I like that smile
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piace quel sorriso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Was he like you expected?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Era come te lo aspettavi?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A bit quieter at first, actually. Which made me feel less silly for being nervous
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un po' più tranquillo all'inizio, in realtà. Questo mi ha fatto sentire meno stupida per essere nervosa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then he said he'd promised himself not to spend the first ten minutes explaining the pizza photograph
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Poi ha detto che si era promesso di non passare i primi dieci minuti a spiegare la foto della pizza

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: And did he manage it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: E ci è riuscito?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For about four minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per circa quattro minuti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I asked because I wanted to hear the story, not because he'd run out of things to say
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho chiesto perché volevo sentire la storia, non perché avesse finito le cose da dire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a better reason
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È un motivo migliore

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We ended up walking around afterward. I even came home with a secondhand book I wasn't planning to buy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Alla fine abbiamo gironzolato. Sono tornata a casa con un libro di seconda mano che non avevo intenzione di comprare

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A productive afternoon
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un pomeriggio produttivo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took two. In the first one I looked like I was trying to remember whether I'd locked the door
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ne ho fatte due. Nella prima sembravo stesse cercando di ricordare se avevo chiuso la porta

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: A completely unnecessary purchase, but I like it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Un acquisto completamente inutile, ma mi piace

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Did you enjoy being there, once the nerves settled?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti è piaciuto essere lì, una volta che i nervi si sono calmati?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes. I stopped trying to decide whether it was going well and just had a nice time
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Ho smesso di cercare di capire se stava andando bene e mi sono semplicemente divertita

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm keeping the small details for myself, but I wanted you to know that part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tengo per me i piccoli dettagli, ma volevo che tu sapessi quella parte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm glad you went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono contento che tu sia andata

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So am I ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Anch'io ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this after we said goodbye
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho fatto questa foto dopo che ci siamo salutati

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Had you?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'avevi chiusa?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not changing it. I'm just looking at it with unnecessary intensity
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non lo sto cambiando. Lo sto solo guardando con un'intensità inutile

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look happy
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembri felice

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I am. And hungry again somehow
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo sono. E ho di nuovo fame in qualche modo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to get home and eat before we talk properly, if that's okay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piacerebbe tornare a casa e mangiare prima di parlare seriamente, se va bene

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course. I'm not going anywhere
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo. Non vado da nessuna parte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still want to hear about your day too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voglio ancora sentire della tua giornata

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: It doesn't have to compete with mine to be interesting
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non deve competere con la mia per essere interessante

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did the washing without starting an international incident with the machine
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho fatto il bucato senza iniziare un incidente internazionale con la lavatrice

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I was still inside. So no 😭
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ero ancora dentro. Quindi no 😭

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's progress
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questo è un progresso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: One sock may have been lost in the process
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Una calza potrebbe essere andata persa nel processo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll remember its sacrifice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ricorderemo il suo sacrificio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You'd have complained if I hadn't done it
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti saresti lamentata se non l'avessi fatto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not complaining. I'm deciding how much praise you deserve
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non mi lamento. Sto decidendo quanto elogio meriti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: At least a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Almeno un po'

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then well done, handsome. I'll give you the longer version tonight ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora ben fatto, bello. Ti darò la versione lunga stasera ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I sent him a quick photo to say I'm on my way, by the way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Gli ho inviato una foto veloce per dirgli che sono in arrivo, tra l'altro

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Just me at the door, nothing elaborate
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Solo io alla porta, niente di elaborato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to send it twice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non devi inviarlo due volte

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. You've already had my full mirror inspection anyway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so. Hai già avuto la mia ispezione completa allo specchio, comunque

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm going now before I find another reason to stand in the hallway
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vado adesso prima di trovare un altro motivo per restare nel corridoio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Completely different
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Completamente diverso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Have a good time. We'll talk when you're free
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Divertiti. Parleremo quando sei libero

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for this morning
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Grazie per questa mattina

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You don't have to spend the date thinking about what I'd want next
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non devi passare il tempo a pensare a cosa vorrei dopo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know. I'm taking that part with me ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so. Porterò con me quella parte ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I took this before crossing the road. It looks much nicer without the lunch crowd
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho fatto questa foto prima di attraversare la strada. È molto più carina senza la folla di pranzo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Exactly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm outside the café. {{name:aiden}} is already here
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono fuori dal caffè. {{name:aiden}} è già qui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He looks far too pleased about being the one who arrived first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembra troppo soddisfatto di essere arrivato per primo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't let him get an entire conversation out of five minutes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non lasciargli fare un'intera conversazione in cinque minuti

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Too late, he's pointing at his wrist
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Troppo tardi, sta indicando il suo polso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm putting my phone away before he starts waving at that too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Metto via il telefono prima che inizi a salutare anche quello

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Five whole minutes early. I was about to become concerned
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Cinque interi minuti in anticipo. Stavo per preoccuparmi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're not wearing a watch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non hai un orologio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I know what time it is without one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: So che ore sono anche senza

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The group meeting finished on time, so I even managed a proper lunch
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: La riunione di gruppo è finita in tempo, quindi sono riuscita anche a farmi un pranzo decente

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then you know I'm early too
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora sai che sono in anticipo anche io

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I do. I just wanted to enjoy being first
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì. Volevo solo godermi il fatto di essere il primo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Is this how the entire date is going to be?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È così che sarà l'intero appuntamento?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like to think I've got a little more to offer
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piace pensare di avere un po' di più da offrire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We'll see
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Vedremo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You look really nice
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei davvero carino

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Grazie

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's all. You don't have to prepare a comeback to that one
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È tutto. Non devi preparare una risposta a questa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non lo ero

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You were a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Eri un po'

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Good. You won't spend the entire date staring at the cake display
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Bene. Non passerai tutto il tempo della data a fissare la vetrina dei dolci

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You're making me consider one now
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi fai considerare di farne uno adesso

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Come on. I found two chairs that don't wobble
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dai. Ho trovato due sedie che non ballano

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's unusually thoughtful of you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È insolitamente premuroso da parte tua

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Wait until you see the cups. They've done nothing about the cups
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aspetta di vedere le tazze. Non hanno fatto nulla per le tazze

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Would you mind taking a photo with me before the drinks arrive?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti dispiacerebbe fare una foto con me prima che arrivino da bere?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Taking it, or being in it?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Farla, o esserne dentro?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Being in it. I can hold the phone
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Essere dentro. Posso tenere il telefono

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's a separate issue
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quella è un'altra questione

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: For {{name:player}}?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per {{name:player}}?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd like one too. But yes, I'd like to send it to him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ne vorrei uno anche io. Ma sì, vorrei inviarlo a lui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: All right. You can send it to me as well
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene. Puoi inviarlo anche a me

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Then come a little closer or I'm only getting your shoulder
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora avvicinati un po' di più o prenderò solo la tua spalla

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You could have just asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Potevi semplicemente chiedere

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I did just ask. Look at the phone
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'ho appena chiesto. Guarda il telefono

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We found a table 😊 I asked for a photo before he could complain about the coffee
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abbiamo trovato un tavolo 😊 Ho chiesto una foto prima che potesse lamentarsi del caffè

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You both look like you're about to argue over the menu
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Siete entrambi come se steste per litigare sul menu

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We already did. This is the peaceful part
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Già lo abbiamo fatto. Questa è la parte tranquilla

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I wanted to show you before I leave
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Volevo mostrartelo prima di partire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: Enjoy it. Talk later ❤️
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Goditela. Ci sentiamo dopo ❤️

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: So, how did this morning go?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora, com'è andata questa mattina?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: We actually finished the work. I didn't have to pretend my laptop was about to die to get out
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: In realtà abbiamo finito il lavoro. Non ho dovuto fingere che il mio laptop stesse per morire per uscire

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: That's disappointing. I wanted to think you'd escaped for me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: È deludente. Volevo pensare che fossi scappato per me

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: You get the afternoon. Don't start asking for a dramatic backstory
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai il pomeriggio. Non iniziare a chiedere una storia drammatica

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I still keep thinking about yesterday, you know
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Continuo a pensare a ieri, lo sai

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: The look on your face is going to stay with me for a while
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: L'espressione sul tuo viso rimarrà con me per un po'

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: I spent years expecting him to get annoyed when I flirted with you. I did not expect this to be where that went
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ho passato anni a aspettarmi che si infastidisse quando flirtevo con te. Non mi aspettavo che finisse così

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.source: He has a few things going on that aren't just arguing with you over a game
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_01_LENA_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ha un paio di cose da fare che non sono solo litigare con te su un gioco

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Did you tell him you’d be back later?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Gli hai detto che saresti tornata più tardi?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Then we can continue the lesson
This has moved well past a study session, and it's harder to laugh off now.
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Si è andati ben oltre una sessione di studio, e adesso è più difficile riderci sopra.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: HAK archived the first kiss of the evening session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: HAK ha archiviato il primo bacio della sessione serale

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I also have ways to give punishments and rewards… without being the teacher 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ho anche modi per dare punizioni e ricompense... senza essere l'insegnante 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Subject initiated a handjob during the private session
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il soggetto ha iniziato una mano durante la sessione privata

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: On this subject… you don’t seem to need any lessons
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: A proposito di questo... non sembri aver bisogno di lezioni

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I’ll probably go revise directly at his place
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Probabilmente andrò a revisionare direttamente da lui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Subject increased the intensity of the act
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Il soggetto ha aumentato l'intensità dell'atto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: They finish with a kiss while she makes him cum
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Finiscono con un bacio mentre lei lo fa venire
La sessione si è conclusa con un’eiaculazione

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we still need to revise now
But it’s going to be hard to focus after that 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ma sarà difficile concentrarsi dopo quello 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: He’ll drop me off a bit later
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Mi riporterà a casa più tardi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I know… but we have to
I’m not the one who’s going to get eaten
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Non sono io quella che verrà mangiata

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: On the contrary… I’m the one who’s going to eat him 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Anzi... sono io quella che lo mangerà 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I know you like it 😌
I know you liked the show 😌
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: So che ti è piaciuto lo spettacolo 😌

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: A little reward just for you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Un piccolo premio solo per te

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Since when do you act like that?
I’m done living only for revisions
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ho finito di vivere solo per le revisioni

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I want to enjoy my life a little
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Voglio godermi un po' la vita

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: And I’ve always had a crush on him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: E ho sempre avuto una cotta per lui

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It seems like it’s mutual… so I’m taking advantage 😇
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Sembra che sia ricambiato... quindi ne approfitto 😇

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Aren’t you ashamed to do all that in front of me?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Non ti vergogni a fare tutto questo davanti a me?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not bothered by it at all

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I've had a shower and eaten something. Are you free for a proper conversation?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ Ho fatto una doccia e mangiato qualcosa. Sei libero per una conversazione seria?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That is exactly how you choose films
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È proprio così che scegli i film

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He said something very similar
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ha detto qualcosa di molto simile

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was nice having the conversation wander off like that. I stopped thinking about it being a first date
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È stato bello lasciare che la conversazione si perdesse così. Ho smesso di pensare che fosse un primo appuntamento

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was anything different from how you'd imagined him?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'era qualcosa di diverso da come te lo immaginavi?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He listened longer before answering than I expected from the messages
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ha ascoltato più a lungo prima di rispondere di quanto mi aspettassi dai messaggi

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At first I thought I'd said something awkward. Then I realized he was actually thinking about what I'd asked
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: All'inizio pensavo di aver detto qualcosa di imbarazzante. Poi ho capito che stava davvero pensando a quello che avevo chiesto

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not always the worst thing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non è sempre la cosa peggiore

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I liked it once I stopped trying to fill every pause
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Mi è piaciuto una volta che ho smesso di cercare di riempire ogni pausa

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He checked that you knew about us meeting, but he didn't keep bringing you up as if I needed to defend being there
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ha controllato che tu sapessi del nostro incontro, ma non ha continuato a parlarti come se avessi bisogno di difendere la mia presenza lì

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And if he wasn't sure about something, he asked me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E se non era sicuro di qualcosa, me lo chiedeva

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've finally sat down properly
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Finalmente mi sono seduta bene.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds like a good way to get to know you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembra un buon modo per conoscerti meglio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It felt that way
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È sembrato così

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We held hands for part of the walk
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ci siamo tenuti per mano per parte della passeggiata

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And outside the bookshop I asked if I could kiss him
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E fuori dalla libreria ho chiesto se potevo baciarlo

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You wanted to?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Volevi farlo?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We were getting ready to say goodbye, and I realized I was trying to think of another reason to stay
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ci stavamo preparando a dirci addio, e ho realizzato che stavo cercando un altro motivo per restare

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So I said what I actually wanted instead
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quindi ho detto quello che volevo davvero

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And he wanted that too?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E lui lo voleva anche?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He did
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was a little awkward finding the words. The kiss wasn't
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È stato un po' imbarazzante trovare le parole. Il bacio non lo è stato

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Afterward I was mostly pleased that I'd asked instead of spending the whole journey home wondering
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dopo, ero per lo più contenta di aver chiesto invece di passare tutto il viaggio di ritorno a chiedermi.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm glad you felt comfortable doing that
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono felice che ti sia sentito a tuo agio a farlo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So am I. I didn't know this morning whether I'd even want to stay for a second drink
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anch'io. Non sapevo stamattina se avrei voluto restare per un secondo drink.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to pretend I know him properly after one afternoon, but I enjoyed the afternoon we had
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non pretenderò di conoscerlo bene dopo un pomeriggio, ma mi è piaciuto il pomeriggio che abbiamo passato.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to decide anything bigger tonight
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non devi decidere niente di più grande stasera.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I told him I'd enjoyed meeting him, and we'll talk again
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so. Gli ho detto che mi era piaciuto incontrarlo e che parleremo di nuovo.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm not going to describe every moment, like we said
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non descriverò ogni momento, come abbiamo detto.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look comfortable
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembri a tuo agio

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to. Tell me how you're doing
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non devi. Dimmi come stai.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A bit thoughtful, but not upset
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Felice. Un po' pensierosa, ma non turbata.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I stayed because I wanted to be there, and left when I felt like going home
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono rimasta perché volevo esserci e sono andata via quando ho sentito di voler tornare a casa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't trying to make the afternoon last a certain amount of time or turn it into something bigger
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non stavo cercando di far durare il pomeriggio per un certo periodo o trasformarlo in qualcosa di più grande.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Did you feel comfortable saying what you wanted?
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti sei sentito a tuo agio a dire quello che volevi?

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. More comfortable once I stopped rehearsing everything in my head
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Più a mio agio una volta che ho smesso di ripetere tutto nella mia testa.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Some things I'd rather keep to myself for now, but there's nothing worrying me that I'm avoiding telling you
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Alcune cose preferisco tenerle per me per ora, ma non c'è nulla che mi preoccupi e che stia evitando di dirti.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what matters to me
story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo è ciò che conta per me.

story/DAY18/nts/DAY18_02_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like being able to tell you I enjoyed it without having to explain every little reason
