story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra sospettosamente un giorno di riposo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'd better not. I finally found one you haven't already told me the ending of
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fai bene a non farlo. Finalmente ne ho trovato uno di cui non mi hai già svelato il finale

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That happened once
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È successo una volta

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You said the brother looked suspicious before he'd even spoken
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai detto che il fratello sembrava sospetto prima ancora di parlare

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was wearing gloves indoors
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Indossava dei guanti in casa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He was washing dishes 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Stava lavando i piatti 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A convincing disguise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un travestimento convincente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can keep your detective work to yourself today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oggi puoi tenerti il tuo lavoro da detective

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It is 😌 No shift, no rushing anywhere this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo è 😌 Niente turno, niente fretta stamattina

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm looking forward to actually seeing your face instead of wondering what the pause between messages means
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E non vedo l'ora di vedere finalmente il tuo viso invece di chiedermi cosa significhi la pausa tra i messaggi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The pause was mostly me trying to find the right words
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La pausa era soprattutto io che cercavo le parole giuste

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. Today you can talk with your mouth full like a normal person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo so. Oggi puoi parlare con la bocca piena come una persona normale

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That I can manage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quello riesco a farlo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I want a nice afternoon with you, not another serious meeting
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bene. Voglio un bel pomeriggio con te, non un'altra riunione seria

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You sounded so pleased last night that I nearly came over just to see the expression that went with it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembravi così contento ieri sera che stavo quasi per venire solo per vedere l'espressione che ci stava dietro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You can inspect it this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Puoi ispezionarlo questo pomeriggio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've opened the window and I'm drinking my coffee while it's still hot ☕
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho aperto la finestra e sto bevendo il mio caffè mentre è ancora caldo ☕

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I intend to. From very close up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Intendo farlo. Da molto vicino

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to look too smug
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cercherò di non sembrare troppo compiaciuto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That would be a lovely change 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sarebbe un bel cambiamento 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Are you staying in after that?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dopo rimani a casa?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't decided the whole evening yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non ho ancora deciso l'intera serata

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's part of what I like about today
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È una delle cose che mi piacciono di oggi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: An unfamiliar experience
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un'esperienza insolita

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} sent me a picture of an arcade sign earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} mi ha mandato prima una foto di un'insegna di un arcade

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's discovered somewhere else to complain about losing?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ha trovato un altro posto dove lamentarsi di aver perso?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he was only making a helpful suggestion for my day off
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A quanto pare stava solo facendo un suggerimento utile per il mio giorno libero

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's how he gets you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È così che ti prende

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I told him I already had plans with you this afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Gli ho detto che avevo già piani con te questo pomeriggio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He said to ask you whether the air hockey table counts as neutral ground
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ha detto di chiederti se il tavolo da air hockey conta come terreno neutro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Only until he loses. Then the table is involved in a conspiracy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Solo fino a quando perde. Poi il tavolo è coinvolto in una cospirazione

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might go later. I'd enjoy watching him try to explain that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potrei andarci più tardi. Mi piacerebbe vederlo cercare di spiegare questo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't accept a best of three after you've already won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non accettare un best of three dopo che hai già vinto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very. I might become difficult to live with if I get used to it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Molto. Potrei diventare difficile da sopportare se mi abituerò

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm writing that down 😌📝
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo scrivo 😌📝

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from yesterday sent me a message about that book we looked at
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il tipo di ieri mi ha mandato un messaggio su quel libro che abbiamo guardato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The one from the shop?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quello del negozio?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes. Apparently the first page was worth getting home for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì. A quanto pare la prima pagina valeva la pena tornare a casa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've only read the back cover, so I told him not to get smug about it yet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho letto solo la quarta di copertina, quindi gli ho detto di non essere ancora troppo compiaciuto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A promising start to a book club
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un inizio promettente per un club del libro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's mostly us finding new ways to avoid saying we want to keep talking
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: È soprattutto noi che troviamo nuovi modi per evitare di dire che vogliamo continuare a parlare

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You've noticed, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Allora l'hai notato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Might?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potrebbe?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I might stop being subtle later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potrei smettere di essere sottile più tardi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: For now I told him I'm spending the afternoon with you. We'll talk this evening 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Per ora gli ho detto che passo il pomeriggio con te. Parleremo stasera 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I'd hate to share my excellent film commentary with a phone
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bene. Odio l'idea di dover condividere il mio eccellente commento sui film con un telefono

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm leaving it in my bag. For the commentary, not for you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo lascio nella mia borsa. Per il commento, non per te

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I should put actual clothes on before the bakery sells everything I want 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Giusto, dovrei mettermi dei vestiti veri prima che la panetteria venda tutto quello che voglio 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You haven't even decided what you want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non hai nemmeno deciso cosa vuoi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's why I need options
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ecco perché ho bisogno di opzioni

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll await the investigation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aspetterò l'indagine

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't eat all your snacks before I get there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non mangiare tutti i tuoi snack prima che io arrivi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Careful, I'm still deciding what to bring you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Attenta, sto ancora decidendo cosa portarti

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: LATER THAT MORNING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: PIÙ TARDI QUELLA MATTINA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Small update: the bakery woman remembered me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Piccolo aggiornamento: la donna della panetteria si è ricordata di me

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds nice
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra bello

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She remembered that I always say I'm only buying bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Si è ricordata che dico sempre che compro solo pane

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Less nice for your defense
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Meno bello per la tua difesa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: She had already reached for a bigger bag
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Aveva già preso una borsa più grande

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That's definitely not just bread
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quello non è di certo solo pane

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is bread in there. Somewhere
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'è del pane lì dentro. Da qualche parte

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got two apple pastries for us, and enough other things to make the walk home worth it 🥐
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho preso due dolci di mele per noi, e abbastanza altre cose per rendere la passeggiata a casa degna 🥐

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembri felice

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I am. I spent ten minutes looking at flowers without calculating where I needed to be next
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo sono. Ho passato dieci minuti a guardare i fiori senza calcolare dove dovevo andare dopo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Didn't buy any. Just enjoyed being there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non ne ho comprati. Ho solo goduto il momento

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We should have more days like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Dovremmo avere più giorni così

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, we should
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, dovremmo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going home to get the container, then I'll come over after lunch like we said
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vado a casa a prendere il contenitore, poi verrò dopo pranzo come abbiamo detto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Half past one still okay?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene ancora alle una e mezza?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Perfect
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Perfetto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll put the drinks in the fridge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Metterò le bevande in frigo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And leave my side of the sofa clear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E lascia libera la mia parte del divano

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look like you've already made peace with doing nothing
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembri aver già fatto pace con il non fare nulla

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Did you see the ass that i have in it 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Hai visto che culo ho con questo addosso? 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: To the gym or to your date with your coach?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: In palestra o al tuo appuntamento con il tuo allenatore?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not be looking for another indecent outfit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Spero che non stai cercando un altro outfit indecente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m spending the afternoon with some friends
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Passerò il pomeriggio con alcuni amici

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm barely down the street and I've already thought of another reason your theory about the film makes no sense 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ sono appena scesa per strada e ho già pensato a un altro motivo per cui la tua teoria sul film non ha senso 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: What next, then?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E adesso, che si fa?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The photo booth is tempting 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cabina fotografica è allettante 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: To preserve the evidence of my defeat?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per conservare le prove della mia sconfitta?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, because I want to see whether you can go four pictures without pulling a face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, perché voglio vedere se riesci a fare quattro foto senza fare una smorfia

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Unlikely. That's a very unfair challenge
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Improbabile. È una sfida davvero ingiusta

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A FEW MINUTES LATER, IN THE PHOTO BOOTH
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: POCHI MINUTI DOPO, NELLA CABINA FOTOGRAFICA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You realize I'm going to ruin at least one of these
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sai che rovinerò almeno una di queste foto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least one? That's optimistic
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Almeno una? È ottimista

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Move closer, then. I need every possible advantage
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Avvicinati, allora. Ho bisogno di ogni vantaggio possibile

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not how photo booths work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non funziona così con le cabine fotografiche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought most of it with you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai portato la maggior parte con te

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. The countdown has started
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Troppo tardi. Il conto alla rovescia è iniziato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Subjects enter the photo booth
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: I soggetti entrano nella cabina fotografica

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Series of personal photographs captured
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Serie di fotografie personali catturate

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I want her to enjoy the evening, and I can admit that I'm curious about how close they're becoming.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Voglio che si goda la serata, e posso ammettere di essere curioso di quanto si stiano avvicinando.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip I
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Striscia della Cabina Fotografica I

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Photo Booth Strip II
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Striscia della Cabina Fotografica II

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You pulled a face in the first one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai fatto una smorfia nella prima

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you smiled in all of them, so I still think I won
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E tu hai sorriso in tutte, quindi penso ancora di aver vinto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That isn't how winning works
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non funziona così vincere

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then explain the last picture
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora spiega l'ultima foto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me before the flash went off 😳
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi hai baciata prima che scattasse il flash 😳

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now it's preserved forever. You're welcome
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E ora è conservato per sempre. Prego!

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I meant the part where we stopped talking and just sat together
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Intendevo la parte in cui abbiamo smesso di parlare e ci siamo semplicemente seduti insieme

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're impossible 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei impossibile 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Still choosing pinball after this?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Scegli ancora il flipper dopo tutto questo?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. And I'm still not spending all evening keeping score
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. E non passerò tutta la sera a tenere il punteggio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's literally a score on that one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'è letteralmente un punteggio anche su quello

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can keep yours to yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi tenere il tuo per te

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER, OUTSIDE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DOPO, FUORI

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd forgotten how loud the street could sound quiet
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ero dimenticata quanto potesse sembrare silenziosa la strada

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My ears are still inside playing the racing game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Le mie orecchie sono ancora dentro a giocare al gioco di corse

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your dignity is in there somewhere too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La tua dignità è da qualche parte lì dentro anche

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi sono divertito

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I didn't realize how much I'd missed having you next to me until I was there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non mi ero reso conto di quanto mi mancassi finché non ero lì accanto a te

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche se ho vinto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even though you're never going to let that go
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche se non lo lascerai mai andare

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had a good time too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche io mi sono divertita

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shall I walk with you for a bit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso camminare con te un po'?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I was thinking of making tea when I get back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Stavo pensando di preparare del tè quando torno

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds sensible
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembra sensato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was almost an invitation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quasi un invito

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Almost?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quasi?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Would you like to come over for a cup of tea? We still have the pastry you refused to eat before your big performance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti va di venire per una tazza di tè? Abbiamo ancora il dolce che hai rifiutato di mangiare prima della tua grande esibizione

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'd like that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piacerebbe

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked that too. Even when your elbow found my ribs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche a me è piaciuto. Anche quando il tuo gomito ha trovato le mie costole

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And no asking where I keep a second controller
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E niente domande su dove tengo un secondo controller

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not even going to mention it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non lo menzionerò nemmeno

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going home and claiming the sofa for myself for a bit 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vado a casa e mi prendo il divano per un po' 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Already missing the film commentary?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Già ti manca il commento sul film?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll survive. I've got a book and somebody who has apparently read further than me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce la farò. Ho un libro e qualcuno che apparentemente ha letto più di me

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your new contact?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il tuo nuovo contatto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. We've been exchanging little messages since I left yours
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Ci siamo scambiati dei messaggi da quando ho lasciato casa tua

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He remembered I was seeing you and waited until I said I was free
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si è ricordato che ti stavo vedendo e ha aspettato che dicessi che ero libero

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were taking too much of the cushion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stavi occupando troppo il cuscino

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I was going to object to him interrupting the important cushion dispute
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. Stavo per obiettare che interrompesse la importante disputa sui cuscini

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nobody would have understood it without several photographs
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nessuno l'avrebbe capito senza diverse fotografie

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A shame there isn't a documentary
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Peccato che non ci sia un documentario

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't encourage me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non incoraggiarmi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: BACK AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: TORNATO A CASA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found my place in the book. It was still the bookmark they put in at the shop 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho trovato il mio posto nel libro. Era ancora il segnalibro che hanno messo nel negozio 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's not much progress
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non è un gran progresso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've made more progress with the conversation than the reading
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho fatto più progressi con la conversazione che con la lettura

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to answer him properly instead of pretending I can do both
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Risponderò a lui per bene invece di fingere di poter fare entrambe le cose

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Talk later, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Parliamo dopo, allora

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes ❤️ This picture was for you, by the way. He hasn't earned the embarrassing bookmark story 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì ❤️ Questa foto era per te, tra l'altro. Non ha guadagnato la storia imbarazzante del segnalibro 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: LATER THAT EVENING
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: PIÙ TARDI QUELLA SERA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: An Answer in Pictures
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Una risposta in immagini

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have two pictures you might like. He said it was okay to show you his one as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho due foto che potrebbero piacerti. Ha detto che va bene mostrarti anche la sua

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been exchanging photos?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: State scambiando foto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. This is the smile he asked for
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Questo è il sorriso che ha chiesto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Be nice. I left you actual leftovers this time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sii gentile. Questa volta ti ho lasciato dei veri avanzi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And this is the photo he took in his kitchen. I'm forwarding it, not claiming the camera work 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E questa è la foto che ha scattato nella sua cucina. La inoltro, non rivendico il lavoro della fotocamera 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was the apron meant to establish his qualifications?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'apron era per dimostrare le sue qualifiche?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently the dinner couldn't smile for the camera
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A quanto pare, la cena non poteva sorridere per la fotocamera

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's an answer you would like
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È una risposta che ti piacerebbe

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was. I laughed before I could pretend not to
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo era. Ho riso prima di poter far finta di nulla

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your photo is lovely, by the way
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La tua foto è bellissima, a proposito

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I knew you'd notice that one first ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sapevo che avresti notato quella prima ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your spoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E il tuo cucchiaio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep it safe. I'll expect a dramatic reunion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Conservalo bene. Mi aspetto una riunione drammatica

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You had two hours to tell me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai avuto due ore per dirmelo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to meet {{name:aiden}} after I've dropped the container at home 😊
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vado a incontrare {{name:aiden}} dopo aver lasciato il contenitore a casa 😊

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The arcade?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'arcade?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He said it would be a shame to let your expert advice go to waste
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Ha detto che sarebbe un peccato lasciare andare sprecati i tuoi consigli esperti

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He doesn't know half of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non sa nemmeno la metà

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's already warned me that one of the machines eats coins
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi ha già avvertito che una delle macchine mangia monete

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Useful. An excuse prepared before you arrive
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Utile. Una scusa preparata prima che tu arrivi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm allowing him exactly one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Gli concedo esattamente uno

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was busy trying to watch it while you accused everybody of something
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ero occupato a cercare di guardarlo mentre tu accusavi tutti di qualcosa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Generous
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Generoso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to see him again, and doing something sounded nicer than another careful conversation over coffee
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Volevo rivederlo, e fare qualcosa sembrava più bello che un'altra conversazione cauta davanti a un caffè

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Go enjoy yourself. You don't need another briefing from me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vai a divertirti. Non hai bisogno di un'altra spiegazione da parte mia

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I've had enough instructions from the detective on the sofa 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. Ho avuto abbastanza istruzioni dal detective sul divano 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: EARLY EVENING, OUTSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: PRIMA SERATA, FUORI DALL'ARCADE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Made it 🎮 You can hear this place from the pavement
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce l'ho fatta 🎮 Puoi sentire questo posto dal marciapiede

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't let him choose every game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non lasciargli scegliere ogni gioco

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's just arrived and pointed at a racing machine
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È appena arrivato e ha puntato a una macchina da corsa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course he has
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo che lo ha fatto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was right about one person
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Avevo ragione su una persona

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm putting my phone away. Wish me luck 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Metto via il telefono. Augurami buona fortuna 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You won't need it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non ne avrai bisogno

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: INSIDE THE ARCADE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DENTRO L'ARCADE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came prepared
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei venuto preparato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per cosa?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sensible shoes. That's somebody expecting to win
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Scarpe comode. Questo è qualcuno che si aspetta di vincere

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's somebody who walked around a market this morning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo è qualcuno che ha girato per un mercato stamattina

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought you something, actually
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: In realtà ti ho portato qualcosa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A consolation prize already?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un premio di consolazione già?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A pastry. I can still eat it myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un dolce. Posso ancora mangiarlo io

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After accusing all seven of them
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dopo aver accusato tutti e sette

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I'll accept the apology in advance
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, accetterò le scuse in anticipo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're making it very difficult to be thoughtful
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stai rendendo molto difficile essere premuroso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you. That was nice of you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Grazie. È stato gentile da parte tua

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. See how little effort that took?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco. Vedi quanto poco sforzo ci è voluto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Are you going to supervise every sentence tonight?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Superviserai ogni frase stasera?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Only the annoying ones
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Solo quelle fastidiose

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's most of my material
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo è gran parte del mio materiale

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to improvise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dovrai improvvisare

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER THEIR FIRST GAME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DOPO LA LORO PRIMA PARTITA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That first point didn't count
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quel primo punto non conta

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thorough detective work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un lavoro da detective accurato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The machine disagrees
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La macchina non è d'accordo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You hit it before I was ready
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'hai colpito prima che fossi pronto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You were explaining how easy this was going to be
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stavi spiegando quanto sarebbe stato facile

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was being welcoming
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stavo solo cercando di essere accogliente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You said you'd go easy on me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai detto che saresti stato clemente con me

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And clearly that was a mistake
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E chiaramente è stato un errore

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: So you admit I won?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quindi ammetti che ho vinto?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I admit there's room for a second game
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ammetto che c'è spazio per una seconda partita

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. You picked the first machine. I pick the next one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Hai scelto la prima macchina. Scelgo io la prossima

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Game finished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Partita finita

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} wins the first round
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} vince il primo round

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And yet you failed to notice me stealing the last bite of your pastry
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Eppure non ti sei accorta che stavo rubando l'ultimo morso della tua pasta

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A Very Sore Loser
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un Perditore Molto Scontroso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:player}} put you up to this
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È stato {{name:player}} a metterti in testa questa idea

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He warned me you'd ask for another round if you lost
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi ha avvertito che avresti chiesto un altro round se avessi perso

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm going to have a word with him
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Devo parlargli

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About knowing you too well?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sulla tua capacità di conoscermi troppo bene?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: About coaching the opposition
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sulla tua idea di allenare gli avversari

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I managed to hit a puck without either of you helping me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce l'ho fatta a colpire un disco senza il vostro aiuto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You did. That last shot was good
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai fatto. L'ultimo tiro era buono

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry, could you repeat that? The machine was making noise
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Scusa, puoi ripetere? La macchina faceva rumore

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't push it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non esagerare

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed. I let you have it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Me ne sono accorto. Te l'ho lasciato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I might need a moment to appreciate it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Potrei aver bisogno di un attimo per apprezzarlo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll give you five seconds
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti do cinque secondi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You really do count everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Conti davvero tutto, eh?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Can I take a picture with you? I'd like to send him one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso fare una foto con te? Vorrei inviargliene una

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course. Is the scoreboard going to be in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo. Vuoi che ci sia il tabellone?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It wasn't. Excellent suggestion
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non c'era. Ottima idea

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At least give me a second to look less defeated
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Almeno dammi un secondo per sembrare meno sconfitto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That's what I'm choosing to believe
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo è ciò in cui scelgo di credere

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Too late. That's the face I want
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Troppo tardi. È quella la faccia che voglio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UN MOMENTO DOPO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He agreed to a photo. The expression is completely his own work
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ha accettato di fare una foto. L'espressione è tutta farina del suo sacco

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I recognize that face
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Riconosco quella faccia

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He's blaming you for warning me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti sta dando la colpa per avermi avvisato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell him I'm enjoying my retirement from listening to his excuses
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Digli che mi sto godendo la mia pensione dall'ascoltare le sue scuse

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll spare him that one for now 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per ora lo risparmio da quella 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DOPO CHE METTE VIA IL SUO TELEFONO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for this afternoon ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Grazie per questo pomeriggio ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you won’t hurt her
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: So che non le farai del male

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But isn’t it weird for you?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ma non è strano per te?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: All of this… in front of you

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Non c'è bisogno di nascondere nulla

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I couldn’t stop myself from taking it 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Non sono riuscita a trattenermi dal prenderlo 😭
Non ha nemmeno bisogno di fare sport

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wants cardio more than anything 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Vuole cardio più di ogni altra cosa 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m really happy with how it went 🔥
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Sono davvero felice di come è andata 🔥
Allora le darò un po' di 🔥

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She’s gonna get her money’s worth 😂
Something happened in the locker room when we were leaving
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: È successo qualcosa negli spogliatoi quando stavamo uscendo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: She wanted to continue the session a bit more
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Voleva continuare un po' di più la sessione

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: So I had to take care of her 😌
Happy with the session or with {{name:hailey}}? 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Felice per la sessione o per {{name:hailey}}? 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: Man I never thought I’d have this kind of conversation with you about {{name:hailey}} 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Non avrei mai pensato di avere questa conversazione con te su {{name:hailey}} 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: But even if it’s weird… it’s kinda cool
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Ma anche se è strano… è un po' figo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I’m coming over tomorrow for a game afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: Vengo domani per un pomeriggio di giochi

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.source: I know you two have a crush on each other
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_AIDEN_EVENING_N.translation: So che voi due vi piacciono

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Hey 😊 I owe you a container lid. Somehow I've managed to bring that home as well 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ehi 😊 ti devo un coperchio per il contenitore. In qualche modo sono riuscita a portarlo a casa 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's considerably less noise than the arcade
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: È decisamente meno rumore rispetto all'arcade

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You have no idea. I've nearly got my hearing back. Other parts of me are less calm
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Non hai idea. Ho quasi riacquistato l'udito. Altre parti di me sono meno calme

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You look happy
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sembri felice

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am ❤️ We're going to leave the phones alone for a bit
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo sono ❤️ Lasceremo i telefoni da parte per un po'

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Talk later
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Parliamo dopo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: DOPO CHE METTE VIA IL SUO TELEFONO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: PIÙ TARDI QUELLA NOTTE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: If I stay like this much longer I'm going to forget I meant to leave
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Se rimango così ancora a lungo dimenticherò che dovevo andare

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That isn't an accident
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Non è un incidente

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Your shirt has ridden up
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: La tua maglietta si è alzata

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I noticed. You can keep your hand there
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: L'ho notato. Puoi tenere la mano lì

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You're making it very hard to be the one who stands up first
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Stai rendendo molto difficile essere quello che si alza per primo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Then kiss me once more and then stand up. I'm not taking you to bed tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Allora baciami un'ultima volta e poi alzati. Non ti porto a letto stasera.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wasn't going to ask
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Non stavo per chiedere.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You were thinking it. So was I. That's why I'm saying it now
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo stavi pensando. Anch'io. Ecco perché lo dico adesso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One last deep kiss on the sofa
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un ultimo bacio profondo sul divano.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hand at her waist, hers under the hem of his shirt
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: La sua mano sulla vita di lei, la sua sotto l'orlo della maglietta di lui.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: This is moving quickly, and I want us to keep talking honestly about what feels right.
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tutto questo sta andando in fretta, e voglio che continuiamo a parlare con sincerità di cosa ci fa stare bene.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I liked tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mi è piaciuta stasera.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The quieter part too?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Anche la parte più tranquilla?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HOME
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: UN PO' DOPO, A CASA

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Especially that part. Your mouth. Your hands. All of it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Soprattutto quella parte. La tua bocca. Le tue mani. Tutto.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can leave without trying to make a clever last remark, you know
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Puoi andare senza cercare di fare un'ultima battuta intelligente, lo sai.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I was going to say I'd like to see you again
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Stavo per dire che mi piacerebbe rivederti.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You can keep that one
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Puoi tenere quella.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Message me tomorrow. We'll work something out
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mandami un messaggio domani. Troveremo un accordo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I will
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo farò.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And take the pastry box. If you leave it here, I'll end up eating the rest
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E porta via la scatola di dolci. Se la lasci qui, finirò per mangiare il resto.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A very difficult responsibility
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Una responsabilità molto difficile.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Somehow I think you'll cope
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: In qualche modo penso che te la caverai.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: AFTER HE LEAVES
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: DOPO CHE È ANDATO.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: {{name:player}}?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: {{name:player}}?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He's gone home. We ended up staying on the sofa much longer than we'd planned
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: È tornato a casa. Siamo rimasti sul divano molto più a lungo di quanto avessimo pianificato.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Tea was a successful idea, then
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il tè è stata un'idea vincente, allora.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Very. We talked, sat close, and then I pulled him in
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Molto. Abbiamo parlato, ci siamo seduti vicini, e poi l'ho tirato a me.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: His hands were under my top. Mine were under his shirt. We kissed until I had to tell him we weren't going further tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Le sue mani erano sotto la mia maglietta. Le mie erano sotto la sua camicia. Ci siamo baciati finché non ho dovuto dirgli che non saremmo andati oltre stasera.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He finally stopped asking whether he was doing better than you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Finalmente ha smesso di chiedere se stava facendo meglio di te.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's a major breakthrough
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: È un grande passo avanti!

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Don't turn not competing into a competition 😭
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Non trasformare il non competere in una competizione 😭

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm learning
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sto imparando

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It felt different tonight. Less like we were trying to work out what was supposed to happen
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Stasera è stato diverso. Meno come se stessimo cercando di capire cosa doveva succedere.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I accidentally brought home his container lid
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sì. Ho portato a casa per sbaglio il coperchio del suo contenitore.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I wanted his hands on me, so I put them there. It didn't need another speech
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Volevo le sue mani su di me, quindi le ho messe lì. Non serviva un altro discorso.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound comfortable with that
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sembri a tuo agio con questo.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. A little flushed. And I'm glad I had this afternoon with you as well
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo sono. Un po' arrossita. E sono felice di aver passato questo pomeriggio con te.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm on my own again. It was a lovely evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sono di nuovo da sola. È stata una serata bellissima.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You sound pleased
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sembri contento.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I am. Tired in a nice way, a bit warm still, and very glad I didn't spend my whole day watching the clock
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo sono. Stanca in un bel modo, ancora un po' calda, e molto felice di non aver passato tutta la giornata a guardare l'orologio.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Keep the details you want to keep. I'm glad you enjoyed yourself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tieni i dettagli che vuoi tenere. Sono felice che ti sia divertito.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I still want a few minutes with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Grazie. Voglio ancora qualche minuto con te prima di dormire ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You two are going to need an inventory
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Voi due avrete bisogno di un inventario.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: LATER THAT NIGHT
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: PIÙ TARDI QUELLA NOTTE

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A Reason to Smile
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un motivo per sorridere

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I finally put the app down 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Finalmente ho messo giù l'app 😌.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you manage to read any of the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sei riuscito a leggere qualcosa del libro?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Some. Very little after we started talking about yesterday. Then even less after the photos
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un po'. Molto poco dopo che abbiamo iniziato a parlare di ieri. Poi ancora meno dopo le foto.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He told me he was looking for an excuse not to leave the bookshop. And that he wanted his hands on me properly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mi ha detto che cercava una scusa per non lasciare la libreria. E che voleva avere le mani su di me per bene.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And you were trying to think of a reason to stay
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E tu stavi cercando di pensare a un motivo per restare.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He has my spoon. We're negotiating
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lui ha il mio cucchiaio. Stiamo negoziando.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Exactly. We seem to have sorted out that misunderstanding 😌❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Esattamente. Sembra che abbiamo risolto quel malinteso 😌❤️.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The messages got much less cautious tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: I messaggi sono diventati molto meno cauti stasera.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You didn't have to keep pretending you were only discussing the book?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Non dovevi continuare a fingere che stavate solo discutendo del libro?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No. I told him I wanted to see him again. And not only talk
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: No. Gli ho detto che volevo rivederlo. E non solo parlare.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And we sent each other a couple more photos. Then a couple that were less innocent
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E ci siamo inviati un paio di foto in più. Poi un paio che erano meno innocenti.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He agreed I could show you these two. The later ones stay between him and me
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ha accettato che potessi mostrarti queste due. Le altre rimangono tra lui e me.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I could mediate
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Potrei fare da mediatore.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's the smile that usually means you're pretending you haven't done anything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Quella è la smorfia che di solito significa che stai fingendo di non aver fatto nulla.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: He noticed it too. Very inconvenient for me. The strap wasn't helping my case
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: L'ha notato anche lui. Molto scomodo per me. La tracolla non aiutava la mia causa.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: And this is the one he took and sent back
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: E questo è quello che ha preso e rimandato indietro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You both look like you're enjoying the conversation
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Siete entrambi sembrate divertirvi nella conversazione

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We were. Neither of us did much reading after that. I kept the last pictures for myself
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo eravamo. Nessuno di noi ha letto molto dopo. Ho tenuto le ultime foto per me

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: The poor book
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il povero libro

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It will recover. I'm not sure I will before tomorrow
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Si riprenderà. Non sono sicura di farlo prima di domani

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Was it easier talking in messages?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: È stato più facile parlare nei messaggi?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You disputed a score displayed in numbers. I don't think you're qualified
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Hai contestato un punteggio mostrato in numeri. Non credo tu sia qualificato.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: In some ways. I could think for a second without worrying that the silence looked strange
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: In un certo senso. Potevo pensare per un secondo senza preoccuparmi che il silenzio sembrasse strano

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: But I also caught myself wanting to hear how he'd say something, not just read it. And wanting his hands instead of another photo
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ma mi sono anche sorpresa a voler sentire come avrebbe detto qualcosa, non solo leggerlo. E a volere le sue mani invece di un'altra foto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That sounds like a reason for another date
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sembra un motivo per un altro appuntamento

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It is. We'll talk tomorrow and choose a time
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Lo è. Parleremo domani e sceglieremo un orario

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: For tonight, I'm done changing between conversations
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Per stasera, ho finito di cambiare tra le conversazioni

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'd like a little time with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Mi piacerebbe passare un po' di tempo con te prima di dormire ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'm done messaging for tonight. I had a really nice evening
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Ho finito di messaggiare per stasera. Ho passato una serata davvero bella

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did the book get much attention?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Il libro ha ricevuto molta attenzione?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Do you want sugar?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Vuoi zucchero?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Not enough to pretend I've become a serious reader
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Non abbastanza da far finta di essere diventata una lettrice seria

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll reserve judgment until you reach the next chapter
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Riservo il giudizio finché non arrivi al prossimo capitolo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Thank you. I'm keeping the rest of the details for myself tonight
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Grazie. Terrò il resto dei dettagli per me stasera

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's fine. How are you feeling?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Va bene. Come ti senti?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Happy. A little too warm to sleep immediately. And ready to just talk to you for a minute ❤️
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Felice. Un po' troppo caldo per dormire subito. E pronta a parlare con te per un minuto ❤️

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One, please
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Uno, per favore.

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Is that your way of arranging another visit?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: È il tuo modo di organizzare un'altra visita?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: How was your evening after I left?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Com'è stata la tua serata dopo che sono andata via?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Quiet. I finished tidying up, then played for a while
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Tranquillo. Ho finito di sistemare, poi ho giocato un po'

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Did you get stuck thinking again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sei di nuovo rimasta bloccata a pensare?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A little, but this afternoon helped more than sitting here trying to predict everything
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Un po', ma questo pomeriggio è stato più utile che stare qui a cercare di prevedere tutto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We still argued about the film, you still stole my food. Nothing felt forced
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Abbiamo comunque litigato sul film, e tu hai rubato il mio cibo. Niente sembrava forzato

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: It wasn't. I was exactly where I wanted to be

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Questa è una risposta molto migliore

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: I'll try not to ruin it
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Cercherò di non rovinarlo

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: You could just sit here with me for a while. Hands included
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Potresti semplicemente sederti qui con me per un po'. Mani incluse

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Gladly
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Volentieri

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: One quick picture before I put the phone away again?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Una foto veloce prima di riporre di nuovo il telefono?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: With me in it?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Con me dentro?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Yes. I'd like to send it to him, like the one earlier
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Sì. Vorrei mandargliela, come quella di prima

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: That's okay. No scoreboard this time?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Va bene. Niente punteggio questa volta?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: No scoreboard. Just us looking like we weren't only drinking tea
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Niente punteggio. Solo noi che sembriamo non bere solo tè

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: Move a little closer or you're only going to be an ear
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Avvicinati un po' o finirai per essere solo un orecchio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: A MOMENT LATER
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: UN MOMENTO DOPO

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..source: We brought the pastry back to mine and made tea. He said I could send you this one too
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_02_LENA_NIGHT_NTS..translation: Abbiamo riportato il dolce a casa mia e abbiamo fatto tè. Ha detto che potevo mandarti anche questa

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And you didn't save me anything? Rude 😒
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: E non mi hai tenuto niente? Che maleducato 😒

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Apparently you had a good session
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: A quanto pare hai avuto una buona sessione

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He didn’t show you the photo, did he?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Non ti ha mostrato la foto, vero?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I hope you got a good look 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Spero che ti sia goduto la vista 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Tomorrow {{name:aiden}} is coming over to play

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ha suggerito che ti unissi a noi
Già mi pento di aver chiesto

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} didn’t tell you everything, did he?
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} non ti ha detto tutto, vero?

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Of course we tell each other everything
From what I saw, it’s more you
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Da quello che ho visto, sei più tu

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You better not fail on purpose just to get punished
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Meglio che non fallisci di proposito solo per essere punito

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I’ll just succeed… and still ask for the punishment 😌
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Semplicemente avrò successo… e chiederò comunque la punizione 😌

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Tomorrow I have revision with {{name:ethan}} in the afternoon
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Domani ho ripetizione con {{name:ethan}} nel pomeriggio

story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: He’s making me take a practice test to see if I improved
story/DAY19/nts/DAY19_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Mi fa fare un test di pratica per vedere se sono migliorata

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: The photo you sent yesterday to cheer me up helped me
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: La foto che mi hai inviato ieri per tirarmi su mi ha aiutato

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: It actually made me feel better
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: In realtà mi ha fatto sentire meglio

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I wasn’t sure if it would
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Non ero sicuro se sarebbe stato

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I’m just happy I have you as my girlfriend
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Sono solo felice di averti come mia ragazza

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: You’re going to make me blush 🙈
Going to try to take a shower
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Sto per provare a fare una doccia.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Don’t get hurt more than you already are 😅
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Non farti male più di quanto tu non sia già 😅

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Okay I really have to go now
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Va bene, devo proprio andare adesso.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Otherwise I’m going to be late ⏳
Text me when you’re on your break
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Mandami un messaggio quando sei in pausa

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Try to have a good morning and enjoy your shower
story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Cerca di avere una buona mattina e goditi la tua doccia.

story/DAY2/DAY2_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I will try love you good luck

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: It’s about the financial support situation
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Si tratta della situazione di supporto finanziario.
Lo saprò di più più tardi oggi

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: You don’t have to handle everything alone
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Non devi gestire tutto da solo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: We’ll talk about it properly tonight
For now just focus on your day
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Per ora concentrati solo sulla tua giornata

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: Except for my whole body no
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: A parte tutto il mio corpo no

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: Be patient, a few more days and it should start improving
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Sii paziente, ancora qualche giorno e dovrebbe iniziare a migliorare.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: I know, thank you for caring so much
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: Lo so, grazie per tenere così tanto.

story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.source: By the way I might have some concerning news
story/DAY2/DAY2_02_EVELYN_CHECK.json::st.translation: A proposito, potrei avere alcune notizie preoccupanti.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I might have way too much time to do nothing
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Potrei avere davvero troppo tempo per non fare nulla.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Don’t worry as soon as I finish work and study I’ll keep you company maybe so much that you’ll want to be left alone 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Non preoccuparti, appena finisco di lavorare e studiare ti terrò compagnia, forse così tanto che vorrai essere lasciato solo 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Impossible for me to get tired of you
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Impossibile per me stancarmi di te
Sei un bastardo, non russò mai 😤

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: Of course of course my lady
No more pics for you you will learn to respect your wife 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Niente più foto per te, imparerai a rispettare tua moglie 😌
Continua a scavare la tua fossa 😇

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: I’m just having fun with you and it makes me really happy
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Mi sto solo divertendo con te e questo mi rende davvero felice.
Va bene, la pausa sta per finire.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: And I’m really happy to see you having fun, even if it’s by teasing me 🙂
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: E sono davvero felice di vederti divertirti, anche se è prendendomi in giro 🙂

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: See you when you finish work, love you
story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.translation: Ci vediamo quando finisci di lavorare, ti amo
Questo è il mio luogo di riposo glamour.

story/DAY2/DAY2_03_LENA_BREAK.json::step.source: But at least I can sit 😅

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: That’s in two days, it’s quite soon
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: È tra due giorni, è piuttosto presto.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I wanted more time to stay with you during recovery
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Volevo più tempo per stare con te durante la convalescenza.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve already done more than enough
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Hai già fatto più che abbastanza

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: That’s not how I see it
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Non è così che lo vedo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I’ll organize things differently so you won’t be alone
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Organizzerò le cose in modo diverso così non sarai solo.
