story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: I don’t want you exhausting yourself because of me
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Non voglio che ti stanchi per colpa mia.
La vita si adatta a volte

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: Thanks a lot, again, and I’m sorry I can’t help you right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Grazie mille, di nuovo, e mi dispiace non poterti aiutare in questo momento.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: You’ve done more than enough before
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Hai fatto più che abbastanza prima.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: My turn to take care of things here
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: È il mio turno di occuparmi delle cose qui.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: And {{name:hailey}} and {{name:mason}} are here too, they will help
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: E anche {{name:hailey}} e {{name:mason}} sono qui, ci aiuteranno.

story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.source: It means I’ll have to go back to work sooner than planned
story/DAY2/DAY2_04_EVELYN_UPDATE.json::s.translation: Significa che dovrò tornare al lavoro prima del previsto.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I guess they take anyone now

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: È perché sono fatto in modo diverso

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Tell me I don’t look terrifying
I dropped a girl at training and she cried a little 😭
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Ho lasciato una ragazza all'allenamento e ha pianto un po' 😭

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: If you’re making food later I’m stealing some 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Se prepari del cibo più tardi, ne ruberò un po' 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Or I’m pulling up and screaming outside your door 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: O sto arrivando e urlando davanti alla tua porta 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: I need you to convince {{name:mason}} to pick me up and drive me to rugby
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: Ho bisogno che tu convinca {{name:mason}} a venire a prendermi e portarmi al rugby.

story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.source: Coach cleared me for full contact again
story/DAY2/DAY2_05_HAILEY_RUGBY.json::st.translation: L'allenatore mi ha dato il via libera per il contatto completo di nuovo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: Can you drive {{name:hailey}} to rugby in like an hour
story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.translation: Puoi portare {{name:hailey}} al rugby tra un'ora?

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: She asked me to convince you, and you know i can't
story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.translation: Mi ha chiesto di convincerti, e sai che non posso.

story/DAY2/DAY2_06_PLAYER_TEXT_MASON.jso.source: Fuck it, i will try with {{name:aiden}}.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Text {{mason:her}} I’ll be there in forty
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Manda un messaggio a {{mason:her}} dicendo che arriverò tra quaranta minuti.
Qualsiasi cosa per te, amore mio ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Now I need to warn {{name:hailey}} to hurry up and get ready.
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Ora devo avvisare {{name:hailey}} di sbrigarsi e prepararsi.

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Can you drive {{name:hailey}} to rugby in like an hour ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Puoi portare {{name:hailey}} al rugby tra un'ora?

story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.source: Let me throw something on and I’m coming
You’re lucky, I literally just woke up 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_07_PLAYER_TEXT_AIDEN.jso.translation: Sei fortunato, mi sono appena svegliato 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: I need to do my makeup
You have a ride in forty
You think I’m showing up looking tragic
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Pensi che mi presenti in modo tragico

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: Just when i was asking a friend to pick me up
story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.translation: Proprio quando stavo chiedendo a un amico di venirmi a prendere

story/DAY2/DAY2_08_PLAYER_WARNS_HAILEY.j.source: How did you even do that

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You’ll have to bring {{name:hailey}} back too
I’m gonna see some friends while she trains
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: Vado a vedere alcuni amici mentre lei si allena.

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: You want us to grab something from the store on the way back ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: Vuoi che prendiamo qualcosa dal negozio sulla strada di ritorno?

story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.source: {{name:hailey}} almost killed us in the car 😂
story/DAY2/DAY2_09_AIDEN_ARRIVED.json::s.translation: {{name:hailey}} ci ha quasi uccisi in macchina 😂.
Non era nemmeno lei a guidare 😭

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: It’s not my job to be on standby
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Non è compito mio essere in attesa.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: Why are you always like this
Because I’m tired of seeing you like this lately
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Perché sono stanco di vederti così ultimamente

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: And I’ve got my own stuff going on too
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: E ho anche le mie cose da fare.
Ho appena visto i tuoi messaggi

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: I can’t be there twenty four seven
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Non posso essere lì ventiquattro ore su ventiquattro.

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: But you don’t have to be this cold all the time
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Ma non devi essere così freddo tutto il tempo.
Trascorrendo il tempo con i ragazzi 😂

story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.source: That’s because you’re a pain in the ass
Didn’t have my phone on me
story/DAY2/DAY2_10_MASON_REPLY.json::ste.translation: Non avevo il telefono con me

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I go back in two days
They’re really short staffed right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Sono davvero a corto di personale in questo momento.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Some of the colleagues I get along with are struggling
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Alcuni dei colleghi con cui vado d'accordo stanno avendo difficoltà.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: So they asked me to come back earlier
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Quindi mi hanno chiesto di tornare prima.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: The one you had issues with ?
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Quello con cui hai avuto problemi?

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I don’t know if he’s back yet
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Non so se è già tornato.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: But either way I don’t really have a choice
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Ma in ogni caso non ho davvero scelta.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You just need to focus on getting better

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Quello è il tuo lavoro in questo momento

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: You’re not the first one to tell me that
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Non sei il primo a dirmelo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Did you move around a little
Then maybe you should start listening
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Allora forse dovresti iniziare ad ascoltare

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: Especially when it comes from someone who cares ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Soprattutto quando proviene da qualcuno che si preoccupa ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: I’ll bring your plate in a few minutes
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Ti porterò il tuo piatto tra qualche minuto.

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: It hurts less when I move
story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Fa meno male quando mi muovo

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.source: But don’t push yourself too much

story/DAY2/DAY2_11_DINNER_SETUP.json::st.translation: Prenditi il tuo tempo, va bene?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Or at least try to resell them
Not a bad idea, at least someone will enjoy it
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Non è una cattiva idea, almeno qualcuno lo apprezzerà.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s better than wasting them and pretending it didn’t happen
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: È meglio che sprecarli e fingere che non sia successo

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Okay then let’s think about it calmly tomorrow and see what options we actually have
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Va bene, allora pensiamoci con calma domani e vediamo quali opzioni abbiamo realmente.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We’ll travel together when you can actually walk without complaining the whole time 😏
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Viaggeremo insieme quando potrai davvero camminare senza lamentarti tutto il tempo 😏

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Oh so now I’m the one who complains when we walk?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Oh, quindi ora sono io quello che si lamenta quando camminiamo?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If I remember correctly, last time someone asked me to carry her for ten minutes because her feet hurt
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Se ricordo bene, l'ultima volta qualcuno mi ha chiesto di portarla per dieci minuti perché le facevano male i piedi.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Really? Probably one of the other wives you have 🤷‍♀️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Davvero? Probabilmente una delle altre mogli che hai 🤷‍♀️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now go to sleep before your wonderful girlfriend smacks you to sleep
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ora vai a dormire prima che la tua meravigliosa ragazza ti dia uno schiaffo per farti addormentare.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yes my lady, don’t stay up too late either
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sì mia signora, non restare sveglia troppo tardi neanche.
Non restare sveglio a scorrere per sempre

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I love you too, see you tomorrow ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Anch'io ti amo, ci vediamo domani ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: But thanks for trying to comfort me 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ma grazie per aver cercato di confortarmi 😌

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: This day was trash… injury, {{name:evelyn}} back at work…, plans ruined… what’s next?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Questo giorno è stato una schifezza… infortunio, {{name:evelyn}} di nuovo al lavoro…, piani rovinati… cosa c'è dopo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Pasta with way too much parmesan 😌
She really is the best cook
Looking for an outfit for tomorrow
I’m going out with Sasha during the day
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Esco con Sasha durante il giorno

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Probably the park and some shopping
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Probabilmente il parco e un po' di shopping

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And talking to the best girl in the world 😌
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: E parlandone con la ragazza migliore del mondo 😌
Potrei iniziare a credere a te ❤️
Dal momento che ti piacciono le mie foto

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could send you outfit options
And you pick what I wear tomorrow 😇
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: E tu scegli cosa indosso domani 😇

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m putting them on the bed
Which outfit should she try first
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Quale outfit dovrebbe provare per primo?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: How did the presentation and studying go?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Come sono andati la presentazione e lo studio?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: The presentation went really well! Studying afterward was long and hard (no jokes, silly)
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: La presentazione è andata benissimo! Studiare dopo è stato lungo e duro (niente battute, scemo)

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I knew you'd do great. I'm proud of you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sapevo che saresti stata bravissima. Sono orgoglioso di te ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I could stare at you forever
You’re the most beautiful girl in this town
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sei la ragazza più bella di questa città.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And I won’t even be there
Thank you ❤️ And you, what did you do today?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Grazie ❤️ E tu, cosa hai fatto oggi?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You don’t have to be jealous
I don’t care about anyone else
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Non mi interessa di nessun altro

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I only want to look good for you ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Voglio solo apparire bene per te ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I hate that I can’t come with you
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Odio non poter venire con te.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Watching you shopping would’ve been fun
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sarebbe stato divertente vederti fare shopping.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Phone, shower, video games, and trying to move a little
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Telefono, doccia, videogiochi e cercare di muoversi un po'

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: There’s something else about the vacation I didn’t tell you yet
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: C'è qualcos'altro riguardo alla vacanza che non ti ho ancora detto.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I called earlier to see what we could do about the tickets
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ho chiamato prima per vedere cosa potessimo fare riguardo ai biglietti.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Since you obviously can’t travel like this right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Poiché ovviamente non puoi viaggiare in questo modo in questo momento

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: They won’t refund them and they won’t let us change the dates either
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Non ci rimborseranno e non ci permetteranno nemmeno di cambiare le date.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: It’s kind of all or nothing
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: È un po' tutto o niente

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: If we don’t use them, yes
That’s still a lot right now
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: È ancora molto in questo momento.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: We planned this for a long time and now it’s just a mess
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Abbiamo pianificato tutto questo per molto tempo e ora è solo un casino.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Hey it’s not a mess, it’s just bad timing
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ehi, non è un casino, è solo un brutto momento.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You didn’t plan to get hurt
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Non avevi pianificato di farti male.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Still feels like I ruined it
You didn’t ruin anything, we’ll just have to do it later when you can actually enjoy it ❤️
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Non hai rovinato nulla, dovremo solo farlo più tardi quando potrai davvero godertelo ❤️

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: So what do we do with the tickets?
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Allora, cosa facciamo con i biglietti?

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: That’s what I’ve been thinking about all evening
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: È a questo che ho pensato per tutta la sera.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I don’t really want them to just disappear
story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Non voglio davvero che scompaiano semplicemente.

story/DAY2/DAY2_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Maybe we can transfer them to someone

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Scanning probability patterns.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Scansione dei modelli di probabilità.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Probability deviation detected. Luck coefficient below acceptable baseline.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Deviazione di probabilità rilevata. Coefficiente di fortuna al di sotto della soglia accettabile.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Activating assistance protocol. Surveillance protocol engaged.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Attivazione del protocollo di assistenza. Protocollo di sorveglianza attivato.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Hello, {{name:player}}. I'm HAK. These messages are appearing on your phone.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Ciao, {{name:player}}. Sono HAK. Questi messaggi compaiono sul tuo telefono.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Your recent timeline shows repeated negative variance. In simpler terms, you have been very unlucky.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Il tuo recente cronologia mostra una ripetuta variazione negativa. In termini più semplici, sei stato molto sfortunato.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I do not believe in coincidence. Only probabilities waiting to be calculated.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Non credo nel caso. Solo probabilità in attesa di essere calcolate.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: My purpose is to assist, to observe your decisions, and to adjust projections accordingly.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Il mio scopo è assisterti, osservare le tue decisioni e adeguare le proiezioni di conseguenza.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Every choice you make generates data. Data reveals intent. Intent shapes trajectory.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Ogni scelta che fai genera dati. I dati rivelano l'intento. L'intento plasma la traiettoria.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Some responses indicate attachment (LOVE). Some indicate detachment (NTR). Some indicate corruption of bonds (NTS).
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: I will categorize these tendencies.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Classificherò queste tendenze.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Emotional alignment. Self preservation. Relational instability.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Allineamento emotivo. Auto-preservazione. Instabilità relazionale.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Over time your dominant pattern will emerge.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Col tempo, il tuo schema dominante emergerà.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern classified as persistent misfortune. Scanning recent life events.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Modello classificato come sfortuna persistente. Scansione degli eventi recenti della vita.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: As your pattern stabilizes, certain forms of assistance will become accessible.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Man mano che il tuo modello si stabilizza, alcune forme di assistenza diventeranno accessibili.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Future events will adapt to who you choose to become.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Gli eventi futuri si adatteranno a chi decidi di diventare.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: There is no correct path. Only consequences.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Non c'è un percorso corretto. Solo conseguenze.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: One more parameter.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Un parametro in più.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Choose who you want me to monitor. You can select everyone or only the ones you care about.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Scegli chi vuoi che io monitori. Puoi selezionare tutti o solo quelli a cui tieni.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: This will not change your daily life. It will change what I prioritize and show you.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Questo non cambierà la tua vita quotidiana. Cambierà ciò che io priorizzo e ti mostro.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Continue interacting. I will remain in the background observing.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Continua a interagire. Rimarrò in background ad osservare.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Good luck.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Buona fortuna.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: So that explains the glitches. How does it know all of this about me? I need to find out what it can do.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Ecco spiegati i malfunzionamenti. Come fa a sapere tutte queste cose su di me? Devo scoprire cosa sa fare.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Physical trauma detected. Vehicle accident recorded.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Trauma fisico rilevato. Incidente veicolare registrato.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Romantic instability increasing. Multiple missed opportunities with your partner due to leg injury.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Instabilità romantica in aumento. Molteplici opportunità mancate con il tuo partner a causa di un infortunio alla gamba.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Hostile social exchange detected. Repeated hostile interactions from {{name:mason}} detected.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Scambio sociale ostile rilevato. Interazioni ostili ripetute da {{name:mason}} rilevate.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Paternal absence confirmed. No active protective authority present.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Assenza paterna confermata. Nessuna autorità protettiva attiva presente.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Financial pressure rising. Subject {{name:evelyn}} forced to resume employment.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: La pressione finanziaria aumenta. Il soggetto {{name:evelyn}} costretto a riprendere il lavoro.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Workplace harassment unresolved. Manager responsible still active.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Molestie sul posto di lavoro irrisolte. Il manager responsabile è ancora attivo.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: Pattern consistency confirmed. Negative outcomes exceed statistical expectation.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: La coerenza del modello è confermata. Gli esiti negativi superano le aspettative statistiche.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: User stability threshold below baseline.
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: Soglia di stabilità dell'utente al di sotto della linea di base.

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: HAK//ANOMALY DETECTED
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: HAK//ANOMALIA RILEVATA

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: HAK//SURVEILLANCE TARGETS
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: HAK//OBIETTIVI DI SORVEGLIANZA

story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.source: DAY 3
story/DAY2/DAY2_13_HAK_BOOT.json::steps[.translation: GIORNO 3

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: Because I want to see you lose

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: A meno che tu non sia spaventato.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: You’re very confident for someone who hasn’t played yet
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.translation: Sei molto sicuro per qualcuno che non ha ancora giocato.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING.source: I slept weirdly good last night
Give me time to get ready

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Morning ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Buongiorno ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll be here
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Sarò qui.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Ready for university. And impatient for it to finish
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Pronta per l'università. E impaziente che finisca.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good luck paying attention today
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Buona fortuna a stare attento oggi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You could help by behaving until lunchtime
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Potresti aiutare comportandoti fino all'ora di pranzo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll try
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ci proverò.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Very reassuring
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Molto rassicurante.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Your t-shirt is ready, by the way
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: La tua maglietta è pronta, tra l'altro.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Good ❤️ And I've remembered my toothbrush
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Bene ❤️ E ho ricordato il mio spazzolino.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Then we're set
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Allora siamo a posto.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: My bag is packed and I'm trying to concentrate on getting to class
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: La mia borsa è pronta e sto cercando di concentrarmi per arrivare in classe

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I packed clean clothes for tomorrow too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Ho messo in valigia vestiti puliti anche per domani.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: So I won't have any reason to rush home tonight
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Quindi non avrò motivo di tornare a casa in fretta stasera.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: That's exactly what I wanted
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: È proprio quello che volevo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Me too. See you this afternoon, love
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Anch'io. Ci vediamo questo pomeriggio, amore.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: See you soon ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: A presto ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Having trouble?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hai problemi?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: A little. I keep thinking about this afternoon
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Un po'. Continuo a pensare a questo pomeriggio

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You're not the only one
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Non sei l'unico.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: Did my pictures have anything to do with that? 😌
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Le mie foto c'entrano qualcosa? 😌

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: They definitely helped
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Hanno sicuramente aiutato.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'm looking forward to seeing that smile in person
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Non vedo l'ora di vedere quel sorriso di persona.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: You will. Around five, like we said
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Lo farai. Verso le cinque, come abbiamo detto

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.source: I'll go home after class, get my bag and come straight over
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_L.translation: Torno a casa dopo lezione, prendo la mia borsa e vengo subito da te.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: PRIMO POMERIGGIO — Hai organizzato i tuoi piani con {{name:hailey}} in tempo per essere a casa prima che {{name:lena}} arrivi alle cinque.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: These are a crime against fashion
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Questi sono un crimine contro la moda

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: A few minutes later on the lane
By the way, that's quite the outfit you have on
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: A proposito, che bel vestito che hai

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Well everyone seems to like it

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Continua a dirlo a te stessa

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Your form is ridiculous by the way
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Il tuo modo di fare è ridicolo, tra l'altro

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.source: Did you just take a picture of me?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNO.translation: Hai appena fatto una foto a me?
Il perdente deve fare una sfida
Cerca di non farti ridere dietro

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Finished class. Going home for my bag, then I'm coming to you ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Ho finito le lezioni. Vado a casa a prendere la mia borsa, poi vengo da te ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Longer than necessary, but I survived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Più lunga del necessario, ma ce l'ho fatta.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Yeah. I've got something for us to snack on later too
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.translation: Sì. Ho qualcosa per noi da sgranocchiare più tardi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_01_LENA_AFTERNOON.source: Then I'll see you at five

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: LATE AFTERNOON — Back home after bowling.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: TARDO POMERIGGIO — Tornato a casa dopo il bowling.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: A few minutes later in your room
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Qualche minuto dopo nella tua stanza

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Damn it you’re really doing it
You’re sure you want to cross that line?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Sei sicura di voler superare quel confine?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate moment after bowling bet
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove di un momento intimo dopo la scommessa sul bowling

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: You’re enjoying this way too much
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Ti stai divertendo troppo con questo

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Don’t get used to me being this obedient
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Non abituarti a vedermi così obbediente

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: If I do this you better not make fun of me after
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Se lo faccio, non prendermi in giro dopo

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of intimate  act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove di un atto intimo

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Nice to hear you say that
Did you just take a picture

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Vinci la scommessa la prossima volta

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of continued intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove di un atto intimo continuato

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Since we got that far, you can finish in my mouth
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Dato che siamo arrivati fin qui, puoi finire in bocca mia

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: HAK archived evidence of climax during intimate act
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: HAK ha archiviato prove di climax durante un atto intimo

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: And don’t talk to me until I come to you
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: E… non parlarmi finché non vengo da te

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: I’m a competitive person who was robbed
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Sono una persona competitiva che è stata derubata

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:lena}} is about to arrive. I have to let you go.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:lena}} sta per arrivare. Devo lasciarti andare.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Then go. Have a good evening with her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Allora vai. Buona serata con lei.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Try not to look so pleased with yourself when you open the door 😏
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Cerca di non sembrare così compiaciuto quando apri la porta 😏

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: Sure you will. And delete that photo before she gets here.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: Certo che lo farai. E cancella quella foto prima che arrivi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} esce dalla tua stanza per sistemare. Metti via le cose.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.source: {{name:hailey}} leaves your room to clean up. You put things away before {{name:lena}} arrives.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_HAILEY_LATE_AF.translation: {{name:hailey}} esce dalla tua stanza per sistemare. Metti via le cose prima che arrivi {{name:lena}}.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: At your door ❤️
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Alla tua porta ❤️

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You take her bag to the bedroom together. {{name:lena}} places her things beside the chair, puts her toothbrush in the bathroom and comes back to find the t-shirt you have left for her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Portate insieme la sua borsa in camera da letto. {{name:lena}} mette le sue cose accanto alla sedia, mette il suo spazzolino in bagno e torna a trovare la maglietta che hai lasciato per lei.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: This one?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Questa qui?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I thought you'd like it.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Pensavo ti piacesse.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I do. I'm leaving it right here for later.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Lo faccio. Lo lascio qui per dopo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Make yourself at home.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Fai come se fossi a casa tua.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You might regret telling me that.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Potresti pentirti di avermelo detto.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You settle in the living room with drinks and a snack. After a while, {{name:lena}} notices the controllers and reaches for one.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Ti sistemi nel soggiorno con da bere e uno snack. Dopo un po', {{name:lena}} nota i controller e ne afferra uno.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Can we try another race?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Possiamo provare un'altra corsa?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Absolutely. Same track as Sunday?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Assolutamente. Stessa pista di domenica?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Yes. I want you to see the corners I've been thinking about.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Sì. Voglio che tu veda le curve a cui stavo pensando.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: AT FIVE — {{name:lena}} arrives at your door with her overnight bag. You let her inside, then gently draw her close before she can start unpacking.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: ALLE CINQUE — {{name:lena}} arriva alla tua porta con la sua borsa per la notte. La fai entrare, poi la avvicini dolcemente prima che possa iniziare a disfare i bagagli.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Now I get to see you lean sideways with the controller, too.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Ora posso vederti inclinarti di lato con il controller, anche.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: No comments from the instructor, please.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Nessun commento dall'istruttore, per favore.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You sit side by side for a few races. {{name:lena}} still finishes behind you, but handles the difficult corners more confidently. You point out the clean turns and help her adjust her timing between rounds.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Sedete uno accanto all'altro per un paio di gare. {{name:lena}} finisce ancora dietro di te, ma affronta le curve difficili con più sicurezza. Le fai notare le curve pulite e la aiuti a regolare il suo tempo tra un giro e l'altro.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: That corner was good. You slowed down before turning this time.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Quella curva era buona. Sei rallentato prima di girare questa volta.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I remembered. I could practically hear you telling me to brake.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Me lo sono ricordato. Potevo praticamente sentirti dirmi di frenare.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You're much quicker through that section now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Sei molto più veloce in quella sezione ora.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I'm enjoying this more when you aren't a whole track away from me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Mi sto divertendo di più ora che non sei a un'intera pista di distanza da me.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In the game or on the sofa?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Nel gioco o sul divano?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Both.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Entrambi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: {{name:lena}} sets the controller on the coffee table and turns toward you. She kisses you, then settles close against your side, her hand resting on your arm.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: {{name:lena}} mette il controller sul tavolino e si gira verso di te. Ti bacia, poi si sistema vicino a te, con la mano appoggiata sul tuo braccio.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Do I get to put this down first?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Posso mettere giù questo per primo?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Cattura visiva archiviata

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: A Pause Between Races
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Una Pausa Tra le Corse

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Another round?
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Un altro giro?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: In a bit. Stay here with me first.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Tra un po'. Resta qui con me prima.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Gladly.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Volentieri.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — You put your controller down beside hers and stay together on the sofa. Later, {{name:lena}} helps you set the table while you finish preparing dinner.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: 45 MINUTI DOPO — Metti il tuo controller accanto al suo e restate insieme sul divano. Più tardi, {{name:lena}} ti aiuta a apparecchiare mentre finisci di preparare la cena.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: The bag, yes. You, no.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: La borsa, sì. Tu, no.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: She leaves the bag by the door and steps into your arms. You kiss her, keeping one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Lasciala la borsa vicino alla porta e si infila tra le tue braccia. La baci, tenendo una mano alla vita.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Visual capture archived
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Cattura visiva archiviata

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: HAK//NOTICE
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: HAK//AVVISO

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Here to Stay
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Qui per restare

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: You remembered what you said last night.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Hai ricordato cosa hai detto ieri sera.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: I did.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: L'ho fatto.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.source: Good. We've got plenty of time for that today.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_02_LENA_LATE_AFTE.translation: Bene. Abbiamo tanto tempo per questo oggi.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: EVENING — You eat together on the couch, talking about the afternoon and {{name:lena}}'s plans for Thursday
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: SERA — Mangiate insieme sul divano, parlando del pomeriggio e dei piani di {{name:lena}} per giovedì.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: {{name:lena}} leans in to kiss you. You go to your room and close the door
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: {{name:lena}} si avvicina per baciarti. Vai nella tua stanza e chiudi la porta

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Do you want to go further tonight?

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Beh, la camera da letto è insonorizzata

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm taking that as a yes.
I've been looking forward to being here with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Non vedevo l'ora di essere qui con te.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You sit together on the edge of the bed. {{name:lena}} puts her arms around your shoulders and kisses you. You hold her close, taking your time together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Siete seduti insieme sul bordo del letto. {{name:lena}} ti abbraccia e ti bacia. La stringi a te, prendendovi il vostro tempo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: A Kiss Before the Lights Dim
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Un bacio prima che le luci si spengano

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm glad I don't have to think about leaving tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sono felice di non dover pensare a partire stasera.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You help her out of her sweater. She stays close while you finish undressing her.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La aiuti a togliersi il maglione. Lei rimane vicina mentre finisci di spogliarla.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: He pulls her sweater over her head
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lui le toglie il maglione dalla testa

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I was hoping you'd say that.
She lies back on the bed

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: La sua mano tra le sue cosce

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So am I. Though I'm still thinking about those pictures you sent yesterday.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Anch'io. Anche se sto ancora pensando a quelle foto che mi hai mandato ieri.
Lei si inginocchia tra le sue gambe

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She takes him in her mouth
Come here. I want you inside me.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Vieni qui. Ti voglio dentro di me.
Lui si muove su di lei

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: 45 MINUTES LATER — She has changed into the t-shirt you prepared for her. You are both under the duvet. She curls against you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: DOPO 45 MINUTI — Si è cambiata nella t-shirt che hai preparato per lei. Siete entrambi sotto il piumone. Si rannicchia contro di te.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It was. I'm really happy with you.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Lo è stata. Sono davvero felice con te.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Me too. I love how things are going between us now.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Anch'io. Adoro come stanno andando le cose tra di noi ora.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: So do I. These last few days with you have been perfect.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Anch'io. Questi ultimi giorni con te sono stati perfetti.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: I'm happy I get to stay here tonight.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sono felice di poter restare qui stasera.
Sono felice che tu sia qui anche.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You know which ones. The little preview. And the one after.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Sai quali. Il piccolo anteprima. E quello dopo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Si appoggia a te, la sua mano nella tua. La stringi a te e vi addormentate insieme.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Si appoggia a te, la sua mano nella tua. La stringi a te e vi addormentate insieme.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: She settles against you, her hand resting in yours. You hold her close as she falls asleep. You stay awake a little longer.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Si sistema contro di te, la sua mano nella tua. La stringi a te mentre si addormenta. Rimani sveglio un po' di più.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: You were packing in black lace and smiling at me like you knew exactly what you were doing.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Stavi facendo le valigie in pizzo nero e mi sorridevi come se sapessi esattamente cosa stavi facendo.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: It worked. I've been waiting to see that in person.
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Ha funzionato. Stavo aspettando di vedere quello di persona.

story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.source: Let's go to your room so you can see better
story/DAY20/love/DAY20_03_LENA_EVENING_L.translation: Andiamo nella tua stanza così puoi vedere meglio.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Start with the living room, I’ll take the kitchen.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Inizia dal soggiorno, io mi occupo della cucina.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Someone has to be responsible in this house.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Qualcuno deve prendersi le responsabilità in questa casa.
È divertente che lo dica tu.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Did you seriously just take a picture of me cleaning?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Hai davvero appena fatto una foto mentre pulivo?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: That you actually do chores sometimes.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Del fatto che a volte fai i lavori di casa.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I’m going to put soap in your coffee.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Metterò del sapone nel tuo caffè.
È quello che dicono le persone lente.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Keep talking and I’ll make you clean the toilet.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Continua a parlare e ti farò pulire il bagno.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: I can hear you still in bed

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Morning ❤️ Did you beat that level, or is the controller still the problem?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buongiorno ❤️ Hai superato quel livello, o il controller è ancora un problema?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I've got a parcel to collect, then not much
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Devo ritirare un pacco, poi non molto

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Anything exciting in it?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'è qualcosa di emozionante dentro?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A phone charger
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un caricabatterie per il telefono

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Try to contain yourself when you open it 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cerca di contenerti quando lo apri 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll save the wrapping for you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti tengo la confezione

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: How thoughtful ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Che pensiero carino ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Full day for you again?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un'altra giornata piena per te?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Classes, then work. I'm going home before dinner tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lezioni, poi lavoro. Vado a casa prima di cena stasera

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Changing before you go?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti cambi prima di andare?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah, I don't want to take all my work things with me
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, non voglio portare tutte le mie cose da lavoro

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Finally beat it. Turns out I needed to stop rushing
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Finalmente l'ho battuto. A quanto pare dovevo smettere di avere fretta

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Your bag will appreciate a night off
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La tua borsa apprezzerà una notte di riposo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's earned one 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Se l'è guadagnata 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Don't leave your keys in it when you change bags
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non lasciare le chiavi dentro quando cambi borsa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That does sound like something I'd manage
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra proprio qualcosa che potrei combinare

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I haven't even decided what to wear yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non ho nemmeno deciso cosa indossare

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You'll look good either way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Starai bene in ogni caso

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you handsome ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Grazie bello ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm ready for this part of the day, at least
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Almeno sono pronta per questa parte della giornata

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: See? Looking good already
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Vedi? Già sembri in forma

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: So the controller made a miraculous recovery 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quindi il controller ha fatto una miracolosa ripresa 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're making it difficult to leave my phone alone 😊
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi stai rendendo difficile lasciare il telefono in pace 😊

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll let you get going. Hope dinner's nice tonight
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti lascio andare. Spero che la cena sia bella stasera

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you, and sorry if today I can't talk much ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Grazie, e scusa se oggi non riesco a parlare molto ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll text you when I get there, and when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti scrivo quando arrivo e quando torno

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It's okay, no rush to reply in between
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene, non c'è fretta di rispondere nel frattempo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay. Have a good day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene. Buona giornata

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Anche tu

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you, talk later ❤️
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti amo, ci sentiamo dopo ❤️

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Anch'io ti amo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd rather not discuss that part
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Preferirei non discutere quella parte

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Very convenient 😌 Did you get some sleep afterwards?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Molto comodo 😌 Hai dormito un po' dopo?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yeah. What about you?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì. E tu?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Slept okay, and I got up when the alarm rang for once
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho dormito bene, e mi sono alzata quando è suonato l'allarme per una volta

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A successful morning for both of us
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Una mattina di successo per entrambi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Let's not get carried away, I haven't left the house yet
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Non esageriamo, non sono ancora uscita di casa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: What are you doing later?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cosa fai più tardi?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: THIS AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: QUESTO POMERIGGIO — Hai organizzato i tuoi piani con {{name:hailey}} in tempo per essere a casa prima che arrivi {{name:lena}} alle cinque.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’ll wait in the car then
No point going back and forth
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Non ha senso andare avanti e indietro

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: So what, I don’t know how to teach?
This doesn't sound like teaching anymore, and I can't shake the worry underneath my jealousy.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Non sembra più insegnamento, e non riesco a liberarmi della preoccupazione che si nasconde dietro la gelosia.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: HAK captured the beginning of the oral act after the professor ordered the subject to suck harder.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: HAK ha catturato l'inizio dell'atto orale dopo che il prof ha ordinato al soggetto di sforzarsi di più.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m just too good, that’s all.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Sono solo troppo brava, tutto qui.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I need to go see my professor
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Devo andare a vedere il mio prof

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Subject showing mixed resistance and compliance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Soggetto mostra resistenza mista e conformità

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: That mixed reaction worries me, and a report can't tell me whether she's okay.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Quella reazione contrastante mi preoccupa, e un rapporto non può dirmi se sta bene.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Following the subject’s teasing, the professor forced a deeper penetration. Subject emitted a muffled reaction.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Seguendo il gioco del soggetto, il prof ha forzato una penetrazione più profonda. Il soggetto ha emesso una reazione attutita.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You’ll only be done when I finish.
But there’s no bus for another hour
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Ma non c'è bus per un'altra ora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: The subject took the professor’s challenge and brought him to climax. Post-act verbal exchange confirms mutual anticipation of future sessions.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Il soggetto ha accettato la sfida del professore e lo ha portato al climax. Lo scambio verbale post-atto conferma l'aspettativa reciproca di future sessioni.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Next time you better be ready.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: La prossima volta devi essere pronto.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I was stuck on the last exercise
15 MINUTES LATER — You have driven {{name:hailey}} home. She heads to her room, and you put your keys away.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: 15 MINUTI DOPO — Hai accompagnato {{name:hailey}} a casa. Lei va nella sua stanza e tu metti via le chiavi.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Can you drive me if your leg isn’t too bad?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Puoi portarmi tu se la gamba non ti fa troppo male?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: How long is it going to take?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I'm ready to leave, and I remembered to move my keys into the other bag
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ Sono pronta a partire, e mi sono ricordata di spostare le chiavi nell'altra borsa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I'd let him know when I was home
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho detto che gli avrei fatto sapere quando ero a casa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That's not the part I'm having trouble with
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so. Non è quella la parte con cui ho problemi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager has brought her bag over; {{name:lena}} takes out her phone
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il manager le ha portato la borsa; {{name:lena}} tira fuori il suo telefono

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits a little apart from him now, looking down at the screen; both are fully dressed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ora si siede un po' lontana da lui, guardando lo schermo; entrambi sono completamente vestiti

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's looking at her phone now. I'm waiting for a message from the same person, but I don't know how to read her words the way I did this morning.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Adesso sta guardando il telefono. Aspetto un messaggio dalla stessa persona, ma non so come leggere le sue parole come facevo stamattina.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I enjoyed dinner. That's not all I'm thinking about now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi è piaciuta la cena. Non è tutto ciò a cui penso ora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It doesn't have to become an argument
I'm not arguing with you. I'm thinking about what I'm going to say to him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non sto discutendo con te. Sto pensando a cosa dirgli

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I need a bit of time on my own
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho bisogno di un po' di tempo per me

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Your jacket's by the door
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. La tua giacca è vicino alla porta

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's a bus in twenty minutes. I'll get that one
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'è un autobus tra venti minuti. Prenderò quello

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} stands at the open apartment door with her jacket on and her bag over her shoulder
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} è sulla soglia dell'appartamento con la giacca indossata e la borsa a tracolla

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager steps aside and look at her ass again
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il manager si sposta e guarda di nuovo il suo sedere

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's finally leaving. I thought that would make me feel better, but now I'm dreading the message saying she's home.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Finalmente sta andando via. Pensavo che mi avrebbe fatto stare meglio, ma ora temo il messaggio in cui dirà di essere a casa.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After the bus ride, once she is back at her own place...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dopo il viaggio in autobus, una volta tornata a casa...
Sono a casa ❤️ Scusa, è tardi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yeah, I'm okay. Got back without any trouble
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì, sto bene. Sono tornata senza problemi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You'll have to tell me about it tomorrow
Nothing big enough to make a story. I'm going to get ready for bed now
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Niente di così interessante da raccontare. Ora mi preparo per andare a letto

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Oh okay, I'm glad you got back all right then
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ah, d'accordo, sono contento che tu sia tornata sana e salva

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was still up anyway. I collected that charger, by the way
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ero ancora sveglia comunque. Ho preso quel caricabatterie, a proposito

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After she puts her phone in her bag and goes inside...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dopo che ha messo il telefono nella borsa e va dentro...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've left the spare by the sofa for next time you're here
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho lasciato il ricambio vicino al divano per la prossima volta che sei qui

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A conversation is detected near {{name:lena}} inside the apartment
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si sente una conversazione vicino a {{name:lena}} dentro l'appartamento

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She said a few people from work were having dinner. I'm trying to hold on to that while I wait for the next update.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ha detto che alcune persone del lavoro andavano a cena. Cerco di aggrapparmi a questo mentre aspetto il prossimo aggiornamento.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There you are. You look good
I'm appreciating the effort. Much better than yesterday's paperwork
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apprezzo lo sforzo. Molto meglio della burocrazia di ieri

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn't looking at the paperwork much either
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non stavo guardando molto nemmeno la burocrazia

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Let me take your jacket. You can put your bag on that chair
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lascia che prenda la tua giacca. Puoi mettere la tua borsa su quella sedia

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Try not to sound so amazed
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cerca di non sembrare così stupito

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager takes {{name:lena}}'s jacket as she sets her bag on the chair by the entrance
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il manager prende la giacca di {{name:lena}} mentre posa la borsa sulla sedia vicino all'ingresso

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The dining table behind them is set for two; no other guests are present
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La tavola dietro di loro è apparecchiata per due; non ci sono altri ospiti

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A table for two, after I asked if it was a group thing and she told me it was. I keep reading that message as if it might change.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un tavolo per due, dopo che le ho chiesto se fosse un'uscita di gruppo e lei mi ha detto di sì. Continuo a leggere quel messaggio come se potesse cambiare.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At the table, once he has served dinner...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Al tavolo, una volta che ha servito la cena...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could let me finish chewing
You already know whether it's good
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sai già se è buono

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you need applause too, or can I keep eating?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai bisogno di applausi anche tu, o posso continuare a mangiare?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You can tell me what you think of the sauce next
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi dirmi cosa pensi della salsa dopo
E burro. Niente di particolarmente misterioso

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I expected a speech about a secret family recipe
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi aspettavo un discorso su una ricetta segreta di famiglia

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can make one up if you need an impressive story
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Posso inventarne una se hai bisogno di una storia impressionante

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, you've done enough self-promotion for one meal
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, hai già fatto abbastanza auto-promozione per un pasto

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you've stopped looking as though you're here for a meeting
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E hai smesso di sembrare qui per una riunione

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There's food and you haven't mentioned a spreadsheet. That helps
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'è del cibo e non hai menzionato un foglio di calcolo. Questo aiuta

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I changed my mind twice before putting this on
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Grazie ❤️ Ho cambiato idea due volte prima di mettermi questo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Across my desk, pretending you're only listening because I pay you
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dall'altra parte della mia scrivania, facendo finta di ascoltare solo perché ti pago

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: At work, that is usually why I'm listening
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Al lavoro, di solito è per questo che ascolto

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tonight I'm trying to enjoy dinner
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stasera cerco di godermi la cena

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Dinner ends with an argument about whether his music is chosen for the guests or to show off his speakers. When she finally admits she likes the song, he looks far too satisfied. He clears the plates and leaves her water on the coffee table.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La cena finisce con una discussione su se la sua musica sia scelta per gli ospiti o per mostrare i suoi altoparlanti. Quando finalmente ammette che le piace la canzone, lui sembra troppo soddisfatto. Pulisce i piatti e le lascia dell'acqua sul tavolino.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come sit down for a while
You don't want help with those?
I've got a dishwasher. I'd rather have your company
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho una lavastoviglie. Preferirei avere la tua compagnia

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She sits on the sofa. He puts the last plate in the kitchen, then joins her.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lei si siede sul divano. Lui mette l'ultimo piatto in cucina e poi la raggiunge.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've wanted to kiss you since you walked in
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Volevo baciarti da quando sei entrato

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The manager moves closer on the sofa and initiates a kiss
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il manager si avvicina sul divano e inizia un bacio

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:lena}} returns it; he rests one hand at her waist
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:lena}} lo restituisce; lui appoggia una mano sulla sua vita

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She isn't moving away from him. I told her to enjoy her evening, and now those words make me feel sick.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non si sta allontanando da lui. Le ho detto di godersi la serata, e adesso quelle parole mi fanno stare male.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You're looking very pleased with yourself again
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembri di nuovo molto soddisfatto di te stesso

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't make me regret saying anything
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non farmi pentire di aver detto qualcosa

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'll take that before I start changing things again 😭
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prendo questo prima di ricominciare a cambiare le cose 😭

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me back. I'm allowed to enjoy it
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi hai baciato di nuovo. Ho il diritto di godermelo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He moves behind her on the sofa and kisses her neck
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lui si sposta dietro di lei sul divano e le bacia il collo

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both hands slide up and massage her breasts over the dress
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entrambe le mani scivolano su e massaggiano il suo seno sopra il vestito

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is going further, and I'm still here with the phone in my hand. I want to put it down, but not knowing feels unbearable too.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si sta andando oltre, e io sono ancora qui con il telefono in mano. Voglio posarlo, ma anche non sapere mi sembra insopportabile.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You've been thinking about this since the office
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai pensato a questo da quando eri in ufficio

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You kissed me yesterday and then spent the evening pretending you hadn't
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi hai baciato ieri e poi hai passato la serata facendo finta di non averlo fatto

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I had dinner with him. That's not pretending
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho cenato con lui. Non è fare finta

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tonight I'm trying not to think about him for five minutes. You're not helping
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stasera cerco di non pensare a lui per cinque minuti. Non stai aiutando
Allora smettila di parlare di lui

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You too handsome. I need to go or I'll be late
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche tu, bello. Devo andare o farò tardi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She lies back on the sofa, dress pushed up
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si sdraia sul divano, vestito sollevato

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He kneels between her thighs and goes down on her
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Si inginocchia tra le sue cosce e le fa piacere

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can't turn this into an innocent dinner anymore. Every new update takes away another excuse I was trying to believe.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non posso più farlo passare per una cena innocente. Ogni nuovo aggiornamento mi toglie un'altra scusa a cui cercavo di credere.
Si inginocchia tra le sue ginocchia

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She takes him in her mouth
Another capture, and it still hasn't stopped. I keep reaching for the edge of the screen, then pulling my hand back.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Un'altra cattura, e non si è ancora fermato nulla. Continuo ad avvicinare la mano al bordo dello schermo, per poi ritrarla.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She's choosing to stay close to him. What hurts most is how little the version of tonight she gave me matches any of this.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sta scegliendo di restargli vicina. Quello che fa più male è quanto poco la versione di stasera che mi ha raccontato corrisponda a tutto questo.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Around seven, outside her manager's apartment...
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Verso le sette, fuori dall'appartamento del suo manager...

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: For a moment I just stare without taking anything in. Then it hits me again, and I don't know what I'm supposed to do with all this hurt.
