story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per un momento resto a fissare senza capire nulla. Poi mi colpisce di nuovo, e non so cosa dovrei fare con tutto questo dolore.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don't look that pleased
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Volevo farlo. Non sembrare così soddisfatto

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don't have to keep checking the time
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non devi continuare a controllare l'ora

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I've arrived ❤️ I'll text you when I'm back
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono arrivata ❤️ Ti scrivo quando torno

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: You looked really pensive in the car earlier
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Sembravi davvero pensierosa in macchina prima

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: That’s actually a really good idea
I think I’ll do exactly that
Look at you becoming strategic
I learn from the best
Flattery won’t save you next cleaning day
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: La lusinga non ti salverà il giorno delle pulizie

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Worth a try though
Anyway
I’m going to sleep and plan my revenge properly
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Vado a dormire e pianifico la mia vendetta per bene

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Don’t go too hard on him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Non essere troppo dura con lui

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: No promises 😌
Did I?
Good night
Good night
After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Dopo aver messo giù il telefono, ti sistemi accanto a {{name:lena}} e vi addormentate insieme.

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Yeah
Is everything going okay with your professor?
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Va tutto bene con il tuo professore?

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: It is
But he put me in difficulty with some exercises today
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ma mi ha messa in difficoltà con alcuni esercizi oggi

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I kind of want revenge
Then do the same thing to him
story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Allora fallo anche tu a lui

story/DAY20/ntr/DAY20_02_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Give him an exercise just as hard

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Come va la tua gamba oggi?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Why do you want to know?
By the way, did you hear {{name:mason}} last night?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: A proposito, hai sentito {{name:mason}} ieri sera?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Shut up and come eat before it gets cold
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Zitto e vieni a mangiare prima che si freddi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: Too bad I’m already awake though
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Peccato che io sia già sveglia però

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.source: You can’t come drag me out of bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_HAILEY_MORNING_.translation: Non puoi venire a trascinarmi fuori dal letto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Before my day gets away from me, did you sleep well?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ehi 😊 Prima che la mia giornata scivoli via, hai dormito bene?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: High praise
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Alto elogio

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I was thinking about yesterday at your place while I made breakfast
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Pensavo a ieri da te mentre preparavo colazione

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have you finally admitted I was right about the film?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai finalmente ammesso che avevo ragione sul film?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No. The bit where I had my head on your shoulder
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: No. Il momento in cui avevo la testa sulla tua spalla

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Oh. I liked that bit too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh. Anche a me è piaciuto quel momento

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You went quiet for once. It was very nice ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei stata zitta per una volta. È stato molto bello ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I could offer that service again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Potrei offrirti di nuovo quel servizio

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Please do. I'd like another afternoon like that soon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Per favore fallo. Mi piacerebbe un'altra pomeriggio così presto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We'll find one. Have you actually eaten yet?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ne troveremo uno. Hai già mangiato?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, before you start. Look
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, prima che inizi. Guarda

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I did. How about you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, e tu?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You look lovely
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei bellissima

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you 😊 The breakfast is just out of frame, but I promise it exists
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Grazie 😊 La colazione è appena fuori inquadratura, ma ti prometto che esiste

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll take your word for it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti credo sulla parola

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: There is something I wanted to ask you before I leave
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: C'è qualcosa che volevo chiederti prima di andare

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: {{name:aiden}} messaged me this morning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: {{name:aiden}} mi ha messaggiato questa mattina

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Pretty well, considering I set an alarm and then argued with it twice 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Abbastanza bene, considerando che ho messo una sveglia e poi ci ho litigato due volte 😭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He's asked if I'd like to come over to his place tonight, just the two of us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi ha chiesto se mi piacerebbe andare a casa sua stasera, solo noi due

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: No arcade rematch attached to the invitation?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Nessuna rivincita in sala giochi legata all'invito?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I checked. Apparently he can spend an evening without a scoreboard 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho controllato. A quanto pare può passare una serata senza un punteggio 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Is that okay with you?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi piacerebbe andare. Va bene per te?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: He messaged me about meeting again tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi ha messaggiato per incontrarci di nuovo stasera

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: The guy from the café?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Il tipo del caffè?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes 😊 He's invited me to have dinner at his place
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì 😊 Mi ha invitata a cena a casa sua

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Apparently he's ready to defend his cooking in person
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: A quanto pare è pronto a difendere la sua cucina di persona

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Did you win?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai vinto?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds like an evening worth surviving the workday for
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra una serata che vale la pena di sopportare la giornata di lavoro

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'd like to go. Are you okay with me going to his place?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi piacerebbe andare. Sei d'accordo se vado a casa sua?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yes, sweetheart. I am ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, tesoro. Lo sono ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I meant what I said. I'd like you to do what you feel like doing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Intendevo quello che ho detto. Vorrei che tu facessi quello che ti va

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I know. I still wanted to ask how you felt about tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo so. Volevo comunque chiederti come ti senti riguardo a stasera

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And I'm glad you did. You don't need to talk yourself out of something you want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E sono felice che tu l'abbia fatto. Non devi convincerti a non fare qualcosa che vuoi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Okay 😊 I'll go home and get ready first, then head over around eight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene 😊 Tornerò a casa e mi preparerò, poi andrò lì verso le otto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Take care of yourself, though. Keep your phone charged and text me when you get there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Prenditi cura di te, però. Tieni il telefono carico e scrivimi quando arrivi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I got up. Interpret that however you like
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Mi sono alzata. Interpretalo come vuoi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I will. I've got the address, and I can get a taxi back whenever I need to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo farò. Ho l'indirizzo e posso prendere un taxi per tornare quando ne ho bisogno

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: If I decide to stay instead, I'll let you know too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Se decido di restare invece, te lo farò sapere anche io

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. I don't need a message every five minutes. I just want to know you're okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bene. Non ho bisogno di un messaggio ogni cinque minuti. Voglio solo sapere che stai bene

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part I can promise ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quella parte posso prometterla ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: And you can tell me if you're feeling nervous again
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: E puoi dirmi se ti senti nervoso di nuovo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: A little. But that doesn’t mean I wish you weren’t going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Un po'. Ma questo non significa che non voglia che tu vada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Work today?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Lavori oggi?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yesterday helped. I liked knowing we could still just be ourselves together
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ieri è stato utile. Mi è piaciuto sapere che possiamo ancora essere noi stessi insieme

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: We can. Including me stealing your cushion ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Possiamo. Compreso il fatto che rubo il tuo cuscino ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: That part was never in doubt
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Quella parte non è mai stata in dubbio

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: You're being very calm about this
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sei molto calmo riguardo a questo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm smiling at my phone, actually 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sto sorridendo al mio telefono, in realtà 🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Good. Then we have matching stupid faces
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Bene. Allora abbiamo facce stupide che si abbinano

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Yours is prettier
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: La tua è più carina

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Now you're just trying to keep me here ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ora stai solo cercando di farmi restare qui ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Until six, then I need to pick up a couple of things on the way home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Fino alle sei, poi devo prendere un paio di cose tornando a casa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Right, I need to leave before my quiet morning becomes me running down the street
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Giusto, devo andare prima che la mia mattina tranquilla diventi me che corro per strada

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good day. Eat something proper during your break
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Buona giornata. Mangia qualcosa di decente durante la tua pausa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Look at you taking over my job 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Guarda te che prendi il mio posto 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Somebody has to remind you when you’re busy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Qualcuno deve ricordarti quando sei occupata

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I love you. I'll text you when I'm home and getting ready ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti amo. Ti scrivo quando sono a casa e mi preparo ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: Love you too. Speak tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti amo anche io. Ci sentiamo stasera

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'm going to be busy for most of the day, so don't be surprised if I'm quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Sarò occupata per gran parte della giornata, quindi non sorprenderti se sono silenziosa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: I'll try not to take being abandoned for a shopping list personally
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Cercherò di non prenderla sul personale se mi abbandoni per una lista della spesa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.source: It has considerably less interesting things to say than you 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_00_LENA_MORNING_NT.translation: Ha molto meno da dire di te 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: EARLY AFTERNOON — You have arranged your plans with {{name:hailey}} early enough to be home before {{name:lena}} arrives at five.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: PRIMO POMERIGGIO — Hai organizzato i tuoi piani con {{name:hailey}} in tempo per essere a casa prima che {{name:lena}} arrivi alle cinque.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Just don’t react to her nonsense

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} arriva e salta tra le braccia di {{name:aiden}}
Il soggetto è saltato tra le braccia di {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: They make this look easy, while I'm still trying to name the knot in my stomach.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Lo fanno sembrare facile, mentre io cerco ancora di dare un nome al nodo che ho allo stomaco.
{{name:hailey}} è saltata tra le braccia di {{name:aiden}} al suo arrivo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Come on, at least put on an underwear

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:aiden}} fa scivolare la mano mentre la tiene

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: You better not pull out another crazy outfit
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Non tirare fuori un altro outfit pazzo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: It’s the reward for the best coach 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: È il premio per il miglior allenatore 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Alright, let’s play before he nags at us
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Dai, giochiamo prima che ci rompa le scatole
{{name:hailey}} si siede di nuovo sulle ginocchia di {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Let's see if you can stay focused too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vediamo se anche tu riesci a rimanere concentrato
Il soggetto si muove intenzionalmente sulle ginocchia di {{name:aiden}}

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} kept moving on {{name:aiden}}’s lap during the games
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} ha continuato a muoversi sulle ginocchia di {{name:aiden}} durante le partite

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: LAST GAME – FIRST TO FINISH WINS EVERYTHING
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: ULTIMA PARTITA – CHI FINISCE PER PRIMO VINCE TUTTO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I’m telling {{name:aiden}} not to look at you
Subject claiming victory under unusual circumstances
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Soggetto che rivendica la vittoria in circostanze insolite

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:hailey}} claimed {{name:aiden}} finished first during the last game
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:hailey}} ha dichiarato che {{name:aiden}} ha finito per primo durante l'ultima partita

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: These are honestly the best game afternoons
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Questi sono davvero i migliori pomeriggi di gioco

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Looking forward to the next one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Non vedo l'ora di fare il prossimo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: I'm glad she isn't hiding what she wants, but I need to be honest about my feelings too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Mi fa piacere che non nasconda quello che vuole, ma devo essere sincero anche su ciò che provo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Man I was really looking forward to playing again 🔥
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Cavolo, non vedevo l'ora di giocare di nuovo 🔥

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:ethan}} already came to pick me up
Do you want me to wait for you for dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Vuoi che ti aspetti per cena?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: At least I won’t have to eat alone with {{name:mason}} like last time
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Almeno non dovrò mangiare da sola con {{name:mason}} come l'ultima volta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: {{name:lena}} is staying over tonight. I'll leave you a plate for when you get back.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: {{name:lena}} resta a dormire stasera. Ti lascerò un piatto per quando torni.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.source: Thanks. Save me some dessert too.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_HAILEY_AFTERNOO.translation: Grazie. Riservami anche un po' di dolce.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey 😊 Finally home, and I'm getting ready to leave in a little while. How was your day?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi 😊 Finalmente a casa, e mi sto preparando per uscire tra poco. Com'è andata la tua giornata?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Not tonight. I came over, I didn’t come to sleep here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non stasera. Sono venuta, non sono venuta per dormire qui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a shame. He gets you after this?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Peccato. Lui ti prende dopo questo?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He gets a message that I got home. You get to message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lui riceve un messaggio che sono tornata a casa. Tu puoi scrivermi domani

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll take that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prendo quello

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Walk me to the door without a clever last remark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. Accompagnami alla porta senza un'ultima battuta intelligente

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DOPO CHE È TORNATA A CASA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay the night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ Sono a casa. Non sono rimasta a dormire

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for telling me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Grazie per avermelo detto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen, rather than leave you guessing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non siamo andati fino in fondo. Volevo dirti cosa è successo, piuttosto che lasciarti indovinare

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You look beautiful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei bellissima

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed on the sofa. Then he put his hand under my dress and fingered me until I came
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dopo cena ci siamo baciati sul divano. Poi ha messo la mano sotto il mio vestito e mi ha toccata fino a farmi venire

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I went down on him after. He came in my mouth. I swallowed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dopo sono andata da lui. È venuto in bocca. Ho ingoiato

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I came home. That was the whole of it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Poi sono tornata a casa. Questo è tutto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Come ti senti?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Happy. A little flushed. Glad I went, and glad I left when I meant to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Felice. Un po' arrossita. Contento di essere andata, e contenta di essere andata via quando dovevo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It was my decision. I wasn’t trying to get to some next step because I thought I should
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È stata una mia decisione. Non stavo cercando di arrivare a un passo successivo perché pensavo di doverlo fare

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you know how you feel about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono contenta che tu sappia come ti senti al riguardo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. He spent half the evening trying to work out whether he was doing better than you. I didn’t answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so. Ha passato metà serata a cercare di capire se stava facendo meglio di te. Non ho risposto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s probably kinder than a ranking
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Probabilmente è più gentile di un ranking

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the idea 😌 And I wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Era l'idea 😌 E volevo un minuto con te prima di dormire ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was the answer I was hoping for ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questa era la risposta che speravo ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the rest of the details to myself tonight, like we talked about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono felice. Terrò per me il resto dei dettagli stanotte, come abbiamo parlato

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s okay. Knowing you’re home and comfortable is enough
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. Sapere che sei a casa e comodo è abbastanza

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I am. I still wanted a minute with you before I sleep ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo sono. Volevo ancora un minuto con te prima di dormire ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UN PO' DOPO, A CASA LORO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm here 😊 Found the right building and everything's fine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono qui 😊 Ho trovato l'edificio giusto e va tutto bene

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. How’s the evening looking?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. Com'è la serata?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Were there other acceptable answers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: C'erano altre risposte accettabili?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It smells like dinner rather than smoke, so I’m choosing to be optimistic 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Profuma di cena piuttosto che di fumo, quindi scelgo di essere ottimista 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please tell me you didn’t open with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Per favore dimmi che non hai aperto con quello

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. I said hello first
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Ho detto ciao prima

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very diplomatic
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Molto diplomatico

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s setting the table. Here, your promised proof that I arrived
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sta apparecchiando la tavola. Ecco, la prova promessa che sono arrivata

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, smiling, and not about to be poisoned by a burnt pizza 😊
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sicura, sorridente e non sul punto di essere avvelenata da una pizza bruciata 😊

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m reassured about at least two of those things
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono rassicurata su almeno due di quelle cose

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t start 😭 I’m good, really
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non cominciare 😭 Sto bene, davvero

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Enjoy yourself, sweetheart. I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Divertiti, tesoro. Sono qui se hai bisogno di qualcosa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Several. Yours was the best one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Diversi. Il tuo era il migliore

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ I’ll check in later. I’m putting my phone away now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Grazie ❤️ Ti scrivo dopo. Ora metto via il telefono

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DOPO CHE METTE VIA IL SUO TELEFONO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You found it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'hai trovato

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: First try. Of course
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Primo tentativo. Certo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I would have come down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sarei scesa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. That’s why I didn’t text you from the pavement
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so. Ecco perché non ti ho scritto dal marciapiede

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That looks much better than the dinner you carefully left out of your photograph
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembra molto meglio della cena che hai accuratamente escluso dalla tua foto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was going to lead with an apology
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stavo per iniziare con una scusa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m joking. You can stop apologizing for one burnt pizza
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sto scherzando. Puoi smettere di scusarti per una pizza bruciata

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then I’ll stop. Sit. I set your side already
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora smetterò. Siediti. Ho già preparato il tuo lato

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Get there safely, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Arriva sano e salvo, tesoro

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: My side. We’ve had one bookshop and a lot of messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il mio lato. Abbiamo avuto una libreria e molti messaggi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I was paying attention
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stavo prestando attenzione

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DURANTE LA CENA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How have you been?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Come stai?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Better than I expected to be. Work was busy. This is the first part of today that feels like mine
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Meglio di quanto mi aspettassi. Il lavoro è stato intenso. Questa è la prima parte di oggi che sembra mia

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And your boyfriend?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E il tuo ragazzo?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s all right. Quieter than he lets on. He spends a lot of time deciding what he’s allowed to want
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. È più tranquillo di quanto faccia credere. Passa molto tempo a decidere cosa può desiderare.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sounds tiring
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembra stancante.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It is, for him. He used to plan everything so nothing could surprise him. He’s trying not to do that with me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo è, per lui. Prima pianificava tutto così da non essere mai sorpreso. Sta cercando di non farlo con me.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he know you’re here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sa che sei qui?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. You'll get your arrival message, I haven't forgotten
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo farò. Riceverai il messaggio di arrivo, non me ne sono dimenticata

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. I told him I arrived. He doesn’t need a transcript of the dinner
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Gli ho detto che sono arrivata. Non ha bisogno di un resoconto della cena.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Fair. I wouldn’t want one of his evenings either
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Giusto. Non vorrei nemmeno una delle sue serate.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’d be surprised what you’d recognize
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti sorprenderesti di cosa riconosceresti.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sorry?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Scusa?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Nothing. The sauce. This is actually recognizable. I’m impressed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Niente. La salsa. Questo è davvero riconoscibile. Sono impressionata.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t sound so surprised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non sembrare così sorpresa.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m allowed to be surprised. You sent me a picture of your face instead of the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho il diritto di essere sorpresa. Mi hai mandato una foto del tuo viso invece del cibo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: The food didn’t know what to do with its face
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il cibo non sapeva cosa fare con il suo viso.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: If you’re going to stare, you can at least feed me the next bite
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Se devi fissare, almeno dammi il prossimo boccone.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Open, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Apri, allora.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Now we’re even with last night’s photos
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco. Ora siamo pari con le foto di ieri sera.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I don’t think we’re even
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non penso che siamo pari.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so proud. You still have sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non sembrare così orgoglioso. Hai ancora salsa sul pollice.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You could deal with that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Puoi affrontarlo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat first. You’re very easy to distract
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mangia prima. Sei molto facile da distrarre.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You came over. I’m allowed to be distracted
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei venuto. Ho il diritto di essere distratta.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I came over for dinner. The rest can wait until the plates are clear
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono venuta per cena. Il resto può aspettare finché i piatti non sono vuoti.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DOPO CENA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You brought the book
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai portato il libro.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I brought the book. I’ve even made it past the bookmark
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho portato il libro. Sono persino andata oltre il segnalibro.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s more than I expected
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È più di quanto mi aspettassi.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t get used to it. I read one page on the way here and then thought about you instead
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non abituarti. Ho letto una pagina mentre venivo qui e poi ho pensato a te.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s a better review than the book was going to get
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È una recensione migliore di quella che il libro avrebbe ricevuto.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here, I marked the page I wanted to talk to you about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco, ho segnato la pagina di cui volevo parlarti.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We can talk about it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Possiamo parlarne.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actually, the book can wait. I didn’t come here just to compare notes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: In realtà, il libro può aspettare. Non sono venuta qui solo per confrontare appunti.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vieni qui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Beyond the Messages
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Oltre i Messaggi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s what I was trying to say without typing it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo è quello che stavo cercando di dire senza scriverlo.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit. I want my hand on you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Siediti. Voglio la mia mano su di te.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don’t look so surprised. Last night’s photos were the warning
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non sembrare così sorpresa. Le foto di ieri sera erano l'avvertimento.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Her Hand
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La sua mano

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Slower. Yes, like that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Più lento. Sì, così.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Your turn. I want your mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Il tuo turno. Voglio la tua bocca.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: His Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: La Sua Bocca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco. Non fermarti.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono vicina.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: She Comes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lei viene

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. That was really good
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ok. È stato davvero buono.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I still got it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ce l'ho ancora

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Quiet. I got outside for a bit, then came back to the incredibly demanding task of doing nothing
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tranquilla. Sono uscita un po', poi sono tornata all'incredibilmente impegnativa attività di non fare nulla

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Shut up
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stai zitto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not staying the night. I should go while I still mean that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non rimango qui stanotte. Dovrei andare finché lo penso ancora

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Message me tomorrow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mandami un messaggio domani

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Maybe
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Forse

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE GETS HOME
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DOPO CHE È TORNATA A CASA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Hey ❤️ I’m home. I didn’t stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi ❤️ Sono a casa. Non sono rimasta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: All right. Thank you for letting me know
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. Grazie per avermelo fatto sapere

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We didn’t go all the way. I wanted to tell you what did happen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non siamo andati fino in fondo. Volevo dirti cosa è successo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: After dinner we kissed by the window. I used my hand on him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dopo cena ci siamo baciati vicino alla finestra. Gli ho messo la mano addosso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: A LITTLE LATER, AT HIS PLACE
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: UN PO' DOPO, A CASA LORO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then he went down on me until I came. I came home after that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Poi lui mi ha fatto piacere fino a farmi venire. Sono tornata a casa dopo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How are you feeling about it?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Come ti senti al riguardo?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Happy I went, and happy I didn’t keep everything behind a screen
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. Felice di essere andata e felice di non aver tenuto tutto dietro uno schermo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: We talked over dinner first. By the time I decided, I knew that was what I wanted. I also knew I wanted to sleep in my own bed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prima abbiamo parlato durante la cena. Quando ho deciso, sapevo che era quello che volevo. Sapevo anche che volevo dormire nel mio letto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m glad you felt comfortable with him
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono contenta che ti sei sentito a tuo agio con lui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I did. The dinner was good too, in case you were still worried about that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Anche la cena era buona, nel caso fossi ancora preoccupato per questo 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll stop preparing the restaurant rescue plan, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora smetterò di preparare il piano di salvataggio del ristorante

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Keep the plan. We could use it for ourselves sometime ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tieni il piano. Potremmo usarlo per noi stessi qualche volta ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I'm at {{name:aiden}}'s 😊 All good, as promised
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono da {{name:aiden}} 😊 Tutto a posto, come promesso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m happy. I’m keeping the details to myself tonight, but I wanted you to know I got home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono felice. Stasera tengo i dettagli per me, ma volevo che sapessi che sono tornata a casa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That’s fine. You don’t have to tell me more than that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. Non devi dirmi di più di così

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you ❤️ It was a good decision to go
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Grazie ❤️ È stata una buona decisione andare

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E tu? Come stai?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Found it easily?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'hai trovato facilmente?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I needed a second before answering, but I’m okay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho avuto bisogno di un attimo prima di rispondere, ma sto bene

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It feels different now we’re actually here. I’d rather say that than pretend I never get nervous
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È diverso ora che siamo qui. Preferisco dirlo piuttosto che fingere di non essere mai nervoso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’d rather you said it too. Would you like me to call?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Preferirei che lo dicessi anche tu. Vuoi che ti chiami?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No, I’m glad we’re talking. I just needed a moment
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No, sono contento che stiamo parlando. Avevo solo bisogno di un momento

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Okay. You can tell me if that changes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Va bene. Puoi dirmelo se cambia ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will. I’m glad you had a good evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo farò. Sono contenta che hai passato una bella serata

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And you? How are you doing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E tu? Come stai?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. I liked seeing your message come in
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. Mi è piaciuto vedere il tuo messaggio arrivare

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. He opened the door holding two plates
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Ha aperto la porta con due piatti in mano

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re very sweet tonight
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei molto dolce stasera

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I have my moments 🙂
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho i miei momenti 🙂

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You do. More than I give you credit for sometimes ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È vero. Più di quanto a volte ti dia merito ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll try not to ruin this one
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Cercherò di non rovinare questo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti amo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I love you too ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti amo anch'io ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll message you in the morning, before you start making plans to keep my spoon
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti scriverò domani mattina, prima che inizi a fare piani per tenerti il mio cucchiaio

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I thought it was mine now
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Pensavo fosse mio adesso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Absolutely not. Neither is my side of the sofa 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Assolutamente no. Né il mio lato del divano 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Actual plates. I was mentally preparing to eat straight from a takeaway box 😭
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Piatti veri. Mi stavo preparando mentalmente a mangiare direttamente da una scatola da asporto 😭

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Both are safe. Get some sleep, sweetheart
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Entrambi sono al sicuro. Fai un po' di sonno, tesoro

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And thanks again for all of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E grazie ancora per tutto questo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Don't thank me. We both wanted it. I’m glad we’re doing this together ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non ringraziarmi. Lo volevamo entrambi. Sono felice che lo stiamo facendo insieme ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buona notte

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good night ❤️
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Buona notte ❤️

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He’s making an effort, then
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora sta facendo uno sforzo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Apparently. One quick picture while he puts them down
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: A quanto pare. Una foto veloce mentre li appoggia

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Safe, indoors, and about to be fed 😊 You can stop wondering whether I got lost
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sicura, al chiuso e pronta a mangiare 😊 Puoi smettere di chiederti se mi sono persa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for letting me know. Enjoy your evening
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Grazie per avermelo fatto sapere. Buona serata

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Please accept my sympathy 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Accetta le mie condoglianze 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I will ❤️ I’m putting my phone away now. Speak later
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo farò ❤️ Metto via il telefono adesso. Ci sentiamo dopo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m here if you need anything
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono qui se hai bisogno di qualcosa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER SHE PUTS HER PHONE AWAY
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DOPO CHE METTE VIA IL SUO TELEFONO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Have I passed the inspection?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho superato l'ispezione?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I said I arrived. I wasn’t writing a review of your home
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho detto che sono arrivata. Non stavo scrivendo una recensione della tua casa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. The chair with everything piled on it would lose me a star
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. La sedia con tutto ammucchiato sopra mi farebbe perdere una stella

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I noticed
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: L'ho notato

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Of course you did
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Certo che l'hai fatto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: He told me to have a good evening. You could start by feeding me
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi ha detto di passare una buona serata. Potresti iniziare a nutrirmi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I bought dinner on the way home. I’m not pretending I suddenly learned to cook
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho comprato la cena tornando a casa. Non sto facendo finta di aver imparato a cucinare all'improvviso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: How was work?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Com'è andato il lavoro?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Honest and organized. That’s an unexpected combination
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Onesto e organizzato. È una combinazione inaspettata

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Careful. Another compliment and I’ll think you like being here
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Attento. Un altro complimento e penserò che ti piaccia essere qui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I do. You can accept that without building a whole speech around it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piace. Puoi accettarlo senza doverci costruire un discorso attorno

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’ll get the food
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Prendo io il cibo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Excellent decision
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ottima decisione

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: DURING DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DURANTE LA CENA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re watching my mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stai guardando la mia bocca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re taking too long. Open
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stai impiegando troppo tempo. Apri

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Does he get fed like this, or is this a special service?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Viene nutrito così, o è un servizio speciale?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re stalling
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Stai temporeggiando

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Busy enough that I kept finding my coffee cold whenever I remembered it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Abbastanza occupata da trovare sempre il mio caffè freddo ogni volta che me ne ricordavo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: And now you’ve got sauce on your thumb
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: E ora hai la salsa sul pollice

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Then deal with it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Allora affrontalo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Gladly. He doesn’t get this part, does he?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Volentieri. Non riceve questa parte, vero?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Eat. Then you can be annoying somewhere more useful
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mangia. Poi puoi essere fastidioso da qualche altra parte

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: AFTER DINNER
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: DOPO CENA

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Wait, is that the strip from the photo booth?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Aspetta, è quella striscia del photo booth?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: It looked better there than in my pocket
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lì sembrava meglio che in tasca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You put the one with your eyes closed at the front
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Hai messo quella con gli occhi chiusi davanti

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wasn’t looking at the camera
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non stavo guardando la macchina fotografica

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I remember
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ricordo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: But everything on my list is done, and my phone is charged
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma ho finito tutto sulla mia lista, e il mio telefono è carico

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want me to turn it around?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vuoi che lo giri?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. Leave it there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Lascialo lì

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’ve gone quiet
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei diventato silenzioso

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I like that you kept it somewhere you’d see it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi piace che tu l'abbia tenuto in un posto dove lo vedi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I liked the evening. Keeping the pictures seemed obvious
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi è piaciuta la serata. Tenere le foto sembrava ovvio

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That was a nice answer
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È stata una bella risposta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I can occasionally manage one. Better than a briefing?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ogni tanto riesco a farne uno. Meglio di un briefing?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Come here before you spoil it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Vieni qui prima che lo rovini

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Here?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Qui?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You know what I mean
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sai cosa intendo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You sound pleased to have the evening back
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sembri contenta di avere di nuovo la serata

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No Need for a Score
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non c'è bisogno di un punteggio

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Was that the reward for a nice answer?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Era questo il premio per una bella risposta?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: No. That was because I wanted to kiss you
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: No. Era perché volevo baciarti

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Even better. Does he get kissed like that after dinner?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ancora meglio. Viene baciato così dopo cena?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stop talking. Sit, and keep your hands where I put them
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Smetti di parlare. Siediti e tieni le mani dove te le metto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the dress?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sotto il vestito?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: ON THE SOFA
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: SUL DIVANO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Two fingers?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Due dita?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Yes. Slow, then less slow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì. Lento, poi meno lento

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Very. Let me show you something before I put my shoes on
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Molto. Fammi mostrarti qualcosa prima di mettermi le scarpe

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Tell me if I’m doing better than he does
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Dimmi se sto facendo meglio di lui

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m not answering that. Keep going
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non rispondo a questo. Continua

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Under the Dress
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sotto il Vestito

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There. Don’t you dare keep score of that
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco. Non osare tenere il punteggio di questo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You’re close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sei vicino

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. Don’t stop
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so. Non fermarti

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: That sound. Does he get that too?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Quel suono. Anche lui lo sente?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Sit back. My turn
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Rilassati. È il mio turno

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: HER TURN
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: IL SUO TURNO

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You don’t have to—
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non devi—

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I know. I want to
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Lo so. Voglio farlo

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Is this the part where I lose to him on purpose?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: È questo il momento in cui perdo contro di lui di proposito?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: This is the part where you stop talking. Hands in my hair. Don’t pull me off unless I say
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Questo è il momento in cui smetti di parlare. Mani nei miei capelli. Non tirarmi via a meno che non lo dica io

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Between His Knees
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Tra Le Sue Ginocchia

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I’m close
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Sono vicino

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Good. Stay there
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Bene. Resta lì

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: In Her Mouth
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Nella Sua Bocca

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: You didn’t have to swallow
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Non dovevi ingoiare

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: I wanted to. Don’t look that pleased
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Volevo farlo. Non sembrare così soddisfatto

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: Stay
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Resta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.source: There 😊 I managed to look like I had longer than twenty minutes to get ready
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_01_LENA_EVENING_NT.translation: Ecco 😊 Sono riuscita a sembrare che avessi più di venti minuti per prepararmi

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: It’s to reward me for being so attentive to my studies 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: È per premiarmi perché sono così attenta nello studio 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: I still have the rest of the reward to enjoy
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ho ancora il resto della ricompensa da godere

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You really sent that to him?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Hai davvero mandato quello a lui?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: How did the practice test go?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Com'è andato il test di pratica?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: She seems sure of herself here, and I'm still learning what that means for me.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Qui sembra sicura di sé, e sto ancora imparando cosa significhi per me.

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: {{name:ethan}} giving cunnilingus as a reward after the successful practice test
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: {{name:ethan}} che fa cunnilingus come ricompensa dopo il test di pratica riuscito

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Careful… if you finish too early you’ll get penalty points
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Attento… se finisci troppo presto prendi punti di penalità

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: You’re not only good at studies…
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Non sei solo brava negli studi…

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: For the next lessons… what’s the objective?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Per le prossime lezioni… qual è l'obiettivo?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But we’ll have to go deeper into the subjects
Then I’m really looking forward to going deeper into all of that 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Allora non vedo l'ora di approfondire tutto questo 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: But I passed it with flying colors 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Ma l'ho passato con il massimo dei voti 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.source: Not too disappointed you didn’t get the punishment?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_02_HAILEY_EVENING_.translation: Non sei troppo delusa di non aver preso la punizione?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Did you enjoy this little day?
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Ti è piaciuta questa piccola giornata?

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: The part where you watched everything during the game session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Quella parte in cui hai guardato tutto durante la sessione di gioco 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Looking forward to the next training session 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Non vedo l'ora della prossima sessione di allenamento 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: If you admit properly I’ll show you something even better
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Se lo ammetti per bene, ti mostrerò qualcosa di ancora meglio

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Look what your best friend left me like when he left
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Guarda come mi ha lasciato il tuo migliore amico quando se n'è andato

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: The part where I sent you a photo of my reward 😌
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Quella parte in cui ti ho mandato una foto della mia ricompensa 😌

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: And that’s the kind of crazy you love
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: E questo è il tipo di follia che ami

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Be ready to see even more
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Preparati a vedere ancora di più

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: I don’t know what you’re talking about
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Non so di cosa stai parlando

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: Too bad… I had another surprise for you if you liked it
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Peccato... avevo un'altra sorpresa per te se ti è piaciuta

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: For finally admitting it, you get a reward too
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Per averlo finalmente ammesso, anche tu ricevi una ricompensa

story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.source: After putting your phone down, you settle back beside {{name:lena}} and fall asleep together.
story/DAY20/nts/DAY20_03_HAILEY_NIGHT_NT.translation: Dopo aver messo giù il telefono, ti sistemi accanto a {{name:lena}} e vi addormentate insieme.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Good morning ☀️
Trying to wake up slowly
Of course you are 😏
I swear you never rest your thumbs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Giuro che non riposi mai le dita.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're happy when my fingers are used to text you, no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Sei felice quando le mie dita vengono usate per scriverti, vero?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true ❤️
By the way…
About the tickets for our trip
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Riguardo ai biglietti per il nostro viaggio

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't even know what to do with them now
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Non so nemmeno cosa fare con loro adesso.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What do you think I should do?
Give them to someone who really needs a break
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Dali a qualcuno che ha davvero bisogno di una pausa

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and why not go with {{name:aiden}}?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tieni quelli e perché non andare con {{name:aiden}}?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Keep them and find someone else to go with
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Tieni loro e trova qualcun altro con cui andare.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Hey you 🙂
That's actually really kind of you 😊
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: È davvero molto gentile da parte tua 😊

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You always try to do the right thing
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Cerchi sempre di fare la cosa giusta

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Of course I am, look at how much luck I have these days thanks to karma 😅
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Certo che lo sono, guarda quanto sono fortunato in questi giorni grazie al karma 😅

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Well having me as your girlfriend is not good enough?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Beh, avere me come tua ragazza non è abbastanza?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: It is! I'm the luckiest man in the world ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: È! Sono l'uomo più fortunato del mondo ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Really?
I swear
I'm also the luckiest girl in the world
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Sono anche la ragazza più fortunata del mondo.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?
For having a vegetable as your man? Not sure about that 😄
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Per avere un vegetale come tuo uomo? Non ne sono sicuro 😄

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You know how much I love vegetables 😉
You're too sweet
With {{name:aiden}}?
Why?
He always wanted to go to that island and at least he has his two legs
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ha sempre voluto andare su quell'isola e almeno ha le sue due gambe.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I don't think I will be very comfortable going alone with him
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Non penso che mi sentirò molto a mio agio ad andare da solo con lui.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: I'm okay
Even if he is my friend and your best friend, it feels weird no?
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Anche se è mio amico e il tuo migliore amico, sembra strano, vero?

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Now that you said it like that I guess it does
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ora che l'hai detto in quel modo, immagino di sì.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: But I trust you both and I don't want you to miss the trip just because of me and at the same time he will finally have the trip to the island he wanted so much
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Ma mi fido di entrambi e non voglio che perdiate il viaggio solo a causa mia e allo stesso tempo lui avrà finalmente il viaggio sull'isola che desiderava tanto.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: You're right I'm thinking too much
And it is in more than a month so I got time to think about it
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: E ci vorrà più di un mese, quindi ho tempo per pensarci.

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: Exactly
You won't be jealous?
Of course I will
My best friend going to the vacation we prepared and spending time with my girlfriend in my place, who on earth won't be jealous!
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: Il mio migliore amico va in vacanza che abbiamo preparato e passa del tempo con la mia ragazza a casa mia, chi diavolo non sarebbe geloso!

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: That's true, and sweet it shows that you care a lot about me ❤️
story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.translation: È vero, ed è dolce che dimostri che ti importa molto di me ❤️

story/DAY3/DAY3_01_LENA_TICKETS.json::st.source: What about you?
That's called love
You're too much of a sweet talker
Only with you ❤️
You better 😌
Someone else?
That feels a little cold 😕
Sorry I didn't mean it that way
