She has to go back to work tomorrow
Money is getting tight and they need her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: I soldi stanno diventando pochi e hanno bisogno di lei.
Che ne dici di quel manager?

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I just hope it's not like last time
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Spero solo che non sia come l'ultima volta.

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: And when you're better you'll be able to help her
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: E quando starai meglio, potrai aiutarla.
Una buona immagine della buonanotte per favore?

story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I’m removing my makeup before bed
story/DAY3/DAY3_12_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Mi sto struccando prima di andare a letto.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I'm sure they'll feel the same so don't worry
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Sono sicuro che si sentiranno allo stesso modo, quindi non preoccuparti.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I made breakfast and it's ready
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Ho preparato la colazione ed è pronta

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Do you want me to bring it to you?
Are you going to take a shower this morning?
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Hai intenzione di fare una doccia stamattina?

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: How are you feeling this morning?
The store doesn't want to take her back
So we will have to endure her mess until we die
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Quindi dovremo sopportare il suo casino fino a quando non moriremo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Or we find some crazy guy who wants her
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: O troviamo qualche pazzo che la vuole.
Fai attenzione ai tuoi passi, va bene?

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I will be a bit busy this morning
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Sarò un po' occupato questa mattina.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: I need to prepare everything for going back to work
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Devo preparare tutto per tornare al lavoro.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: My bag my clothes and a few documents
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: La mia borsa, i miei vestiti e alcuni documenti.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: So if you need something ask {{name:hailey}} or {{name:mason}}
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Quindi, se hai bisogno di qualcosa, chiedi a {{name:hailey}} o a {{name:mason}}.
A meno che non sia urgente

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Just do what you have to do
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Fai solo quello che devi fare

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: Thank you for taking care of me
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Grazie per avermi preso cura di me

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: The same stress as a first day I guess
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Lo stesso stress di un primo giorno, immagino.

story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.source: But I'm happy to see my colleagues!
story/DAY4/DAY4_01_EVELYN_MORNING_BAR_SH.translation: Ma sono felice di vedere i miei colleghi!

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Hello mister secretary 😌
(I'm a grown woman, I'm a grown woman 😌)
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: (Sono una donna adulta, sono una donna adulta 😌)

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: ( Don't kill him 😇)
How many of you are there in your head?
Enough to bury you in the garden 🌸
Anyway
How are you doing today?
Better than yesterday
Still slow though
Slow is fine, or more like your normal speed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Lento va bene, o più come la tua velocità normale 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: You better train to run fast
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: È meglio che ti alleni per correre veloce.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Random warning 😇
You'll see what happens to bad frogs when I'm fully healed
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Vedrai cosa succede alle cattive rane quando sarò completamente guarito.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Threats don't reach my princess ears
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Le minacce non raggiungono le orecchie della mia principessa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Goodbye peasant 😇
I need either {{name:aiden}} or {{name:mason}} to take me to rugby on Wednesday
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Ho bisogno di {{name:aiden}} o {{name:mason}} per portarmi al rugby mercoledì.

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: I'm planning ahead because apparently that's what mature women do 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Sto pianificando in anticipo perché a quanto pare è quello che fanno le donne mature 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Who are you?
What have you done to my {{name:hailey}}
How dare you say that 😤
That's not how a proper majordomo is supposed to behave 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Non è così che un vero maggiordomo dovrebbe comportarsi 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.source: Are you a princess?
More like a frog to me
story/DAY4/DAY4_02_HAILEY_WEDNESDAY_RIDE.translation: Più simile a una rana per me

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: You can stay if you want
They say he's the most handsome guy at uni
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Dicono che sia il ragazzo più bello dell'università.

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: We both know how he really is
Still, it's true that he's handsome
But I only look at you so I don't care 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Ma ti guardo solo io, quindi non mi importa 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.source: I only look at you too ❤️
I'll let you enjoy lunch with your friends
story/DAY4/DAY4_03_LENA_LUNCH.json::step.translation: Ti lascerò goderti il pranzo con i tuoi amici.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Like caring about each other a little
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Come prendersi cura l'uno dell'altro un po'

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Since when do you care what I do
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Da quando ti interessa quello che faccio?

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It's just hard to have a conversation with you without you getting mad
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: È solo difficile avere una conversazione con te senza che tu si arrabbi.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just wish we could talk a little less aggressively
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Vorrei solo che potessimo parlare in modo un po' meno aggressivo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And care about each other a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: E prendersi cura l'uno dell'altro un po' di più

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: It was in the living room
So I don't care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Quindi non mi interessa di te
Non è quello che ho detto

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I stayed with you the whole time at the hospital
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Sono rimasto con te tutto il tempo in ospedale.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I even carried you to your bed when we got home
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Ti ho persino portato a letto quando siamo tornati a casa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: And that's just about the accident
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: E questo è tutto riguardo l'incidente.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Never mind the rest of the year
And thank you again for that
I just want us to talk for reasons other than needing something
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Voglio solo che parliamo per motivi diversi dal bisogno di qualcosa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Don't you have a girlfriend for that
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Non hai una ragazza per questo?
Non si tratta di uscire con te

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I just want to know you better
And have a good time with you sometimes
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: E passare del tempo con te a volte

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: I'll try to be less aggressive
Then {{name:hailey}} took it or the couch ate it
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: Allora {{name:hailey}} l'ha preso o il divano l'ha mangiato.

story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.source: Is it too hard for you to text me for anything other than complaints?
story/DAY4/DAY4_04_MASON_STUFF_OR_CONSOL.translation: È così difficile per te scrivermi per qualsiasi cosa oltre alle lamentele?

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I can carry ranked later if you are up for it
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Posso fare ranked più tardi se sei d'accordo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Keep laughing, I am dropping 30 tonight
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Continua a ridere, stasera ne faccio 30.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Before you roast me, yes my hair looks stupid
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Prima di prendermi in giro, sì, i miei capelli sembrano stupidi.

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Say that louder, I need motivation
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Dillo più forte, ho bisogno di motivazione!
Come sta la tua gamba oggi?

story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do your rehab and stop trying to be a hero
story/DAY4/DAY4_05_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Fai la tua riabilitazione e smettila di cercare di essere un eroe

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It can get busy in the evening

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Questo è tutto ciò che voglio

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: I checked your medication and your food
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Ho controllato la tua medicina e il tuo cibo
Per favore, non saltare il pranzo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: Try not to stress too much okay
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Cerca di non stressarti troppo, va bene?

story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.source: It still feels a little strange going back
story/DAY4/DAY4_06_EVELYN_16H_GOING_TO_W.translation: Sembra ancora un po' strano tornare indietro.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You look like the kind of person who would file a very sad complaint from bed 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Sembri il tipo di persona che presenterebbe un reclamo molto triste dal letto 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: A very bad one if it's really late, so hurry 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Una molto brutta se è davvero tardi, quindi sbrigati 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Let me just buy some rat poison on the way home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Fammi solo comprare un po' di veleno per topi sulla strada di casa.

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't starve before I get there mister rat🤍
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Non morire di fame prima che io arrivi, signor topo🤍

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: How no, what about your limousine?
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Come no, che ne è della tua limousine?

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: Don't you dare make fun of me 😒
Since you're broken and no one is home
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Poiché sei rotto e non c'è nessuno a casa

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: I'm coming back with a friend instead
Which means your food is getting delivered to your room a little later than planned 😇
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Il che significa che il tuo cibo verrà consegnato nella tua stanza un po' più tardi del previsto 😇

story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.source: You say that like I'm about to file a complaint
story/DAY4/DAY4_07_HAILEY_BUS_DELAY_FOOD.translation: Lo dici come se stessi per presentare un reclamo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then I went straight to the shower 😌
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Poi sono andato dritto sotto la doccia 😌

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So now you look unfairly pretty?
Pretty enough that I need proof with my own eyes
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Abbastanza carina da aver bisogno di prove con i miei occhi.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm tired and now I'm blushing
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Sono stanco e ora mi sto arrossendo.
Come è stata la tua giornata?

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: So you don't have to worry

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Non è necessario che tu lo faccia.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But I want to talk to you a little more
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Ma voglio parlarti un po' di più

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want to stay and talk to you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Voglio restare e parlare con te

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Go rest, you need it after your long day
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Vai a riposarti, ne hai bisogno dopo la tua lunga giornata.
Non puoi fare il broncio con me

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: But it's true, so that makes me even more annoyed 🙄
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Ma è vero, quindi mi fa arrabbiare ancora di più 🙄

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I'm only saying it because I care about you
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Lo dico solo perché mi importa di te

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I want you in good shape tomorrow
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Voglio che tu sia in forma domani.

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: Then go sleep if you understand
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Allora vai a dormire se capisci
Tutto il mio corpo è stanco 😭

story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.source: I made something quick when I got back
story/DAY4/DAY4_08_LENA_EVENING.json::st.translation: Ho fatto qualcosa di veloce quando sono tornato.

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Stopped at the gym on the way back
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Fermato in palestra sulla strada di ritorno

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: A couple idiots there tried to waste my time
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Un paio di idioti lì hanno cercato di farmi perdere tempo.

story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.source: Didn't want you wondering where I was
story/DAY4/DAY4_09_MASON_GYM_LATE_RETURN.translation: Non volevo che ti chiedessi dove fossi.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: Or maybe he just understood boundaries this time
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: O forse questa volta ha semplicemente capito i confini.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I was a little slow at first
But muscle memory comes back quickly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Ma la memoria muscolare torna rapidamente.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: And you, how was your day?
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: E tu, com'è stata la tua giornata?

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I'm going to prepare dinner earlier today, tell me when you're hungry, I will bring it to you directly
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Preparerò la cena prima oggi, fammi sapere quando hai fame, te la porterò direttamente.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: I had forgotten how exhausting it can be
story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.translation: Avevo dimenticato quanto possa essere estenuante.

story/DAY5/DAY5_00_PLAYER_TEXT_EVELYN_RE.source: But it felt good to be back
I saw him during the evening

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Would have been better with you next to me
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Sarebbe stato meglio con te accanto a me

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: And you, eat something this morning
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: E tu, mangia qualcosa questa mattina.

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: So thank you for forcing me to go to bed early 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Quindi grazie per costringermi ad andare a letto presto 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
But yes, this one was good

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Come va la tua gamba questa mattina?

story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Better I think, i can move around more
story/DAY5/DAY5_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Meglio, penso, posso muovermi di più.

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And how he's going to drag you outside the second you can walk again
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: E come ti trascinerà fuori non appena potrai camminare di nuovo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: And the girls are drinking his every word 🙄
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: E le ragazze bevono ogni sua parola 🙄

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: At this point I think the girls would eat him alive if they could
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: A questo punto penso che le ragazze lo mangerebbero vivo se potessero.
Indovina chi si è unito a noi

story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He just sat down like he owns the table 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_02_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Si è appena seduto come se possedesse il tavolo 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'm thinking about you a lot today
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Sto pensando a te molto oggi

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I wish I could just leave and come lay next to you for ten minutes
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Vorrei poter semplicemente andarmene e venire a sdraiarmi accanto a te per dieci minuti.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Ten minutes would turn into two hours
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Dieci minuti si trasformerebbero in due ore.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Uni is finally over for today
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: L'università è finalmente finita per oggi.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: And then I would fail everything because of you
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: E poi fallirei in tutto a causa tua.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Text me if you need anything okay?
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Mandami un messaggio se hai bisogno di qualcosa, va bene?

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I have to go back now
Now I still have work until 14
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Ora ho ancora lavoro fino alle 14.

story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Then my part time job until 18 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_03_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Poi il mio lavoro part-time fino alle 18 😭
Come va la tua gamba adesso?

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do not get used to it
I just want your brain occupied for a bit
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Voglio solo che il tuo cervello sia occupato per un po'

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Send me one word later: alive
Or are you pretending to be productive today?
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: O stai facendo finta di essere produttivo oggi?

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Liar, but I respect the confidence
Then we do chill games, no screaming
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Allora facciamo giochi tranquilli, niente urla.

story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: And if you do not feel it, we skip
story/DAY5/DAY5_04_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: E se non lo senti, saltiamo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Occupato? 😌
Cosa ha causato tutto questo?

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: A girl in class is losing her mind over some guy she barely knows
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Una ragazza in classe sta perdendo la testa per un tipo che conosce a malapena.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So now everyone is doing that whole crush autopsy 😭
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Quindi ora tutti stanno facendo quell'intera autopsia della cotta 😭
E tu ti sei unito?
Solo un po' 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I said people like confidence and good timing
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Ho detto che alla gente piacciono la fiducia e il buon tempismo.
Non è un cattivo consiglio.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I know, what would your advice be?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Lo so, quale sarebbe il tuo consiglio?

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Just be yourself, be funny, be kind, be honest, that's probably all
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Sii te stesso, sii divertente, sii gentile, sii onesto, probabilmente è tutto.

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: So all I need is a sparkling personality? 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Quindi tutto ciò di cui ho bisogno è una personalità scintillante? 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Do you have five minutes or are you pretending to be very important?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Hai cinque minuti o stai facendo finta di essere molto importante?
Non esattamente quello che ho detto
Sembra proprio me 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Okay, that's enough emotional labor for your afternoon 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Va bene, basta lavoro emotivo per il tuo pomeriggio 😇
Grazie per aver risposto seriamente 🤍
Prego

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: If you need more help for your monologue, I'm here 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Se hai bisogno di ulteriore aiuto per il tuo monologo, sono qui 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: I can make time for the small people
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Posso trovare tempo per le persone piccole
Risposta sbagliata 😌
Stavo solo chiedendomi qualcosa

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Do you fall for people fast or do you act difficult first?
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Ti innamori delle persone in fretta o fai la difficile prima?
Dipende dalla persona

story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.source: Why? Are you planning on jumping from the roof onto someone? 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_05_HAILEY_AFTER_LUNCH_TA.translation: Perché? Hai intenzione di saltare dal tetto su qualcuno? 😌
Stronzo 🖕

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Then soda and a few biscuits 😌
Want me to change your clothes and brush your teeth too
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Vuoi che ti cambi i vestiti e ti lavi i denti anche?

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Might grab food too if the line doesn't piss me off
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Potrei prendere del cibo anche se la fila non mi fa arrabbiare.

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: A drink and whatever is easiest 🙂
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Una bevanda e qualunque cosa sia più facile 🙂

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: You asked a guy with one busted leg
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: Hai chiesto a un ragazzo con una gamba rotta.

story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.source: Your leg's hurt, you're not sick, asshole
story/DAY5/DAY5_06_MASON_STORE_OR_FOOD_R.translation: La tua gamba fa male, non sei malato, stronzo.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I will pretend i didnt see that
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Fingero di non aver visto quello

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I knew keeping you around had value
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Sapevo che tenerti vicino aveva un valore

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Don't get emotional, you still haven't seen the options yet 😇
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Non farti prendere dall'emozione, non hai ancora visto le opzioni 😇

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: I have a party on Saturday night
So I may need your opinion on hair tomorrow
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Quindi potrei aver bisogno della tua opinione sui capelli domani.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: And if it goes badly, you are legally required to save me
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: E se va male, sei legalmente obbligato a salvarmi.

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: Or you will have to pay for the damage
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Oppure dovrai pagare per i danni

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: How am I saving you from hair?
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Come ti sto salvando dai capelli?

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: By telling me when I look insane before I leave the house 😌
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Dicendomi quando sembro pazzo prima di uscire di casa 😌

story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.source: That seems hard, you will hear me everyday
story/DAY5/DAY5_07_HAILEY_PARTY_HAIR_HEL.translation: Sembra difficile, mi sentirai ogni giorno.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Anche tu stanco, curare è faticoso.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: I'm going to sleep early tonight
Then don't stay up for me
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Allora non restare sveglio per me

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: At least you didn't skip dinner
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Almeno non hai saltato la cena

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Look at you sounding all responsible now 🙄
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Guarda come sembri così responsabile adesso 🙄

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: I still need to finish one thing for tomorrow
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Devo ancora finire una cosa per domani.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Just don't drag it out too long
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Non tirarla troppo per le lunghe.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Uni and both jobs in one day
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Uni e entrambi i lavori in un giorno

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Listen to you ordering me around 😒
Someone has to protect your last brain cell
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Qualcuno deve proteggere il tuo ultimo neurone.

story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.source: Not sure I'll fall asleep right away
story/DAY5/DAY5_08_LENA_NIGHT_TIRED.json.translation: Non sono sicuro di addormentarmi subito.
Non c'è da meravigliarsi che tu sia esausto.
Sto andando avanti con le ultime energie 😭

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: So you can copy me and finally get some muscle
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Quindi puoi copiarmi e finalmente ottenere un po' di muscoli.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: I'm making the first post tonight
You better be the first like
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Meglio che tu sia il primo a mettere mi piace.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: I finally made my fitness page
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: Ho finalmente creato la mia pagina fitness

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: Or at least make it look like I have more than three followers
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: O almeno fai sembrare che ho più di tre follower.

story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.source: Is that a request or an order
story/DAY5/DAY5_09_MASON_FITNESS_ACCOUNT.translation: È una richiesta o un ordine?

story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.source: I will be very late tonight
Okay, be careful on your way back
story/DAY5/DAY5_10_EVELYN_NIGHT_LATE_HOM.translation: Va bene, fai attenzione mentre torni indietro.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: He looked at me strangely a few times
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Mi ha guardato in modo strano un paio di volte.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: It was still quite a long day
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Era ancora una giornata piuttosto lunga

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: I slept as soon as I got home
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Ho dormito non appena sono tornato a casa.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: I will make breakfast in a few minutes
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Preparerò la colazione tra pochi minuti.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Tell me if you want it brought to you
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Dimmi se vuoi che te lo porti.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Don't worry take your time, {{name:hailey}} already made me breakfast, just rest
story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: Non preoccuparti, prenditi il tuo tempo, {{name:hailey}} mi ha già fatto colazione, riposati pure.

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: Thank you to both of you

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.translation: La mia gamba non fa male oggi
E tu, com'è andato il lavoro?

story/DAY6/DAY6_00_EVELYN_MORNING_CHECKI.source: We had more people than expected

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Still stiff when I get up, but I can feel it's getting better
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Ancora rigido quando mi alzo, ma posso sentire che sta migliorando.

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Someone has to keep you in one piece 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: La mia sveglia sembrava malvagia oggi.

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Only because you keep cheering me on
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Solo perché continui a fare il tifo per me

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Now that's the kind of answer I like
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Ora questa è la risposta che mi piace

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Come on, only two more weeks and then you're free
story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Dai, solo due settimane in più e poi sei libero.
Va bene, questo ha aiutato un po' 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Did you sleep better at least?

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Un po' di più di ieri

story/DAY6/DAY6_01_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: How are you feeling this morning?

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: Move faster and I become nicer
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Muoviti più veloce e divento più gentile.
Nessuna promessa da entrambe le parti

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: I actually made it all the way to the bathroom and now I'm stuck here
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: In realtà sono riuscito ad arrivare fino al bagno e ora sono bloccato qui

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: You said two minutes ten minutes ago
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Hai detto due minuti dieci minuti fa.
La cura della bellezza richiede tempo 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.source: And I still need to wash too
Also this is very rude for someone loitering outside a bathroom door 😭
story/DAY6/DAY6_02_PLAYER_TEXT_HAILEY_SH.translation: Anche questo è molto scortese per qualcuno che si trova in attesa davanti a una porta del bagno 😭

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: I get a lot of time for myself
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: Ho molto tempo per me stesso

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: And sorry I can't help much around the house
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: E scusa se non posso aiutare molto in casa.

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: I really need to save money for next year
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: Ho davvero bisogno di risparmiare soldi per il prossimo anno.
Sure! Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: It's good when we talk sometimes
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: È bello quando parliamo a volte

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: Said I should check if you actually ate
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: Ha detto che dovrei controllare se hai davvero mangiato.

story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.source: And if you need anything brought up
story/DAY6/DAY6_03_MASON_EVELYN_CHECK_LE.translation: E se hai bisogno di far emergere qualcosa

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Non iniziare a comportarti da geloso 😌
Ha davvero adottato il tuo tavolo.

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Then I go straight to work

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Mandami un messaggio quando hai finito

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Eat properly and not too many video games
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Mangia correttamente e non troppi videogiochi

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Sorry I can't read very well today
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Mi dispiace, oggi non riesco a leggere molto bene.

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: You're lucky that leg is already hurt
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Sei fortunato che quella gamba è già ferita.

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: See you when class is over ❤️
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Ci vediamo quando la lezione è finita ❤️

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: He really has an effect on girls
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Ha davvero un effetto sulle ragazze.

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: They laugh at everything he says
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: Ridono di tutto ciò che dice.

story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.source: Good thing you already have your man to make you laugh ❤️
story/DAY6/DAY6_04_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN_CHAR.translation: È una buona cosa che tu abbia già il tuo uomo per farti ridere ❤️

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Mission completed 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Missione completata 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Since the meeting me, myself and I had two days ago 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Da quando ho avuto l'incontro con me stesso e io due giorni fa 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: You're doing great in the role 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Stai facendo un ottimo lavoro nel ruolo 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: You're impossible
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Sei impossibile

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Thank you, see you tonight young Padawan 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Grazie, ci vediamo stasera giovane Padawan 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Wait, one more job for my emergency stylist 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Aspetta, un altro incarico per il mio parrucchiere d'emergenza 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: For Saturday's party: loose waves or a high ponytail?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Per la festa di sabato: onde morbide o coda alta?

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Loose waves. You can't go wrong with those
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Onde morbide. Con quelle vai sul sicuro

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: High ponytail. Easier to dance with
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Coda alta. È più comoda per ballare

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Loose waves it is. Soft, cute, and completely innocent 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Allora onde morbide. Dolci, carine e del tutto innocenti 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Thanks for warning {{name:mason}} about the ride 🤍
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Grazie per aver avvisato {{name:mason}} riguardo al passaggio 🤍.

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: High ponytail it is. Practical AND cute. Look at you thinking ahead 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Allora coda alta. Pratica E carina. Guarda come pensi a tutto 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Styling crisis solved. My work here is done
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Crisi di acconciatura risolta. Il mio lavoro qui è finito

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Thanks 🤍 Don't retire yet, I still need to choose the outfit
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Grazie 🤍 Non andare ancora in pensione, devo ancora scegliere il vestito

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: {{mason:He}} did the full dramatic sigh, but {{mason:he}} got the message 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: {{mason:He}} ha fatto un grande sospiro drammatico, ma {{mason:he}} ha capito il messaggio 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Why not thank {{mason:him}} yourself?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Perché non ringrazi {{mason:him}} di persona?

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: I'm too shy 😌
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Sono troppo timido 😌

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Yes of course, shy to thank {{mason:him}} but not shy to ask for a ride
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Sì certo, timida nel ringraziare {{mason:him}}, ma non timida nel chiedere un passaggio

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Touché 😇
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Ha! Giusto 😇

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: But that's your job
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Ma quello è il tuo lavoro

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: House logistics manager, remember?
story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.translation: Manager della logistica della casa, ricordi?

story/DAY6/DAY6_05_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_WAR.source: Since when?

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Please support me in this difficult time
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Per favore, sostienimi in questo momento difficile.

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Too bad I can't move to buy them
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Peccato che non possa muovermi per comprarli.

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: But if you do well in your extra class I'll ask {{name:mason}} to get some for you 😌
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Ma se te la cavi bene nella tua lezione extra, chiederò a {{name:mason}} di prenderne un po' per te 😌

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: I'm on my break and I already want to escape 😭
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Sono in pausa e voglio già scappare 😭

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: I hate you as much as I hate extra classes 😭
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Ti odio tanto quanto odio le lezioni extra 😭

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: I take that as a compliment 😌
I have an extra class tonight with my main teacher because I messed up my exams
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Ho una lezione extra stasera con il mio insegnante principale perché ho rovinato i miei esami.

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Apparently natural charm is not accepted as an academic strategy 😒
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: A quanto pare, il fascino naturale non è accettato come strategia accademica 😒

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Too bad because I'm sure I could convince the teacher to give me good grades 😇
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Peccato perché sono sicuro di poter convincere l'insegnante a darmi buoni voti 😇

story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.source: Or he could make you do extra classes all summer
story/DAY7/DAY7_05_HAILEY_UNI_EXTRA_CLAS.translation: Oppure potrebbe farti fare lezioni extra per tutta l'estate.

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: But I still don't like the vibe around him
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Ma non mi piace ancora l'atmosfera che lo circonda.

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Don't worry, I'm keeping my distance
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Non preoccuparti, sto mantenendo le distanze.

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I wish I had more than ten quiet minutes with you today
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Vorrei avere più di dieci minuti tranquilli con te oggi.
Quanto tempo ci vorrà fino a quando hai finito?

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: I'll text you again when I can ❤️
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Ti scriverò di nuovo quando posso ❤️

story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.source: Just too many people, too much noise, too many things at once
story/DAY7/DAY7_06_LENA_WORK_BREAK.json:.translation: Troppa gente, troppo rumore, troppe cose tutte insieme

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: And you take care of yourself too
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: E anche tu prenditi cura di te stesso.

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: It might be a little tense again
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: Potrebbe essere di nuovo un po' teso.

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: But I will stay focused on my work
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: Ma rimarrò concentrato sul mio lavoro

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: Do not let him get to you
And I know when to step back if needed
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: E so quando fare un passo indietro se necessario

story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.source: Text me if something feels off
story/DAY7/DAY7_07_EVELYN_16H_SUPPORT.js.translation: Mandami un messaggio se qualcosa non va.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: I don't like weird people around you
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Non mi piacciono le persone strane intorno a te.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: Tired, but one more day and it's the weekend
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Stanco, ma un giorno in più e sarà il weekend

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: And better now that I'm talking to you
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: E meglio adesso che parlo con te

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: I'm going to shower and relax a little
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Vado a fare una doccia e a rilassarmi un po'

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: Try not to miss me too much for ten minutes
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Cerca di non sentirmi troppo mancare per dieci minuti

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: So the day went by faster
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: Quindi la giornata è passata più in fretta.

story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..source: That's all I wanted to hear
story/DAY7/DAY7_08_LENA_AFTER_WORK_HOME..translation: È tutto ciò che volevo sentire

story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.source: My extra class is dragging and I need {{mason:him}} to come pick me up after
story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.translation: La mia lezione extra sta trascinando e ho bisogno che {{mason:him}} venga a prendermi dopo

story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.source: You want me to text {{mason:him}} now?
If I do it, {{mason:he}}'ll act like I personally invented traffic 😌
story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.translation: Se lo faccio, {{mason:he}} si comporterà come se avessi inventato io il traffico 😌

story/DAY7/DAY7_09_HAILEY_ASKS_PLAYER_TO.source: Don't let it go to your head 😌

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Why would I show you my ass ??
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Perché dovrei mostrarti il mio culo ??

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: It was my back and arm !
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Era la mia schiena e il mio braccio!
Va bene va bene, è colpa mia.

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: You're not in a rush for just a few days, are you?
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Non hai fretta per solo pochi giorni, vero?

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Any lead on the coach thing?
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Hai qualche informazione sulla questione dell'allenatore?

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Did you find someone legit or not?
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Hai trovato qualcuno di affidabile o no?

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: I need to check a few things first
How am I not gaining muscle when I work out this much? 😒
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Come mai non sto guadagnando muscoli quando mi alleno così tanto? 😒

story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..source: Are you showing your back or your ass ??
story/DAY7/DAY7_10_MASON_COACH_FOLLOWUP..translation: Stai mostrando la schiena o il culo??

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: I might know someone who could help
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Potrei conoscere qualcuno che potrebbe aiutare.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: Just find out if he has something real
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Scopri solo se ha qualcosa di reale.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: He knows trainers and too many people in general
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Lui conosce allenatori e troppe persone in generale.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: He could still point you to someone solid
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Potrebbe comunque indirizzarti verso qualcuno di affidabile.

story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.source: If he keeps it useful and short
story/DAY7/DAY7_11_PLAYER_SUGGESTS_AIDEN.translation: Se lo tiene utile e breve

story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.source: {{mason:He}} looked annoyed, but I think that's just {{mason:his}} face after dark 😇
story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.translation: {{mason:He}} sembrava infastidito, ma penso sia solo la faccia di {{mason:his}} dopo il tramonto 😇

story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.source: Hero only when I do what you ask?
story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.translation: Eroe solo quando faccio ciò che chiedi?

story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.source: So do it more often if you want to rise in my esteem 😇
story/DAY7/DAY7_13_HAILEY_PICKUP_FOLLOWU.translation: Quindi fallo più spesso se vuoi guadagnare la mia stima 😇

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: How is the house chaos level tonight?
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Qual è il livello di caos in casa stasera?

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Do you really need to ask?
Also I still owe you a clean win in co-op
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Inoltre ti devo ancora una vittoria pulita in cooperativa.

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: You mean I carry you again?
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Vuoi dire che ti porto di nuovo?

story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Keep talking and I mute your mic
story/DAY7/DAY7_14_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Continua a parlare e ti silenzio il microfono.
Mandami un messaggio quando sei pronto

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Tomorrow is the last push before the weekend
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Domani è l'ultimo sforzo prima del weekend

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Do you have anything planned this weekend?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Hai qualcosa in programma per questo fine settimana?
Tranne dormire per 24 ore di fila

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: You mean drooling on your pillow?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Vuoi dire sbavare sul tuo cuscino?

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I'm really going to break your other leg, by accident of course
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sto per rompere anche la tua altra gamba, per sbaglio ovviamente.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Yeah, I was waiting for you
I'm showing this text to my lawyer, madame
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Sto mostrando questo testo al mio avvocato, madame

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I'll just kill you with kisses instead
You do have some guts, I'll give you that
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Hai davvero del coraggio, te lo concedo.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Now sleep before I change my mind and come annoy you some more
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Ora dormi prima che cambi idea e venga a darti fastidio ancora.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Can I at least get a goodnight pic?
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Posso almeno avere una foto della buonanotte?

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: Only because you waited for me
Wow, harder and harder to fall asleep now
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Wow, sempre più difficile addormentarsi adesso

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I didn't want to end the day without hearing from you
story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Non volevo finire la giornata senza avere tue notizie.

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.source: I thought you said I talk too much

story/DAY7/DAY7_16_LENA_NIGHT.json::step.translation: Oh sì, è stato un mio errore

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: That's the only thing keeping me alive 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: È l'unica cosa che mi tiene in vita 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Pretty good, I'm feeling better and better
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Abbastanza bene, mi sento sempre meglio.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: Text me if you need me
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Mandami un messaggio se hai bisogno di me

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: My body already knows it's the end of the week
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Il mio corpo sa già che è la fine della settimana.

story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.source: I'll text you when I can
Did you sleep okay at least?
But not enough to make me a morning person
story/DAY8/DAY8_00_LENA_MORNING.json::st.translation: Ma non abbastanza da farmi diventare una persona mattiniera.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We need to find a solution
Then tell me what you want me to do
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Allora dimmi cosa vuoi che faccia
Perché abbiamo ancora bisogno di soldi

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a stable route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Scelta di impegno rilevata, la tua risposta bloccherà permanentemente {{name:evelyn}} in un percorso stabile.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a shared tension route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Scelta di impegno rilevata, la tua risposta bloccherà permanentemente {{name:evelyn}} in un percorso di tensione condiviso.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Commitment choice detected, your answer will permanently lock {{name:evelyn}} into a high risk route
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Scelta di impegno rilevata, la tua risposta bloccherà permanentemente {{name:evelyn}} in un percorso ad alto rischio.
Continua a lavorare lì per ora

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: We find a safer plan together
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Troviamo insieme un piano più sicuro.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will find a job, something I can do from home
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Troverò un lavoro, qualcosa che posso fare da casa.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: You should not do that alone
You do not need to suffer there
If I bribe him a little he should find me something quickly
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Se lo corrompo un po', dovrebbe trovarmi qualcosa in fretta.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I did not answer because it was too late
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Non ho risposto perché era troppo tardi.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I will take care of you even more
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Ma mi prenderò cura di te ancora di più.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Give me one or two days and I will find something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Dammi uno o due giorni e troverò qualcosa.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: In the meantime, just say you are sick
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Nel frattempo, dì solo che sei malato.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I do not want you to carry everything
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Non voglio che tu porti tutto.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: My manager is making it difficult for me
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Il mio manager mi sta rendendo le cose difficili.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: A few days will not kill us
We are not that poor yet
I still have the money I saved for the trip
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Ho ancora i soldi che ho risparmiato per il viaggio.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I will use it if we need to
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Lo userò se ne avremo bisogno.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I do not think we will
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Ma non penso che lo faremo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I just need the right opportunity
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Ho solo bisogno della giusta opportunità

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: Then I will not go back tonight
But tell me quickly when you find something for me
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Ma dimmi in fretta quando trovi qualcosa per me

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: I just have to bear with him
I know it is not the best
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: So che non è il migliore

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I cannot help you yet
As soon as I can walk again I will work
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Non appena potrò camminare di nuovo, lavorerò.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: And you will be able to leave
I am sorry you have to endure him
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mi dispiace che tu debba sopportarlo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: If he gets too annoying just kick him in the balls
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Se diventa troppo fastidioso, dagli un calcio nei coglioni.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: He watches me like I owe him something
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Mi guarda come se gli dovessi qualcosa.

story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.source: But I also hate feeling like a burden to you
story/DAY8/DAY8_01_EVELYN_MORNING_ROUTE_.translation: Ma odio anche sentirmi un peso per te.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: If I find a few options, you might be forced to give your opinion later 🤍
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Se trovo alcune opzioni, potresti essere costretto a dare la tua opinione più tardi 🤍

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Too bad it wasn't a question 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Peccato che non fosse una domanda 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Better than yesterday and the day before
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Meglio di ieri e dell'altro ieri

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: Finally my room is going to get cleaned 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Finalmente la mia stanza verrà pulita 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: You're so sweet in the morning
I might go shopping this afternoon
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Potrei andare a fare shopping questo pomeriggio.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: I need to find an evening outfit for Saturday night
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Devo trovare un outfit per la sera di sabato.

story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.source: So this is a fashion emergency?
story/DAY8/DAY8_02_HAILEY_THANKS_FOR_PIC.translation: Quindi questa è un'emergenza di moda?

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: But still, how dare he try to steal my job and brag about it
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Ma comunque, come si permette di cercare di rubare il mio lavoro e vantarsene?

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I'm going to break his leg too
I get it but that's not a good idea
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Capisco, ma non è una buona idea.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: He'd make you nurse him too
He won't even know how close to death he was
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Non saprà nemmeno quanto fosse vicino alla morte.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I have to go back now
I'm going straight to work after this
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Vado dritto al lavoro dopo questo

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: I guess he feels lonely without you
story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.translation: Immagino che si senta solo senza di te.

story/DAY8/DAY8_03_LENA_LUNCH_AIDEN.json.source: So now I have to put up with him instead
He's telling everyone he's your nurse now

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I think I still need distance from all of that
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Penso che abbia ancora bisogno di distanza da tutto ciò.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Is it because of the accident?
But also just in my head, I guess
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Ma anche solo nella mia testa, suppongo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: We'll go at your pace then
I just keep thinking about working there after I graduate
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Continuo a pensare di lavorare lì dopo la laurea.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I don't want to ruin that
You protecting yourself is not ruining anything

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Hai il diritto di avere dei limiti

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I really needed you to say that
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Avevo davvero bisogno che lo dicessi.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Even if I have homework, I'm going to monopolize you tomorrow 😌
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Anche se ho dei compiti, domani ti monopolizzerò 😌

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Be prepared, you won't be playing any video games
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Preparati, non giocherai a nessun videogioco.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: What can I do for you so I can play a little?
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Cosa posso fare per te così posso giocare un po'?

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Of course on your beautiful lips
Since we're talking about it, I wanted to ask you something...
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Dato che ne stiamo parlando, volevo chiederti qualcosa...

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: You know it's been a while since we... you know 😳
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Sai, è passato un po' di tempo da quando... sai 😳

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: And before your accident we only did it twice
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: E prima del tuo incidente lo abbiamo fatto solo due volte.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Even if we talked about it last time...
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Anche se ne abbiamo parlato l'ultima volta...

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Sometimes I wonder if I'm too tense
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: A volte mi chiedo se sono troppo teso.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: You're beautiful and you drive me crazy
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Sei bellissima e mi fai impazzire

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Then why do you hold back sometimes?
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Allora perché a volte ti trattieni?

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Sometimes it kind of feels like you don't enjoy it
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: A volte sembra quasi che tu non lo stia godendo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: And because it's you, I don't want to mess up, so I hold back
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: E poiché sei tu, non voglio combinare guai, quindi mi trattengo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: What do you actually want when it's just us?
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Cosa vuoi davvero quando siamo solo noi?

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Emotional openness detected. Reassurance and mutual discovery strengthen trust and intimacy
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Rilevata apertura emotiva. La rassicurazione e la scoperta reciproca rafforzano la fiducia e l'intimità.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Ambiguity window detected. Revealing unusual desire may open a different kind of bond
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Finestra di ambiguità rilevata. Rivelare un desiderio insolito potrebbe aprire un tipo diverso di legame.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Less messy in my head at least
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Meno confuso nella mia testa almeno

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Withdrawal signal detected. Pulling back now may create lasting emotional distance
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Segnale di ritiro rilevato. Ritirarsi ora potrebbe creare una distanza emotiva duratura.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I want to understand what you like and what makes you feel good
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Voglio capire cosa ti piace e cosa ti fa sentire bene.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I think some situations turn me on more than they should
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Penso che alcune situazioni mi eccitino più di quanto dovrebbero.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I still don't feel comfortable doing it again right now
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Non mi sento ancora a mio agio nel farlo di nuovo in questo momento.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I want to understand what you like and what makes you feel safe
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Voglio capire cosa ti piace e cosa ti fa sentire al sicuro.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I don't want to rush you
I think I need time too
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Penso che abbia bisogno di tempo anche io.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: And to feel like we're really together in it
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: E per sentirci davvero insieme in questo

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Then we'll take all the time you need
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Allora prenderemo tutto il tempo di cui hai bisogno.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Next time we see each other, we'll go at our own pace
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: La prossima volta che ci vediamo, andremo al nostro ritmo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: It's hard to explain without sounding strange
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: È difficile spiegare senza sembrare strano.
A volte non sei solo tu

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: It's the situation around you that gets in my head
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: È la situazione intorno a te che mi entra in testa

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Do you promise you won't judge?
Do you even have to ask?

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Non ha fatto nulla di enorme.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: Lately I've had thoughts about you sleeping with someone else
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Ultimamente ho pensato a te che dormi con qualcun altro.
Please provide the game dialogue you would like me to translate into Italian.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: That was not on my bingo card
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Non era sulla mia scheda bingo.

story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..source: I... don't know what to say
But he kept hovering around me all day
story/DAY8/DAY8_14_LENA_ROUTE_LOCK_TALK..translation: Ma continuava a gironzolare intorno a me tutto il giorno.

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Text me tonight if you're free
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Mandami un messaggio stasera se sei libero

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: I heard your starting to walk way more
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Ho sentito che hai iniziato a camminare molto di più.
La tua gamba è finalmente guarita?

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Not completely but I am getting there
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Non completamente, ma ci sto arrivando.

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Soon i will be able to kick your ass
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Presto sarò in grado di prenderti a calci nel sedere.

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: Maybe i should break your arms now just to be safe
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Forse dovrei spezzarti le braccia adesso giusto per essere al sicuro

story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.source: You can't do that to a gamer
story/DAY9/DAY9_00_AIDEN_CHECKIN.json::s.translation: Non puoi fare questo a un gamer

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.source: I'll make sure you actually do the exercises too
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.translation: Farò in modo che tu faccia davvero gli esercizi
Pronta per la nostra prima sessione?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.source: Your leg decides the pace, not your ego
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.translation: Il tuo piede decide il ritmo, non il tuo ego

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.source: Someone has to stop you from doing something stupid
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.translation: Qualcuno deve fermarti dal fare qualcosa di stupido

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.source: Pretty sure I'm supposed to be the coach here 😏
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_LO.translation: Sono abbastanza sicura che dovrei essere io l'allenatrice qui 😏

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: Do you wear a cape when nobody is looking? 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: Indossi un mantello quando nessuno ti guarda? 😌
Hai bisogno di aiuto o di flirtare?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: (I know you cannot run but like emotionally)
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: (So che non puoi scappare, ma emotivamente)

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: Your outfit choice is still under investigation
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: La tua scelta di outfit è ancora sotto indagine

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: If I look cute, you get credit
If I look TOO cute, you get blamed 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: Se sembro TROPPO carina, hai colpe 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.source: I looked at the assignment again
Send it later and I will help
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_L.translation: Mandala più tardi e ti aiuterò

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: Honestly, it will keep me busy
And I am happy if it means you can finally rest a little
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: E sono felice se significa che finalmente puoi riposarti un po'.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: Just keep me updated when you hear more about the work
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: Tienimi aggiornato quando sai di più sul lavoro

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: I wanted to thank you again

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: Per avermi aiutato in questo modo

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: And for offering to handle the financial side for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: E per offrirti di gestire il lato finanziario per un po'

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.source: But I still do not feel right letting you manage that while you are injured
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_L.translation: Ma non mi sembra giusto lasciarti gestire tutto mentre sei infortunato

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: And... thank you for last night
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: E... grazie per la scorsa notte

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I was scared of saying it wrong

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Questo per me conta di più
Tu sei più importante per me

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: You're not making it easy for me to stay serious 😭
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Non mi stai rendendo facile rimanere serio 😭

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I feel better after talking like that
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Mi sento meglio dopo aver parlato in questo modo.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I don't need everything to be perfect right away
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Non ho bisogno che tutto sia perfetto subito.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: I just want us to keep being like this
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Voglio solo che continuiamo a essere così.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: Because I really like where this is going with us
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Perché mi piace davvero dove sta andando tra di noi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: You being careful with me is not a bad thing
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Essere attento con me non è una cosa negativa.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: It actually makes me feel loved
Now I need five more minutes in bed after that
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Ora ho bisogno di altri cinque minuti a letto dopo questo.
Avevo davvero bisogno di quel sonno

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: But I should clean a little and work from home for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Ma dovrei pulire un po' e lavorare da casa per un po'.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.source: Still soft and sleepy but better
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNIN.translation: Ancora morbido e assonnato ma meglio

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: {{name:hailey}} is showing you the question on her computer
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: {{name:hailey}} ti sta mostrando la domanda sul suo computer

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: The teacher said compare the two examples
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: L'insegnante ha detto di confrontare i due esempi
Il mio cervello ha detto no grazie 💅

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: Start with what changes between them
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Inizia con cosa cambia tra di loro

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: Okay I wrote the first answer
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Ok, ho scritto la prima risposta

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: You focused and you did it well
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Sei stato concentrato e l'hai fatto bene

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.source: You need to do better than that 😤
I have to get ready before the party eats my evening 😇
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON.translation: Devo prepararmi prima che la festa mi rubi la serata 😇
Un foglio di lavoro per un complimento

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questo... è effettivamente un buon punto

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Unless you somehow manage to lose a dumbbell overnight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: A meno che tu non riesca a perdere un manubrio durante la notte

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm talented, but not that talented
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono talentuosa, ma non così tanto

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm still keeping an eye on you
I'm mostly waiting for my shift to end
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Aspetto principalmente che il mio turno finisca

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: So I started looking for games instead
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Così ho iniziato a cercare giochi invece

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: I was thinking about this morning
Looks like the kind of game that tests the player's teamwork 😅
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembra il tipo di gioco che mette alla prova il lavoro di squadra 😅

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't expect me to carry you
Confident for someone who almost got defeated by a yoga mat this morning 😂
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei sicuro di te per qualcuno che quasi è stato sconfitto da un tappetino da yoga stamattina 😂

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: We spent more time getting everything ready than actually exercising
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Abbiamo passato più tempo a prepararci che ad allenarci

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: By the time we finally started, we were almost done
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quando finalmente abbiamo iniziato, eravamo quasi a posto

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.source: Everything is already in place for tomorrow
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_05_MASON_AFTERNOON_.translation: Tutto è già pronto per domani

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Hey
I would not need to move from the house
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Non avrei bisogno di muovermi da casa

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Just me, my PC, and some work I can handle from here
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Solo io, il mio PC e un po' di lavoro che posso gestire da qui

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: That would be wonderful
Really wonderful
Do you need anything else from me?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Hai bisogno di qualcos'altro da me?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: No
I think I have everything I need
