story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Penso di avere tutto ciò di cui ho bisogno

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: What about you?
Do you need anything?
I already have more than enough good things for me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ho già più che abbastanza cose belle per me

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I was trying not to ask too soon
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Stavo cercando di non chiedere troppo presto

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: That sounds suspiciously sweet
It was supposed to be
You taking care of me like this is already a lot
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Prenderti cura di me in questo modo è già tanto

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Careful
If you keep saying things like that, I might start feeling useful
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Se continui a dire cose del genere, potrei iniziare a sentirmi utile

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: Then maybe I should keep saying them
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Allora forse dovrei continuare a dirle

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You deserve to feel useful too
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Meriti di sentirti utile anche tu

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'll remember that
Good
Just keep me updated tonight
But do you have any news about that work you mentioned?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ma hai qualche notizia su quel lavoro di cui parlavi?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I'm curious about this mysterious job now
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ora sono curioso riguardo a questo lavoro misterioso

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: You'll be the first to know
I'll hold you to that 😌
Almost
I checked most of it already
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Ho già controllato la maggior parte

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: I just want to verify a few more things before I promise anything
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Voglio solo verificare alcune cose prima di promettere qualcosa

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: So it is serious?
Yeah
If everything is clean, I will tell you properly tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Se tutto è a posto, te lo dirò per bene stasera

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.source: It should be something pretty cool for me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_06_EVELYN_AFTERNOON.translation: Dovrebbe essere qualcosa di abbastanza figo per me

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Do you have two minutes?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Hai due minuti?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I'll be doing moderation for a website and live channel
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Farò moderazione per un sito web e un canale live

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: The pay is pretty good
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: La paga è piuttosto buona

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And everything can be done from my PC
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: E tutto può essere fatto dal mio PC

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: That already sounds much better than having to leave the house
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Già suona molto meglio che dover uscire di casa

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: The only downside is the schedule
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: L'unico lato negativo è il programma

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: How so?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Come mai?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: There aren't really any fixed hours
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Non ci sono davvero orari fissi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: When they need me, I have to be available immediately
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Quando hanno bisogno di me, devo essere disponibile immediatamente

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And once a moderation session starts, I can't leave my PC until it's finished
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: E una volta che inizia una sessione di moderazione, non posso lasciare il PC fino a quando non è finita

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Not for food
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Nemmeno per mangiare

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Just finishing drying my hair 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Sto solo finendo di asciugarmi i capelli 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Barely for the bathroom
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: A malapena per il bagno

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: That does sound a little rough
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Questo suona un po' difficile

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: But I understand it too
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Ma lo capisco anche

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: If they need urgent moderation, they probably need someone there immediately
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Se hanno bisogno di moderazione urgente, probabilmente hanno bisogno di qualcuno lì immediatamente

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Will that be okay for you?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene per te?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I think so
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Penso di sì

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: It's not perfect, but it's something I can actually do from home
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Non è perfetto, ma è qualcosa che posso davvero fare da casa

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Then that's what matters
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Allora questo è ciò che conta

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: And now that I'm not working anymore, I'll have plenty of time
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: E ora che non lavoro più, avrò un sacco di tempo

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: So don't worry about the rest
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Quindi non preoccuparti per il resto

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I'll make sure you always have food, water and everything you need nearby
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Farò in modo che tu abbia sempre cibo, acqua e tutto ciò di cui hai bisogno a portata di mano

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: You can focus on your work without worrying about anything else
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Puoi concentrarti sul tuo lavoro senza preoccuparti di nient'altro

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: You're going to spoil me
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Mi vizierai

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: After everything you've done for me lately?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Dopo tutto quello che hai fatto per me ultimamente?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I think it's only fair 😌
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Penso sia giusto 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Thanks, {{name:evelyn}}
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Grazie, {{name:evelyn}}

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Anytime
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Sempre

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: DAY 10
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: GIORNO 10

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Give me five minutes and I'll be there
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Dammi cinque minuti e sarò lì

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: 5 MINUTES LATER
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: 5 MINUTI DOPO

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Alright, I'm available now
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Va bene, sono disponibile ora

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: What's up?
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Cosa c'è?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: It was about the work I mentioned earlier
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Riguardava il lavoro di cui ti ho parlato prima

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: I wanted to explain what it actually is
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Volevo spiegarti di cosa si tratta realmente

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.source: Yes finally, I was curious about it
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_07_EVELYN_EVENING_L.translation: Sì finalmente, ero curiosa di saperlo

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: Honestly, I hope I can get the cast off soon
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Onestamente, spero di poter togliere il gesso presto

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: But don't get stupid with it
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Ma non fare stupidaggini con esso

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: That's exactly what someone stupid would say
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: È esattamente quello che direbbe qualcuno stupido

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: Don't go to bed too late
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Non andare a letto troppo tardi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: The game won't be ready tonight
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Il gioco non sarà pronto stasera

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.source: It's downloading like it has somewhere better to be
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_08_MASON_EVENING_LO.translation: Si sta scaricando come se avesse posti migliori dove andare
Sei ancora a posto dopo questa mattina?

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not start pacing like an old man
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Non iniziare a camminare avanti e indietro come un vecchio
Mi sono ricordata della cosa da studiare

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Start with what changes, then why it matters
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Inizia con cosa cambia, poi perché è importante
Versione ufficiale della festa in arrivo
In realtà è stato davvero bello

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: And you did a good job picking the outfit
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: E hai fatto un ottimo lavoro a scegliere l'outfit

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Do not make it a thing
Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.translation: Carina e al sicuro, esattamente come hai ordinato

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_09_HAILEY_EVENING_L.source: Tell me how cute i am 😌

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I was scared of how things would feel between us
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Avevo paura di come ci saremmo sentiti tra di noi

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: But I think we handled it well
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Ma penso che l'abbiamo gestita bene.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And I kept thinking about what you said this morning
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: E continuavo a pensare a quello che hai detto stamattina.
Riguardo a noi che siamo onesti

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Also I changed into one of your shirts
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Inoltre, mi sono cambiato in una delle tue magliette.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: That feels illegal when I'm not there
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Sembra illegale quando non ci sono.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: Are you flirting with me, lady?
What a lucky man I am
And I'm a really lucky girl to have you ❤️
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: E sono una ragazza davvero fortunata ad averti ❤️

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: I'm going to wash my face and get in bed before I start missing you too loudly
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: Vado a lavarmi il viso e a mettermi a letto prima di iniziare a sentirti mancare troppo forte.

story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.source: And lay down staring at the ceiling for a while
story/DAY9/love/DAY9_10_LENA_EVENING_LOV.translation: E sdraiati a fissare il soffitto per un po'

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: Just letting you know I handled it myself
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Solo per farti sapere che me ne sono occupato io.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: I'm going back to that gym on my own terms
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Torno in quella palestra a modo mio.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: If they start bothering me again, we can settle it outside 😒
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Se iniziano a darmi fastidio di nuovo, possiamo risolverlo fuori 😒

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: But you could also ask to have them kicked out of the gym
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Ma potresti anche chiedere di farli cacciare dalla palestra.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.source: One of them owns the place
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTR.translation: Uno di loro possiede il posto

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: He said I can stay after class and he will go through the assignment with me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ha detto che posso restare dopo le lezioni e che passerà il compito con me
Come una vera studentessa in emergenza 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That is probably the fastest way to make you learn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Probabilmente è il modo più veloce per farti imparare
Sembrava calmo riguardo a tutto questo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Like I am not doomed, just badly organized
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Come se non fossi spacciata, solo mal organizzata

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your outfit choice is still under investigation
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: La tua scelta di outfit è ancora sotto indagine
Anche con la modalità salvataggio del professore?
Soprattutto con la modalità salvataggio del professore

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If I have to suffer academically, I deserve to look amazing later
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Se devo soffrire accademicamente, merito di apparire fantastica dopo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I will update you after his help session 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti aggiornerò dopo la sua sessione di aiuto 😇

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Send it later and I will look
But school already answered about the private lessons
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma la scuola ha già risposto riguardo le lezioni private

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: They want me with my main professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Vogliono che io sia con il mio professore principale

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Mattina

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: New outfits or something like that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Nuovi outfit o qualcosa del genere

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I feel like it will be somthing stupid and i don't want to change outfit anyway
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sento che sarà qualcosa di stupido e non voglio cambiare outfit comunque.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What should I do if he pushes that on me?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Cosa dovrei fare se me lo spinge addosso?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Your reply here can have effect in the near future
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: La tua risposta qui può avere effetti nel prossimo futuro

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Wait to see the outfits, then talk to him if you do not like them
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Aspetta di vedere gli outfit, poi parlargli se non ti piacciono.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Trust him, even if he is annoying he does run the bar well right?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Fidati di lui, anche se è fastidioso gestisce bene il bar, giusto?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If it is not okay, tell him calmly and set a boundary
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Se non va bene, diglielo con calma e stabilisci un confine.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: So I do not refuse before I even know what it is
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Quindi non rifiuto prima di sapere di cosa si tratta.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Exactly
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Esattamente

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, so how did it go at the bar last night?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Buongiorno, com'è andata al bar ieri sera?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You're right maybe im making a big fuse for nothing
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai ragione, forse sto facendo un grande casino per niente.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Try to trust him on the work side
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Cerca di fidarti di lui sul lavoro.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: He is annoying, but the bar is still running, so he is doing something right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: È fastidioso, ma il bar è ancora aperto, quindi sta facendo qualcosa di giusto.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You really think so?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo pensi davvero?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Just stay calm and do not assume the worst too early
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Rimani calmo e non presumere il peggio troppo presto.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will try to give him the benefit of the doubt
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Cercherò di dargli il beneficio del dubbio.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It was okay
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: È andato bene

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Either way, don't worry about him that much, just work normally
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: In ogni caso, non preoccuparti troppo per lui, lavora normalmente

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Have a good time with your colleagues too
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Divertiti anche con i tuoi colleghi

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And text me the moment something feels wrong
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E scrivimi non appena qualcosa non va

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Lo farò

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for being in my corner
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Grazie per essere dalla mia parte

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It's normal don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: È normale, non preoccuparti.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I kept my head down and did my work
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ho tenuto la testa bassa e ho fatto il mio lavoro.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But the manager watched everything like a hawk, quit annoying
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma il manager osservava tutto come un falco, smettila di infastidire.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is going to be fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Andrà tutto bene

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You just have to endure him for a bit and he will leave you alone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Devi solo sopportarlo un po' e ti lascerà in pace.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes you're right
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, hai ragione.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: At least I enjoy working with my colleagues
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Almeno mi piace lavorare con i miei colleghi

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Oh also, that bastard said he might bring new dress code rules soon
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Oh, inoltre, quel bastardo ha detto che potrebbe portare presto nuove regole sul codice di abbigliamento.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: But I guess I needed the truth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ma immagino di aver bisogno della verità

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That doesn't mean it felt good
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Questo non significa che sia stato piacevole.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Knowing that you don't want me
It's not that I don't want you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Non è che non ti voglia

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It's just that right now I'm not ready for that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: È solo che in questo momento non sono pronto per questo.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just need a little time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ho solo bisogno di un po' di tempo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I really didn't want to hurt you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Non volevo davvero farti del male.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a bit and work from home for a while
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Vado a pulire un po' e lavorerò da casa per un po'.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I need to keep my mind busy
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Devo tenere la mia mente occupata
Avevo davvero bisogno di quel sonno

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest last night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: E... grazie per essere stato onesto ieri sera
Non è stato facile da sentire

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: La tua servetta personale è qui!

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your room finally lost the fight
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: La tua stanza ha finalmente perso la battaglia
La mia stanza non è disordinata

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Finally ! I always had hope in you
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Finalmente! Ho sempre avuto fiducia in te

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You look like you are supervising more than cleaning
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sembri più un supervisore che un pulitore

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Hurry up and clean your room
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sbrigati a pulire la tua stanza

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Say that again and I am putting you in the donation bag
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dillo di nuovo e ti metto nella borsa delle donazioni

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} found a box under my bed and gave me the mother look
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} ha trovato una scatola sotto il mio letto e mi ha lanciato uno sguardo da madre

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: My lawyer said I should stay silent
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Il mio avvocato ha detto che dovrei rimanere in silenzio

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Now I need to go before she finds more evidence 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ora devo andare prima che trovi altre prove 😭

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: {{name:evelyn}} decided today is apparently war against dust
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: {{name:evelyn}} ha deciso che oggi è guerra contro la polvere

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: We are doing a huge cleaning session
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Stiamo facendo una grande sessione di pulizia

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Come va la tua gamba oggi?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Per lo più non è un termine medico.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Especially when you act like you're fine
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Soprattutto quando fai finta di stare bene

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Non ti fidi di me affatto

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Non mi fido semplicemente dei tuoi istinti di sopravvivenza.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Just take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Prendila con calma finché non ho finito.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Okay, my break is almost over
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Va bene, la mia pausa è quasi finita

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Devo andare a fare di nuovo qualcosa di utile.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Ti scriverò dopo il mio turno 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time feel slow
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Non è terribile, giusto abbastanza da far sembrare il tempo lento.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Sto praticamente vivendo il mio sogno in questo momento.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_05_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Then you'd probably break the other one too 😒
I'm about to leave for the gym
The sooner I go, the sooner it's over
I'm still sorry I can't really help
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Mi dispiace ancora di non poter davvero aiutare

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Just tell me if anything happens
You'll run over there on one leg?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Good news, I don't work tonight or tomorrow night
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Buone notizie, non lavoro stasera né domani sera

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Just focus on getting better, that's the most important thing right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Concentrati solo sul guarire, è la cosa più importante in questo momento

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Thank you for everything you do
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Grazie per tutto quello che fai

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm sorry for being such a burden right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi dispiace essere un peso in questo momento

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Don't say that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non dire così

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You are not a burden
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sei un peso

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And none of this is your fault
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: E niente di tutto questo è colpa tua

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You just need time to recover, that's all
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai solo bisogno di tempo per riprenderti, tutto qui

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: After dinner tonight, we can spend some time together if you want 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dopo cena stasera, possiamo passare un po' di tempo insieme se vuoi 😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'd love that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi piacerebbe

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then we'll do that
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora lo faremo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: So I'll finally have some free time
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Quindi finalmente avrò un po' di tempo libero

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I think I'm going to use it to clean the house and do some laundry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Penso che ne approfitterò per pulire casa e fare un po' di bucato

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Do you have anything that needs washing too?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Hai qualcosa che deve essere lavato anche tu?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yeah, I have a few things
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, ho un paio di cose

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But are you sure you don't need help?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma sei sicura di non aver bisogno di aiuto?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: No, don't worry
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: No, non preoccuparti

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to rest until you're fully healed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Devi riposarti finché non sei completamente guarita

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: You're sure ?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sei sicura?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Yes, I know you want to help but I can handle this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_07_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sì, so che vuoi aiutare, ma posso gestirla io

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I might be a little late
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Potrei arrivare un po' in ritardo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Thank you for setting everything up
Take your time, i'm not starting without you 😊
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Prenditi il tuo tempo, non inizio senza di te 😊

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: {{name:mason}} is using the bathroom right now
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: {{name:mason}} sta usando il bagno in questo momento

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I can't even brush my teeth yet
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Non riesco nemmeno a lavarmi i denti ancora

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll come downstairs in about fifteen minutes
I prepared the movie and the popcorn
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho preparato il film e i popcorn

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Now i'm only missing you and {{name:mason}}
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_08_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ora mi manca solo tu e {{name:mason}}

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Alcune persone non vivono da sole
Questo dovrebbe rispondere alla tua domanda

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: Are you almost done in the bathroom?
And yet you keep talking to me
I'll come out when I'm done
Because you've been in there forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Perché sei lì dentro da un'eternità

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.source: I need to brush my teeth too
You don't need forty minutes to brush your teeth
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_09_MASON_EVENING_NTR.translation: Non ti servono quaranta minuti per lavarti i denti

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Also yes I did the worksheet before leaving
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Sì, ho fatto il foglio prima di partire

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Professor would probably materialize from the shadows if I skipped it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Il professore probabilmente materializzerebbe dalle ombre se lo saltassi

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But the party is actually at the principal's son's place 😭
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma la festa è in realtà a casa del figlio del preside 😭
Versione ufficiale della festa in arrivo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I just crossed paths with him
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho appena incrociato il suo cammino

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He only gave me a little wave
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi ha solo fatto un piccolo cenno

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: But now I feel weirdly shy because of the outfit
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ma ora mi sento stranamente timida a causa dell'outfit

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Because I did not plan to be seen by him dressed like this
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Perché non avevo pianificato di farmi vedere da lui vestita così

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Stop looking smug through the phone
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Smettila di sembrare così compiaciuto attraverso il telefono

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He said I look more mature than usual and now I am blaming both of you 😇
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ha detto che sembro più matura del solito e ora do la colpa a entrambi voi 😇
Il tuo gusto è ancora pericoloso

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: My professor said it was nice too, which was weirdly stressful 💅
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Anche il mio professore ha detto che era carino, il che è stato stranamente stressante 💅

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Cute and safe, exactly like you ordered
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Carina e al sicuro, esattamente come hai ordinato

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Please say I look like a responsible student who definitely revises 😌
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Per favore, dì che sembro una studentessa responsabile che sicuramente studia 😌

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: The party was actually really fun
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: La festa è stata davvero divertente

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I saw a bunch of people I had not seen in forever
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho visto un sacco di persone che non vedevo da un sacco di tempo

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So now my social battery is fully dead
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ora la mia batteria sociale è completamente scarica

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked a little with my professor
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho parlato un po' con il mio professore

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He asked if I was enjoying the party and said the outfit suited me
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Mi ha chiesto se mi stavo divertendo alla festa e ha detto che l'outfit mi stava bene
Il che è stato leggermente stressante in realtà

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was not expecting to run into him there
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_10_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Non mi aspettavo di incontrarlo lì

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
It makes it a little more worth it
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Lo rende un po' più conveniente.

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Posso vederti prima che tu vada a letto?

story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/ntr/DAY9_11_LENA_NIGHT_NTR.js.translation: Vado a fare una doccia e poi a letto.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Come play with me so i can kick your ass
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Vieni a giocare con me così posso prenderti a calci.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: So who is it and when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Quindi chi è e quando inizio?
Probabilmente avrai bisogno di un po' di attrezzatura.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Your coach should text me during the day if everything is good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Il tuo allenatore dovrebbe mandarmi un messaggio durante il giorno se va tutto bene.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Why won't you say his name?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: Perché non dici il suo nome?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.source: Or is it because you have no one? 😒
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_00_MASON_MORNING_NTS.translation: O è perché non hai nessuno? 😒

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds way too dramatic for homework help 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Suona troppo drammatico per un aiuto con i compiti 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: If this saves my grades and keeps me out of school humiliation then I owe you one 😇
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Se questo salva i miei voti e mi tiene lontana dall'umiliazione a scuola, allora ti devo una 😇

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: So your {{name:tutor}} plan is becoming a real thing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Quindi il tuo piano con il {{name:tutor}} sta diventando reale

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I still can't believe I actually need help that badly 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Non riesco ancora a credere che ho davvero bisogno di aiuto così tanto 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: But having someone at home or online already sounds way less awful than staying after class with teachers
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma avere qualcuno a casa o online sembra già molto meno terribile che restare dopo le lezioni con i prof

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I do have good ideas sometimes
Sometimes is doing a lot of work there 😌
Did you actually find someone serious or are you just improvising with confidence again?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Hai davvero trovato qualcuno di serio o stai improvvisando con sicurezza di nuovo?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Te l'avevo detto che me ne sarei occupata

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.source: Your future is safe with me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_01_HAILEY_MORNING_NT.translation: Il tuo futuro è al sicuro con me

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hey, are you awake?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ehi, sei sveglia?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I want to help
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Voglio aiutare

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You are not useless, you are the one keeping everything running here
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Non sei inutile, sei tu a tenere tutto in piedi qui

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Also I am looking for something we can do together
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Inoltre sto cercando qualcosa che possiamo fare insieme

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I might have a lead
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Potrei avere una pista

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I want to verify it before I commit you to anything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma voglio verificarla prima di impegnarti in qualcosa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: What kind of work?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Che tipo di lavoro?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Is it safe?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: È sicuro?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And is it legal?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E è legale?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, certo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is mostly scheduling and meeting people in public
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Si tratta principalmente di organizzare appuntamenti e incontrare persone in pubblico

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Morning, yeah I woke up a few minutes ago
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Buongiorno, sì, mi sono svegliato da pochi minuti

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No bar
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Niente bar

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No late nights forced by a manager
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Niente notti tardive imposte da un manager

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Meeting people?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Incontrare persone?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For what?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Per cosa?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Passive Insight says how you frame your next response can change her reaction
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Passive Insight dice che come formuli la tua prossima risposta può cambiare la sua reazione

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is like being a friend for a day, they pay for your time and company
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: È come essere un amico per un giorno, ti pagano per il tuo tempo e la tua compagnia

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is basically paid dates, but with strict rules and public places only
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono praticamente appuntamenti pagati, ma con regole rigorose e solo in luoghi pubblici

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That sounds strange
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sembra strano

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: People pay just to talk?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: La gente paga solo per parlare?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Some people feel really lonely
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Alcune persone si sentono davvero sole

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: How are you feeling today?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Come ti senti oggi?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: They want company without pressure
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Vogliono compagnia senza pressione

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you are good at making people feel safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E tu sei brava a far sentire le persone al sicuro

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone you like
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E chissà, magari troverai qualcuno che ti piace

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti sei presa cura di noi per molto tempo, è ora che tu viva la tua vita

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono troppo grande per questo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful and still young, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: No, non lo sei, sei bellissima e ancora giovane, dai una possibilità a te stessa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Hmm..I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Hmm..vedrò

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Paid dates?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Appuntamenti pagati?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Meglio

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: That is not really my world
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Non è davvero il mio mondo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It does not mean you owe anything to anyone, it is more like acting for a day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Non significa che devi nulla a nessuno, è più come recitare per un giorno

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is time and conversation
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: È tempo e conversazione

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It pays really well
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Si paga davvero bene

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And we set boundaries before you accept any client so there is no risk
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E fissiamo dei confini prima che tu accetti qualsiasi cliente, così non c'è rischio

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And who knows, maybe you will find someone
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E chissà, magari troverai qualcuno

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: You took care of us for a long time, it is time for you to live your life too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti sei presa cura di noi per molto tempo, è ora che tu viva la tua vita

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I am too old for that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono troppo grande per questo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No you are not, you are beautiful, just give yourself a chance
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: No, non lo sei, sei bellissima, dai una possibilità a te stessa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will see
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Vedrò

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I still feel guilty
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma mi sento ancora in colpa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But i do not like the idea of being judged
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma non mi piace l'idea di essere giudicata

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: No one will judge you
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Nessuno ti giudicherà

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: And you will not be alone in this, I will check everything, check with the client and watch over you all day
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: E non sarai sola in questo, controllerò tutto, parlerò con il cliente e ti terrò d'occhio per tutto il giorno

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: For now I will verify the platform and the rules
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Per ora verificherò la piattaforma e le regole

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: If anything feels wrong we drop it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Se qualcosa non va, lasciamo perdere

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I can try it and if I do not like it I will stop
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Posso provarci e se non mi piace, smetto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Of course, you only have a one week obligation anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Certo, hai solo un impegno di una settimana comunque

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I stayed home like you said but I feel like I let my colleagues down
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sono rimasta a casa come hai detto, ma mi sento di aver deluso i miei colleghi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Alright, when do I start?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene, quando inizio?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I will text you once I know more
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti scriverò appena so di più

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Okay
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Va bene.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Thank you for taking care of me and finding me work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Grazie per prenderti cura di me e per trovarmi lavoro

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: It is normal, go rest a little you deserve your day off
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: È normale, vai a riposarti un po', te lo meriti il tuo giorno libero

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Do not feel guilty, working there was not good for you anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Non sentirti in colpa, lavorare lì non era comunque buono per te

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: I told you I would handle it for the work, and for your coworkers it is fine, you can still see them outside work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ti ho detto che me ne sarei occupata per il lavoro, e per i tuoi colleghi va bene, puoi comunque vederli fuori dal lavoro

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: Yes that is true
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Sì, è vero

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.source: But I do not want to be useless
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_02_EVELYN_MORNING_NT.translation: Ma non voglio essere inutile

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: It was a lot to hear
But I'm glad you told me instead of hiding it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ma sono contento che me l'hai detto invece di nasconderlo.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I didn't want to lie to you
I just think I need a little time now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Penso solo che abbia bisogno di un po' di tempo adesso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: To understand where I stand in all this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Per capire dove mi trovo in tutto questo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And where I stand with us 😕
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: E dove mi trovo con noi 😕

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Not because I think you love me less
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Non perché pensi che mi ami di meno

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: More because I didn't expect things to feel like that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Più perché non mi aspettavo che le cose si sentissero in quel modo.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And you don't have to force anything for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: E non devi forzare nulla per me
Ecco perché non sto entrando in panico.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I just want to move carefully
Because this really matters to me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Perché questo è davvero importante per me
Anche tu sei importante per me

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Then give me a little time to figure out how I feel about all of this
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Allora dammi un po' di tempo per capire come mi sento riguardo a tutto questo.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Take all the time you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Prenditi tutto il tempo di cui hai bisogno
Avevo davvero bisogno di quel sonno

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: That helps more than you think 🥺
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Questo aiuta più di quanto pensi 🥺

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: I'm going to clean a little and work from home for a bit
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Vado a pulire un po' e a lavorare da casa per un po'

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: Still a little foggy but better 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: Ancora un po' nebbioso ma meglio 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.source: And... thank you for being honest with me last night
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_03_LENA_LATE_MORNING.translation: E... grazie per essere stato onesto con me ieri sera.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I walked past a clothing store after class
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono passata davanti a un negozio di abbigliamento dopo lezione

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: And they had a huge sale 😭
Do you know how hard it was not to go inside?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sai quanto è stato difficile non entrare?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You say that like it's a real struggle
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo dici come se fosse una vera lotta

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Your shopping addiction needs professional treatment
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: La tua dipendenza dallo shopping ha bisogno di un trattamento professionale

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: At least my clothes look good
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Almeno i miei vestiti sono carini

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You were definitely planning to buy it
Trying to enjoy a peaceful afternoon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sto cercando di godermi un pomeriggio tranquillo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I should have an answer sometime today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Dovrei avere una risposta entro oggi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: I'll let you know as soon as I hear back
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti farò sapere appena ho notizie

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: Please don't hire some terrifying genius
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Per favore, non assumere qualche genio spaventoso

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.source: You need to get better soon
I miss making fun of the way you walk 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_04_HAILEY_AFTERNOON_.translation: Mi manca prenderti in giro per il modo in cui cammini 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Hello
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ciao

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That sounds like exactly what she needs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Sembra proprio quello di cui ha bisogno

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I usually start by identifying the subjects causing the most trouble
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Di solito inizio identificando le materie che creano più problemi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Then we create a study plan and work through it step by step
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Poi creiamo un piano di studio e lo seguiamo passo dopo passo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She's capable of doing well, but...
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: È capace di farcela, ma...

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: She just struggles to stay motivated sometimes
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: A volte fa fatica a rimanere motivata

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: That's very common
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: È molto comune

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Most students are more capable than they think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: La maggior parte degli studenti è più capace di quanto pensi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: They just need structure and consistency
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Hanno solo bisogno di struttura e costanza

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: When would you be available?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Quando sei disponibile?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Tomorrow afternoon would work for me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Domani pomeriggio va bene per me

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: It's Ethan
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Sono Ethan

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I can come by, meet her and evaluate where she currently stands
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Posso passare, incontrarla e valutare a che punto è

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Perfetto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'll let her know
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Le farò sapere

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Fantastico

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Feel free to message me if you have any questions before then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Scrivimi pure se hai domande prima di allora

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I received your tutoring request earlier today
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Ho ricevuto la tua richiesta di tutoraggio oggi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Thanks for reaching out
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Grazie per avermi contattato

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I'm looking for someone who can help {{name:hailey}} prepare for her exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Sto cercando qualcuno che possa aiutare {{name:hailey}} a prepararsi per gli esami

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: What students do you usually work with?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Con quali studenti lavori di solito?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I mainly work with high school and college students
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Lavoro principalmente con studenti delle superiori e universitari

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: Perfect
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Perfetto

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: And my goal isn't just to explain lessons
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: E il mio obiettivo non è solo spiegare le lezioni

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..source: I also help students build study habits and stay focused
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_05_TUTOR_SEARCH_NTS..translation: Aiuto anche gli studenti a costruire buone abitudini di studio e a rimanere concentrati

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: The guy clearly knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Il tipo sa chiaramente quello che fa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He does have a crazy body
Well that actually makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Beh, questo mi fa sentire un po' meglio

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: At least I already know him
And I know he isn't some random creep you found online
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: E so che non è qualche creep random che hai trovato online

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You really have no faith in me
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Non hai davvero fiducia in me

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: You wanted to keep his name a surprise
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Volevi tenere il suo nome una sorpresa

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Still more grateful than you deserve 🙂
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ancora più grata di quanto tu meriti 🙂

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell {{name:aiden}} I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Dì a {{name:aiden}} che sono pronta quando lo è lui

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: He's a young coach who just moved to town
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: È un giovane allenatore che si è appena trasferito in città
Ha più o meno la tua età

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Has he actually coached anyone before?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Ha mai allenato qualcuno prima d'ora?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: And where did you even find him?
He used to be one of {{name:aiden}}'s coaches
Okay that sounds a lot less suspicious
If he coached {{name:aiden}}, he probably knows what he's doing
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Se ha allenato {{name:aiden}}, probabilmente sa il fatto suo.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: I'm curious to see what he can do
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Sono curiosa di vedere cosa può fare.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.source: Tell that Chris I'm ready whenever he is
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_06_MASON_AFTERNOON_N.translation: Dì a Chris che sono pronta quando lo è lui.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Come va la tua gamba oggi?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Mostly is not a medical term
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Per lo più non è un termine medico.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Especially when you pretend you're fine
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Soprattutto quando fai finta di stare bene

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: You don't trust me at all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Non ti fidi di me affatto.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I just don't trust your survival instincts
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Non mi fido semplicemente dei tuoi istinti di sopravvivenza.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Please take it easy until I finish
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Per favore, prendila con calma finché non ho finito.
Va bene, la pausa è quasi finita

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I need to go act useful again
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Devo andare a fare di nuovo qualcosa di utile.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'll text you after my shift 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Ti scriverò dopo il mio turno 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Not terrible, just enough to make time move slowly
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Non è terribile, giusto abbastanza per far muovere il tempo lentamente.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: I'm basically living my dream right now
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.translation: Sto praticamente vivendo il mio sogno in questo momento.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_07_LENA_AFTERNOON_NT.source: Thank you, I practiced that lie

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Hey, are you really sure I'll be able to do that job?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ehi, sei davvero sicura che potrò fare quel lavoro?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I can't help but worry about it a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma non posso fare a meno di preoccuparmi un po'

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's perfectly normal, it's a big change after all
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: È perfettamente normale, dopo tutto è un grande cambiamento

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: But I am confident that you will do great
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ma sono fiduciosa che farai benissimo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Right now I am mostly making sure everything is legitimate
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: In questo momento sto solo assicurandomi che tutto sia legittimo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I want to verify all the details before I tell you to start
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Voglio verificare tutti i dettagli prima di dirti di iniziare

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That makes me feel a little better
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Questo mi fa sentire un po' meglio

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Normally I should have all the answers tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Normalmente dovrei avere tutte le risposte domani

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: If everything checks out, you will be able to begin after that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Se tutto va bene, potrai iniziare dopo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Already tomorrow?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Già domani?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is sooner than I expected
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: È prima di quanto mi aspettassi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Of course
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Certo

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will explain everything in more detail tomorrow
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ti spiegherò tutto in modo più dettagliato domani

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Now you have my attention
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Ora hai la mia attenzione

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I am curious to know what you found
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sono curiosa di sapere cosa hai trovato

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And maybe a little nervous too
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: E forse un po' nervosa anche

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That is perfectly normal
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: È perfettamente normale

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: We will take it one step at a time
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Affronteremo tutto un passo alla volta

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Alright
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Va bene

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Then I will wait for your message later 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Allora aspetterò il tuo messaggio più tardi 😊

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Why are you asking?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perché lo chiedi?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: Because I keep thinking about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Perché continuo a pensarci

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I'm not that smart and don't have much experience in those things
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non sono così intelligente e non ho molta esperienza in queste cose

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And I am wondering if I will actually be good enough
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: E mi chiedo se sarò davvero all'altezza

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: That's not true, you are more capable than you think
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Non è vero, sei più capace di quanto pensi

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: And even if you don't have experience, you can learn
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: E anche se non hai esperienza, puoi imparare

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I will be there to help you with everything you need
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Sarò lì per aiutarti con tutto ciò di cui hai bisogno

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.source: I know, and I really appreciate that
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_08_EVELYN_AFTERNOON_.translation: Lo so, e te ne sono davvero grata

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ehi 😊 la cena è quasi pronta

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I figured this might motivate you 😌
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho pensato che questo potesse motivarti 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I made steak and french fries
I know how much you love that
Now I'm even more motivated to come downstairs
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ora sono ancora più motivata a scendere

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I'll see you in a minute then
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Ci vediamo tra un minuto allora

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: Do you want to come downstairs?
Or should I bring your plate upstairs?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: O dovrei portarti il piatto su?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.source: I should force myself to move a little
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_09_EVELYN_EVENING_NT.translation: Dovrei costringermi a muovermi un po'

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Hey, just imagine how unfair this is going to be
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Ehi, immagina quanto sarà ingiusto tutto questo.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Careful or I'll cancel your coach
Thanks for taking the time to look for someone and finding me a coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Grazie per aver trovato qualcuno e per avermi trovato un allenatore.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: That's one less thing I have to deal with
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: È una cosa in meno di cui preoccuparmi.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: You dealing with anything by yourself would have been a miracle anyway
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Affrontare qualcosa da solo sarebbe stato un miracolo comunque.
Sono contenta di aver potuto aiutare.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: I'm about to get a dream body while you're stuck in bed with your broken body
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Sto per avere un corpo da sogno mentre tu sei bloccato a letto con il tuo corpo rotto.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: A dream body won't fix your face
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Un corpo da sogno non sistemerà la tua faccia.
Ma la faccia è ancora brutta, però.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.source: Jealousy doesn't look good on you
Neither will all that muscle when you still lose to me at everything
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_10_MASON_EVENING_NTS.translation: Neanche tutti quei muscoli se continui a perdere contro di me in tutto.
Continua a dirlo a te stesso, zoppo.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I was hoping you'd forget about it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Speravo che te ne saresti dimenticata

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He wants to see where you're at and what needs work
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Vuole vedere a che punto sei e cosa c'è da migliorare

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: He's going to discover how cooked you are 😔
You're enjoying this way too much
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ti stai divertendo un po' troppo
Va bene, domani ripetizioni, stasera festa 😌

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'll try to make a good first impression tomorrow 😊
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Cercherò di fare una buona prima impressione domani 😊

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I'm heading to the party with the girls now. Goodnight, coach
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Sto andando alla festa con le ragazze. Buonanotte, coach

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: Have fun at the party, and get home safe
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Divertiti alla festa e torna a casa sana e salva

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: I talked to him this afternoon
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Ho parlato con lui questo pomeriggio

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: And he knows how to work with students preparing for exams
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: E sa come lavorare con gli studenti che si preparano per gli esami

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.source: So you're saying my academic rescue mission is officially happening 😭
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_11_HAILEY_EVENING_NT.translation: Quindi stai dicendo che la mia missione di salvataggio accademico sta per iniziare ufficialmente 😭

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: But I feel like I'm getting better at it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Ma sento che sto migliorando in questo.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: It makes it a little more worth it
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Lo rende un po' più conveniente.

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: Can I see you before you go to bed?
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Posso vederti prima che tu vada a letto?

story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.source: I'm going to shower and go to bed
story/DAY9/nts/DAY9_12_LENA_NIGHT_NTS.js.translation: Vado a fare una doccia e poi a letto.

ui.auto.all_characters_depicted_are_fict.source: All characters depicted are fictional creations and are at least 18 years old within the game's story. Any resemblance to real individuals is purely coincidental.
ui.auto.all_characters_depicted_are_fict.translation: Tutti i personaggi rappresentati sono creazioni fittizie e hanno almeno 18 anni nella storia del gioco. Qualsiasi somiglianza con persone reali è puramente casuale.

ui.auto.all_photos_tracks_the_photo_disc.source: All Photos tracks the photo discovery pool in the live game content.
